5003: अविक्लमः Absence of fatigue, vigour, freshness.
5004: अविक्षत a. Unimpaired, uninjured; unhurt, whole, entire; विक्रेतुः प्रतिदेयं तत्तस्मिन्नेवाह्न्यविक्षतम् Smṛti.
5006: अविक्षिप a. [P. VI. 2. 157-8] Unable to distribute or dispense (आक्रोशार्थे), (विक्षेप्तुं न शक्तः or यो न विक्षिपति); not distributing or badly distributing.
5007: अविक्षिप्त a. 1 Not thrown away. --2 Attentive, composed.
5008: अविगत a. Not gone off, retained, present.
5009: अविगम a. Unseparated, unremoved. --मः Non-separation, association, inherence, presence, existence.
5010: अविग्नः N. of a fruit-tree( करमर्दक).
5011: अविग्रह a. [नास्ति विग्रहो यस्य] 1 Bodiless, incorporeal; epithet of the Supreme Being (who has no body). --2 Not known. --हः (In gram.) A compound the sense of which cannot be expressed by its constituent parts separately (नित्यसमास).
5012: अविघात a. Unimpeded, unobstructed; °गति a. unobstructed in one's course.
5013: अविघ्न a. Unobstructed, free from impediments; °क्रियोपलंभाय Ś. 1. --घ्नं Freedom from obstacle or impediment, welfare (this word is usually neuter, though विघ्न is m.); साधयाम्यहमविघ्नमस्तु ते R. 11. 91; अविघ्नमस्तु ते स्थेयाः पितेव धुरि पुत्रिणां 1. 91; अविघ्नमस्तु सावित्र्याः प्रदाने दुहितुस्तव Mb.
5014: अविचाचल a. Ved. Not staggering or fluctuating, standing firmly.
5015: अविचार a. 1 Void of judgment, undiscriminating, ill-judging, unwise. --2 Unhesitating, prompt. --3 Having spies. --रः 1 Absence of judgment, indiscretion, error, folly. --2 Promptitude. --3 A country fit for the grazing of sheep.
5016: अविचारणीय a. Not to be called in question; आज्ञा गुरूणां ह्यविचारणीया R. 14. 46.
5017: अविचारित a. 1 Ill-judged, not well thought out or considered. --2 Determined, certain. --Comp. --निर्णयः a prejudice, prejudiced opinion.
5018: अविचारिन् a. 1 Unthinking, inconsiderate, indiscreet. --2 Prompt.
5020: अविचृत्य a. Ved. Not to be loosened.
5021: अविच्छिन्न a. 1 Not separated, undivided. --2 Continuous, uninterrupted; °संताना संततिः K. 65, R. 17. 11.
5022: अविच्छेद a. 1 Uninterrupted. --2 Undivided, entire, whole. --दः 1 Entirety, wholeness. --2 Connection, continuity; Ki. 14. 32.
5023: अविच्युत a. 1 Not deviated from, observed or followed strictly. --2 Eternal, permanent.
5024: अविजात a. Ved. Not having brought forth, having no offspring.
5025: अविजातीय a. Of the same kind.
5026: अविज्ञ a. 1 Ignorant, untaught. --2 Clumsy, stupid, awkward; °ता ignorance, folly.
5027: अविज्ञात a. 1 Unknown. --2 Unintelligible, doubtful, indistinct. --Comp. --गद a. Ved. speaking in an unintelligible way.
5028: अविज्ञातृ a. 1 Not knowing. --m. (ता) The Supreme Being (परमेश्वर). --2 N. of Viṣṇu; अविज्ञाता सहस्रांशुः V. Sah.
5029: अविज्ञेय a. Undistinguishable, not to be recognized or known, unknowable. --यः The Supreme God.
5030: अविडीनं A direct flight of birds (पाक्षिणामाभिमुख्याभिगमनं).
5031: अवितथ a. 1 Not false, true; तदवितथमवादीर्यन्ममत्वं प्रियेति Śi. 11. 33; अवितथा वितथा सखि मा गिरः 6. 18. --2 Realised, not fruitless; अवितथफलाः स्वप्नाः K. 65; कुरु गुरुवचनमवितथं K. 178; चकारावितथां भ्रातुः प्रतिज्ञां R. 15. 95; 5. 26. --थं Truth; अवितथमाह प्रियंवदा Ś. 3, P. is right, what P. says is right; Ve. 2. --थं ind. Not falsely, according to truth; Ms. 2. 144. --था N. of a metre.
5032: अवितारिन् a. Ved. 1 Not doing any harm, harmless (अनपायिन्). --2 Not departing, remaining.
5033: अवित्त a. 1 Not famous, unknown. --2 Poor.
5034: अवित्ति a. 1 Not obtaining or getting. --2 Unwise, foolish. --त्तिः f. 1 Not finding, getting, or possessing. --2 Want of wisdom. --3 Poverty.
5036: अविथुर a. Not separated, united (Ved. for अविधुर).
5037: अविथ्या [अवये हिता, अवि थ्यंन् P. V. 1. 8] N. of the plant अजथ्या.
5038: अविदग्ध a. 1 Unlearned, inexperienced, stupid. --2 Not well burnt, undigested.
5039: अविदाहिन् a. 1 Imperfectly digested, producing heart-burn. --2 Not burning or afflicting.
5040: अविदस्य a. Ved. Unceasing, inexhaustible, perennial, perpetual.
5042: अविदित a. Unknown; °गतयामा रात्रिः U. 1. 27 the watches of which stole away (glided imperceptibly away). --तः The Supreme God.
5043: अविदीधयु a. Ved. 1 Not delaying or hesitating. --2 Shining.
5044: अविदूर a. Not distant, near, contiguous. --रं Proximity, vicinity. --रं ind. Near to, not far from; so अविदूरेण, अविदूरात्, --दूरतः, --विदूरे.
5045: अविद्ध a. Unpierced. --Comp. --कर्णा, --र्णी [अविद्धः अछिद्रः पर्णरूपः कर्णोऽस्याः] N. of a plant (पाठा) Cissampelos Hexaudra. --दृश् a. all-seeing. --वर्चस् a. of unimpaired glory.
5046: अविद्य a. 1 Not educated, unlearned, foolish, unwise; अविद्यानां तु सर्वेषामीहातश्चेद्धनं भवेत् Ms. 9. 205. --2 Not pertaining to knowledge. --द्या 1 Ignorance, folly, want of learning. --2 Spiritual ignorance. --3 Illusion, illusion personified or Māyā (a term frequently occurring in Vedānta; by means of this illusion one perceives the universe, which does not really exist, as inherent in Brahma which alone really exists). The term appears also in the systems of Gautama, Patañjali, Kapila, where it has different bearings; (with Buddhists) ignorance together with non-existence.
5047: अविद्यामय a. Caused by ignorance or illusion.
5048: अविद्रिय a. Ved. 1 Without a rent or hole. --2 Impenetrable, solid.
5049: अविधवा Not a widow, a married woman whose husband is still living; भर्तुर्मित्रं प्रियमविधवे विद्धि मामंबुवाहं Me. 99.
5050: अविधा ind. An interjection meaning ‘help, help’ used in calling for help in danger.
5051: अविधान a. [न. ब.] Deviating from the fixed rule, irregular. --नं Absence of a definite rule; irregularity, deviation from rule.
5052: अविधि a. Not lawful, contrary to rule. --धिः Irregularity, absence of a rule or precept; °पूर्वक not according to rule.
5053: अविधेय a. Unmanageable, adverse; विधेरविधेयतां Mu. 4. 2; हर्षविषादयोरविधेयत्वं Dk. 161 not being influenced or swayed by &c.
5054: अविनः [अवति यज्ञं, अव्-इनच् Uṇ. 2. 46] 1 A sacrificer. --2 An officiating priest at a sacrifice.
5055: अविनय a. [न. ब.] Immodest, insolent, ill-behaved, ill-mannered. --यः 1 Want of good manners or modesty; बहवोऽविनयान्नष्टा राजानः सपरिच्छदाः Ms. 7. 40, 41. --2 Rude behaviour, rudeness, immodest or rude act; °बहुलतया चाभिनवयौवनस्य K. 143; अयमाचरत्यविनयं मुग्धासु तपस्विकन्यासु Ś. 1. 25; indecorum, impropriety of conduct. --3 Incivility, disrespect. --4 Offence, crime, fault. --5 Pride, arrogance, insolence; अविनयमपनय विष्णो Śaṅkara.
5056: अविनीत a. 1 Immodest, ill bred, unmannered. --2 Acting improperly, wicked, vile. --3 Insolent, rude. --4 Not tamed, ill-trained; Ms. 4. 67. --ता An unchaste woman.
5057: अविनश्वर a. Destructible. --रः The Supreme God.
5058: अविनाभावः 1 Non-separation. --2 Inherent or essential character, inseparable connection. --3 Connection (in general); अविनाभावोऽत्र संबंधमात्रं न तु नांतरीयकत्वं K. P. 2.
5060: अविंध्यः N. of a Rākṣasa, minister of Rāvaṇa. --ध्या N. of a river.
5061: अविपक्व a. Not ripe (fig. also); immature, undigested.; °बुद्धि inexperienced, of undeveloped understanding.
5062: अविपाक a. Suffering from indigestion. --कः The state of not being ripe, indigestion, a disease arising from indigestion.
5063: अविपद् f. Absence of misery, prosperity.
5064: अविपन्न a. 1 Uninjured, unhurt. --2 Not defiled or polluted, pure.
5065: अविप्र a. Ved. 1 Not (spiritually) excited, not inspired. --2 Not a worshipper or praiser. --प्रः One not a Brāhmaṇa.
5066: अविप्लुत a. Undeviating, steadily observing; unviolated.
5067: अविभक्त a. 1 Undivided, unpartitioned, joint, (as property of a family, or co-heirs); अविभक्ता विभक्ता वा सपिंडाः स्थावरे समाः. --2 Not broken, entire. --3 Not different. --4 Existing everywhere.
5068: अविभाग a. Unpartitioned, undivided. --गः 1 Not dividing. --2 Undivided inheritance.
5069: अविभाज्य a. Indivisible. --ज्यं 1 Indivisibility. --2 Not being liable to be partitioned; (said of certain articles which are not to be divided at the time of partition); e. g. वस्त्रं पात्रमलंकारं कृतान्नमुदकं स्त्रियः । योगक्षेमं प्रचारं च न विभाज्यं प्रचक्षते Ms. 9. 219. °ता indivisibility, unfitness for partition.
5072: अविमुक्त a. Unloosed, not quitted or let go. --क्तं 1 N. of a Tīrtha or sacred place near Benares, or Benares itself; न विमुक्तं शिवाभ्यां यदविमुक्तं ततो विदुः. --2 The space between the chin and the head. --Comp. --ईश्वरः a celebrated Śiva-linga at Benares.
5074: अविमोक्य a. Ved. Not to be loosened.
5075: अवियुक्त a. Undivided, conjoined, united; not separated, absent.
5076: अवियोग a. Not separated, united, connected. --गः 1 Non-separation, presence. --2 Conjunction, association. --Comp. --तृतीया N. of a certain festival or holiday. --व्रतं a vow to be observed by women on the third day of the first fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa.
5077: अविरत a. 1 Not desisting or ceasing from (with abl.); uninterrupted, continual, unbroken, perpetual; अविरतोत्कंठमुत्कंठितेन Me. 102; Prov. मंदोप्यविरतोद्योगः सदैव विजयी भवेत् ‘slow and steady wins the race’. --2 Abandoned. --तं ind. Eternally, continually; अविरतं परकार्यकृतां सतां Bv. 1. 113.
5078: अविरति a. Incessant, ceaseless. --तिः f. 1 Continuity, uninterruptedness. --2 Incontinence.
5079: अविराम a. Uninterrupted, continuous. --मः Uninterrupted succession, continuance. --मं ind. Uninterruptedly.
5080: अविरल a. 1 Thick, dense; °वारिधारा U. 6 sharp-driving shower; °अश्रुबिंदु; not thin, many; सादरमभिमुखदत्ताविरलपदः K. 95. --2 Contiguous, close. --3 Coarse, gross, substantial. --4 Uninterrupted, continuous. --लं ind. 1 Closely; अविरलमालिंगितुं पवनः Ś. 3. 7. --2 Uninterruptedly, incessantly, constantly; U. 3. 24. --Comp. --धारासारः an incessant down-pour of heavy rain.
5081: अविरलित a. Closely stuck, lying very close; °कपोलं U. 1. 27 cheek to cheek.
5082: अविराधयत् a. Ved. Not withdrawing oneself; not desisting.
5083: अविरुद्ध a. 1 Not opposed, compatible, consistent with. --2 Living together. --3 Unobstructed, unhindered, unimpeded. --4 Allowed; proper; यद्यविरुद्धं श्रोष्यामि V. 2.
5084: अविरोधः 1 Consistency, compatibility, congruity; सामान्यास्तु परार्थमुद्यमभृतः स्वार्थाविरोधेन ये Bh. 2. 74 consistently with their own interest; सर्वेषामविरोधेन ब्रह्मकर्म समारभे Pūjāmantra. --2 Absence of impediment. --3 Assent, concurrence.
5086: अविरेच्य a. Not to be purged.
5087: अविलक्ष्य a. 1 Having no aim or mark. --2 Guileless. --3 Irremediable.
5089: अविलंघनीय a. 1 Not to be transgressed. --2 Prescribed, fixed, settled.
5090: अविलंब a. Prompt, not delaying, quick. --बः Absence of delay, quickness, promptitude. --बं, अविलंबेन ind. Without delay, quickly.
5091: अविलंबित a. Without delay, quick, expeditious, prompt. --तं ind. Quickly, without delay.
5093: अविलास a. Free from whims, faithful, constant. --सः Absence of pastime or whim.
5094: अविलिख a. 1 Not writing or painting, or unable to do so; ( P. VI. 2. 157-8). --2 Writing badly. --3 Different from one who writes.
5095: अविवक्षित a. 1 Not intended or aimed at; भ्रातरः इत्यत्र एकशेषग्रह मविवक्षितं. --2 Not to be said or spoken.
5097: अविवादिन् a. Not contending, quiet, peaceable.
5098: अविवाहिन् a. 1 Not marrying, remaining single or celibate. --2 Not relating to marriage. --3 Interdicted as to marriage.
5099: अविविक्त a. 1 Uninvestigated, not properly thought out. --2 Indiscriminate, confounded. --3 Public. --4 Making no difference; °दृश् viewing all as one with God.
5100: अविवेक a. Wanting in judgment or discrimination, thoughtless. --कः 1 Want of discrimination or judgment, absence of prudence, imprudence; अविवेकः परमापदां पदं Ki. 2. 30. --2 Hastiness, rashness, recklessness. --3 Ignorance ( अन्योन्यतादात्म्यरूपमिथ्याज्ञानं). --Comp. --कृत a. done rashly.
5101: अविवेकिन् a. 1 Undiscriminating, inconsiderate, thoughtless. --2 Superficial, short-sighted, ignorant.
5102: अविवेन a. Ved. Not disaffected. --नं ind. Not disaffectedly, favourably.
5103: अविशंक a. Having no fears or doubt, fearless. --कां Absence of doubt or fear, confidence, certainty. --कं, --अविशंकेन ind. Without doubt, hesitation.
5104: अविशंकित a. 1 Unapprehensive, fearless. --2 Without doubt, confiding; गृध्रवाक्यात्कथं मूढास्त्यजध्वमविशंकिताः K. P.
5105: अविशस्तृ m. An unskilful cutter up or killer (of animals at a sacrifice).
5107: अविशेष a. Without any difference, alike, similar, uniform. --षः, --षं 1 Absence of difference, uniformity, similarity. --2 Identity, sameness. --3 The subtle elements (in Sān. phil.). --Comp. --ज्ञ a. not knowing the difference (in things), undiscriminating.
5108: अविश्रांत a. 1 Untiring, incessant, ceaseless; Ś. 6. --2 Unhurt. --तं ind. Incessantly, continuously.
5109: अविश्वास a. Not inspiring confidence, mistrusted. --सः Mistrust, suspicion. --सा A cow calving after long intervals.
5110: अविश्वस्त a. Not trusted, suspected; न विश्वसेदविश्वस्ते H. 1.
5112: अविष a. 1 Not poisonous. --2 Anti-venomous, antidote. --3 Protecting. --षः [अव्-टिषच् Uṇ. 1. 45] 1 An ocean. --2 A king. --3 Sky. --षा N. of a plant (निर्विषातृण). --षी 1 A river. --2 The earth. --3 Heaven.
5113: अविषय a. 1 Unperceived, invisible, beyond the reach of the senses. --2 Insensible. --3 Disregarding objects of sense; °मनसां यतीनां M. 1. 1. --यः 1 Absence, disappearance; रवेरविषये किं न प्रदीपस्य प्रकाशनं H. 2. 79. --2 Not an object of (anything), not within the reach of, beyond, transcending; न कश्चिद्धीमतामविषयो नाम Ś. 4; सकलवचनानामविषयः Māl. 1. 30 beyond the reach (power) of words; सौमित्रेरपि पत्रिणामविषये तत्र प्रिये क्वासि भोः U. 3. 45. --3 Disregard of the objects of sense.
5114: अविषयीकरणं Not making anything an object of.
5115: अविष्ठ Ved. Gladly accepting, protecting very carefully or attentively; Rv. 7. 28. 5.
5116: अविष्या [अव् गतौ इसुन् अविर्गतिमिच्छति क्यच् भावे अ Tv.] 1 Wish to go (गमनेच्छा); Rv. 2. 38. 3. --2 Wish.
5117: अविष्यु a. Ved. 1 Attacking. --2 Desirous, wishing. --3 Violent, vehement. --4 Wishing to protect.
5118: अविस् n. [अव्-भावे इसुन्] 1 Protection. --2 Going. --m. An extender, enlarger.
5119: अविसंवादिन् a. Unfailing, not false; Ki. 13. 15; लक्षणान्येव तवाविसंवादीनि Dk. 67 entirely agreeing.
5120: अविसर्गिन् a. Not quitting, retaining, adhering to. --m. (--गी) An unintermittent fever.
5121: अविस्तर a. Of small extent or length, concise.
5122: अविस्तारः Absence of amplification or diffuseness.
5123: अविस्तीर्ण a. Not extended or amplified, curtailed, concise.
5125: अविस्पष्ट a. Not clear or plain, indistinct, obscure. --ष्टं An indistinct speech.
5126: अविहर्यत a. Not desired ( अनभिलषित); येनाविहर्यतक्रतोः Rv. 1. 63. 2 doer of undesired acts; whose will cannot be averted.
5127: अविह्रुत a. Ved. 1 Not to be killed, unassailable. --2 Unbent, unbroken. --3 Not curved.
5128: अविह्वरत् a. Ved. 1 Not slipping, not falling. --2 Undeviating.
5129: अवी [अवत्यात्मानं लज्जया अव्-ई Uṇ. 3. 158] A woman in her courses.
5130: अवीचि a. Waveless. --चिः N. of a particular hell; °मयः a place of punishment for liars (यत्र जलमिव स्थलमश्मपृष्ठमवभासते Bhāg.)
5131: अवीज --जक(अबीज) 1 Seedless; Ms. 10. 71. --2 Impotent; Ms. 9. 79. --3 Having no prime cause. --जः Restraint, controlling the mental passions. --जा Vine plant. --जं 1 Bad seed, bad grain; °विक्रयिन् Ms. 9. 291. --2 Absence of seed. --Comp. --हन् a. Ved. not pernicious to men.
5132: अवीतं A variety of अनुमान or inference; (व्यतिरेकमुखेन प्रवर्तमानं निषेधकमवीतं; यथा पृथिवी पृथिवीतरभिन्ना गंधवत्त्वात् Tv.).
5133: अवीर a. 1 Unmanly, effeminate, cowardly. --2 Having no son (as a woman). --3 Helpless. --4 Destitute of men. --रा A woman who has neither sons nor husband; अजातपुत्रा विधवा साऽवीरा परिकीर्तिता; (opp. वीरा which is thus defined; पतिपुत्रवती नारी वीरा प्रोक्ता मनीषिभिः); अनर्चितं वृथा मांसमवीरांयाश्च योषितः Ms. 4. 213; Y. 1. 163.
5135: अवृक a. 1 Free from danger, safe. --2 Not hurting, inoffensive, true. --3 Free from one who obscures. --कं 1 Safety, peace, security. --2 Quiet, repose.
5136: अवृजिन a. Ved. Straightforward, sincere, not deserting (friends); an epithet of the Ādityas; Rv. 2. 27. 2.
5137: अवृत a. 1 Unchecked, unimpeded. --2 Unselected. --3 Uncovered, unprotected. --4 Unsubdued.
5138: अवृत्ति a. [न. ब.] 1 Not existing, not present, not being in. --2 Having no livelihood. --त्तिः f. 1 Absence of subsistence or means of livelihood, inadequate support; अवृत्तिकर्षिता हि स्त्री प्रदुष्येत् स्थितिमत्यपि Ms. 9. 74; 10. 101; आददीताममेवास्मादवृत्तावेकरात्रिकं 4. 223. --2 Absence of wages; °त्वं non-existence.
5139: अवृथा ind. Not in vain, successfully. --Comp. --अर्थ a. successful, gaining one's desired object.
5140: अवृद्धिक a. Not augmentative, not bearing interest (as capital). --कं Original capital, principal.
5141: अवृध a. Ved. 1 Not increasing. --2 Not promoting, not honouring.
5142: अवृष्टि a. Not pouring down rain (as a cloud). --ष्टिः Want of rain, drought; famine.
5143: अवे {c2c} P. [अव इ] 1 (a) To know, understand, learn, perceive, be aware of; अवैमि ते तस्यां सोदर्यस्नेहं Ś. 4; अवैमि चैनामनघेति R. 14. 40; द्विषदभियोग इत्यवैति Mu. 1. 7.; अवैमि ते सारं Ku. 3. 13; R. 2. 35. (b) To know, look upon or consider, regard, तदवैमि कैतवं Ku. 4. 9; Ś. 5. 11; Bk. 7. 33; किं मां सुतक्षयकरं सुत इत्यवैषि Ve. 5. 2. --2 To go or move away. --3 To go to, approach (with acc.). --4 To rush upon, come down upon (Ved.) --Freq. or Pass. (अवेयते) To beg pardon for, conciliate.
5144: अवेत p. p. 1 Elapsed, past. --2 Obtained, attained. --3 Joined or united with.
5145: अवेक्ष् {c1c} A. [अव-ईक्ष्] 1 To look at, perceive, observe, behold. --2 To aim at, have in view; योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेहं Bg. 1. 23; take into account or consideration, have regard to; अवेक्ष्य धातोर्गमनार्थमर्थविद् R. 3. 21; किमपि निमित्तमवेक्ष्य V. 5; त्रिदिवोत्सुकयाप्यवेक्ष्य मां R. 8. 60 out of regard for me; K. 329; oft. with न meaning ‘not to mind or heed,’ ‘disregard’; R. 11. 69; न हि कमलिनीं दृष्ट्वा ग्राहमवेक्षते मतंगजः M. 3 (it may also mean ‘expect’ here); निद्रावशेन भवता ह्यनवेक्ष्यमाणा R. 5. 67. --3 To look to or after, attend to; अवेक्षमाणं महतीं मुहुर्मुहुः Śi. 1. 10. --4 To take care of, guard, watch over, protect; वसुधेयमवेक्ष्यतां त्वया R. 8. 83; श्लाघ्यां दुहितरमवेक्षस्व जानकीं U. 1, 7. --5 To think, consider; यदवोचदवेक्ष्य मानिनी Ki. 2. 3. --6 To look into or examine, inspect; स कदाचिदवेक्षितप्रजः R. 8. 32; प्रकृतीरवेक्षितुं 18 inquire into; Ś. 6. --7 To expect, hope for.
5146: अवेक्षक a. 1 Showing, showing all round. --2 Inspecting, supervising; a superintendent.
5147: अवेक्षणं 1 Looking towards or at, seeing. --2 Guarding, watching over, protection, taking care of, attending to, supervision, inspection; वर्णाश्रमावेक्षणजागरूकः R. 14. 85; हस्त्यश्वावेक्षणेऽनाभियुक्तः Mu. 3. --3 Attention, care, observation. --4 Regarding, considering; see अनवेक्षणं.
5148: अवेक्षणीय pot. p. To be looked to or respected, to be looked upon or considered; तपस्विसामान्यमवेक्षणीया R. 14. 67.
5149: अवेक्षा 1 Seeing, looking at. --2 Attention, care, regard; लब्धं रक्षेदवेक्षया Ms. 7. 101; अत्रास्त्यवेक्षा त्वयि मे Rām. --3 Agreement, engagement.
5150: अवेक्षितृ a. Looking at; thinking of, regarding &c.
5151: अवेक्षिन् a. Seeing, observing; धर्मावेक्षिता Ś. 5. regard for justice or righteousness.
5152: अवेणि a. 1 Not braided. --2 Having no braid of hair. --3 Not flowing together or commingled (as the waters of rivers).
5153: अवेदयान a. Not knowing, not ascertaining.
5155: अवेद्य a. 1 Unknowable, secret. --2 Unattainable. --द्यः A calf. --द्या (A woman) not to be married; Ms. 10. 24.
5157: अवेल a. 1 Having no boundary or limit, unlimited. --2 Having no time, untimely. --लः Concealment of knowledge. --ला 1 Unfavourable time. --2 Chewed betel (supposed to be = अव+इला).
5158: अवेष्टिः Ved. Expiation(of sins) by sacrifices.
5159: अवैध a. (धी f.) 1 Irregular, not conformable to law or rule; अवैधं पंचमं कुर्वन् राज्ञो दंडेन शुध्यति. --2 Not sanctioned by the Śāstras.
5162: अवोक्षणं [अव-उक्ष्-भावे ल्युट्] Ved. Sprinkling with the hand slightly bent; उत्तानेनैव हस्तेन प्रोक्षणं परिकीर्तितं । न्यंचताभ्युक्षणं प्रोक्तं तिरश्चावोक्षणं स्मृतं ॥
5163: अवोद a. [अव-उंद्-भावे घञ् निपातः नलोपः P. VI. 4. 29] Wet, moist. --दः Sprinkling, moistening.
5164: अवोदेव a. [देवानामवस्तात् अव्ययी°] Bringing down the gods; below (the region of the) gods.
5166: अव्य a. [अवि भवार्थे यत्] Coming or belonging to a sheep.
5167: अव्यक्त a. 1 Indistinct, not manifest or apparent, inarticulate; °वर्ण indistinct accents Ś. 7. 17; फलमव्यक्तमब्रवीत्. --2 Invisible, imperceptible. --3 Undetermined; अव्यक्तोयमचिंत्योयं Bg. 2. 25; 8. 20. --4 Undeveloped, uncreated. --5 (In alg.) Unknown (as a quantity or number). --क्तः 1 N. of Viṣṇu. --2 N. of Śiva. --3 Cupid. --4 Primary matter which has not yet entered into real existence. --5 A fool. --क्तं (In Vedānta phil.) 1 The Supreme Being or universal Spirit, Brahma. --2 Spiritual ignorance. --3 The subtle body. --4 The state of sleep (सुषुप्त्यवस्था). --5 (In Sān. phil.) The primary germ of nature (सर्वकारण), the primordial element or productive principle from which all the phenomena of the material world are developed; बुद्धेरिवाव्यक्तमुदाहरंति R. 13. 60; महतः परमव्यक्तमव्यक्तात्पुरुषः परः Kaṭh., Sāṅ. K. 2, 10, 14, 16, 58. --6 The soul. --7 Nature. --क्तं ind. Imperceptibly, indistinctly, inarticulately. --Comp. --अनुकरणं imitating inarticulate or unmeaning sounds; P. V. 4. 57; VI. 1. 98. --आदि a. whose beginning is inscrutable. --क्रिया {1} an algebraic calculation. {2} any act of an indistinct character. --पद a. inarticulate. --मूर्ति a. having an incomprehensible form. --मूलप्रभवः the tree of mundane existence (in Sān. phil.). --राग a. darkred, ruddy. (--गः) the colour of the dawn; अव्यक्तरागस्त्वरुणः Ak. --राशिः an unknown number or quantity (in algebra). --लक्षणः --व्यक्तः an epithet of Śiva (whose qualities are not perceptible). --लिंग a. whose signs are invisible (as a disease). (--गः) an ascetic (संन्यासी). (--गं) the great principle (महत्) (in Sān. phil.). --वर्त्मन्, --मार्ग a. whose ways are mysterious or inscrutable. --वाच् a. speaking indistinctly. --साम्यं an equation of unknown quantities.
5168: अव्यग्र a. 1 Not agitated or ruffled, steady, cool. --2 Not engaged or occupied (in business); अव्यग्रस्य पुनरस्य U. 2. --3 Indifferent, undisturbed. --4 Attentive, careful. --ग्रं ind. Quietly, at ease, coolly, leisurely; क्रव्यमव्यग्रमत्ति Māl. 5. 16.
5169: अव्यंग a. 1 Not mutilated or defective, well-made, sound, perfect; अव्यंगांगीं सौम्यनाम्नीं Ms. 3. 10. --2 Plain, not figurative (as a meaning). --गा 1 = अव्यंडा q. v. --2 A legume or pod of the awn of barley.
5171: अव्यंजन a. 1 Having no distinctive or characteristic marks or signs (as of the sex); °ना कन्या. --2 Having no good marks. --3 Indistinct. --4 Not figurative. --नः An animal without horns, though of an age to have them.
5172: अव्यंडा [न विगतमंडं बीजमस्याः] 1 N. of the plant Carpopogon Pruriens Roxb. --2 A legume or pod of the awn of barley.
5173: अव्यतिः f. Ved. 1 Satisfaction, satiating. --2 Desire.
5174: अव्यतिकीर्ण a. Unmixed, unblended, distinct; specific, separate.
5175: अव्यथ a. 1 Not giving or inflicting pain, merciful. --2 Free from pain. --थः [न व्यथते पद्भ्यां न संचलति व्यथ् भयचलनयोः अच्] A snake. --था 1 N. of two plants; Terminalia Citrina Roxb.; and Hibiscus Mutabilis. --2 Dry ginger. --3 (Ved.) Firmness, steadiness.
5177: अव्यथि a. Ved. [व्यथ्-इन्, न. त.] Not tremulous or tottering (in steps), steady, sure-footed, undaunted; epithet of the horses of the Aśvins. --थिः f. 1 A firm step. --2 Undauntedness.
5178: अव्यथिन् a. [cf. P. III. 2. 157] 1 Free from pain. --2 Free from fear, fearless; Śi. 15. 12. --3 Not giving pain.
5179: अव्यथिषः [न-व्यथ्-टिषच् Uṇ. 1. 49] 1 The Sun. --2 The ocean. --षी 1 The earth. --2 Midnight; night (अव्यथिषी धरारात्र्योः Ujjval.)
5180: अव्यथ्य a. Free from pain; not giving pain.
5182: अव्यनत् a. Ved. Not breathing, lifeless.
5183: अव्यपेक्षा Carelessness; °च्यूतने M. 3. 20 inadvertently fallen down.
5184: अव्यभि(भी)चारः 1 Non-separation; अन्योन्यस्याव्यभीचारो भवेदामरणांतिकः Ms. 9. 101. --2 Constancy, steadiness, fidelity.
5185: अव्यभिचारिन् a. 1 Not opposed or adverse, favourable; भवंत्यव्यभिचारिण्यो भर्तुरिष्टे पतिव्रताः Ku. 6. 86. --2 Not subject to exceptions, true in all cases, without any instance to the contrary; यदुच्यते पार्वति पापवृत्तये न रूपमित्यव्यभिचारि तद्वचः Ku. 5. 36; रंध्रोपनिपातिनोऽनर्था इति यदुच्यते तदव्यभिचारि वचः Ś. 6; इंद्रियार्थसंनिकर्षज्ञानमव्यपदेश्यमव्याभिचारि Gaut. S. --3 Virtuous, moral, chaste. --4 Steady, permanent, faithful (as devotion).
5186: अव्यय a. [नास्ति व्ययो यस्य] 1 (a) Not liable to change, imperishable, undecaying, immutable; वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययं Bg. 2. 21; विनाशमव्ययस्यास्य न कश्चित्कर्तुमर्हति 17, 4. 1, 6, 13; 7. 24-5; 15. 5, 17; Ms. 1. 18, 19, 57; 2. 81; R. 8. 24. (b) Eternal, everlasting; अश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययं Bg. 15. 1; अकीर्तिं कथयिष्यंति तेऽव्ययां 2. 34. --2 Unexpended, unwasted. --3 Economical. --4 Giving imperishable fruit. --यः 1 N. of Viṣṇu. --2 N of Śiva. --यं 1 (In the Vedānta) A member or corporeal part of an organized body. --2 Brahma. --3 (In gram.) An indeclinable particle &c.; सदृशं त्रिषु लिंगेषु सर्वासु च विभक्तिषु । वचनेषु च सर्वेषु यन्न व्येति तदव्ययम् ॥. --Comp. --आत्मन् of an imperishable or eternal nature. (--त्मा) the soul or spirit. --वर्गः the class of indeclinable words.
5188: अव्ययीभावः [अनव्ययमव्ययं भवत्यनेन; अव्यय-च्वि-भू करणे घञ्] 1 N. of one of the four principal kinds of compounds in Sanskrit, an adverbial or indeclinable compound (formed of an indeclinable, i. e. a preposition or an adverb, and a noun); अधिहरि, सतृणं &c. --2 Absence of expenditure (owing to poverty); द्वंद्वो द्विगुरपि चाहं मद्गेहे नित्यमव्ययीभावः । तत्पुरुष कर्मधारय येनाहं स्यां बहुव्रीहिः ॥ Udb. (which, by the bye, gives the names of compounds in Sanskrit). --3 Unchangeable state, imperishableness.
5189: अव्यर्थ a. 1 Not useless or fruitless, fruitful, profitable. --2 Effectual, successful.
5190: अव्यलीक a. 1 Not false, true. --2 Agreeable, having no disagreeable feelings (प्रिय); इत्थं गिरः प्रियततमा इव सोऽव्यलीकाः शुश्राव सूततंनयश्च तदा व्यलीकाः Śi. 5. 1.
5191: अव्यवधान a. 1 Close, immediate, without any intervening object, direct. --2 Not screened or concealed, open. --3 Not covered, bare (as ground). --4 Careless, inattentive. --नं Carelessness; °ता, °त्वं contiguity; carelessness.
5193: अव्यवस्थ a. 1 Not fixed, moving, unstable; स्थलारविंदश्रियमव्यवस्थां Ku. 1. 33. --2 Unlimited. --3 Unsettled, indiscriminate; भंगं जयं चापतुरव्यवस्थं R. 7. 54; disorderly, irregular. --स्था 1 Irregularity, deviation from established rule; किमव्यवस्थां चलितोऽपि केशवः Śi. 12. 36. --2 An incorrect opinion given on a point of religious or civil law.
5194: अव्यवस्थित a. 1 Not conformable to law or practice, unacquainted with the law or custom. --2 Ill-regulated, fickle, unstable; अव्यवस्थितचित्तस्य प्रसादोपि भयंकरः Nīti. 9 --3 Not in due order, unmethodical.
5195: अव्यवहार्य a. 1 Not entitled to eat, drink, or commune in general with people of the same caste, excommunicated. --2 Not to be made the subject of litigation.
5196: अव्यसन a. Free from evil practices, not vicious, moral. --नं Absence of vice, morality, virtue.
5197: अव्यस्त a. 1 Undecomposed, simple. --2 Not separated, collected.
5198: अव्याकृत a. 1 Not developed, not manifest; तद्धेदं तर्ह्यव्याकृतमासीत्, इदं नामरूपाभ्यामव्याकृतं. Ś. B. --2 Not decomposed, elementary. --तं (In Vedānta phil.) 1 An elementary substance from which all things were created (considered identical with Brahma.) --2 (In Sān. phil.) The prime germ of nature (प्रधान).
5199: अव्याख्या, --ख्यानं Want of clearness or explanation, obscurity.
5201: अव्याख्येय a. 1 Inexplicable, unintelligible. --2 Not requiring explanation, easy.
5202: अव्याज a. Free from guile or fraud. --जः, --जं 1 Absence of guile or fraud, honesty. --2 Simplicity, artlessness; oft. in comp. with सुंदर, मनोहर &c. in the sense of ‘artlessly’, ‘naturally’; इदं किलाव्याजमनोहरं वपुः Ś. 1. 18; M. 2. 14; °रमणीयं प्रेम K. 175.
5203: अव्यापक a. 1 Not comprehensive. --2 Not spread over or pervading the whole; not an invariable concomitant, special, individual, peculiar; °ता, --°त्वं non-comprehensiveness, speciality, individuality.
5204: अव्यापिन् a. 1 Not comprehensive, not invariably concomitant, special, individual. --2 Partial, limited.
5205: अव्याप्त a. 1 Not pervaded, peculiar, special. --2 Limited.
5206: अव्याप्तिः f. 1 Inadequate extent or pervasion of a proposition. --2 Non-inclusion or exclusion of a part of the thing defined, one of the three faults of a definition; लक्ष्यैकदेशे लक्षणस्यावर्तनमव्याप्तिः; यथा शिखासूत्रवान् ब्राह्मणः इत्यस्य संन्यासिन्यव्याप्तिः, तस्य ब्राह्मणत्वेपि शिखासूत्रत्वाभावात्.
5207: अव्याप्य a. Not extending to the whole circumstances, not pervading the whole extent; वह्निर्धूमस्याव्याप्यः. --Comp. --वृत्तिः f. (In Vaiś. phil.) a category of limited application, partial inherence with regard to time or space, as pleasure, pain &c.; अव्याप्यवृत्तिः क्षणिको विशेषगुण इष्यते Bhāṣā P. 27.
5208: अव्यापार a. Having no work, unemployed. --रः 1 Cessation from work, state of being unemployed. --2 A business not practised or understood. --3 Not one's own business; अव्यापारेषु व्यापारं कृ to meddle with affairs not one's own (which do not concern one).
5209: अव्यायाम a. Having no exercise. --मः Non-exertion, absence of fatigue from exertion.
5210: अव्यायत a. Not occupied; not detached.
5211: अव्याहत a. Not broken or interrupted, unobstructed; obeyed; भर्तुरव्याहताज्ञा R. 19. 57. --तं A true or uncontradicted statement.
5212: अव्युत्पन्न a. 1 Not proficient, inexperienced, not practised, ignorant; अव्युत्पन्नो बालभावः K. 196. --2 Having no proper or regular derivation (as a word) (अवयवार्थशून्य), उणादयोऽव्युत्पन्नाः प्रातिपदिकं. --न्नः A person not versed in the grammar, idiom &c. of a language, a smattering or superficial linguist ( शब्दावयवार्थानभिज्ञोऽवैयाकरणः).
5213: अव्रण a. Without wounds or scars or rents, unhurt, sound. --णं One of the four diseases of the eye.
5214: अव्रत a. Not observing (the prescribed) religious rites or obligations; अव्रतानाममंत्राणां जातिमात्रोपजीविनामासहस्रशः समेतानां परिषत्त्वं न विद्यते ॥ Ms. 12. 114; 3. 170; 10. 20.
5215: अव्रत्यं [व्रताय हितं, यत् न. त.] Violation of religious duties, offenceagainst the rule of an ascetic.
5216: अश् {vI.v} {c5c} A. [अश्नुते, आनशे, आशिष्ट-आष्ट, अशिता-अष्टा, अशिष्यतेअक्ष्यते, अशितुं-अष्टुं, अशित-अष्ट] 1 To pervade, fill completely, penetrate; खं प्रावृषेण्यैरिव चानशेऽब्दैः Bk. 2. 30; सदिगश्नुवानमिव विश्वमोजसा Ki. 12. 21; Śi. 17. 46, 65. --2 To reach, go or come to, arrive at, attain to; सर्वमानंत्यमश्नुते Y. 1. 260. --3 To get, gain, obtain, enjoy, experience; अत्युत्कटैः पापपुण्यैरिहैव फलमश्नुते H. 1. 83; उदयमस्तमयं च रघूद्वहादुभयमानशिरे वसुधाधिपाः R. 9. 9; न वेदफलमश्नुते Ms. 1. 109; 4. 149; 5. 46; अर्थज्ञ इत्सकलं भद्रमश्नुते Nir.; फलं दृशोरानशिरे महिष्यः N. 6. 43; Bg. 3. 4; 5. 21; Bk. 3. 37; 5. 14; 14. 19. --4 To become master of; to master, to be able (Ved.). --5 To heap, accumulate. WITH अनु {1} to reach, come up to. {2} to equal. --आ {1} to reach to. {2} to obtain, get. {3} to addict oneself to. --उद् {1} to reach to the top of. {2} to reach, obtain, get. {3} to be master of. --उप {1} to obtain, enjoy, acquire; न च लोकानुपाश्नुते Mb.; क्रियाफलमुपाश्नुते Ms. 6. 82, 12. 20, 81. {2} to become master of. --परि to reach, attain; fill competely, pervade. --प्र {1} to arrive at, reach, occupy, fill completely. {2} to fall to the lot of one (acc.). {vII.v} {c9c} P. (rarely A.) (अश्नाति, आशीत्, आश, अशिता, अशिष्यति, अशित) 1 To eat, to consume; निवेद्य गुरवेऽ श्नीयात् Ms. 2. 51; अश्नीमहि वयं भिक्षां Bh. 3. 117. --2 To taste, enjoy; यद्ददाति यदश्नाति तदेव धनिनो धनं H. 1. 164-165; अश्नंति दिव्यान् दिवि देवभोगान् Bg. 9. 20; प्रत्यक्षं फलमश्नंति कर्मणां Mb. --Caus. (आशयति) To feed, give to eat, cause to eat or drink (with acc. of person); आशयच्चामृतं देवान् Sk.; Ms. 3. 83, 94, 219, 220; (for derivatives from the causal see under आ). --WITH अति to precede or surpass in eating. --उप to eat; taste, enjoy.
5217: अशन a. [अश्-ल्युट्] Reaching, reaching across. --नः N. of a tree = असन q. v. --नं 1 Pervasion, penetration. --2 The act of eating, feeding. --3 Tasting, enjoying. --4 Food; अशनं धात्रा मरुत्कल्पितं व्यालानां Bh. 3. 10; मांसाशनं च नाश्नीयुः Ms. 5. 73; यज्ञशिष्ट° 3. 118; फलमूलाशनैः 5. 54; oft. at the end of adjective comp. in the sense of ‘eating’, ‘one whose food is’ &c.; फलमूलाशन, हुताशन, पवनाशन &c. --Comp. --कृत् a. Ved. preparing food. --पतिः lord of food. --पर्णी a kind of tree.
5218: अशना [अशनमिच्छति अशन-क्यच् क्विप्] Desire to eat, hunger.
5219: अशनायति Den. P. To desire food, to be hungry; P. VII. 4. 34; यावद्वै पुरुषस्य स्वं भवति नैव तावदशनायति Śat. Br.
5220: अशनाया [अशनमिच्छति अशन-क्यच् स्त्रियां भावे अ] Hunger; च्युताशनायः फलवद्विभूत्या Bk. 3. 40; अन्नाद्वाऽशनाया निवर्तते पानात्पिपासा Śat. Br.
5222: अशित p. p. [अश्-कर्मणि-क्त] 1 Eaten, satisfied. --2 Enjoyed.
5223: अशितंगवीन a. Formerly grazed by cattle; see आशितंगवीन.
5225: अशिन् a. [अअ-निनि] Reaching far; enduring, lasting.
5226: अशकुनः --नं An inauspicious or bad omen; Śi. 9. 83.
5228: अशक्तिः f. 1 Weakness, impotence, powerlessness. --2 Inability, incapacity; श्रमेण तदशक्त्या वा न गुणानामियत्तया R. 10. 32. --3 (In Sān. phil.) Incapacity of the intellect to produce knowledge.
5229: अशक्य a. Impossible, impracticable; यदशक्यं न तच्छक्यं H. 1. 90. --Comp. --अर्थ a. unavailing, useless.
5230: अशंक, अशंकित a. 1 Fearless, undaunted; प्रविशत्यशंकः H. 1. 81. --2 Secure, certain, having no doubt.
5231: अशत्रु a. 1 One who has no enemy. --2 One whom no enemy defies or challenges. --3 Without opposition from foes. --त्रु n. The condition of having no enemies. --त्रुः The moon.
5232: अशन् m. Ved. A stone for slinging; a stone or cloud.
5233: अशनिः m. f. [अश्नुते संहति, अश् अनि Uṇ. 2. 101] 1 Indra's thunderbolt; शक्रस्य महाशनिध्वजं R. 3. 56. --2 Flash of lightning; अनुवनमशनिर्गतः Sk.; अशनिः कल्पित एष वेधसा R. 8. 47; अशनेरमृतस्य चोभयोर्वशिनश्चांबुधराश्च योनयः Ku. 4. 43. --3 A missile. --4 The tip of a missile. --5 A sacrificial rite (अनुयाज) to kill an enemy. --6 A master. --निः m. 1 Indra. --2 Fire. --3 Fire produced from lightning.
5234: अशब्द a. Not expressed in words; किमर्थमशब्दं रुद्यते K. 60 inaudibly. --ब्दं 1 The ‘inexpressible,’ i. e. Brahma. --2 (In Sān. phil.) प्रधान or primary germ of nature; ईक्षतेर्नाशब्दं Ś. B.
5235: अशम् ind. Ved. Non-welfare, harm, mischief.
5236: अशरण a. Helpless, forlorn, destitute of refuge; बलवदशरणोस्मि Ś. 6; so अशरण्य.
5237: अशरीर a. Bodiless, incorporeal. --रः 1 The Supreme Being (परमात्मन्), Brahma. --2 (In Mīmāmsā) A god or deity in general. --3 Cupid, the god of love चेतांसि चिंताभिरिवाशरीरः Ki. 17. 10: Śi. 9. 61. --4 An ascetic who has renounced all worldly connections; °त्वं --ता absolution.
5238: अशरीरिन् a. Incorporeal, unearthly, heavenly; usually with words like वाणी, वाक् &c. U. 2, Ve. 3, Ś, {4} 1 Brahmā. --2 A god.
5239: अशर्मन् a. Unhappy, afflicted, sorry. --n. Unhappiness, misery, affliction, sorrow; एकौघभूतं तदशर्म कृष्णां (प्रपेदे) Ki. 3. 35; 12. 25.
5240: अशस् a. Ved. 1 Not blessing, not praising. --2 Cursing, hating.
5241: अशस्त a. Ved. 1 Inexpressible, untold. --2 Not esteemed, hated, ill-starred. --Comp. --वार a. Ved, who is not asked for wealth, i. e. who grants it of his own accord; Rv. 10. 99. 5; having indescribable treasures(?)
5242: अशस्तिः f. Ved. 1 Not wishing well, an evil wish or design, curse, imprecation. --2 A curser, hater.
5243: अशस्त्र a. Having no weaponsunarmed. --स्त्रं Not a weapon; °विहितो वधः H. 2. 85; °पूतं मरणमुपदिशामि Ve. 2 (आत्मघातित्वेन शस्त्रेण न पूतं); अशस्त्रपूतं Māl. 5. 12.
5244: अशांत a. 1 Not quelled, violent, wild, restless, anxious; नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य अशांतस्य कुतः सुखं Mb. --2 Not sacred, irreligious, profane.
5245: अशाम्य a. Unappeasable, implacable, irreconcilable (as hatred, enmity &c.).
5248: अशासन a. Having no order or rule. --नं Want of government, anarchy, disorder.
5250: अशास्त्र a. Not conformable to sacred authority, not scriptural, heterodox. --Comp. --विहित, --सिद्ध a. not sanctioned or enjoined by scriptures.
5251: अशास्त्रीय a. Unscriptural, heterodox; illegal, immoral.
5252: अशित्रः [अश्-संहतौ इत्र Uṇ. 4. 172] 1 A thief. --2 An oblation of rice.
5253: अशिरः [अश्-इरच्] 1 The fire. --2 The sun. --3 Wind. --4 A demon; N. of a Rākṣasa. --रा The wife of a Rākṣasa. --रं A diamond.
5254: अशिरस् a. Headless. --m. A body without head, a trunk. --Comp. --स्नानं bathing the whole body except the head.
5255: अशिव a. 1 Inauspicious, causing or threatening mischief; अशिवा दिशि दीप्तायां शिवास्तत्र भयावहाः (रुरुवुः) Rām. --2 Unlucky, unfortunate. --3 Unkind, unfriendly, envious. --4 Pernicious, dangerous. --वः N. of a certain divine being. --वा A female demon or goblin. --वं 1 Ill-luck, misfortune. --2 Mischief. --Comp. --आचारः {1} improper behaviour, rudeness of conduct. {2} conduct opposed to every (sacred) authority.
5256: अशिशु a. Childless, without young ones. --शुः A youth. --श्वी, अशिश्विका 1 A childless female; without young ones (as a cow). --2 A childless woman.
5257: अशिष्ट a. 1 Ill-bred, ill-behaved, rude. --2 Unrefined, barbarous, not respectable, unworthy; °आलापेन Pt. 4. --3 Atheistical, profane. --4 Not sanctioned by any recognized authority. --5 Not prescribed in any work of authority; °ता, °त्त्वं rudeness.
5258: अशिष्य a. Not to be taught, not to be informed.
5259: अशिष्ठ a. 1 Eating much. --2 Ved. Reaching very far. --ष्ठः Fire.
5260: अशीत a. Not cold, hot. --Comp. --करः, --रश्मिः &c. the sun.
5261: अशीतिः f. [निपातोयं P. V. 1. 59] Eighty (used in the singular and fem. gender whatever be the number and gender of the noun it qualifies); sometimes in dual and pl.; पिंडानां तिस्रोऽशीतीः Ms. 11. 221. --Comp. --भागः the eightieth part, one part out of eighty; Ms. 8. 140.
5262: अशीतिक a. [अशीतिः परिमाणं यस्य, ठन्] 1 An octogenarian, one eighty years of age. --2 Measuring eighty.
5264: अशील a. 1 Ill-behaved, vulgar, rude. --2 Indifferent. --लं Bad manners, rudeness, depravity.
5265: अशुचि a. 1 Not clean, dirty, foul, impure; सोऽशुचिः सर्वकर्मसु; in mourning; त्रिरात्रमशुचिर्भवेत्. --2 Black. --चिः The black colour. --चिः f. 1 Impurity. --2 Degradation.
5266: अशुद्ध a. 1 Impure, foul. --2 Inaccurate, incorrect, wrong. --3 Unknown, unascertained. --Comp. --वासकः a vagrant, a suspicious person.
5267: अशुद्धि a. 1 Impure, foul. --2 Wicked. --द्धिः f. Impurity, foulness.
5268: अशोधन, --धित a. Unclean. --नं 1 Uncleanliness. --2 Inaccuracy, incorrectness.
5269: अशुभ a. 1 Inauspicious. --2 Impure, dirty, foul (opp. शुभ); शुभेनाशुभेन वोपायेन K. 158 by any means, fair or foul. --3 Unlucky, unfortunate. --भं 1 Inauspiciousness. --2 Sin, a shameful deed. --3 Misfortune, calamity; नाथे कुतस्त्वय्यशुभं प्रजानां R. 5. 13; प्रायः शुभं विदधात्यशुभं च जंतोः Māl. 1. 23. --Comp. --उदयः an inauspicious omen.
5270: अशुष a. Ved. 1 Eating, consuming, voracious. --2 [न शुष्यति शुष्क, न° त°] Not causing to dry up; Rv. 1. 174. 3. --3 Not extinguished.
5271: अशून्य a. 1 Not empty or vacant; तस्य निन्यतुरशून्यतामुभे R. 19. 13 occupied. --2 Not unattended to, fulfilled, executed; स्वनियोगमशून्यं कुरु (occurring frequently in dramas), execute or go about your business. --न्यं 1 Not a void. --2 Something sent to accompany another; लेखस्याशून्यार्थं किंचिदनुप्रेषितं Mu. 5; अयं लेखस्याशून्यार्थो भविष्यति ibid. (an accompaniment such as a customary present accompanying a letter). --Comp. --शयनं, --शयनद्वितीया, --शयनव्रतं N. of a certain ceremony or vow.
5275: अशेव a. [शी-वनिप्-न° त°] Giving pleasure or happiness.
5276: अशेष a. [न. ब.] Without remainder, whole, all, entire, complete, perfect; अशेषशेमुषीमोषं माषमश्नामि केवलं Udb.; क्रतोरशेषेण फलेन युज्यतां R. 3. 65, 48. --षः Non-remainder. --षं, अशेषेण, अशेषतः ind. Wholly, entirely, completely; तथाविधस्तावदशेषमस्तु सः Ku. 5. 82; येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि Bg. 4. 35, 10. 16; एतद्वोयं भृगुः शास्त्रं श्रावयिष्यत्यशेषतः Ms. 1. 59, 2. 66, 9. 105. --Comp. --साम्राज्यः N. of Śiva.
5278: अशेषयति Den. P. To finish completely; स वेद निःशेषमशेषितक्रियः Ki. 1. 20; Ku. 7. 29.
5279: अशेषस् a. Ved. Without offsprings or descendents.
5280: अशैक्षः An Arhat (no longer a pupil).
5281: अशोक a. Without sorrow, not feeling or causing sorrow. --कः 1 N. of a tree having red flowers (Jonesia Aśoka Roxb.); (said, according to the convention of poets, to put forth flowers when struck by ladies with the foot decked with jingling anklets; cf. असूत सद्यः कुसुमान्यशोकः… पादेन नापैक्षत सुंदरीणां संपर्कमाशिंजितनूपुरेण Ku. 3. 26; Me. 78; R. 8. 62; M. 3. 12, 16; also पादाघातादशोकस्तिलककुरबकौ वीक्षणालिंगनाभ्यां स्त्रीणां स्पशांत् प्रियंगुविंकसति बकुलः सीधुगंडूषसेकात् । मंदारो नर्मवाक्यात् पटुमृटुहसनाच्चंपको वक्त्रवातात् चूतो गीतान्नमेरुविंकसति च पुरो नर्तनात्कर्णिकारः). --2 N. of Viṣṇu. --3 N. of a minister of king Daśaratha. --4 N. of a celebrated king of the Maurya dynasty, said to have reigned from 234-198 B. C. --5 N. of the tree बकुल. --कं 1 N. of a medical plant (कटुक). --2 The sixth day in the first half of Chaitra. --3 One of the female domestic deities of the Jainas. --का 1 Quicksilver. --2 The blossom of the Aśoka plant (forming one of the five arrows of Cupid). --Comp. --अरिः the कदंब tree. --अष्टमी [नास्ति शोको यस्याः कर्म°] the eighth day in the first half of Chaitra. --तरुः, --नगः, --वृक्षः the Aśoka tree. --तीर्थं a holy place named Aśoka near Benares. --त्रिरात्रः, --त्रं N. of a festival or व्रत which lasts for three nights; अस्त्यशोकत्रिरात्राख्यं व्रतं शोकभयापहं । त्रिरात्रं तच्च कर्तव्यं व्रतं शोकविनाशनं ॥. --पूर्णिमा N. of a certain holiday, a ceremony to be observed on the 15th day of the month of Phālguna. --मंजरी N. of a metre. --रोहिणी N. of a medical plant (कटुका). --वनिका a grove of Aśoka trees; °न्याय see under न्याय. --षष्ठी N. of a certain holiday; चैत्रे मास्यसिते पक्षे षष्ठ्यां षष्ठीं प्रपूजयेत् । सुखाय पुत्रलाभाय शुक्लपक्षे तथैव च ॥.
5282: अशोचः 1 Absence of care or anxiety. --2 Tranquility, calmness. --3 Modesty.
5283: अशोच्य a. Not to be lamented or deplored; अशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे Bg. 2. 11.
5284: अशौचं 1 Impurity, dirtiness, foulness; Pt. 1. 195. --2 Legal impurity or contamination; defilement caused either by child-birth (called जननाशौच) or by the death of some relation (called मृताशौच); it lasts for 10 days; during the मृताशौच a person defiled by it is not to touch any body else, or to eat with others in the same row or to do any sacred action; अहोरात्रमुपासीरन्नशौचं बांधवैः सह Ms. 11. 184. --Comp. --अंतः end of defilement. --संकरः blending or coming together of two or more defilements.
5285: अश्न a. [अश्नुते व्याप्नोति अश्नाति वा, अश-नन्] 1 Pervading. --2 Eating, voracious. --3 Pervaded, filled. --श्नः 1 N. of a demon. --2 A cloud (Nir.). --3 A stone to grind Soma on.
5287: अश्नीतपिबता [अश्नीत विबत इत्युच्यते यस्यां निदेशक्रियायां, सयू° स°] Invitation to eat and drink, a feast where people are called to eat and drink; अश्नीतपिबतीयंती प्रसृता स्मरकर्मणि Bk. 5. 92.
5288: अश्मः 1 A mountain, a rock (at the end of comp.). --2 (Ved.) A cloud.
5289: अश्मकः [अश्मेव स्थिरः, इवार्थे कन्] 1 N. of a sage. --2 N. of a country in the south; तथाश्मकाः पुलिंदाश्च कलिंगाश्च विशेषतः Rām.; (probably an old name of Travancore); according to Bṛ. S. 14. 22 it is in the north-west. --3 The inhabitants of the country (pl.). --4 A part of the साल्व country or its inhabitants; or its king.
5290: अश्मन् a. Ved. Eating or pervading. --m. [अश्नुते व्याप्नोति संहंत्यनेन बा° मनिन् Uṇ. 4. 146] 1 A stone; नाराचक्षेपणीयाश्मनिष्पेषोत्पतितानलं R. 4. 77. --2 A hard stone, rock. --3 Flint. --4 A cloud. --5 A thunderbolt. --6 A mountain. --Comp. --आस्य a. having a stone-mouth or source, flowing from a rock. --उत्थं bitumen. --कदली N. of a plant, a kind of कदली. --कुट्ट, --कुट्टक a. {1} breaking anything on stones. {2} broken by a stone. (--ट्टः, --ट्टकः) a class of devotees; a वानप्रस्थ; Y. 3. 49; Ms. 6. 17. --केतुः [अश्मेव केतुर्यस्य] N. of a plant. --गंधा N. of a plant. --गर्भः, --र्भं, --गर्भजः, --जं, --योनिः an emerald. --गर्भजः fire produced from a flint. --गुडः --डा a kind of weapon. --घ्नः N. of a tree. --चक्र a. furnished with a disc of stone. --जः, --जं {1} red-chalk. {2} iron. --जतु n., --जतुकं bitumen. --जातिः an emerald named पान्ना. --दारणः an axe or crow for breaking stones. (--णं) breaking stones or rocks. --दिद्यु a. one who has obtained a stony weapon, having adamantine weapons or grasped weapons (व्याप्तायुध, अश्ममयायुध). --पुष्पं bitumen, benzoin. --भालं a mortar of stone or iron. --भिद्, --भेदः, --भेदकः the plant Coleus Scutellarioides (supposed to dissolve stone in the bladder.). --रथः N. of a sage. --व्रज a. included in rocks. --सार a. like iron or stone. (--रः, --रं) {1} iron; प्राणाः सत्वरमश्मसारकठिना गच्छंति गच्छंत्वमी S. D. {2} sapphire. °मय a. made of iron. --हन्मन् n. {1} a weapon of iron; Rv. 7. 104. 5. {2} a stroke of the thunderbolt.
5291: अश्ममय, अश्मवत् a. Stony, made of stone.
5292: अश्मर a. [अश्मन्-र] 1 Stony, rocky. --2 Pertaining to stones.

5295: अश्मंत a. 1 Inauspicious., unlucky (अशुभ). --2 Unlimited. --तः N. of a Marut. --तं [अश्मन्ॐऽतोऽत्र शकं° पररूपम्] 1 A fire-place. --2 A field, plain. --3 Death.
5296: अश्मंतकः --कं 1 A fire-place. --2 The shade for a lamp (दीपाधार). --3 A kind of grass. --कः N. of several trees:--(a) अम्लोटक; its leaf; Māl. 9. 7; (b) N. of a tree कोविदारक; (c) N. of a plant from the fibres of which a Brāhmaṇa's girdle may be made.
5297: अश्रः A corner, mostly at the end of comp.; चतुरश्र, त्र्यश्र &c. --श्रं [ अश्नुते नेत्रं, अश्-रक्] 1 A tear. --2 Blood (usually written अस्र q. v.). --Comp. --पः a blood-drinker, a fiend, cannibal.
5298: अश्रिन् a. Having tears, in tears.
5299: अश्रद्ध a. Without faith, unbelieving, diffident. --द्धा Unbelief, diffidence.
5301: अश्रद्धेय a. Not to be believed, incredible.
5302: अश्रम a. Ved. Indefatigable, untiring. --मः 1 Freedom from fatigue, freshness, vigour. --2 Absence of toil, laziness.
5303: अश्रमण a. Indefatigable. --णः One who is not an ascetic or Buddhist mendicant.
5304: अश्रांत a. 1 Unwearied, not fatigued, untired. --2 Incessant, continual; अश्रांतपुण्यकर्माणः Mv. 1. 26. --तं Absence of rest. --तं ind. Incessantly, continually; मयूखैरश्रांतं तपति यदि देवो दिनकरः U. 6. 14.
5305: अश्रवण a. Deaf, having no ears. --णः A snake. --णं Loss of hearing, deafness.

5336: अश्वत्थामन् m. [अश्वस्येव स्थाम बलमस्य, पृषो° समासः; cf. Mb. अश्वस्येवास्य यत्स्थाम नदतः प्रदिशो गतम् ॥ अश्वत्थामैव बालोयं तस्मान्नाम्ना भविष्यति ॥] N. of a celebrated Brāhmaṇa warrior and general on the side of the Kauravas, son of Droṇa and Kṛpī. [After the last great battle in which Duryodhana was mortally wounded, Aśvatthāman, with two other surviving Kauravas, entered the Pāṇḍava camp at night, where he stamped Dhṛṣṭadyumna, the slayer of his father, to death and killed the five young sons of the Pāṇḍavas, killing even Parīkṣit while yet in the mother's womb who was, however, restored to life by Kṛṣṇa. The next morning Draupadī clamoured for revenge upon the murderer of her children, but she consented to forego her demand for his blood if the precious jewel he wore on his head were brought to her. Bhīma, Arjuna, and Kṛṣṇa overtook Aśvatthāman and compelled him to yield the jewel which Yudhiṣṭhira afterwards wore on his head. He is represented as a very brave, fiery-tempered, young warrior, the embodiment of Brāhmaṇic and saintly lustre, and his altercation with Karṇa about the nomination of a general to succeed Droṇa clearly brings out the chief features of his character; see Ve. 3rd act. He is one of the 7 Cirajīvins ‘ever living persons’].

A cavalier, a horse-tamer. --नौ (du.) 1 The two physicians of the gods who are represented as the twin sons of the sun by a nymph in the form of a mare; cf. त्वाष्ट्री तु सवितुर्भार्या वडवारूपधारिणी ॥ असूयत महाभागा सांतरीक्षेऽश्विनावुभौ ॥. [According to Vedic conception they are the harbingers of Uṣas or the dawn; they are young, beautiful, bright, swift &c.; and, according to Yāska, they represent the transition from darkness to light, when the intermingling of both produces that inseparable duality expressed by the twin nature of these deities; according to different interpretations quoted in the Nirukta they were ‘heaven and earth’, ‘day and night’, ‘two kings, performers of holy acts’ which may be traced to their dual and luminous nature. Mythically they were the parents of Nakula and Sahadeva and the physicians of the gods and are called Gadāgadau, Svarvaidyau, Dasrau, Nāsatyau, Vādaveyau, Abdhijau &c. They were celebrated for their active benevolence and curative power which they showed in restoring the sage Cyavana, when grown old and decrepit, to youth, and prolonged his life.]. --2 Two horses. --3 (In astr.) The twins of the zodiac.

5360: अष्टन् num. a. [अश्-व्याप्तौ कनिन् तुट् च Uṇ. 1. 154.] (nom. acc. अष्ट-ष्टौ) Eight. It often occurs in comp. as अष्टा with numerals and some other nouns; as अष्टादशन्, अष्टाविंशतिः, अष्टापद &c. (°ष्टा°) prepared or offered in ‘eight’ pans. (--लः) a sacrifice in which ghee is offered in eight pans. --कर्ण a. one who has the number eight as a mark burnt in his ears ( P. VI. 3. 115). (--णं) the eight qualities which a Brāhmaṇa should possess; दया सर्वभूतेषु, क्षांतिः, अनसूया, शौचं, अनायासः, मंगलं, अकार्पण्यं, अस्पृहा चेति ॥ Gautama. °आश्रय a. endowed with these eight qualities. --ष्ट (ष्टा) चत्वारिंशत् a. forty-eight. --तय a. eight-fold. --तारिणी the eight forms of the goddess तारिणी; तारा चोग्रा महोग्रा च वज्रा काली सरस्वती । कामेश्वरी च चामुंडा इत्यष्टौ तारिण्यो मताः ॥. --त्रिंशत् (--ष्टा) a. thirty-eight. --त्रिकं [अष्टावृत्तं त्रिकं] the number 24. --दलं {1} a lotus having eight petals. {2} an octagon. --दशन् (°ष्टा°) see below after अष्टातय. --दिश् f. [कर्म° संज्ञात्वान्न द्विगुः] the eight cardinal points; पूर्वाग्नेयी दक्षिणा च नैरृती पश्चिमा तथा । वायवी चोत्तरैशानी दिशा अष्टाविमाः स्मृताः ॥. °करिण्यः the eight female elephants living in the eight points; करिण्योऽभ्रमुकपिलापिंगलानुपमाः क्रमात् । ताम्रकर्णी शुभ्रदंती चांगना चांजनावती ॥ Ak. °पालाः the eight regents of the cardinal points; इंद्रो वह्रिः पितृपतिः (यमः) नैरृतो वरुणो मरुत् (वायुः) । कुबेर ईशः पतयः पूर्वादीनां दिशां क्रमात् ॥ Ak. °गजाः the eight elephants guarding the 8 quarters; ऐरावतः पुंडरीको वामनः कुमुद्ॐऽजनः । पुष्पदंतः सार्वभौमः सुप्रतीकश्च दिग्गजाः ॥ Ak. --द्रव्यं the eight materials of a sacrifice; अश्वत्थोडुंबरप्लक्षन्यग्रोधसमिधस्तिलाः । सिद्धार्थपायसाज्यानि द्रव्याण्यष्टौ विटुर्बुधाः ॥. --धातुः the eight metals taken collectively; स्वर्णं रूप्यं च ताम्रं च रंगं यशदमेव च । शीसं लौहं रसश्चेति धातवोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः ॥. --पद --द् (°ष्ट or ष्टा°) a. {1} eight-footed. {2} a term for a pregnant animal. --पदः (°ष्टा°) {1} a spider. {2} a fabulous animal called Śarabha. {3} a worm. {4} a wild sort of jasmin. {5} a pin or bolt. {6} the mountain Kailāsa (the abode of Kubera). (--दः, --दं) [अष्टसु धातुषु पदं प्रतिष्ठा यस्य Malli.] {1} gold; आवर्जिताष्टापदकुंभतोयैः Ku. 7. 10; Śi. 3. 28. {2} a kind of chequered cloth or a board for drafts, dice-board (Mar. पट); °परिचयचतुराभिः K. 196. °पत्रं a sheet of gold. --प (पा) दिका N. of a plant. --पदी (°ष्ट-ष्टा°) {1} wild sort of jasmin. {2} a variety of metre, often used in Jayadeva's Gītagovinda. --पलं a kind of medicinal preparation of ghee. --पाद्य a. (°ष्टा°) eight-fold. --मंगलः a horse with a white face, tail, mane, breast and hoofs. (--लं) [अष्टगुणितं मंगलं शा° त°] a collection of eight lucky things; according to some they are: --मृगराजो वृषो नागः कलशो व्यंजनं तथा । वैजयंती तथा भेरी दीप इत्यष्टमंगलम् ॥; according to others लोकेऽस्मिन्मंगलान्यष्टौ ब्राह्मणो गौर्हुताशनः । हिरण्यं सर्पिरादित्य आपो राजा तथाष्टमः ॥. --मानं one kuḍava. --मासिक a. occurring once in 8 months. --मुष्टिः a measure called कुंचि; अष्टमुष्टिर्भवेत् कुंचिः, --मूर्तिः the ‘eight-formed’, an epithet of Śiva; the 8 forms being the 5 elements (earth, water, fire, air and ether), the sun and moon, and the sacrificing priest; cf Ś. 1. 1--या सृष्टिः स्रष्टुराद्या वहति विधिहुतं या हविर्या च होत्री । येद्वे कालंविधत्तः श्रुतिविषयगुणा या स्थिता व्याप्य विश्वं । यामाहुः सर्वभूतप्रकृतिरिति यया प्राणिनः प्राणवंतः । प्रत्यक्षाभिः प्रपन्नस्तनुभिरवतु वस्ताभिरष्टाभिरीशः ॥; or, briefly expressed, the names in Sanskrit (in the above order) are:--जलं वह्निस्तथा यष्टा सूर्याचंद्रमसौ तथा । आकाशं वायुरवनी मूर्तयोऽष्टौ पिनाकिनः ॥. °धरः ‘having {8} forms’, Śiva. --रत्नं the eight jewels taken collectively; the title of a collection of {8} Ślokas on morality. --रसाः the {8} sentiments in dramas &c.; शृंगारहास्यकरुणरौद्रवीरभयानकाः । बीभत्साद्भुतसंज्ञौ चेत्यष्टौ नाट्ये रसाः स्मृताः ॥ K. 5361: अष्टक a. [अष्ट परिमाणमस्य कन्] Consisting of {8} parts, eight-fold; क्रोधजोऽपि गणोऽष्टकः Ms. 7. 48. --कः 1 [अष्टकं (पाणिनेः), विदंति अधीयते वा इत्यष्टकाः P. 5366: अष्टम a. (मी f.)
