Beginning with, and so on; see आदि. --4 Immediately preceding; एकादशाद्यं Śrut. 27 immediately before the 11th, i. e. 10th; so संयुक्ताद्यं 2. --5 Eatable (अद्-ण्यत्). --द्याः (m. pl.) A class of deities. --द्या 1 An epithet of Durgā. --2 The first day (तिथि) of a month. --द्यं 1 The beginning. --2 Grain, food. --3 A kind of funeral obsequial ceremony ( पितृश्राद्धमेद). --Comp. --कविः ‘the first poet,’ an epithet of Brahmā or Vālmīki; see आदिकवि. --बीजं the primary or material cause of the universe, which, according to the Sāṃkhyas, is प्रधान or the inanimate principle. --माषकः a measure of five gunjas (about 17.5 grains Troy).
6163: आदितेय [अदितेरपत्यं ठक्] 1 A son of Aditi. --2 A god, divinity in general. --3 The sun.
6164: आदित्य a. [अदितेरपत्यं ण्य] 1 Solar, belonging to, or born in, the solar line; U. 6. 18. --2 Devoted to, or originating from, Aditi. --3 Belonging to, or sprung from, the Ādityas. --त्यः 1 A son of Aditi; a god, divinity in general. (The number of Ādityas appears to have been originally seven, of whom Varuṇa is the head, and the name Āditya was restricted to them. In the time of the Brāhmaṇas, however, the number of Ādityas rose to 12, representing the sun in the 12 months of the year; धाता मित्रोऽर्यमा रुद्रो वरुणः सूर्य एव चाभगो विवस्वान् पूषा च सविता दशमः स्मृतः ॥ एकादशस्तथा त्वष्टा विष्णुर्द्वादश उच्यते ।); आदित्यानामहं विष्णुः Bg. 10. 21; Ku. 2. 24. (These 12 suns are supposed to shine only at the destruction of the universe; cf. Ve. 3. 6; दग्धुं विश्वं दहनकिरणैर्नोदिता द्वादशार्काः). --2 The sun. --3 A name of Viṣṇu in his fifth or dwarf-incarnation; स्वयंभूः शंभुरादित्यः V. Sah. --4 N. of the Arka plant. --त्यौ (dual) N. of a constellation, the seventh lunar mansion. --Comp. --केतुः {1} N. of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra. {2} the charioteer of the sun. --चंद्रौ (dual) the sun and the moon. --पत्रः N. of a plant. (--त्रं) the leaf of the Arka tree. --पर्णिनी a creeping plant with gold-coloured flowers, growing near the bank of water. --पुष्पिका red swallow wort. --भक्ता [आदित्ये भक्ता] N. of a plant see अर्कभक्ता, --मंडलं the disc or orb of the sun. --व्रतं worship of the sun. --सूनुः ‘the son of the sun’, N. of Sugrīva, Yama, Saturn and Karṇa.
6165: आदिन् a. [अत्तीति अद् णिनि] Eating (in comp.); परस्परादिनः Ms. 12. 59.
6166: आदि(दी)नवः, --वं 1 Misfortune, distress. --2 Hinderance; want of luck (in dice). --3 Fault; see अनादीनव. --Comp. --दर्श a. having evil designs towards a fellowplayer at dice (Ved.).
6167: आदिश् {c6c} U. 1 To point out, indicate, show; मार्गं आदिश् (oft. in dramas) lead the way; Ś. 5. --2 To order, direct, command; वेलोपलक्षणार्थमादिष्टोस्मि Ś. 4; पुनरप्यादिश तावदुत्थितः Ku. 4. 16; तेषामप्येतदादिशेत् Ms. 11. 193; आदिक्षदस्याभिगमं वनाय Bk. 3. 9, 7. 28; R. 1. 54, 2. 65; to appoint; वसुमित्रं गोप्तारमादिश्य M. 5. --3 To aim at; assign; आदिक्षत्सिंहासनं तस्य Bk. 3. 3; हरिवीराणामादिशद्दक्षिणां दिशं Rām. --4 To report, announce; teach, lay down, prescribe, instruct, advise; न चास्य व्रतमादिशेत् Ms. 4. 80; बुद्धिमादिश्य R. 12. 68. --5 To specify, determine; Y. 2. 260. --6 To foretell, predict; सा सिद्धेनादिष्टा Ratn. 4, Bṛ. S. 5. 96; आदिष्टः सुरासुरसंगरो भावी V. 5. --7 To undertake, try; ब्रह्मास्त्रमादिश Mb. --8 To provoke, challenge. --9 To profess as one's own duty. --Caus. To indicate, show, point out, announce &c. (same as आदिश्).
6168: आदिश् f. Ved. 1 Aim, design, intention. --2 A project, proposition. --3 A proposal, declaration. --4 A region, quarter. --5 A sacrifice offered to a particular deity.
6169: आदिष्ट p. p. 1 Directed, commanded, advised, enjoined &c. --2 Said, foretold. --3 Substituted. --ष्टं 1 Command, order. --2 Advice. --3 Leavings of a meal (उच्छिष्ट).
6170: आदिष्टिन् a. One who gives orders. --m. (अस्त्यर्थे इनि). 1 A Brāhmaṇa in the first order of his life; a pupil, student (ब्रह्मचारिन्). --2 A penitent, one engaged in any expiatory rite; Ms. 5. 88.
6171: आदेशः 1 An order, command; भ्रातुरादेशमादाय Rām.; आदेशं देशकालज्ञः प्रतिजग्राह R. 1. 92; राजद्विष्टादेशकृतः Y. 2. 304 doing acts forbidden by the king. --2 Advice, instruction, precept, rule; आदित्यो ब्रह्मेत्यादेशः Ch. Up. --3 Account, information, relation, pointing out, indication. --4 A prediction, prophecy; विप्रश्निकादेशवचनानि K. 64; see सिद्धादेश also. --5 (Gram.) A substitute; धातोः स्थान इवादेशं सुग्रीवं संन्यवेशयत् R. 12. 58. --6 (In astrology) Event, result, consequence of the conjunction of stars. --Comp. --कारिन् a. obedient.
6172: आदेशनं The act of instructing or commanding.
6173: आदेशिन् a. 1 Ordering, commanding. --2 Causing, producing. --3 Exciting, instigating; कपोलपाटलादेशि बभूव रघुचेष्टितं R. 4. 68. --m. 1 A commander, director. --2 An astrologer, fortune-teller.
6174: आदेष्टृ a. One who orders. --m. 1 An adviser, commander, director. --2 An employer of priests (यजमान).
6175: आदीनवः 1 Distress, pain, uneasiness. --2 Fault, transgression; Śi. 2. 22. --3 An inflictor of distress.
6176: आदीप् Caus. To kindle, set on fire; to illuminate.
6177: आदीपनं 1 Setting on fire, inflaming. --2 Exciting, stimulating; embellishing. --3 Whitening the walls, floors &c. on festive occasions.
6178: आदीपित, आदीप्त p. p. Set on fire, blazing up.
6179: आदृ {c6c} A. (द्रियते) 1 To respect, honour, reverence; सीतां रघूत्तम भवत्स्थितिमाद्रियस्व Mv. 7. 3 receive respectfully; take or receive respectfully; द्वितीयाद्रियते सदा H. Pr. 7; सर्वे तस्यादृता धर्मा यस्यैते त्रय आदृताः Ms. 2. 234; Bk. 6. 55. --2 To heed or care for, mind, take notice of; usually with न; न त्यागमाद्रियते K. 104, 167; वाक्यं नाद्रियते च बांधवजनः Bh. 3. 111; अनादृत्य disregarding; मम वचनमनादृत्य in spite of or notwithstanding my words. --3 To feel timid from a feeling of respect, be awed. --4 To apply or devote oneself closely to, have regard for; भूरि श्रुतं शाश्वतमाद्रियंते Māl. 1. 5. --5 To desire, be eager for; Mv. 6. 3. --6 To enjoy honour, be honoured.
6180: आदरः [आ-दृ-कप्] 1 Respect, reverence, honour; निर्माणमेव हि तदादरलालनीयं Māl. 9. 49; न जातहार्देन न विद्विषादरः Ki. 1. 33; Ku. 6. 20. --2 Attention, care, notice, close application; आदरप्रयत्न Māl. 7 careful efforts; तां प्रणामादरस्रस्तजांबूनदवतंसकां Ku. 6. 91. --3 (a) Eagerness, desire, regard; भूयान्दारार्थमादरः Ku. 6. 13; आदरादुपसर्पिततुरंगः K. 119 eagerly; यत्किंचनकारितायामादरः 120; अन्वेष्टुमादरमकरवं 152 made up my mind; Ki. 8. 41, 26; 13. 58. (b) Earnest desire, request; Ś. 6. --4 Effort, endeavour; गृहयंत्रपताकाश्रीरपौरादरनिर्मिता Ku. 6. 41. --5 Commencement, beginning. --6 Love, attachment.
6182: आदरणीय, आदर्तव्य pot. p. Venerable, respectful.
6183: आदारः Ved. 1 Allurement, attraction, an instigator (Sāy.). --2 N. of a plant used instead of Soma (when it is not available).
6186: आदृत p. p. 1 Honoured, respected. --2 (Used actively) (a) Zealous, diligent, earnest; आदृततरमवोचत् K. 211, 170; Ku. 7. 30. (b) Attentive, careful; दंडनीत्यां नात्यादृतोऽभूत् Dk. 154. (c) Respectful (सादर); इत्यादृतेन कथितौ R. 13. 72; इति स्म पृच्छत्यनुवेलमादृतः 3. 5 respectfully or earnestly; Ms. 11. 226, 7. 150.
6187: आदृश् {c1c} P. To look at, see, behold. --Caus. To show, indicate, exhibit; उत्कलादर्शितपथः R. 4. 38.
6188: आदर्शः [आदृश्यतेऽत्र, दृश् आधारे घञ्] 1 A mirror, a looking-glass; आत्मानमालोक्य च शोभमानमादर्शबिंबे स्तिमितायताक्षी Ku. 7. 22. --2 The original manuscript from which a copy is taken; (fig.) a pattern, model, type; आदर्शः शिक्षितानां Mk. 1. 48; आदर्शः सर्वशास्त्राणां K. 5; so गुणानां &c. --3 A copy of a work. --4 A commentary, gloss. --5 A particular boundary of a country. --6 N. of a country. --Comp. --मंडलः {1} a globular mirror. {2} the surface of a mirror (--लं). {3} a kind of snake (with globular spots).
6190: आदर्शनं 1 Showing, making apparent, displaying. --2 A mirror.
6191: आदृष्टिः f. Looking at, power of looking.
6192: आदॄ {c9c} U. Ved. 1 To crush, split open. --2 To make accessible, bring to light, manifest.
6193: आदर्दिर a. Ved. Crushing, splitting open.
6195: आदेवक a. [दिव्-ण्वुल्] One who sports or plays.
6196: आदेवनं 1 Gambling. --2 A die used in gambling. --3 A board for gambling; place for playing.
6198: आद्यून a. [आ-दिव्-क्त, ऊट् नत्वं च P. V. 2. 67; perhaps derived from अद् to eat] Shamelessly voracious, gluttonous, hungry; Ki. 11. 5.
6201: आधमनं 1 A deposit, pledge; एको ह्यनीशः सर्वत्र दानाधमनविक्रये; Kāty.; योगाधमनविक्रीतं योगदानप्रतिग्रहं Ms. 8. 165. --2 Fraudulent puffing of goods at a sale.
6202: आधमर्ण्यं [अधमर्णस्य भावः कर्म वा ष्यञ्] The state of being indebted.
6203: आधर्मिक a. [अधर्मं चरति ठञ् P. IV. 4. 41 Vārt.] Unjust, unrighteous.
6204: आधा {c3c} U. 1 To put, place, deposit, implant, lodge; जनपदे न गदः पदमादधौ R. 9. 4; Bg. 5. 10; दुष्यंतेनाहितं तेजः Ś. 4. 3; आहितो जयविपर्ययोपि मे R. 11. 86 inflicted on me; 19. 26; संभृते शिखिनि गूढमादधुः 19. 54 consigned to the flames, burnt; धैर्यं चाधिषताधिकं Bk. 7. 102 plucked up greater courage. --2 To apply, propose, fix upon, direct towards; प्रतिपात्रमाधीयतां यत्नः Ś. 1; मय्येव मन आधत्स्त Bg. 12. 8; गमने मतिमाधत्त Rām.; Ś. 2. 3; आधीयतां धैर्ये धर्मे च धीः K. 63 direct; सर्वकार्येष्वाहितमतिः K. 56. --3 To appropriate to oneself, hold, possess, take, carry, have, bear; भूयो बभौ दर्पणमादधानां Ku. 7. 26; आधत्ते कनकमयातपत्रलक्ष्मीं Ki. 5. 39 takes or assumes; गर्ममाधत्त राज्ञी R. 2. 75, 5. 57; आहितक्रोधा Amaru. 18. --4 To bear up, uphold, support; शेषः सदैवाहितभूमिभारः Ś. 5. 4. --5 To cause, produce, create, rouse, excite (fear, wonder &c.); छायाश्चरंति बहुधा भयमादधानाः Ś. 3. 27; Ki. 4. 12, 6. 19, 8. 46, 57; Ku. 6. 20; Bk. 2. 8; विस्मयं M. 5. 17; K. 246; नवरसरुचिरां निर्मितिमादधती भारती K. P. 1; to put in, infuse; Śi. 2. 76. --6 To supply, give, impart (with dat., gen. or loc); शुद्धिमादधाना R. 1. 85; इंद्र त्रैलोक्यमाधाय Mb. --7 To appoint; तमेव चाधाय विवाहसाक्ष्ये R. 7. 20. --8 To consecrate (as fire); तत्राग्निमाधाय समित्समिद्धं Ku. 1. 57. --9 To perform, practise (as a vow &c.).
6205: आधातृ a. One that puts in, deposits, imparts &c.; M. 1. 6.
6206: आधानं 1 Placing, putting upon; समिदाधानं, तुलाधानं &c. --2 (a) Taking, having. (b) Receiving, recovering. (c) Containing or being in possession of anything or consecrating. --3 Keeping the sacred fire (अग्न्याधान), a ceremony performed with the sacred fire; पुनर्दारक्रियां कुर्यात् पुनराधानमेव च Ms. 5. 168. --4 Doing, executing, performing. --5 Infusing, putting in, inspiring, imparting; गुणो विशेषाधानहेतुः सिद्धो वस्तुधर्मः S. D. 2; निश्चयाधानं K. 262; प्रजानां विनयाधानाद्रक्षणाद्भरणादपि R. 1. 24 imparting or providing moral instruction. --6 (a) Engendering, producing, कौतुकाधानहेतोः Me. 3; गर्भाधानक्षणपारेचयात् 9. (b) Assigning, attributing, employing. --7 Effort, exertion, application; Mv. 3. 13. --8 A pledge, deposit; Y. 2. 238, 247. --9 A place where anything is deposited, a receptacle, as in पक्वाधानं, पुरुषाधानं. --10 A surety. --11 Enclosure, circuit. --12 A ceremony performed previous to conception; see गर्भाधान.
6207: आधानिकः [आधान-ठञ्] A ceremony performed after cohabitation to cause or favour conception.
6208: आधायः One who has placed anything.
6210: आधिः [आधीयते स्थाप्यते प्रतीकाराय मनोऽनेन, आ-धाकि P. III. 3. 92; connected with आध्यै in some senses] 1 Mental pain or anguish, agony, anxiety, (opp. व्याधि which is bodily pain); न तेषामापदः संति नाधयो व्याधयस्तथा Mb.; मनोगतमाधिहेतुं Ś. 3. 11; R. 8. 27, 9. 54; Bh. 3. 105; Bv. 4. 11; Māl. 4; Ki. 1. 37. --2 A bane, curse, misery; यांत्येवं गृहिणीपदं युवतयो वामाः कुलस्याधयः Ś. 4. 17; Mv. 6. 28. --3 A pledge, deposit, pawn, mortgage; Y. 2. 23; Ms. 8. 143. --4 A place, residence. --5 Location, site. --6 Definition, epithet. --7 Misfortune, calamity (व्यसन). --8 Reflection on religion or duty (धर्मचिंता). --9 Hope, expectation. --10 A man solicitous for the maintenance of his family (कुटुंबव्यापृत). --Comp. --ज्ञ a. {1} suffering pain, distressed. {2} crooked. --भोगः the use or enjoyment of a deposit (as of a horse, cow &c. when pledged). --मन्युः (pl.) feverish heat or burning. --स्तेनः one who uses a deposit without the owner's consent.
6211: आधित्वं, --ता The nature or circumstance of a pledge; °उपाधि the object or purpose for which a pledge is given.
6212: आधीकृ {c8c} P. To pledge, mortgage, pawn, deposit.
6214: आधेय pot. p. 1 To be placed, pledged, appointed &c. --2 To be assigned, attributed, or given. --3 To be received, held, or supported; to be contained. --यं = आधानं.
6215: आहित p. p. 1 Placed, set, deposited; मनस्याहितकर्तव्याः Ku. 2. 62 bearing in mind what they had to do; भारतीमाहितभरां Śi. 2. 69 full of deep meaning. --2 Given, imparted. --3 Entertained, felt. --4 Comprising, containing. --5 Performed, done. --Comp. --अग्नि a. {1} one who keeps or places the fire on the altar, sacrificer; cf. अग्न्याहित. {2} a Brāhmaṇa who maintains and consecrates sacred fire in his house perpetually. --अंक a. marked, spotted. --औत्सुक्य a. one who creates anxiety; R. 2. 73. --क्लप्न a. exhausted, tired. --लक्षण a. bearing a characteristic epithet; ककुत्स्थ इत्याहितलक्षणोऽभूत् R. 6. 71; (according to Malli. = प्रख्यातगुण noted or well-known for good qualities). --व्यथ a. pained, grieved. --स्वन a. making a sound, noisy.
6216: आहितिः f. Ved. Placing on, anything placed on.
6217: आधिकरणिकः [अधिकरणे नियुक्तः ठक्] A judge; Mk. 9.
6219: आधिकारिक a. (की f.) 1 Supreme, superior, relating to a person or thing in authority. --2 Official, belonging to any office or duty.
6220: आधिक्यं [अधिकस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Excess, abundance, preponderance, high degree; ऋद्धिराधिक्यं समृद्धिः Sk. --2 Superiority, supremacy; आधिक्यं साधितं H. 3.
6221: आधिदैविक a. (की f.) [ अधिदेवठञ्] 1 Relating to अविदेव or tutelary deity (as a Mantra); अधियज्ञं ब्रह्म जपेदाधिदैविकमेव च Ms. 6. 83. --2 Caused by fate (as pain &c.); according to Suśruta pain is of three kinds; आध्यात्मिक, आधिमौतिक or आविदैविक.
6222: आधिपत्यं [अधिपतेर्भावः कर्म वा यक्] 1 Supremacy, power, sovereignty, lordship; राज्यं सुराणामपि चाधिपत्यं ( अवाप्य) Bg. 2. 8. --2 The duties of a king; पांडोः पुत्रं प्रकुरुष्वाधिपत्ये Mb.
6223: आधिभौतिक a. (की f.) [अधिभूत ठञ्] 1 Caused by animals (as pain). --2 Relating to beings. --3 Elementary, material, derived from the primitive elements.
6224: आधिराज्यं [अधिराजस्य भावः कर्म वा ष्यञ्] Royalty, sovereignty, supreme sway; बभौ भूयः कुमारत्वादाधिराज्यमवाप्य सः R. 17. 30; Mu. 2.
6225: आधिवेदनिकं [अधिवेदनाय हितं ठक् तत्र काले दत्तं ठञ् वा] Property, gifts &c. made to a first wife upon marrying a second; यच्च द्वितीयविवाहायिंना पूर्वस्त्रियै पारितेषिकं धनं दत्तं तदाधिवेदनिकं Viṣṇu.; cf. Y. 2. 143, 148 also.
6226: आधु {c5c} U. To shake, stir, agitate.
6227: आधवः Ved. 1 One who stirs up or agitates. --2 That which is agitated, mixture. --3 Throwing.
6229: आधवनीयः A vessel in which the Soma plant is shaken and cleansed.
6231: आधुनिक a. (की f.) [अधुना भवः ठञ्] New, modern, of recent origin.
6232: आधृ {c1c} {c10c} P. 1 (a) To hold, keep, contain; सर्वं चाधारयेत् हृदि Ks. 2. 37. (b) To support, bear. --2 To bring, supply.
6233: आधारः [आ-धृ घञ्; आध्रियंतेऽस्मिन्क्रियाः इति Kāśi.] 1 Support, prop, stay; Mu. 1. 2. --2 (Hence) Power of sustaining, aid, patronage, assistance; त्वमेव चातकाधारः Bh. 2. 50. --3 A receptacle, reservoir; तिष्ठंत्याप इवाधारे Pt. 1. 67; चराचराणां भूतानां कुक्षिराधारतां गतः Ku. 6. 67; अपामिवाधारमनुत्तरंगं Ku. 3. 48; तोयाधारपथाश्च वल्कलशिखानिष्यंदरेखांकिताः Ś. 1. 14; आधारः क्षमांभसां K. 44; Y. 3. 144, 165. --4 That which holds or contains, a vessel, recipient. --5 A part, character (in dramas); Mv. 1. 3. --6 A basin round the foot of a tree; आधारबंधप्रमुखैः प्रयत्नैः R. 5. 6. --7 A dike, dam, embankment. --8 A canal. --9 The sense of the locative case, location, comprehension; आधारोऽधिकरणं; (आधार is of {3} kinds: --औपश्लेषिक, वैषयिक, and अभिव्यापक see Sk. on P. I. 4. 45). --10 Relation. --Comp. --आधेयभावः the influence, relation, or action of the support or recipient upon the thing received or supported; H. 3. 12. --शक्तिः f. {1} Māyā or illusion. {2} the Supreme goddess.
6236: आधार्य pot. p. To be located. --Comp. --आधारसंबंधः the relation of the recipient and the thing to be received or located.
6238: आधृष् {c5c} P. 1 To assail, defy. --2 To overcome, injure, hurt. --{c10c} P. or Caus. 1 To defy, challenge; as sail, attack; Y. 2. 5 injure, hurt, overcome. --2 To convict, refute.
6240: आधर्षणं 1 Conviction of crime or error; sentence. --2 Refutation. --3 Injuring, annoying.
6241: आधर्षित p. p. 1 Injured, annoyed forcibly. --2 Aggrieved, censured, injured. --3 Refuted in argument, disproved. --4 Sentenced, convicted.
6245: आधोरणः [आधोर् गतिचातुर्ये ल्युट्] The rider or driver of an elephant; आधोरणानां गजसन्निपाते R. 7. 46, 5. 48, 18. 39.
6246: आध्मा {c1c} P. 1 To inflate, puff up, swell. --2 To blow or fill with wind, sound (as a conch &c). --pass. To be elated or inflated, be filled; Ve. 3. 38; Mv. 5. 2.
6247: आध्मात p. p. 1 Puffed up, inflated, elated, filled with (lit. and fig.). charged with; पापेनेवाध्मातमूर्तयः K. 107; Dk. 110; मिथ्याध्मात Mv. 3. 28; 6. 30; Mk. 9. 12; अमृत° U. 6. 21, Mk. 5. 22; भर° हृदयः U. 1. 29; दर्प° filled with pride. --2 Excessively affected, increased, magnified; U. 5. 6; Mk. 5. 18. --3 Sounded, sounding. --4 Burnt. --5 Sick by the swelling of the belly. --तः 1 Flatulence, swelling of the abdomen with noise. --2 War, battle.
6248: आध्मानं [आ-ध्मा-ल्युट्] 1 Blowing inflation; (fig.) growth, increase; Mv. 7. 14. --2 Boasting, vaunting. --3 A bellows. --4 Intumescence, swelling of the belly, body &c., dropsy.
6249: आध्मापनं A means of inflating or causing a sound.
6251: आध्यात्मिक a. (की f.) [आत्मानं आधिकृत्य भवः ठञ्] 1 Relating to the Supreme Spirit. --2 Spiritual, holy. --3 Relating to self; Y. 1. 101; Ms. 2. 117. --4 Caused by the mind (pain, sorrow &c.); see आधिदैविक.
6252: आध्यापकः [अध्यापक एव स्वार्थे अण] A teacher, a spiritual preceptor.
6253: आध्यायिक a. (की f.) [अध्याय ठञ] Occupied or employed in reading or studying (the Vedas) (अधीतवेद).
6254: आध्यासिक a. (की f.) [ अध्यासेन कल्पितः ठक] Caused by adhyāsa i. e. by attributing the nature and properties of one thing to another (in Vedānta phil.).
6255: आध्यै {c1c} P. To think on, meditate, remember.
6257: आधी f. Ved. Thinking, longing, care, anxiety.
6258: आधीत p. p. Ved. Reflected or meditated upon. --तं The object or subject of one's thought; that which is intended or hoped for.
6259: आध्या Remembering, especially with regret, sorrowful recollection.
6260: आध्यानं 1 Anxiety. --2 Remembering with regret, pensive or sorrowful recollection. --3 Meditating or reflecting upon.
6261: आध्र a. Ved. [आ-धृ-क] Poor, indigent, weak. --ध्रः Support.
6262: आध्वनिक a. (की f.) [अध्वनि व्यापृतकुशलो वा ठक्] Being on a journey, wayfaring; कांतारेष्वपि विश्रामो जनस्याध्वनिकस्य वै Mb.
6263: आध्वरिक a. (की f.) [अध्वर-ठक्] One who knows or has studied works relating to the (Soma) sacrifice. --कः [अध्वरस्य व्याख्यानो ग्रंथः] A work which treats of (Soma) sacrifice.
6264: आध्वर्यव a. (वी f.) [अध्वर्योः इदं अञ्] 1 Belonging to the adhvaryu (q. v.) or to the Yajur-veda. --2 One conversant with the Yajurveda; ( P. IV. 3. 123). --वं 1 Service at a sacrifice. --2 Particularly, the office of an Adhvaryu priest.
6265: आनः 1 Inhalation, breath inspired. --2 Mouth or nose (Sāy.). --3 Breathing, blowing.
6266: आनकः 1 [आनयति उत्साहवतः करोति अन्-णिच्-ण्वुल् Tv.] A large military drum (beaten at one end), a double drum, a drum or tabor in general; पणवानकगोमुखाः सहसैवाभ्यहन्यंत Bg. 1. 13. --2 The thunder-cloud. --Comp. --दुदुंभिः epithet of Vasudeva, father of Kṛṣṇa; cf. Hariv. वसुदेवो महाबाहुः पूर्वमानकदुंदुभिः । जज्ञे यस्य प्रसूतस्य दुंदुभ्यः प्राणदन्दिवि ॥ आनकानां च संह्रादः सुमहानभवद्दिवि. (--भिः, --भी f.) a large drum or dhol, kettle-drum (beaten at one end). --स्थली N. of a country.
6267: आनडुह a. (ही f.) [अनडुह इदं अण्] Belonging to or originating from a bull; Y. 1. 280.
6268: आननं [आनित्यनेन, आ-अन् करण ल्युट्] 1 The mouth, face; R. 3. 3; नृपस्य कांतं पिबतः सुताननं 17 --2 A large division of a work, chapter, book &c. (e. g. the two ānanas of Rasagaṅgādhara).
6269: आनंतर्यं [अनंतर-ष्यञ्] 1 Immediate succession. --2 Immediate proximity, absence of interval (of time or space).
6270: आनंत्यं [अनंत-ष्यञ्] 1 Infinity, endlessness (in time, space or number); आनंत्याद् व्यभिचाराच्च K. P. 2. --2 Boundlessness. --3 Immortality, eternity; Ms. 3. 266; 6. 84, 9. 107; लोकानंत्यं दिवः प्राप्तिः पुत्रपौत्रप्रपौत्रके Y. 1. 78, 260. --4 An upper world, heaven, future happiness; यस्तु नित्यं कृतमतिर्धर्ममेवाभिपद्यते । अशंकमानः कल्याणि सोऽमुत्रानंत्यमश्नुते Mb.
6271: आनंद् {c1c} P. To rejoice, be glad or delighted; आनंदितारस्त्वां दृष्ट्वा Bk. 22. 14; Gīt. 11. --Caus. 1 To gladden, delight; Y. 1. 356; Bk. 21. 12. --2 To amuse oneself.
6272: आनंदः [आनंद् --घञ्] 1 Happiness, joy, delight, pleasure; आनंदं ब्रह्मणो विद्वान्न बिभेति कदाचन supreme bliss or felicity; आनंद एवास्य विज्ञानमात्मानंदात्मानो हैवं सर्वे देवाः Śat. Br. --2 God, Supreme spirit (ब्रह्म) (said to be n. also in this sense). --3 N. of the forty-eighth year of the cycle of Jupiter. --4 N. of Śiva. --5 N. of Viṣṇu. --6 N. of Balarāma (according to Jaina doctrines). --7 N. of a cousin and follower and favourite disciple of Buddha Śākyamuni, compiler of the Sūtras. --8 A variety of the Daṇḍaka metre. --दा, --दी N. of two plants. --दं 1 Wine, liquor. --2 A kind of house. --Comp. --अर्णवः the delight of Brahma. --काननं, --वनं N. of Kāśī. --गिरिः, --ज्ञानः, --ज्ञानगिरिः N. of a celebrated annotator on Śankarāchārya. --ज a. caused by joy (as tears). --द, --कर a. exhilarating, delighting. --दत्तः [आनंदो दत्तो येन] the membrum virile. --पटः [ आनंदजनको पटः] a bridal garment. --पूर्ण a. delighted supremely, full of bliss. (--र्णः) the Supreme spirit. --प्रमवः semen. --नैरव a. causing both joy and fear. (--वः) N. of Śiva. --लहरिः, --री f. ‘wave of enjoyment,’ title of a small hymn by Śaṅkarācārya addressed to Pārvatī.
6275: आनंदथु a. [आ-नंद्-अथुच्] Happy, joyful. --थुः Happiness, joy, pleasure.
6276: आनंदन a. Pleasing, delighting; °नं चेतसः H. 1. 210. --नं 1 Delighting, making happy. --2 Paying respects to. --3 Courteous treatment of a friend or a guest at meeting and parting, courtesy, civility. --4 What gives or produces delight.
6277: आनंदमय a. Blissful, full of joy, made up or consisting of happiness; सुषुप्तित्थान एकीभूतः प्रज्ञाघन एवानंदमयो ह्यानदभुक् Māṇḍ. Up. --यः The Supreme spirit. --या A form of Durgā. °कोषः the innermost wrapper or vesture of the body, causal frame enshrining the soul; see कोश.
6278: आनंदयितव्यं The object of enjoyment or sensual pleasure.
6279: आनंदयितृ a. One who gives joy or delight.
6280: आनंदिः [आ-नंद्-इन्] 1 Joy, happiness; कोसल्यानंदिवर्धनः Rām. --2 Curiosity.
6281: आनंदिन् a. [आ-नंद्-णिनि] 1 Happy, joyful, delighted. --2 Pleasing, giving delight.
6283: आनम् {c1c} P. 1 To bend, bend down, bow, incline, stoop; Śi. 1. 13. --2 To salute (respectfully), bow down to; तमपि राजकमाननाम K. 59. --3 To humble. --Caus. (नमयति) To cause to bend down; कुचभारानप्निता न योषितः Bh. 3. 27; विदर्भपति मानमितं बलैश्च M. 5. 3 humbled.
6284: आनत p. p. 1 Respectfully saluted or bowed to. --2 (Actively used) Bent down, bending, stooping, inclined; कुसुमानताः (तरवः) Ki. 5. 25; Rs. 6. 3; पादानतः Ku. 3. 8; so प्रश्रय°, फलभार°. --3 Making a low bow, saluting respectfully; R. 1. 92, 4. 69. --4 Humble, obedient, submissive, pacified, conciliated.
6285: आनतिः f. 1 Bending, bowing, stooping (fig. also); गुणवत्मित्रमिवानतिं प्रपेदे Ki. 13. 15; चरणानतिव्यतिकरे Amaru. 44; किं वक्षश्चरणानतिव्यतिकरव्याजंन गोपाय्यते 22. --2 A bow or salutation, obeisance; आत्मजातिसदृशिं किलानतिं Ki. 13. 36; Śi. 1. 11. --3 Homage, reverence. --4 Delight.
6286: आनमः Bending, stretching (as a bow); cf. दुरानम.
6287: आनम्र a. A little bent, bowing, stooping.
6288: आनर्तः [आनृत्यत्यत्र आधारे घञ्] 1 A stage, theatre, a dancing hall. --2 War, battle. --3 N. of a king of the solar race. --4 N. of a country or its inhabitants, or its king. (It was also called Saurāṣṭra and may be identified with the modern Kattywar. Dvārakā was its capital, which is called Ānartanagarī. There was also an important town called Valabhī, which afterwards became its capital. The celebrated Tīrtha called Prabhāsa also stood in the same peninsula.) --र्तं 1 Water. --2 Dancing (m. also). --Comp. --पुरं, --नगरी the capital of the Ānarta country.
6289: आनर्तक a. 1 Belonging to Ānarta. --2 Dancing about.
6290: आनर्तीय a. [आनर्त-छ] Belonging to or coming from Ānarta.
6291: आनर्थक्यं [अनर्यस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Uselessness, unprofitableness; श्रुत्यानर्थक्यनिति चेत् Kāty.; आम्नायस्य क्रियार्थत्वादानर्थक्यमतदर्थानां Jaimini S. --2 Unfitness, impropriety.
6292: आनव a. [आनुः प्राणी तस्येदं अण्] 1 Human (as strength &c.). --2 Kind to men, benevolent. --वः 1 Men, people. --2 Foreign men or people.
6293: आनस a. (सी f.) [अनसः शकटस्य पितुर्वा इदं अण्] Ved. 1 Belonging to a waggon or cart. --2 Belonging to a father.
6294: आनह् {c4c} U. 1 To bind to, fasten. --2 (A.) To be stopped.
6295: आनद्ध p. p. 1 Bound, tied, fastened. --2 Costive (as stomach). --द्धः 1 A drum in general. --2 Dressing, putting on clothes, ornaments &c., accoutring. --Comp. --बस्तिता retention of urine or constipation.
6296: आनाहः 1 Binding. --2 Suppression of urine, constipation, epistasis. --3 Length (especially of cloth).
6297: आनाहिक a. [आनाह-ठक्] To be used in cases of constipation.
6298: आनाथ्यं [अनाथस्य भावः ष्यञ्] The state of being helpless or forlorn, orphanism, helplessness.
6299: आनिर्हत a. Ved. Of indestructible nature; wholly gone out of the world (Mahīdhara). --तः A class of principal deities.
6300: आनिल a. (ली f.) [अनिलस्येदं अण्] 1 Proceeding from or produced by wind, windy. --2 Presided over by or sacred to Vāyu (as an oblation &c). --लः, --आनिलिः N. of Hanūmat or Bhīma.
6301: आनी {c1c} P. 1 To bring, fetch; भुवनं मत्पार्श्वमानीयते Ś. 7. 8; तेषामुदकमानीय Ms. 3. 210. --2 To bring on, produce, cause; आनिनाय भुवः कंपं R. 15. 24. --3 To lead towards or near, convey. --4 To mix in. --5 To reduce or lead to any condition; वशं आनी to reduce to subjection. --6 To lead off, divert. --Caus. To cause to bring (with instr. of person who brings); R. 12. 12, 15. 74.
6302: आनयः, आनयनं 1 Bringing. --2 Investiture with the sacred thread (cf. उपनय).
6303: आनायः [आनीयते मत्स्योऽनेन नी-करणे-घञ्] A net; जालमानायः P. III. 3. 124.
6304: आनायिन् m. [आनाय-इनि] A fisherman, fisher; आनाथिभिस्तामपकृष्टनक्रां R. 16. 55, 75.
6305: आनाय्य a. To be brought near. --य्यः [आनी-ण्यत् आयादेशः P. III. 1. 127] Consecrated fire taken from गार्हपत्य or household fire and placed on the south side (also called दाक्षिणाग्नि); दक्षिणाग्निविशेष एवेदं स हि गार्हपत्यादानीयते अनित्यश्च सततमप्रज्वलनात् Sk.
6306: आनीतिः f. [आ-नी-क्तिन्] Leading near; चंक्रमित्वा प्रियानीतिं रामो रक्षोवधे स्थितः । Mugdha.
6310: आनील a. Darkish, slightly blue. --लः A black horse.
6311: आनुकल्पिक a. [अनुकल्पं वेत्ति अधीते वा उक्था° ठक्] 1 One who knows or studies the anukalpa q. v. --2 To be obtained by अनुकल्प.
6312: आनुकूलिक a. (की f.) [ अनुकूलठक्] Favourable, conformable.
6313: आनुकूल्यं [अनुकूलस्य भावः कर्म वा ष्यञ्] 1 Favourableness, conformity, suitableness; यत्रानुकूल्यं दंपत्योस्त्रिवर्गस्तत्र वर्धते Y. 1. 74. --2 Kindness, favour.
6315: आनुगतिक a. (की f.) Relating to a follower.
6316: आनुगुण्यं [अनुगुणस्य भावः कर्म वा ष्यञ्] Favourableness, suitableness, congruity.
6317: आनुग्रामिक a. (की f.) [अनुग्रामं भवः ठञ्] Rural, rustic.
6320: आनुपदिक a. (की f.) [अनुपदं धावति ठक् वेद अधीते वा] Following, pursuing, tracking, studying.
6321: आनुपूर्वं, --र्व्यं --र्वी [अनुपूर्वस्य भावः ष्यञ् ततो वा ङीषि यलोपः] 1 Order, succession, series; Ms. 2. 41. --2 (In law) The regular order of the castes; षडानुपूर्व्या विप्रस्य क्षत्रस्य चतुरोऽवरान् Ms. 3. 23. --3 (In logic) Conclusion regularly or syllogistically drawn.
6322: आनुपूर्वे --र्व्ये --ण, आनुपूर्व्या ind. One after another, in due order; आनुपूर्व्येणोत्यितराजलोकः K. 95.
6323: आनुमानिक a. (की f.) [ अनुमानादागतः ठक्] 1 Relating to a conclusion. --2 Derived from an inference, subject to inference, inferential. --3 Inferred. --कं The Pradhāna of the Sāṃkhyas; आनुमानिकमप्येकेषामिति चेन्न Br. Sūt.; °त्वं the state of being inferable.
6324: आनुयात्रिकः A follower, attendant; Māl. 6; U. 4.
6326: आनुलेपिक a. [अनुलेपिकायाः स्त्रिया धर्म्यम्] Forming the duty of an अनुलेपिका.
6327: आनुलोमिक a. (की f.) [ अनुलोमंवर्तते अनुलोम ठक्] 1 Regular, orderly, in due course. --2 Favourable, suitable.
6328: आनुलोम्य a. ‘In the direction of the hair,’ produced in natural or direct order. --म्यं [अनुलोमस्य भावः कर्म वा ब्राह्म° ष्यञ्] 1 Natural or direct order, proper arrangement; आनुलोम्येन संभूता जात्या ज्ञेयास्त एव ते Ms. 10. 5, 13. --2 Regular series or succession. --3 Favourableness, fit disposition. --4 Bringing to one's right place.
6330: आनुवेश्यः [अनुवेशं वसति] A neighbour who lives next to the next-door neighbour; प्रातिवेश्यानुवेश्यौ च कल्याणे विंशतिद्विजे Ms. 8. 392; (on which Kull. says; निरंतरगुहवासी प्रातिवेश्यः, तदनंतरगृहवास्यानुवेश्यः). The word is also found to be written as अनुवेश्य.
6331: आनुशासनिक a. (की f.) [ अनुशासनाय हितं ठक्] Relating to or treating of instruction.
6332: आनुशूक a. (की f.) Being with or within the awns (as rice).
6333: आनुश्र(श्रा)विक a. (की f.) [ गुरुपाठादनुश्रूयते अनुश्रवो वेदस्तत्र विहितः ठक्] According to hearing, resting on tradition. --कः Means of obtaining Heaven, absolution &c. Sk.
6334: आनुषक् ind. Ved. In continuous order, uninterruptedly, one after the other.
6335: आनुषंगिक a. (की f.) [ अनुषंगात् आगतः ठक् स्त्रियां ङीप्] 1 Connected with, concomitant. --2 Implied, inherent. --3 Necessarily following, inevitable, necessary. --4 Of secondary importance, secondary; असुभिः स्थास्नु यशश्चिचीषतः ननु लक्ष्मीः फलमानुषंगिकं Ki. 2. 19; अन्यतरस्यानुषंगिकत्वेऽन्वाचयः Sk.; see अन्वाचय. --5 Attached to, fond of, frequenting; तत्र° Pt. 1. --6 Like, analogous. --7 Relative, proportionate. --8 (In gram.) Elliptical, including words not included in the sentence.
6337: आनुषूक a. Promoting, urging, driving forward.
6338: आनुष्टुभ a. (भी f.) [अनुष्टुप् छंदोऽस्य उत्सा° अञ्] 1 Consisting of Anushṭubhs. --2 Relating to Anuṣṭubh, formed like the metre. --भं The Anuṣṭubh metre.
6339: आनुसूय a. (यी f.) [अनुसूयया अत्रिपत्न्या दत्तं अण्] Coming from or given by Anusūyā; R. 14. 14.
6340: आनूकं ind. Ved. In abundance, greatly.
6341: आनूप a. (पी f.) [अनूपदेशे भव, अण्] 1 Watery, marshy, wet. --2 Produced in a marshy place. --पः Any animal frequenting marshy or watery places (as a buffalo); °मांसं the flesh of such animals.
6342: आनूपक a. Living in marshy places.
6343: आनृण्यं [अनृणस्य भावः कर्म वा ष्यञ्] Acquittance of debt or obligation; see अनृणता.
6344: आनृत a. (ती f.) [अनृतं शीलमस्य अण्] Always telling lies, untruthful.
6345: आनृशंस --स्य a. Mild, kind; merciful. --सं, --स्यं 1 Mildness. --2 Kindness; Ms. 1. 101, 8. 411. --3 Compassion, pity, mercy.
6346: आनैपुणं, --ण्यं [अनिपुणस्य भावः अण्, ष्यञ् वा] Clumsiness, stupidity.
6347: आनैश्वर्यं [अनीश्वरस्य भावः ष्यञ्] Absence of power or supremacy.
6348: आंत a. (ती f.) [अंत-अण्] Final, terminal. --तं ind. Completely, to the end.
6350: आंतर a. [अंतर् मध्ये भवः अण्] 1 Internal, secret, hidden; U. 6. 12; Māl. 1. 24. --2 Inmost, inward; U. 2. --रं Inmost nature. --Comp. --ज्ञ Knowing the hidden secret (of things &c.); Māl. 1. 8.
6351: आंतरतम्यं, आंतर्यं Nearest or closest relationship (as of letters).
6352: आंतरागारिक a. Belonging to the duties of a store-keeper or chamberlain.
6353: आंतराल a. [अंतरालं वेत्ति अण्] One conversant with the inner nature.
6354: आंतरि(री)क्ष a. (क्षी f.) [ अंतरिक्षे भवः अण्] 1 Atmospherical, heavenly, celestial. --2 Produced in the atmosphere. --क्षं The firmament, the intermediate region between the earth and sky.
6355: आंतर्गणिक a. (की f.) [अंतर्गणं भवः ठञ्] Included, comprised (as in a class, troop &c).
6356: आंतर्गेहिक a. (की f.) [अंतर्गेहं वेश्मनि भवः ठञ्] Being or produced inside a house.
6357: आंतिका [अंतिकेव अण् टाप्] An elder sister.
6358: आंत्र a. (त्री f.) [अंत्र-अण्] Relating to the bowels. --त्रं Ved. Bowels, entrails.
6359: आंत्रिक a. (की f.) Visceral, being within or relating to the bowels.
6360: आंदोल् {c10c} P. [--दोलयति, दोलित] 1 To swing, rock or move to and fro. --2 To shake, tremble (fig. also); Māl. 4; मंदमारुतांदोलिता लतेव Dk. 17, 21.
6362: आंदोलनं [आंदोल् भावे ल्युट्] 1 Swinging, a swing. --2 Moving to and fro, shaking, rocking; किंत्वासामरविंदसुंदरदृशां द्राक्चामरांदोलनात् Udb. --3 Trembling, oscillation.
6363: आंधसः The scum of boiled rice.
6364: आंधसिकः [अंधो भक्तं शिल्पमस्य ठक्] A cook.
6366: आंध्र a. Belonging to Andhra(as language). --ध्रः (pl.) The Telagu country, modern Telangaṇa; see अंध्र.
6367: आन्न a. (न्नी f.) [अन्नं लब्धा अन्न-ण P. IV. 4. 85] 1 Fed, having food. --2 Relating to, derived from food.
6369: आन्वयिक a. (की f.) [अन्वये प्रशस्तकुले भवः ठञ्] 1 Of a good family, well-born, of noble birth. --2 Orderly.
6370: आन्वाहिक a. (की f.) [अन्वह-ठञ्] Daily occurring or to be performed every day; पक्तिं चान्वाहिकीं Ms. 3. 67.
6371: आन्वीक्षिकी [अन्वीक्षा प्रयोजनमस्याः ठञ्] 1 Logic, logical philosophy. --2 Metaphysics (आत्मविद्या q. v.); आन्वीक्षिक्यात्मविद्या स्यादीक्षणात्सुखदुःखयोः । ईक्षमाणस्तया तत्त्वं हर्षशोकौ व्युदस्यति ॥ Kām. 2. 11; आन्वीक्षिकीश्रवणाय Māl. 1; Ms. 7. 43; (न्याय आन्वीक्षिकी पंचाध्यायी गौतमेन प्रणीता Madhusūdana).
6372: आन्वीपिक a. (की f.) [अन्वीपं वर्तते ठक्] Favourable.
6373: आप् {c5c} P., rarely {c1c} P. (आप्नोति or आपति, आप, आपत्, आप्स्यति, आप्तुं, आप्त) 1 To obtain, attain, get; पुत्रमेवंगुणोपेतं चक्रवर्तिनमाप्नुहि Ś. 1. 12; अनुद्योगेन तैलानि तिलेभ्यो नाप्तुमर्हति H. Pr. 30; शतं क्रतुनामपविघ्नमाप सः R. 3. 38; so फलं, कीर्ति, सुखं &c. --2 To reach, go to; overtake, meet, fall in with; शबरीमापतुर्वने Bk. 6. 59. --3 To pervade, occupy, enter into. --4 To undergo, suffer, meet with; दिष्टांतमाप्स्यति भवान् R. 9. 79; Ms. 8. 188. --5 To equal. --pass. (आप्यते) 1 To be reached, found, met with, obtained &c. --2 To arrive at one's end or aim. --3 To become filled. --Caus. (आपयति) 1 To cause to reach or obtain. --2 To cause any one to feel or perceive. --3 To hit.
6374: आपः [आप्-घञ्] 1 N. of one of the 8 demigods called Vasus. --2 (At the end of comp.) दुराप difficult to be obtained. --पं [अपां समूहः] 1 A flood or stream of water, water. --2 Sky (Nir.).
6377: आपयितृ a. [आप्-णिच्-तृच्] One who gets or procures, procuring.
6378: आपिः [आप्-णिच्-इन्] 1 Obtaining wealth &c. --2 A friend, acquaintance, ally (बंधु); °त्वं friendship, alliance.
6379: आप्त p. p. [आप्-क्त] 1 Got, obtained, gained; °कामः, °शापः &c. --2 Reached, overtaken, equalled. --3 Reaching to, extending as far as. --4 Trustworthy, reliable, credible (as news &c.). --5 Trusty, confidential, faithful (person); R. 3. 12; 5. 39; Ms. 8. 63. --6 (a) Clever, skilful; प्राजकश्चेद्भवेदाप्तः Ms. 8. 294. (b) Apt, fit. --7 Full, complete, abundant; यजेत राजा क्रतुभिर्विविधैराप्तदक्षिणैः Ms. 7. 79. --8 True, exact. --9 Intimate, closely related, acquainted; कन्यायाः किल पूजयंति पितरो जामातुराप्तं जनं U. 4. 17 relatives; Ms. 5. 101. --10 Appointed. --11 Generally received, commonly used; authentic. --12 Accused, prosecuted. --13 Reasonable, sensible. --प्तः 1 A trustworthy, reliable, or fit person; credible person or source, guarantee; आप्तः यथार्थवक्ता T. S. --2 A relative, friend; निग्रहात्स्वसुराप्तानां वधाच्च धनदानुजः R. 12. 52; कथमाप्तवर्गोयं भवत्याः M. 5; Y. 1. 28, 2. 71; Ms. 2. 109, 8. 64. --3 An Arhat. --प्ता A twisted lock of hair. --प्तं 1 A quotient. --2 (In Math.) Equation of a degree. --Comp. --उक्तिः f. {1} an augment. {2} an affix. {3} a word of received acceptation and established by usage only; see आप्तवाच् also. --काम a. {1} one who has obtained his desire. {2} one who has renounced all worldly desires and attachments. (--मः) the supreme soul. --कारिन् a. doing things in a fit or confidential manner; Ms. 9. 12. (--m.) a trusty agent or confidential servant. --गर्भा a pregnant woman. --दक्षिण a. having proper or abundant gifts. --बचनं {1} received text or authority, revelation. {2} the words of a credible or trustworthy person R. 11. 42, 15. 48. --वाक्यं a true or correct sentence; = वचनं above. --वाच् a. worthy of belief, regarded as authority, one whose words are credible and authoritative; परातिसंधानमधीयते यैर्विद्येति ते संतु किलाप्तवाचः Ś. 5. 25. (--f.) {1} the advice of a friend or credible per son. {2} the Vedas or Śruti a word of authority (said to apply to Smṛtis, Itihāsas and Purāṇas also, which are considered as authoritative evidence); आप्तवागतुमानाभ्यां साध्यं त्वां प्रति का कथा R. 10. 28. --श्रुतिः f. {1} the Vedas. {2} Smṛtis &c.
6380: आप्तिः f. [आप् क्तिन्] 1 Getting, obtaining, gain, acquisition; नित्र°, काम° &c. --2 Reaching, overtaking, meeting with. --3 Binding, connection, relation. --4 Union; especially with a woman (Med.). --5 Fitness, aptitude, propriety. --6 Completion, fulfilment; कामस्याप्तिं जगतः प्रतिष्ठां Kaṭh. --7 Future time. --pl. N. of 12 sacrificial verses beginning with Āpaye.
6381: आप्य a. [अपां इदं अण् स्वार्थे ष्यञ्] 1 Watery. --2 Obtainable, attainable (आप्-ण्यत्). --प्यः A class of gods. --प्यं Ved. Confederation, alliance.
6382: आपकर a. (री f.) [अपकरे भवः अण् अञ् च] Offensive, unfriendly, mischievous.
6383: आपक्व a. Crude, raw, half-baked. --क्वं A cake, bread.
6384: आपगा [अपां समूहः आपं; तेन गच्छति गम् ड] A river, stream; फेनायमानं पतिनापगानां Śi. 3. 72.
6385: आपगेयः [आपगायां गंगायां भवः ढक्] A son of the river, an epithet of Bhīshma or Kṛṣṇa.
6387: आपणिक a. [आपणादागतः ठक्] 1 Relating to traffic, market &c., mercantile. --2 Got from the market (as duties). --कः 1 A shop-keeper, merchant, dealer. --2 A tax on market shops. --3 Assize, market-rate.
6388: आपत् {c1c} P. 1 To fall upon, attack, assail; उदायुधानापततः R. 12. 44, 5. 50; Bk. 3. 48. --2 To approach, come towards; K. 202; एतत्प्रायेण श्रुतिविषयमापतितमेव K. 136 has reached the ears; 268. --3 To fly towards, come in flying, come or drive in haste, rush upon. --4 (a) To happen, take place, occur, come to pass; कथमिदमापतितं U. 2; K. 262, 158; अहो न शोभनमापतितं Pt. 2. (b) To fall to one's lot or share, befall; अहोऽस्माकं महद्भोजममापतितं Pt. 1; आपतंति हि संसारपथमवतीर्णानामेते वृत्तांताः K. 175, 132; सर्वस्यैव स्खलितमापतति 291; H. 1. 30, 173. --5 (a) To occur to, cross (the mind); इति हृदये नापतितं K. 288. (b) To be felt or regarded; मधुरतराण्यापतंति मतसः K. 103 are felt or regarded; 202, 236, 329. --Caus. (पातयति) To go towards, approach (Ved.).
6389: आपतनं 1 Approaching, coming, assailing &c. --2 Happening, occurrence. --3 Descending, alighting --4 Obtaining. --5 Knowledge; क्वचित् प्राकरणिकादर्थादप्राकरणिकस्यार्थस्यापतनं S. D. 10. --6 Natural sequence, necessarily following.
6390: आपति a. Ved. Coming in haste, rushing on. --तिः The wind (always blowing) (सततगतिर्पायुः).
6391: आपतिक a. (की f.) Accidental, unforeseen, sent from heaven. --कः A hawk, falcon.
6392: आपतित a. 1 Fallen to the lot of. --2 Happened, befallen, occurred, come to pass. --3 Alighted, descended.
6393: आपात a. Rushing upon, attacking. --तः 1 Rushing or falling upon, attack, descending, alighting; तदापातभयात्पथि Ku. 2. 45; गरुडापातविश्लिष्टमेघनादास्त्रबंधनः R. 12. 76. --2 Throwing down. --3 Causing to descend or fall, falling down; धारापातैः Me. 48. --4 (a) The present or current moment, the instant; आपातरम्या विषयाः पर्यंतपरितापिनः Ki. 11. 12, आपतसुरसे भोगे निमग्नाः किं न कुर्वते S. D.; H. 4. 75; Bv. 1. 115; Māl. 5. (b) (Hence) First sight or appearance; see आपाततः --5 Happening, becoming apparent, appearance. --Comp. --दुःसह a. unbearable at the first attack; U. 7. --दुष्प्रसह a. unbearable in its onset, making a furious charge; M. 5. 10.
6394: आपाततः ind. At the first sight or attack, instantly, immediately; S. D. 632.
6395: आपातिन् a. Falling on, attacking, descending, happening.
6396: आपत्य a. (त्यी f.) [अपत्य-अण्] 1 Relating to offspring. --2 (In gram.) Relating to the formation of patronymic words.
6397: आपथि a. Ved. Being on the way or journey. --थिः, --थीः, --थ्यः Ved. A wanderer, traveller.
6398: आपद् {c4c} A. 1 To go near, walk towards, approach; एष रावणिरापादि वानराणां भयंकरः Bk. 15. 89. --2 To enter into, go to, attain to (a place, state &c.); वक्तमापद्य मारुतः Śik. 9; निर्वेदनापद्यते becomes disgusted Mk. 1. 14; आपेदिरेंऽबरपथं Bv. 1. 17; क्षीरं दधिभावमापद्यते Ś. B. milk turns into curds; पांडुरतामापद्यमानस्य K. 69 becoming pale; 160; विस्मयमापेदे 179; श्लोकत्वमापद्यत यस्य शोकः R. 14. 70 assumed the form of a verse; चिंतामापेदे Dk. 130 fell a-thinking; so विश्वासं, निर्वृतिं, संशयं, वशं, पंचत्वं &c. --3 To get into trouble, fall into misfortune; अर्थधर्तौ परित्यज्य यः काममनुवर्तते । एवमापद्यते क्षिप्रं राजा दशरथो यथा ॥ Rām.; see आपन्न below. --4 To happen, occur; Bk. 6. 31; एवमापद्यते M. 1 so it is. --Caus. 1 To bring about, bring to pass, accomplish, effect; कूजद्भिरापादितवंशकृत्यं R. 2. 12; Śānti. 3. 19. --2 To lead or reduce to, cause to suffer; R. 5. 5. --3 To cause, to produce, bring on; लघिमानमापादयति K. 105, 109; दोषमपि गुणत्वमापादयति makes the best of a bad matter. --4 To reach or attain to. --5 To spread, circulate (as news). --6 To turn or change into; एकामपि काकिणीं कार्षापणलक्षमापादयेम Dk. 156.
6399: आपत्तिः f. [आ-पद्-क्तिन्] 1 Turning or changing into, entering into any state or condition. --2 Obtaining, procuring, getting; स्थानापत्तेर्द्रव्येषु धर्मलाभः Kāty. --3 Misfortune, calamity, adversity; Y. 3. 42. --4 A fault, transgression. --5 Remonstrance, expostulation. --6 (In phil.) An undesirable conclusion or occurrence (अनिष्टप्रसंग).
6400: आपद् f. [आ-पद् क्विप्] A calamity, misfortune, danger, distress, adversity; दैवीनां मानुषीणां च प्रतिहर्ता त्वमापदां R. 1. 60; अविवेकः परमापदां पदम् Ki. 2. 30, 14; प्रायो गच्छति यत्र भाग्यरहितस्तत्रैव यांत्यापदः Bh. 2. 90; आपदि स्था, आपदं प्राप् to fall into difficulty. --Comp. --कल्पः an alternative to be used in times of difficulty; Ms. 11. 28. --कालः days of adversity, time of distress, hour of danger; अब्राह्मणादध्ययनमापत्काले विधीयते Ms. 2. 241. --कालिक a. (का-की f.) occurring in time of difficulty. --गत, --ग्रस्त-प्राप्त a. {1} fallen into misfortune, involved in difficulties. {2} unfortunate, unhappy, distressed. --धर्मः [आपदि कर्तव्यो धर्मः] a practice, profession, or course of procedure, not usually proper for a caste, but allowable in times of extreme distress or calamity; Ms. 1. 116, 10. 130. (--र्मं) N. of a पर्व in Bhārata.
6402: आपन्न p. p. 1 Gained, obtained, acquired; जीविकापन्नः for आपन्नजीविकः Sk. --2 Gone or reduced to, fallen into; कष्टां दशामापन्नोपि Bh. 2. 29; so दुःख°. --3 Afflicted, distressed, being in difficulty; आपन्नाभयसत्रेषु दीक्षिताः खलु पौरवाः Ś. 2. 16; Me. 53; H. 4. 106, V. 2. --4 Befallen; परिच्छेदो हि पांडित्यं यदापन्ना विपत्तयः H. 1. 148. --Comp. --सत्त्वा pregnant, quick or big with child; a pregnant woman; सममापन्नसत्त्वास्ता रेजुरापांडुरत्विषः R. 10. 59.
6404: आपादनं Causing to arrive at, leading or contributing to, bringing about; tending to; द्रव्यस्य संख्यांतरापादने Sk.
6405: आपनिकः [आ-पन्-इकन् Uṇ. 2. 46] 1 An emerald, sapphire. --2 A Kirāta or barbarian.
6406: आपमित्यक a. [अपमित्य परिवर्त्य निर्वृत्तम् कक्] Received by barter or exchange. --कं Property or anything obtained by barter or for a consideration.
6407: आपया [आपेन जलपूरेण याति या-क] N. of a river near the Sarasvatī.
6408: आपराह्णिक a. (की f.) Being in the afternoon.
6409: आपर्तुक a. (की f.) Not restricted to particular times or seasons.
6412: आपस् n. [आप्-असुन्] 1 Water; आपोमिर्मार्जनं कृत्वा. --2 Sin. --3 A religious ceremony.
6413: आपस्कारं The root or extremity of the trunk or body.
6414: आपा {c1c} P. 1 To drink up (lit. and fig.); षडाननापीतपयोधरासु R. 14. 22; आपीतसूर्यं नभः Mk. 5. 20 quite concealed or obscured; दिवाकरापीतरसा महौषधीः Mb. --2 To drink with the ears or eyes, hear or see intently; ता राघवं दृष्टिभिरापिबंत्यः R. 7. 12; K. 86; भगवत्कथासुधामापीयकर्णांजलिभिः Bhāg. --3 To eclipse, surpass.
6415: आपानं, --नकं 1 A drinking party, banquet; Mk. 8; आपाने पानकलिता दैवनाभिपणोदिताः Mb. --2 A tavern, liquor-shop, a place for drinking in company (°भूमि); तांबूलीनां दलैस्तत्र रचितापानभूतयः R. 4. 42; Ku. 6. 42; आपानकमुत्सवः K. 32.
6416: आपायिन् a. Drinking, fond of drinking.
6417: आपाकः [समंतात् परिवेष्ट्य पच्यतेऽत्र] A baking oven, a potter's kiln.
6418: आपांग्यं [अपांगे देयं ञ्य] To be used for anointing the corners of the eyes (as अंजन).
6420: आपिंजर a. Somewhat red, reddish; R. 16. 51. --रं Gold.
6421: आपिशलिः N. of an old grammarian.
6422: आपिशल a. Originating from आपिशलि. --लः A pupil of आपिशलि.
6424: आपीड् {c10c} P. 1 To press, weigh down; पयोधरभारेणापीडितः Gīt. 12; भुजाभ्यां तमापीड्य clasping him to the bosom. --2 To press hard, afflict, perplex, worry. --3 To compress.
6425: आपीड a. 1 Giving pain, hurting. --2 Squeezing, compressing. --3 A chaplet (tied on the crown of the head), garland in general; चूडापीडकपालसंकुलगलन्मंदाकिनीवारयः Māl. 1. 2. --4 (Hence fig.) A crest jewel; तस्मिन्कुलापीडनिभे विपीडं R. 18. 29; Māl. 1, 6, 7.
6426: आपीडनं 1 Compressing, squeezing; tying tightly. --2 Embracing, clasping. --3 Giving pain, hurting.
6427: आपीडित p. p. 1 Compressed, bound tightly; embraced &c. --2 Decorated with chaplets.
6428: आपीत a. 1 Yellowish. --2 Drunk or sipped a little (as water). --तः Yellowish colour. --तं A pyritic mineral (माक्षिकधातु).
6429: आपूपिक a. (की f.) [ अपूपठक्] 1 A good maker of अपूप (cakes). --2 Accustomed to eat cakes. --3 Fond of cakes, eating cakes (with benefit). --4 Selling cakes. --5 Baking cakes. --6 Forming an ingredient of cakes, good for cakes (as गुड). --कः A baker; confectioner. --कं A multitude of cakes (अपूपानां समूहः).
6431: आपूषं A kind of metal (perhaps tin).
6432: आपृच् {c7c} U. 1 To fill, pervade, occupy completely. --2 To mix or blend with. --3 (A.) To satiate oneself.
6433: आपृच् a. [पृच् क्विप्] Connected, blended. --ind. In a mixed manner, confusedly.
6434: आपॄ {c9c} U. or Caus. To fill; R. 16. 65; Bg. 11. 30; Bk. 6. 118; (fig.) to make full, complete, to fulfil (wishes); भृत्यैरापूर्यते नृपः H. 2. 74. --pass. To be filled, to be filled with wind, be blown (as a conch); आपूर्यमाणानां स्नानशंखानां K. 16.
6435: आपूर a. Becoming full. --रः 1 Flow, current, large flood, quantity; स्वेदापूरो युवति चरितां व्याप गंडस्थलानि Śi. 7. 74; हर्षभरापूरपीडनोत्फुल्लया दृशा Ks. 23. 71. --2 Filling, making full.
6436: आपूरण a. Becoming full. --णं Filling, making full; गर्त° कृतं Pt. 1.
6437: आपूर्ण p. p. filled &c.; आपूर्णश्च कलाभिरिन्दुरमलः Māl. 9. 39.
6438: आपूर्तिः f. 1 Filling. --2 Fulness, satisfaction, satiety.
6439: आपूर्यमाण a. Becoming full, being filled; °पक्षः the crescent or waxing moon.
6440: आपेक्षिक a. (की f.) [ अपेक्षाठक्] Raising expectations.
6441: आपोक्लिमं N. of the 3rd, 6th, 9th, or 12th position; तृतीयं षष्ठनवमभंत्यं चापोक्लिमं विदुः [cf. Gr. apoklima].
6442: आपोमय a. (यी f.) [आपस्-विकारे प्राचुर्ये वा मयट] Consisting of water.
6443: आपोमात्रा The subtle elementary principle of water.
6444: आपोशानः N. of a kind of prayer or formula repeated before and after eating (the formulas being respectively अमृतोपस्तरणमसि स्वाहा and अमृतापिधानमसि स्वाहा); आपोशानक्रियापूर्वं सत्कृतान्नमकुत्सयन् Y. 1. 31, 106. --नं The act of making an उपस्तरण (seat) and अपिधान (covering) for the food eaten.
6446: आप्त्यः Ved. N. of a class of deities, especially of the deity Trita as belonging to that class.
6447: आप्यै {c1c} A. 1 To grow fat, stout, or full, become full, increase; आहुत्य, प्यायते सूर्यः Y. 3. 71. --2 To make full, strengthen, enlarge. --Caus. (--प्याययति) 1 To make fat, full, or comfortable, increase, enlarge; तेजसा तव तेजश्च विष्णुराप्याययिष्यति Mb.; सैव कांतिर्मन्मथाप्यायिता द्युतिः S. D.; वायुभिराप्यायितशरीरः Pt. 1; Me. 44; Ms. 9. 314. --2 To gratify, regale, satisfy, please; आप्यायितो वचनामृतेन H. 1; K. 124, Mv. 1, 2.
6448: आपी a. Fat, stout. --पीः f. The 20th Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.
6449: आपीन p. p. [प्यै-क्त] Stout, fat, strong. --नः A well; आपीन्ॐऽधुः Sk. --नं An udder, teat; आपीनभारोद्वहनप्रयत्नात् R. 2. 18.
6450: आप्यान p. p. 1 Fat, stout, robust, strong; Bk. 5. 56, 9. 2. --2 Pleased, satisfied. --नं 1 Love. --2 Growth, increase.
6452: आप्यायन a. Causing fulness or stoutness, promoting welfare. --नं, --ना [प्याय्-ल्युट्] 1 The act of making full or fat. --2 Satisfying, refreshing, pleasing. --3 Satisfaction, satiety: देवस्याप्यायना भवति Pt. 1. --4 Advancing, promoting. --5 Corpulency, growing fat or stout. --6 Anything which causes corpulency or good condition. --7 A strengthening medicine. --8 Pouring water on Soma and thus causing it to swell. --Comp. --शील a. satisfying.
6453: आप्यायित a. 1 Satisfied, pleased --2 Improved; grown, increased. --3 Stout, fat, robust.
6454: आप्र a. Ved. [आ-पृ-मूल° क] 1 Filling. --2 Able to reach (Sāy.). --3 Busy, zealous.
6455: आप्रच्छ् {c6c} A. 1 To bid adieu, bid farewell; आपृच्छस्व प्रियसखममुं तुंगमालिंग्य शैलं Me. 12; R. 8. 49, 12. 103; Māl. 7.; Bk. 14. 63. --2 To salute on receiving, but particularly parting with a visitor (साधो यामि इति वचनं). --3 To ask. --4 To extol.
6457: आपृच्छ्य pot. p. 1 To be saluted, welcomed or honoured. --2 Praiseworthy, commendable. --3 Beautiful.
6458: आप्रच्छनं 1 Bidding adieu, taking leave at the time of departure. --2 Welcoming, hailing.
6461: आप्रपदं [प्रपदं पदाग्रं तत्पर्यंतं अव्ययी°] A dress reaching to the feet. --ind. To the end of the foot, reaching to the feet.
6462: आप्रपदीन a. [आप्रपदं व्याप्नोति ख] Reaching to the feet (as dress); K. 130; (आप्रपदीनकं also).
6463: आप्री f. [आप्रीणात्यनया आ-प्री-डगौरा° ङीष्] Ved. 1 Conciliation, propitiation, gaining one's favour. --2 (pl.) ‘Propitiatory verses’, a name given to certain invocations addressed to several deified objects in consecutive order, and said to be introductory to the animal sacrifice; some take the Āprīs to represent the objects themselves, the verses being consequently called Āprī verses. The objects invoked are 12:--Susamiddha, Tanūnapāt, Narāśaṃsa, the divine being bearing invocations to the gods, Barhis, the doors of the sacrificial chamber, night and dawn, the two divine beings protecting the sacrifice, the three goddesses Ilā, Sarasvatī, and Mahī, Tvaṣṭṛ, Vanaspati and Svāhā, (all these being regarded by Sāyaṇa to be different forms of Agni); स एता आप्रीरपश्यत्ताभिर्वैस मुखत आत्मानमाप्रीणीत; cf. also Max Müller's Hist. Anc. Lit. pp. 463-466.
6464: आप्रीतपः, --पाः N. of Viṣṇu (protecting those who have appeased his anger).
6465: आप्लु {c1c} A. 1 To jump up, dance, spring; आप्लुत्य पदान्यष्टौ Mb.; (रथं) आपुप्लुवे सिंह इवाचलाग्रं. --2 To bathe, wash, immerse oneself (fig. also); प्रयागे आप्लुत्य गात्राणि Mb.; आप्लुत्याकाशगंगायां ibid.; Ms. 7. 216, 11. 203. --Caus. (प्लावयति) 1 To cause to be washed or bathed; आप्लावयत गात्राणि Mb. --2 To wash, wet, sprinkle; अन्नमाप्लाव्य वारिणा Ms. 3. 244, 11. 98. --3 To overflow, overwhelm, inundate, flood over. --4 To set in commotion. --5 (Atm.) To bathe.
6466: आप्लवः, --प्लवनं 1 Bathing, immersing. --2 Sprinkling with water (on all sides). --Comp. --व्रतिन् or आप्लुतव्रतिन् m. a house-holder who has passed through the first order ( ब्रह्मचर्य) and is admitted into the second (गार्हस्थ्य), an initiated householder; cf. स्नातक.
6467: आप्लावः 1 Bathing, immersing. --2 Sprinkling, wetting. --3 Submerging. --4 A flood, an inundation.
6468: आप्लुत p. p. 1 Bathed; अवभृथाप्लुतो मुनिः R. 11. 31; Ku. 6. 5. --2 Wetted, sprinkled; R. 17. 37. --3 Overflowing with, filled or overcome with; बाष्प, °व्यसन°, रुधिर° &c. --तः, °व्रती An initiated house-holder, see आप्लवव्रतिन्. --तं Bathing.
6469: आप्वन् m. [आप्-वन् Uṇ. 1. 152] Wind, air (आप्वः according to Ujjval.)
6472: आबंध् {c9c} P. 1 To bind, fasten, tie on, place, fix; क्व समाधानमाबध्नातु अवष्टंभः K. 290; न क्वचिन्निर्भरमाबध्नाति पदं 104 places; तेऽपि पोषिताः पोषितरि स्नेहमाबध्नंति 289. --2 To make, form; आबद्धांजलिः, see आबद्ध below. --3 To hold fast, cling to.
6473: आबद्ध p. p. 1 Bound, tied. --2 Fixed; स्यंदनाबद्धदृष्टिषु R. 1. 40. --3 Formed, made; आबद्धमंडला तापसपरिषद् K. 49 sitting in a circle; आबद्धरेखमभितो रविमंजरीभिः Gīt. 11; Bk. 3. 30; Ki. 5. 33. --4 Obtained. --5 Hindered. --द्धं (द्धः also) 1 Binding, joining. --2 A yoke. --3 Ornament. --4 Affection. --Comp. --माल a. forming a wreath, arranged in a row; Me. 9.
6475: आबंधः, --धनं 1 A tie or bond (fig. also); प्रेमाबंधविवार्धित Ratn. 3. 18; Amaru. 38. --2 The tie of a yoke, or that which fastens the ox to the yoke, or the yoke to the plough. --3 Ornament, decoration. --4 Affection.
6476: आबर्ह a. Having the power of tearing or pulling out. --र्हः, --र्हणं [-आ-बर्ह- हिंसायां घञ् ल्युट् वा] 1 Tearing or pulling out. --2 Killing.
6477: आबर्हिन् a. [आबर्ह्-इनि] Fit for tearing out; मूलमस्याबर्हि P. IV. 4. 88.
6479: आबाध् {c1c} A. 1 To check, rein in, restrain. --2 To interrupt, obstruct. --3 To annoy, harass, attack, molest, injure. --4 To set forth or declare wrongly.
6480: आबाधः 1 Affliction, injury, trouble, molestation, damage; न प्राणाबाधमाचरेत् Ms. 4. 54, 51. --2 Interruption, hinderance. --3 Attack (Ved.). --धा 1 Pain, distress. --2 Mental agony or anguish. --3 Segment of the base of a triangle.
6482: आबिल a. 1 Turbid, dirty (= आविल q. v.). --2 Clearing, breaking.
6484: आबुध् {c1c} P. To perceive, notice, understand (Ved.).
6486: आब्द a. (ब्दी f.) [अब्द-अण्] Belonging to, or produced from, a cloud.
6487: आब्दिक a. (की f.) [अब्द-ठक्] Annual, yearly; आब्दिकः करः Ms. 7. 129, 3. 1.
6488: आभगः Ved. A partner (of any thing); to be shared in (Sāy.).
6490: आभा {c2c} P. 1 To shine, blaze; सुतरां रत्नमाभाति चामीकरनियोजितं Subhāṣ.; R. 3. 33. --2 To appear, look like; आभासि तीर्थप्रतिपादितर्द्धिः R. 5. 15, 70, 13. 14; Bk. 7. 8, 66. --3 To outshine.
6491: आभा [भा-अङ्] 1 Light, splendour, lustre; दीपाभां शलभा यथा Pt. 4. --2 Colour, appearance, beauty; प्रशांतमिव शुद्धाभं Ms. 12. 27. --3 Likeness, resemblance; oft. at the end of comp. in these two senses; रुक्माभं appearnig or shining like gold; यमदूताभं Pt. 1. 58; मरुत्सखाभं R. 2. 10. --4 A reflected image, shadow, reflection.
6493: आभाणकः A popular saying, proverb; तथा च लौकिकानामाभाणकः as the proverb goes.
6494: आभाष् {c1c} A. 1 To address, speak to, converse with; वैशंपायनश्चंद्रापीडमाबभाषे K. 117; कुरुते नालापमाभाषिता Nāg. 4. --2 To say or speak (something) (with two acc.); आभाषि रामेण वचः कनीयान् Bk. 3. 51. --3 To say or speak; सखी वेत्रभृदाबभाषे R. 6. 82, 14. 44. --4 To name. --5 To talk aloud, shout.
6496: आभाषणं 1 Addressing, speaking to (संबोधन). --2 Conversation; संबंधमाभाषणपूर्वमाहुः R. 2. 58.
6497: आभाष्य pot. p. To be addressed, worthy of being spoken to; जनमाभाष्यमिमं न मन्यसे R. 8. 48. --ष्यं What is to be said by way of address; Me. 101.
6498: आभास् {c1c} A. 1 To shine, blaze. --2 To be bright. --3 To appear, seem, look like; स्थानांतरं स्वर्ग इवाबभासे Ku. 7. 3; R. 7. 43, 63; 14. 12. --4 To appear untruly, have an appearance; शुक्तिः रजतवदाभासते; Ki. 17. 21. --Caus. To illuminate.
6500: आभासः [भास्-अच्] 1 Splendour, light, lustre. --2 A reflection; तत्राज्ञानं धिया नश्येदाभासात्तु घटः स्फुरेत् Vedānta. --3 (a) Resemblance, likeness; oft. at the end of comp.; नभश्च रुधिराभासं Rām. &c.; चिदाभास, (b) Semblance, phantom; युक्तिवाक्यतदाभाससमाश्रयाः S.B.; तत्साहसाभासं Māl. 2 looks like wantonness. --4 Any unreal or fallacious appearance (as in हेत्वाभास); पुनरुक्तवदाभासः S. D. --5 A fallacy, fallacious reasoning, semblance of a reason, an erroneous but plausible argument; see हेत्वाभास; S. D. 270. --6 An intention, purpose.
6501: आभासनं Making apparent or clear; illuminating.
6502: आभासु(स्व)र a. Splendid, bright, shining. --रः 1 A collective name of 64 demigods. --2 N. of an attendant Gaṇa.
6503: आभिचरणिक, आभिचारिक a. (की f.) [अभिचरण-चार-ठञ्] 1 Magical. --2 Imprecatory, maledictory. --कं A spell or incantation, magic.
6504: आभिजन a. (नी f.) [अभिजन-अण्] Relating to birth (अभिजन), patronymic (as a name); तां पार्वतीत्याभिजनेन नाम्ना Ku. 1. 26. --नं Nobility or loftiness of birth.
6505: आभिजात्यं [अभिजातस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Nobility of birth; °शंसिनी च नम्रता Dk. 137; Ratn. 3. 18; Mv. 2. 18. --2 Rank. --3 Learning. --4 Beauty.
6506: आभिजित a. [अभिजिति नक्षत्रे जातः अण्] Born under the constellation Abhijit.
6507: आभिधा [अभिधैव स्वार्थे अण्] 1 A sound, word. --2 A name; mentioning; see अभिधा.
6508: आभिधानिक a. (की f.) Contained in a dictionary. --कः A lexicographer.
6509: आभिधानीयक a. Relating to a word or name. --कं The property of a name.
6510: आभिप्लविक a. (की f.) [ अभिप्लव-ढक्] Relating to the religious ceremony called अभिप्लव q. v.
6511: आभिमुख्यं [अभिमुखस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Direction towards; °ख्यं याति goes to meet or encounter. --2 Being in front of or face to face; नीताभिमुख्यं पुनः Ratn. 1. 2. --3 Favourableness.
6512: आभिरामिक a. (की f.) Good, agreeable; Mu. 4.
6513: आभिरूपकं, आभिरूप्यं [ अभिरूपवुञ् ष्यञ् च] Beauty.
6514: आभिषेचनिक a. (की f.) [ अभिषेचन-ठञ्] Relating to the inauguration of a king; आभिषेचनिकं यत्ते रामार्थमुपकल्पितं Rām.; Mv. 4.
6515: आभिहारिक a. (की f.) [ अभिहार-ठञ्] 1 To be offered as a present. --2 Taken by force, or fraud. --कं 1 A present. --2 A room.
6516: आभीकं [आभीकेन दृष्टं साम अण्] N. of a Sāma melody.
6517: आभीक्ष्ण्यं [अभीक्ष्णस्य भावः ष्यञ्] Continued repetition; बहुलमाभीक्ष्ण्ये P. III. 2. 81, 4. 22.
6518: आभीय a. Contained in a chapter of Pāṇini which ends with bha (भ).
6519: आभीरः [आ समंतात् भियं राति, रा-क Tv.] 1 A cowherd; आभीरवामनयनाहृतमानसाय दत्तं मनो यदुपते तदिदं गृहाण Udb.; according to Ms. 10. 15 आभीर is the offspring of a Brāhmaṇa and a female of the Ambaṣṭha tribe. --2 (pl.) N. of a country or its inhabitants; श्रीक्ॐकणादयोभागे तापीतः पश्चिमे तटे । आभीरदेशो देवेशि विंध्यशैले व्यवस्थितः ॥. --री 1 A cowherd's wife. --2 A woman of the Ābhīra tribe. --3 The language of the Ābhīras; आभीरेषु तथाभीरी (प्रयोक्तव्या) S. D. 432. --Comp. --पल्लिः, --ल्ली f., --पल्लिका a station or abode of herdsmen, a village inhabited by cowherds.
6520: आभील a. [आभियं लाति ददाति लाक] 1 Fearful, terrible; Śi. 18. 78. --2 Suffering from. --लं Injury, physical pain.
6521: आभु a. [आ-भू-डु] Pervading, reaching (Sāy.); empty; stingy, empty-handed.
6523: आभुग्न a. A little curved or bent.
6524: आभू {c1c} P. Ved. To be present, continue one's existence.
6525: आभू a. Ved. 1 Approaching(as a praiser.) --2 Strong, sufficient, efficacious. --3 Applied according to rule (as a hymn). --4 Very prosperous. --m. A prison, a place of confinement.
6526: आभूतिः f. 1 Pervasion. --2 Overpowering strength. --3 Capability, efficiency.
6528: आभृ {c1c} P. 1 To bring; आ नो अग्ने रयिं भर Rv. 1. 79. 8; कदपत्याभृत दुःखं Bhāg. --2 To carry. --3 To fill, fill with. --4 To bear, support.
6529: आभरणं 1 An ornament, decoration (fig. also); किमित्यपास्याभरणानि यौवने धृतं त्वया वार्द्धकशांभि वल्कलं Ku. 5. 44; प्रशमाभरणं पराक्रमः Ki. 2. 32. (आभरण occurs in the names of works; e. g. सरस्वतीकंठाभरण). --2 The act of nourishing.
6531: आभेरी One of the modes of music (रागिणी) personified as a female.
6532: आभोगः [आ-भुज्-घञ्] 1 Curving, winding. --2 A curve; आभोगकुटिला (गङ्गा) Mb.; crumpling. --3 Circuit, circumference, expanse, extension, precincts, environs; अकथितोऽपि ज्ञायत एव यथायमामोगरतपोवनस्येति Ś. 1; गगनाभोगः the expanse of heaven, wide firmament of the sky; Bh. 3. 57; Mv. 6. 30; Māl. 9. 16. --4 Magnitude, fulness, extent. expansive form; गंडाभोगात् Me. 92 from the broad cheek; प्रतिरवाभोग Māl. 3. 8, 4. 10, 5. 11; प्रतिभयाभोगैः प्लवंगाधिपैः Mv. 6. 24 bodily form or stature; U. 2, 2. 14; भवाभोगोद्विग्नाः Bh. 3. 42, 86; Mv. 2; K. 305, 333. --5 Effort. --6 The expanded hood of a cobra (used by Varuṇa as his umbrella). --7 Enjoyment, satiety, completion; विषयाभोगेषु नैवादरः Śāntilakṣaṇa. --8 A serpent.
6533: आभोगय a. [आभोगं याति या-क] To be enjoyed (as Soma juice). --यं Livelihood (Ved.).
6534: आभोगिः Ved. 1 Enjoyment. --2 Living, supporting life.
6535: आभ्यंतर a. (री f.) [अभ्यंतरे भवः अण्] 1 Interior, inner, inward; as आभ्यंतरो भृत्यवर्ग. --2 One of the two kinds of प्रयत्न or effort giving rise to the vocal sounds.
6536: आभ्यवकाशिक a. (की f.) Living in the open air.
6537: आभ्यवहारिक a. (की f.) [अभ्यवहाराय हितं ठक्] Eatable (as food &c.).
6538: आभ्यादायिकं [अभ्यादान-ठक्] A kind of स्त्रीधन or woman's property.
6539: आभ्यासिक a. (की f.) [ अभ्यासठक्] 1 Resulting from practice. --2 Practising, repeating. --3 Being near, neighbouring, adjoining (आभ्याशिक).
6540: आभ्युदयिक a. (की f.) [ अभ्युदयठक्] 1 Tending to good, granting prosperity; अनाभ्यदयिकं श्रमणकदर्शनं Mk. 8. --2 Relating to the rise or beginning of anything; सुख° Ms. 12. 88. --3 High, exalted, important. --कं A Śrāddha or offering to ancestors; an occasion of rejoicing.
6541: आभ्रिक a. (की f.) [अभ्र्या खनति ठक्] One who digs with a spade.
6542: आम् ind. An interjection of(a) assent, acceptance, ‘oh’, ‘yes’; आं कुर्मः M. 1; (b) recollection; आं तस्मिन्नुर्वश्या वचनं स्खलितमासीत् V. 3; आं ज्ञातम् Ś. 3, Oh, I see it now; M. 3; (c) determination, ‘surely,’ ‘verily’, आं चिरस्य खलु प्रतिबुद्धोस्मि; (d) reply.
6543: आम a. [आम्यते ईषत् पच्यते; आ-अम कर्मणि घञ् Tv.] 1 Raw, uncooked, undressed (opp. पक्व) (oft. applied to the cow in the Veda); आमान्नं Ms. 4. 223; Y. 1. 287. --2 Unripe, immature. --3 Unbaked, unannealed (as a jar). --4 Undigested. --मं 1 State of being raw. --2 Constipation, passing hard excretion. --3 Grain freed from chaff. --मः 1 Disease; sickness. --2 Indigestion; आहारस्य रसः सारः यो न पक्वोऽग्निलाधवात् । आमसज्ञां स लभते महाव्याधिसमाश्रयः ॥ Suśr. --Comp. --अतिसारः dysentery or diarrhœa caused by vitiated mucus in the abdomen (the excretion being in this case mixed with hard and fetid matter). --अद् a. eating raw flesh or food. --अन्नं undressed rice. --आशयः [ आमस्यापक्वान्नस्याशयः] ‘receptacle of undigested food’, the upper part of the belly to the navel, stomach. --कुंभः a jar of unbaked clay; H. 4. 66. --गंधि n. smelling of raw meat or of a burning corpse. --गंधिकं the smell of raw meat. --ज्वरः a kind of fever; cf. रवेद्यमानज्वरं प्राज्ञः क्ॐऽभसा परिषिंचति Śi. 2. 54. --त्वच् a. of tender skin. --पाकः a preliminary stage of the disease called dropsy. --पात्रं an unannealed vessel; विनाशंव्रजति क्षिप्रमामपात्रमिवांभसि Ms. 3. 179. --पीनसं running at the nose, defluxion. --मांसाशिन् m. a cannibal, an eater of raw flesh. --रक्तं dysentery. --रसः imperfect chyme. --वातः constipation, torpor of the bowels attended with flatulence and intumescence. --शूलः pain of indigestion, colic. --श्राद्धं a Śrāddhaperformed with uncooked food; आपद्यनग्नौ तीर्थे च चंद्रसूर्यग्रहे तथा । आमश्राद्धं द्विजैः कार्यं शूद्रेण च सदैव हि ॥ Prācetasa.
6548: आमनं Ved. Friendly disposition or inclination, affection.
6550: आमंत्र् {c10c} A. 1 To bid farewell, bid adieu; आमंत्रयस्व सहचरं Ś. 3; लताभगिनीं Ś. 4; Ku. 6. 94; K. 223. --2 To speak to, call out to, address, converse with; तमामंत्रयांबभूव K. 81, 197, Ve. 1; A. R. 3. --3 To say, speak; परिजनोप्येवमामंत्रयते K. 195. --4 To call, invite, ask (to come); आमंत्रयध्वं राष्ट्रेषु ब्राह्मणान् Mb. --5 To invoke.
6551: आमंत्रणं --णा 1 Addressing, calling, calling out to अबेति वै योषाया आमंत्रणं Śat. Br. --2 Bidding adieu, taking leave of. --3 Greeting, welcome, courtesy. --4 Invitation; अनिंद्यामंत्रणादृते Y. 1. 112. --5 Permission. --6 Conversation. अत्योन्यामंत्रणं यत्स्याज्जनांते तज्जनांतिकं S. D. 6. --7 The vocative case. --8 Deliberation; asking; interrogation.
6552: आमंत्रयितृ a. Asking, inviting, calling &c. --m. (--ता) An inviter, entertainer, especially of Brāhmaṇas.
6553: आमंत्रित p. p. 1 Invited, called. --2 Appointed to do unnecessary things. --तं 1 Addressing. --2 Talk, conversation; V. 2. --3 The vocative case; संबोधने या प्रथमा सामंत्रितसंज्ञा स्यात् Sk.
6554: आमंत्र्य pot. p. To be addressed or called to, to be invited &c. --त्र्यं A word in the vocative case.
6556: आमंद्र a. Having a slightly deep tone, uttering a low, muttering sound, rambling; आमंद्राणा फल मविकलं लप्स्यसे गर्जितानां Me. 34. --द्रः A slightly deep tone, rumbling.
6557: आमयः [आ-मी करणे अच्; Tv.; said to be fr. अम् also] 1 Disease, sickness, distemper; दर्पामयः Mv. 4. 22; आमयस्तु रतिरागसंभवः R. 19. 48; समौ हि शिष्टिराम्नातौ वजर्यंतावामयः स च । Śi. 2. 10. --2 Damage, hurt. --3 Indigestion. --यं N. of the medical plant Costus Speciosus.
6558: आमयाविन् a. [आमय-विन्-निपातः P. V. 2. 122 Vāit.] Sick, dyspeptic, affected with indigestion; °पित्वं indigestion, dyspepsia.
6559: आमरणांत, --तिक a. (की f.) Lasting till death, lasting for life; आमरणाताः प्रणयाः कोपास्तत्क्षणभंगुराः H. 1. 118; अन्योन्यस्याव्यभीचारो भवेदामरणांतिकः Ms. 9. 101.
6561: आमर्षः --र्षणं Anger, wrath, impatience; see अमर्ष.
6562: आमलकः, --की 1 The tree, Emblic Myrobalan, Emblica Officinalis Gærtn (Mar. आंवळा). --2 N. of another tree (वासक). --कं Fruit of the Emblic Myrobalan; बदरामलकाम्रदाडिमानां Bv. 2. 8.
6563: आमहीया f. N. of a particular Ṛk or verse of the Ṛg-veda; ( Rv. 8. 48. 3).
6564: आमात्यः [अमात्य एव स्वार्थे अण्] 1 A minister, counsellor. --2 A general; see अमात्य.
6566: आमावास्य a. (स्यी f.) [ अमावास्या अण्] 1 Belonging to the new moon or its festival. --2 Happening or born at the time of new moon or conjunction. --स्यं The new moon oblation.
6567: आमिक्षा [आमिष्यते सिच्यते, मिष सक् Tv.] Curd of milk and whey, a mixture of boiled and coagulated milk; तप्ते पयसि दध्यानयति सा वैश्वदेव्यामिक्षा भवति.
6568: आमिक्ष्यं, आमिक्षीयं [आमिक्षा यत्-छ] Curd suitable for the preparation of Āmikṣā; so आनिक्षीणं in the same sense.
6570: आमित्रिः m. f. The child of an enemy.
6573: आमिषं [अम्टिषच् दीर्घश्च Uṇ. 1. 46] 1 {1} Flesh; उपानयत् पिंडमिवामिषरय R. 2. 59; ययामिषं जले मत्स्यैर्भक्ष्यते श्वापदैर्भुवि । आकाशे पक्षिभिश्चैव तथा सर्वत्र वित्तवान् --2 (Hence fig.) A prey, victim, object of enjoyment; (राज्यं) रंध्रान्वेषणदक्षाणां द्विषामामिषतां ययौ R. 12. 11 fell a prey &c.; Dk. 164. --3 Food, bait. --4 A bribe. --5 Desire, lust; as in निरपेक्षो निरामिषः Ms. 6. 49. --6 Enjoyment; pleasing or lovely object. --7 Form. --8 A leaf. --9 The fruit of the Jambīra tree. --Comp. --आशिन् a. carnivorous, eating flesh. --प्रियः, --भुज् ‘fond of flesh,’ a kind of bird, heron.
6574: आमिस् m. Ved. 1 Raw flesh or meat. --2 A dead body.
6577: आमील् {c1c} P. To close (the eyes); नेत्रे चामीलयन्नेष Kāv. 2. 11; to shut; चैतन्यं Mv. 2. 22 benumbing; धाराकदबरजोवृष्टिषु चामीलयन् K. 303 being absorbed in.
6578: आमीलनं Shutting or closing of the eyes; K. 256.
6580: आमुखं 1 Commencement. --2 (In dramas) A prologue, prelude (प्रस्तावना); every Sanskrit play is introduced by आमुख. It is thus defined in S. D. नटी विदूषको वापि पारिपार्श्वक एव वा । सूत्रधरेण सहिताः संलापं यत्र कर्वते ॥ चित्रैर्वाक्वैः स्यकार्योत्त्यैः प्रस्तुताक्षेपिमिर्मिथः । आमुखं तत्तु विज्ञेयं नाम्ना प्रस्तावनापि सा ॥ 287. --खं ind. To the face.
6581: आमुच् {c6c} U. 1 To loosen, let go. --2 To wear, tie round or fasten; put on (as a garment &c.); accoutre with; करोऽयमामुक्तविवाहकौतुकः Ku. 5. 66, 7. 21; आमुंचतीवाभरणं द्वितीयं R. 13. 21, 12. 86, 16. 74, 17. 25; Ki. 11. 15; आमुंचद्वर्म रत्नाढ्यं Bk. 17. 6. --3 To throw, cast, discharge; आमोक्ष्यंते त्वयि कटाक्षान् Me. 35. --4 To throw or cast off, take off, put aside (as garments &c.).
6582: आमुक्त p. p. 1 Loosened, let go, liberated. --2 Put on, worn &c., see above. --3 Discharged, cast, shot off.
6583: आमुक्तिः f. 1 Liberation, being let loose. --2 Final beatitude. --3 Putting on, wearing (clothes, ornaments &c.). --क्ति ind. Till final beatitude is obtained.
6584: आमोचनं 1 Loosing, liberating. --2 Emitting, shedding, letting forth, discharging. --3 Putting or tying on.
6586: आमुष्मिक a. (की f.) [अमुष्मिन् परलोके भवः ठक्] Belonging to the next or other world; आमुष्मिकं श्रेयः Suśr.; नैवालोच्य गरीयसीरपि चिरादामुष्प्निकीर्यातनाः S. D.
6587: आमुष्यायण a. or --णः (णी f.) [ अमुष्य ख्यातस्यापत्यं नडा° फक् अलुक्] Wellborn, a son or descendant of such a one; i. e. of an illustrious person or family; आमुष्यायणो वै त्वमसि Śat. Br.; तदामुष्यायणरय तत्रभवतः सुगुहीतनाम्नो भट्टगापालस्य पौत्रः Māl. 1; Mv. 1.
6589: आमृद् {c9c} P. 1 To crush by rubbing. --2 To crumple. --3 To press, squeeze.
6590: आमर्दः 1 Crushing. --2 Roughly handling; अर्धपीतस्तनं मातुरामर्दक्लिष्टकेशरं Ś. 7. 14. --3 Pressing, squeezing. --4 N. of a town.
6592: आमृश् {c6c} P. 1 To touch; handle (roughly), lay hands upon; नवातपामृष्टसरोजचारुभिः Ki. 4. 14; (तां) मुहुरामृशन्मृगधरोऽग्रकरैः Śi. 9. 34; शरासनज्यां मुहुराममर्श Ku. 3. 64; K. 163; Dk. 71; Ś. 7. 2. --2 (a) To seize upon, eat up; R. 5. 9. (b) To attack, assail; आमृष्टं नः परैः पदं Ku. 2. 31. --3 To rub, injure.
6593: आमर्शः, --र्शनं 1 Touching, close contact. --2 Rubbing, wiping. --3 Counsel, advice.
6594: आमृष्ट p. p. 1 Touched, attacked, seized &c. --2 Sweetened, made delicious; Pt. 4. --3 Rubbed, struck against; Ś. 7. 2. --4 Wiped, rubbed.
6595: आमेन्य a. To be measured from all sides; to be reached with an arrow or bolt (?).
6597: आमोद a. Gladdening, cheering up, delighting. --दः 1 Joy, pleasure, delight; आमोदं परमं जग्मुः Rām. --2 Fragrance (diffusive), perfume; आमोदमुपजिघ्रंतौ स्वनिःश्वासानुकारिणं R. 1. 43; आमोदं कुसुमभवं मृदेव धत्ते मृद्गंधं न हि कुसुमानि धारयंति Subhāṣ.; Śi. 2. 20; Me. 31. --3 Strong smell.
6598: आमोदन a. Delighting, pleasing. --नं 1 Delighting, rejoicing. --2 Making fragrant.
6599: आमोदित p. p. 1 Pleased, delighted. --2 Made fragrant, scented.
6600: आमोदिन् a. 1 Happy, delighted. --2 Fragrant; fragrant or perfumed with; oft. at the end of comp.; नवकुटजकदंबामोदिनो गंधवाहाः Bh. 1. 35. --m. (--दी) A perfume for the mouth (made in the form of a pill of camphor &c.).
6601: आमोष a. Robbing, stealing. --षः Theft, robbing.
6603: आमोहनिका A kind of fragrant odour.
6604: आम्ना {c1c} P. 1 (a) To hand down traditionally or in sacred texts; भवत्प्रणीतमाचारमामनंति हि साधवः Ku. 6. 31; एवं किल सूत्रकारा आमनंति Māl. 7. (b) Hence, to regard, consider, mention, lay down; त्वामामनंति प्रकृतिं पुरुषार्थप्रवर्तिनीं Ku. 2. 13, 5. 81; M. 1. 4; Bk. 18. 5; Kām. 8. 24; U. 5; Mv. 4. 30. --2 To keep in mind, commit to memory, learn, study, repeat; आमनन्मंत्रमुत्तमं Bk. 17. 30; यद् ब्रह्म सम्यगाम्नातं Ku. 6. 16 learnt. --3 To celebrate, hail.
6605: आम्नात p. p. 1 Considered, regarded, said to be; समौ हि शिष्टैराम्नातौ वर्त्स्यंतावामयः स (शत्रुः) च Śi. 2. 10. --2 Studied, repeated. --3 Remembered, kept in mind. --4 Handed down in sacred texts or traditionally. --तं Study.
6606: आम्नातिन् a. [आम्नात-इनि] One who has studied the Vedas.
6607: आम्नानं [आ-म्ना-भावे ल्युट्] 1 Recitation or study of the sacred texts or Vedas. --2 Mention; repetition in general.
6608: आम्नायः [आ-म्ना-घञ्] 1 (a) Sacred tradition, sacred texts handed down by tradition or repetition. (b) Hence, the Veda, Vedas taken collectively (including Brāhmaṇas, Upaniṣads and Āraṇyakas also); अधीती चतुर्ष्वाम्नायेषु Dk. 120; आम्नायवचनं सत्यमित्ययं लोकसंग्रहः । आम्नायेभ्यः पुनर्वेदाः प्रसृताः सर्वतोमुखाः ॥ Mb. --2 A sacred text or precept in general; U. 4. --3 Traditional usage, family or national customs. --4 Received doctrine. --5 Advice or instruction (in past and present usage). --6 A Tantra. --7 A series of families. --Comp. --सारिन् a. {1} pious, observing the traditional usages. {2} containing the essence of the Veda.
6609: आम्नायवत् a. Attended with, or learnt by, traditional instruction; U. 6.
6610: आंबरीषपुत्रकः A country inhabited by the Ambarīṣaputras.
6612: आंबिकेयः [अंबिकाया अपत्यं ढक्] An epithet of (a) Dhṛtarāṣṭra; (b) Kārtikeya.
6614: आंभसिक a. (की f.) [अंभसा वर्तते ठक्] Aquatic. --कः A fish.
6615: आम्रः [अम् गत्यादिषु रन् दीर्घश्च Uṇ. 2. 16] The mango-tree. --म्रं The fruit of the mango-tree. --Comp. --आवर्तः {1} N. of a tree (आम्रातक). {2} inspissated mango juice. (--र्तं) the fruit of आम्रातक. --कूटः the name of a mountain; सानुमानाम्रकूटः Me. 17. --गंधकः N. of a plant (समष्ठिलवृक्ष). --पेशी [आम्रस्य पेशीव] a portion of dried mango-fruit. --वणं [आम्रस्य वनं cf. P. VIII. 4. 5] a grove of mango trees; सोहमाम्रवणं छित्त्वा Rām.
6616: आम्रातः [आम्रं आम्ररसं अतति अत्-अच् Tv.] The hog-plum, Spondias Mangifera (its juice resembling that of the mango). --तं The fruit of this tree.
6617: आम्रातकः 1 The hog-plum. --2 Inspissated mango juice (Mar. साट); आम्रस्य सहकारस्य कटे विस्तारितो रसः । घर्मशुष्को मुहुर्दत्त आम्रातक इति स्मृतः ॥ Bhāva P. --3 N. of a mountain.
6618: आम्रिमन् m. Acid taste; see Gaṇa to P. V. 1. 123.
6619: आम्रेड् Caus. To repeat; एतदेव यदा वाक्यमाम्रेडयति देवराट् Mb.
6620: आम्रेडनं Tautology; repetition of words or sounds.
6621: आम्रेडित p. p. Reiterated, repeated (as words). --तं 1 Repetition of sound or word. --2 (In gram.) Reduplication, the second word in reduplication; द्बितीयाम्रेडितांतेषु Sk.
6622: आम्लः, --म्ला The tamarind tree. --म्लं Sourness, acidity.
6623: आम्लि(म्ली)का 1 The tamarind tree. --2 Acidity of stomach.
6624: आयः [आ इ-अच्, अय्-घञ् वा] 1 Arrival, approach. --2 Gaining or acquisition of money, acquiring (opp. व्यय); आये दुःखं व्यये दुःखं Pt. 1. 163. --3 Income, revenue, receipt; ग्रामेषु स्वामिग्राह्यो भाग आयः Sk.; Y. 1. 322, 326; Mk. 2. 6; आयद्वाराणि Dk. 162 sources of income; आयव्ययौ च नियतावाकरान् कोषमेव च Ms. 8. 419; आयाधिकं व्ययं करोति he lives beyond his means. --4 Gain, profit. --5 The eleventh house (in astrology). --6 The guard of the women's apartments. --Comp. --व्ययौ (dual) receipt and disbursement, income and expenditure. --स्थानं a place where revenues are collected.
6625: आयत् a. Ved. Coming, approaching; °वसु one to whom good or wealth comes.
6626: आयतीगवम् ind. At the time when cows return home; प्रक्रांतामायतीगवं Bk. 4. 14.
6628: आयिन् a. Ved. Coming or driving near.
6629: आयःशूलिक a. (की f.) [ अयःशूलठक् P. V. 2. 76] Active, diligent, indefatigable. --कः A man who, in order to gain an object, uses forcible instead of gentle means ( तीक्ष्णोपायेन योऽन्विच्छेत्स आयःशूलिको जनः) cf. K. P. 10; अयःशूलेन अन्विच्छति (scil. अर्थान्) इत्यायः शूलिकः.
6630: आयज् {c1c} A. 1 To honour, worship (the gods). --2 To give, present, furnish, supply. --3 To consecrate, ordain, dedicate.
6631: आयजि a. Ved. Performing sacrifices from all sides; procuring, granting.
6632: आयजिष्ठ a. Sacrificing or procuring best.
6634: आयागः A gift given at a sacrifice; °भूत a. obtained by sacrifice.
6635: आयत् {c1c} A. 1 To strive, endeavour. --2 To rest or depend on, rest with (with loc.); वयं त्वय्यायतामहे Mv. 1. 49, 3. 34; Dk. 42. --3 To arrive, come to, reach, dwell (Ved.).
6636: आयतनं [आयतंतेऽत्र, यत् आधारे ल्युट्] 1 Place, abode, house, resting-place; (fig. also); शूलायतनाः Mu. 7 hangmen; स्नेहस्तदेकायतनं जगाम Ku. 7. 5 was centred in her; R. 3. 36; सर्वाविनयानामेकैकमप्येषामायतनं K. 103; °मृगेण 130 domestic deer; Chāṇ. 32; (hence) a receptacle, home, support, seat. --2 The place of the sacred fire, altar, shed for sacrifices. --3 A sanctuary, sacred place; as in देवायतनं, मठायतनं &c. --4 The site of a house, groundplot. --5 A barn. --6 An inner seat (with Buddhists who consider the five senses with manas as the six Āyatanas). --7 The cause of disease.
6637: आयतनत्वं State of being an altar or seat.
6638: आयतनवत् a. Having a certain seat or home. --m. N. of the fourth foot of Brahmā.
6639: आयत्त p. p. [आ-यत्-क्त] 1 Dependent on, resting with (with loc. or in comp.); दैवायत्तं कुले जन्म मदायत्तं तु पौरुषं Ve. 3. 33; भाग्यायत्तमतः परं Ś. 4. 16. --2 Docile, tractable. --3 Attempted, tried; °ता, त्वं dependence, humility, docility.
6640: आयत्तिः f. [आ-यत्-क्तिन्] 1 Dependence, subjection. --2 Affection. --3 Strength, power, might. --4 Boundary, limit. --5 An expedient, remedy. --6 Majesty, dignity. --7 A day. --8 Steadiness of conduct, continuance in the right path. --9 Length. --10 Future time (These two senses should perhaps be referred to आयति q. v.).
6642: आयम् {c1c} U. 1 To extend, lengthen out, stretch out; वस्त्रं-पाणिंआयच्छते Sk.; स्वांगमायच्छमानः Ś. 4. v. l.; आयच्छति कूपाद्रज्जुं Sk. draws up; बाणमुद्यतमायसीत् Bk. 6. 119 stretched out. --2 To restrain, draw in (as breath &c.); Ms. 3. 217, 11. 100; Y. 1. 24. --3 To stretch oneself, to grow long (Atm.); P. I. 3. 28. --4 To grasp, possess; Bk. 8. 46. --5 To bring or lead towards. --Caus. 1 To lengthen, stretch, spread or draw out. --2 To remove, transplant.
6643: आयत p. p. 1 Long; दशांगुलमायता यष्टिः a stick ten fingers long; शतमध्यर्धं (योजनं) आयता Mb.; °स्वभावानि च दुःखानि K. 175 lasting. --2 Diffuse, prolix. --3 Big, large, great; Pt. 1. --4 Drawn, attracted. --5 Longdrawn, distant. --6 Curbed, restrained. --तः An oblong (in geometry). --तं ind. Deeply, long; as in आयतं निश्वस्य. --Comp. --अक्ष a. (क्षी f.), --ईक्षण, --नेत्र, --लोचन a. (a woman) with large eyes. --अपांग a. having long-cornered eyes. --अर्धः half an oblong. --आयतिः f. long continuance, remote futurity; Śi. 14. 5. --छदा a plantain tree. --लेख a. long-curved; Ku. 1. 47. --स्तूः m. [आयतं स्तौति, नि° दीर्घः] a panegyrist, bard.
6644: आयतिः f. 1 Length, extension. --2 Future time, the future; °भंग K. 55 (length also), 58, Dk. 29; भूयसी तव यदायतायतिः Śi. 14. 5; रहयत्यापदुपेतमायतिः Ki. 2. 14; Ms. 7. 169; अनायति क्षमं वचः Pt. 3. 112 imprudent, not good for the future; °ग्लानिभूतः Mu. 4. 12; स्थिर° Ki. 1. 23, permanent. --3 Future consequence or result; आयतिं सर्वकार्याणां तदात्वं च विचारयेत् Ms. 7. 178; Ki. 1. 15, 2. 43, 3. 43; Ki. 4. 21 fruit-yielding season. --4 Majesty, dignity. --5 Stretching the hand, accepting, obtaining. --6 Work (कर्मन्); यथा मित्रं ध्रुवं लब्ध्वा कृशमप्यायतिक्षमं Ms. 7. 208 (कर्मक्षमं Kull.). --7 Connection, junction. --8 Meeting, union. --9 Source, descent; तदायतिः Dk. 154 descended from him. --10 Restraint (of mind).
6645: आयतिमत् a. 1 Long, extended. --2 Dignified, majestic, stately. --3 Selfrestrained.
6646: आयंतृ m. Ved. One who approaches, one who fastens or raises.
6647: आयमनं 1 Length, extension. --2 Restraint, curbing. --3 Stretching (as a bow).
6648: आयामः [आ-यम् घञ्] 1 Length; तिर्यगायामाशोभी Me. 57. --2 Expansion, extension; Ki. 7. 6. --3 Stretching, extending. --4 Restraint, control, stopping; प्राणायामपरायणाः Bg. 4. 29; प्राणायामः परं तपः Ms. 2. 83.
6649: आयामवत् a. Extended, long; V. 1. 4; Śi. 12. 65.
6651: आयामिन् a. 1 One who restrains. --2 Long (in space or time); K. 25, 55; °यामासु Ki. 11. 48.
6653: आयवनं Ved. A spoon for stirring or any similar implement.
6655: आयस् {c4c} P. 1 To exert oneself; पिंडार्थमायस्यतः Mu. 3. 14. --2 To weary oneself, become exhausted or fatigued; नायस्यसि तपस्यंती Bk. 6. 69, 14. 104, 15. 54. --Caus. 1 To trouble, afflict; आयासयति मां जलाभिलाषः K. 35; Mu. 7. 8; V. 2. --2 To weary, tire out, worry. --3 To injure, affect; lessen, diminish; Bk. 8. 61. --4 To string (as a bow); अनायासितकार्मुकः Pt. 1. 385.
6656: आयस्त p. p. [यस्-क्त] 1 Pained, distressed, afflicted. --2 Hurt, injured, killed. --3 Vexed, angry. --4 Effected with difficulty. --5 Thrown, cast, sent forth. --6 Sharpened, whetted. --7 (Actively used) Toiling, labouring, exerting oneself.
6657: आयासः [आ-यस्-घञ्] 1 Effort, exertion, trouble, difficulty, pain, labour; बहुलायास Bg. 18. 24; cf. अनायास also. --2 Fatigue, weariness; स्नेहमूलानि दुःखानि देहजानि भयानि च । शोकहर्षौ तथायासः सर्वं स्नेहात् प्रवर्तते ॥ Mb. --3 Mental pain, anguish.
6658: आयासक a. [आ-यस्-ण्वुल्] Causing fatigue, wearisome; troublesome; Bh. 3. 58.
6659: आयासिन् a. [आ-यस्-णिनि] 1 Exhausted, fatigued. --2 Making exertions, striving; मनस्तु तद्भावदर्शनायासि Ś. 2. 1. v. l.
6660: आयस a. (सी f.) [अयसो विकारः अण्] 1 Made of iron, iron, metallic; आयसं दंडमेव वा Ms. 8. 315; सखि मा जल्प तवायसी रसज्ञा Bv. 2. 59. --2 Armed with an iron weapon. --सी A coat of mail, an armour for the body. --सं 1 Iron; मूढं बुद्धमिवात्मानं हैमीभूतमिवायसं Ku. 6. 55; स चकर्ष परस्मात्तदयत्कांत इवायसं R. 17. 63. --2 Anything made of iron. --3 A weapon. --4 A wind instrument.
6661: आयस्कारः The upper part of the thigh of an elephant.
6662: आया {c2c} P. 1 To come, arrive, approach. --2 To reach, attain, go to (any particular state); क्षयं, वशं, बधंन, तुलां &c. --3 To follow, result. --4 To be possible or practicable (with inf.).
6663: आयात a. Come, approached. --तं Excess, superabundance (उद्रेक); Ki. 5. 23.
6665: आयानं 1 Coming, arrival. --2 Natural temperament, disposition, nature.
6667: आयाचित a. Urgently requested or asked for.
6668: आयु a. [इ-उण् Uṇ. 1. 2] Ved. Living, going, moveable. --युः 1 A living being, man. --2 Mankind, human race. --3 Living beings taken collectively. --4 The first man. --5 Life, duration of life. --6 Wind. --7 A son, descendant, offspring. --8 The son of Purūravas and Urvaśī. --Comp. --षक् a. attached to; joined with men.
6669: आयुज् {c7c} U. or Caus. 1 To join, fasten or tie, yoke (to anything). --2 To appoint. --3 To fix or direct (the mind) towards; आयोजितस्तपस्यात्मा K. 173. --Caus. 1 To fix, or place; Rs. 2. 21. --2 To make or form; कुसुमायोजितकार्मुको मधुः Ku. 4. 24.
6670: आयुक्त p. p. 1 Appointed, charged with (with gen. or loc.); कुशलोऽन्वेषणस्याहमायुक्तो दूतकर्मणि Bk. 8. 115. --2 United, joined, obtained. --क्तः A minister, an agent or deputy.
