6671: आयोगः 1 Appointment, en trusting one with something. --2 Action, performance of an act. --3 Offering flowers, perfumes &c. --4 A shore or bank; a quay to which boats are attached. --5 Connection, union; स देशो भ्रमरायोगः प्रदीप इव लक्ष्यते Rām. --6 Obstruction (रोध).
6672: आयोजनं 1 Joining. --2 Taking. seizing. --3 Collecting. --4 Effort.
6673: आयुत a. 1 Mixed, mingled. --2 Melted. --तं Half-melted butter.
6674: आयुध् {c4c} A. To fight with, attack, oppose. --Caus. To oppose, attack, fight with; रथिनः पादचारमायोधयंति U. 5.
6675: आयुधः, --धं [आयुध् घञर्थेक] 1 A weapon, shield &c.; it is of {3} kinds (1) प्रहरण, e. g. a sword; (2) हस्तमुक्त, e. g. a disc; (3) यंत्रमुक्त, e. g. an arrow; न मेत्वदन्येन विसोढनायुधं R. 3. 63. --2 A vessel (Ved.). --धं 1 Gold used for ornaments. --2 (pl.) Water (Ved.). --Comp. (--अ) आगारं an armoury, arsenal; अहमप्यायुधागारं प्रविश्यायुधसहायो भवामि Ve. 1; Ms. 9. 280 --जीविन् a. living by one's weapon. (--m.) a warrior, soldier. --धर्मिणी the tree called जयंती (रोगनाशने तस्या आयुधधर्भत्वात्). --पिशाचिका ‘devil of arms,’ devilish warlike spirit; Mv. 3; A. R. 4; B. R. 4.
6676: आयुधिक a. Relating to arms. --कः [आयुधेन जीवति ठञ्] A soldier, warrior.
6677: आयुधिन्, आयुधीय a. [आयुध-इनि-छ] Bearing or using weapons. --धी, --धीयः A warrior; Śi. 18. 11.
6678: आयोधनं 1 A battle, fight, war; आयोधने कृष्णगतिं सहायं R. 6. 42; आयोधनाग्रसरतां त्वयि वीर याते 5. 71. --2 Battle-field; प्रययौ तूर्णमायोधनं प्रति Mb. --3 Slaughter, killing.
6679: आयुस् n. [इ-असि-णिच्च Uṇ. 2. 117] 1 Life, duration of life; दीर्घमायुः R. 9. 62, 12. 48; तक्षकेणापि दष्टस्य आयुर्मर्माणि रक्षति H. 2. 16; आयुर्वर्षशतं नृणां परिमितं Bh. 3. 107; शतायुर्वै पुरुषः Ait. Br.; प्राणो हि भूतानामायुः । तस्मात्सर्वायुषमुच्यते । सर्वमेव त आयुर्यांति T. Up. --2 Vital power. --3 Food. --4 N. of a ceremony called आयुष्टोम performed to secure long life. (In comp. the final स् of this word is changed to ष् before hard consonants, and to र् before soft ones). --Comp. --कर a. (री f.) promoting long life; K. 351. --काम a. wishing for long life or health. --कृत् a. giving or producing life. --द्रव्यं {1} a medicament. {2} ghee. --योगः N. of a योग in astronomy. --वृद्धिः f. long life, longevity. --वेदः [आयुरस्मिन् विद्यतेऽनेन वा आयुर्विदतीत्यायुर्वेदः Suśr.] the science of health or medicine, counted as a sacred science, and regarded as a supplement to the Atharvaveda; it comprises {8} different departments; (1) शल्यं surgery; (2) शालाक्यं diagnosis of diseases belonging to the head and its organs; (3) कायचिकित्सा treatment of diseases of the whole body; (4) भूतविद्या treatment of diseases of the mind supposed to be caused by the influence of evil spirits; (5) कौमारभृत्यं treatment of children; (6) अगदतंत्रं doctrine of antidotes; (7) रसायनतंत्रं doctrine of elixirs; and (8) वाजीकरणतंत्रं treatment of remedies to increase generative power. --वेददृश्, --वेदमय, --वेदिक, --वेदिन् a. {1} belonging to medicine. {2} acquainted with medical science, medical. (--m.) a physician. --शेषः {1} remainder of life; °शेषतया Pt. 1; °जीवित Pt. 4. being destined to live longer. {2} end or decline of life. --स्तोमः (आयुष्टोमः) a sacrifice performed to obtain long life.
6680: आयुष्मत् a. [आयुस् मतुप्] 1 Alive, living. --2 Long-lived; आयुष्मंतं सुतं सूते Ms. 3. 263. (Generally used in dramas by elderly persons in addressing a nobly-born person; e. g. a charioteer addresses a prince as आयुष्मन्. A Brāhmaṇa is also so addressed in saluting; cf. Ms. 2. 125; आयुष्मान् भव सौम्येति वाच्यो विप्रोऽमिवादने). --3 Lasting. --4 Old. --m. 1 The third of the 27 Yogas or divisions of the ecliptic. --2 The Yoga star कृत्तिका; the third lunar mansion.
6681: आयुषं (At the end of a few comps.) Life; e. g. पुरुषायुषजीविन्यः R. 1. 63.
6682: आयुष्कः [आयुः कायते, कै-क Tv.] 1 That which proclaims age or duration of life. --2 (With Jainas) Connection with the body or person.
6683: आयुष्य a. [आयुः प्रयोजनमस्य, यत्] Promoting long life, vital, preservative of life; इदं यशस्यमायुष्यमिदं निःश्रेयसं परं Ms. 1. 106, 3. 106, 4. 13; M. 4. 4 v. l.; Dk. 158. --ष्यं 1 Vital power, abundance of life or vigour. --2 N. of a ceremony performed after the birth of a child.
6684: आये ind. An interjection of calling, expressive of affection.
6685: आयोगवः [अयोगव एव, स्वार्थे अण्] The son of a Śūdra by a Vaiśya wife (his business being carpentry; cf Ms. 10. 48); शूद्रादायोगवः क्षत्ता चांडालश्चधमो नृणाम् । वैश्यराजन्यविप्रास्तु जायंते वर्णसंकराः ॥. --वी A woman of this tribe.
6686: आरः, --रं [आ-ऋ-घञ्] 1 Brass. --2 Oxide of iron. --3 An angle, corner. --4 N. of a tree (मधुराम्रफल). --रः 1 The planet Mars. --2 The planet Saturn. --3 Going. --4 Distance. --5 Nearness, as in आरात् q. v. --6 Extremity (प्रांतभाग). --रा (आ-ऋ-अच्) 1 A shoemaker's awl. --2 A knife, probe, instrument of iron. --3 A spoke; cf. अर. --4 A goad, or whip; उद्यम्यारामग्रकायोत्थितस्य Śi. 18. 7. --Comp. --अग्र {1} the point of an awl. {2} the iron thong at the end of a whip. --आवलिः N. of a chain of mountains, a part of the Vindhya. --कूटः, --टं brass; U. 5. 14.
6688: आरक्ष a. Preserved, defended, fit to be protected. --क्षः, --क्षा 1 Protection, preservation, guard; आरक्षे मध्यमे स्थितान् Rām;  Śānti. 3. 5; Ms. 3. 204. --2 The junction of the frontal sinuses of an elephant (कंभसंधि). --3 The part of the forehead below this junction. --4 An army.
6689: आरक्ष(क्षि)कः 1 A watchman, patrol, sentinel. --2 A village or police magistrate.
6690: आरग्वधः The tree Cassia Fistula (Mar. बाहवा) largely used in medicinal recipes. --धं Its fruit.
6691: आरचित a. Arranged, prepared, formed &c; see रचित.
6693: आरट्टः 1 N. of a country to the north-east of Panjab, famous for its breed of horses; (the people of Guzarath in Rāvalpinḍi still call their country Hairat or Airatdeśa); the inhabitants of this country (pl.). --2 A horse from this country.
6694: आरणं Ved. 1 Depth, abyss. --2 A precipice.
6696: आरणेय a. (यी f.) [अरणि-ठक्] Relating to or sprung from Araṇi q. v. --यः N. of Śuka. --यं or °पर्वन् Title of the last section of the third book of the Mahābhārata.
6697: आरण्य a. (ण्या, --ण्यी f.) [अरण्ये भवः ण्] Wild, forest-born, relating to a forest (opp. ग्राम्य); °पशुः Ms. 10. 48; (आरण्यपशु is of {7} kinds: --सरीसृपो रुरुश्चैव महिषो वानरस्तथा । पृषतर्क्षौ मृगश्चैव पशुर्वै सप्तधा मतः ।) --ण्यः, --ण्यं 1 A forest. --2 A kind of corn growing without sowing seed. --3 N. of certain signs of the zodiac (see °राशि below). --4 Cow-dung (--ण्यः only). --5 N. of a Parvan in the Mahābhārata. --6 N. of a Kāṇḍa in the Rāmāyaṇa. --Comp. --कुक्कुटः a wild cock. --गानं one of the four Gānas or psalmbooks of the Sāma-veda --पर्वन् n. N. of the third book of the Mahābhārata, usually called Vana-Parvan. --पशुः a wild beast. --मुद्गा a kind of bean. --राशिः (in the zodiac) {1} the signs Leo, Aries, and Taurus. {2} the former half of Capricorn.
6698: आरण्यक a. [अरण्ये भवः वुञ्] Relating to or produced in a forest, wild, forest-born (usually with the words अध्याय, मनुष्य, न्याय, पथिन्, विहार, and हस्तिन् P. IV. 2. 129 Vārt). --कः A forester, an inhabitant of the woods; तपःषड्भागमक्षय्यं ददत्यारण्यका हि नः Ś. 2. 13; R. 5. 15. --कं An Āraṇyaka; it is one of a class of religious and philosophical writings (connected with the Brāhmaṇas) which are either composed in forests, or must be studied there; e. g. ऐतरेयारण्यकं, बृहदारण्यकं and तैत्तिरीयारण्यकं; अरण्येऽ नूच्यमानत्वात् आरण्यकं Bṛ. Ār. Up.; (अरण्येऽ ध्ययनादेव आरण्यकमुदाहृतं). --Comp. --कांडं the title of the third book of the Rāmāyaṇa.
6699: आरथः [ईषत्स्वल्यो रथः] A carriage drawn by one horse or ox.
6700: आरनालं Gruel made from the fermentation of boiled rice.
6701: आरभ् {c1c} A. 1 To begin, commence, undertake; आरभंतेऽल्पमेवाज्ञाः Subhāṣ.; आरब्धा बलिविग्रहं Bk. 5. 38. --2 To be active or energetic, be busy; अप्यनारभमाणस्य Śi. 2. 91. --3 To rely on. --4 To reach or attain to, obtain. --5 To seize, grasp. --6 To form, make; भूतैः पंचभिरारब्धे देहे Bhāg.
6702: आरब्ध p. p. Begun, commenced. --ब्धं Beginning.
6704: आरभटः [आरभ्-अटि] An enterprising or courageous man. --टः, --टी Boldness, confidence. --टी 1 A branch of the dramatic art, machinery of the drama, representation of supernatural, horrible events on the stage; मायेंद्रजालंसग्रामक्रोधोद्भ्रांतादिचेष्टितैः संयुक्ता वधबंधाद्यैरुद्धतारभटी मता ॥ (said to be of four kinds, see S. D. 420 et seq.) --2 A kind of literary style (वृत्ति). --3 A particular style of dancing.
6705: आरभ्य ind. Having begun, beginning with, ever since, since, with a prepositional force (with abl.); मालत्याः प्रथमावलोकदिवसादारभ्य Māl. 6. 3; Ś. 3; K. 102, 134, 196; sometimes with acc. also; प्रतिपद्दिनमारभ्य Bhāg.
6706: आरंभः [आ रभ्-घञ् मुम्] 1 Beginning, commencement; °उपायः plan of commencement; नृत्यारंभे हर पशुपतेरार्द्रनागाजिनेच्छां Me. 99. --2 An introduction. --3 (a) An act, undertaking, deed, work; आगमैः सदृशारंभः R. 1. 15; Ku. 7. 71; V. 3; Bh. 2. 69; R. 7. 31; Bg. 12. 16. (b) Preparation; U. 4. (c) A thing begun; U. 4. --4 Haste, speed, velocity; चंडारंभः समीरः Ve. 2. 18. --5 Effort, exertion; Bg. 14. 12. --6 Scene, action; चित्रार्पितारंभ इवावतस्थे R. 2. 31. --7 Pride. --8 Killing, slaughter.
6708: आरंभणं [आ-रभ् ल्युट् मुम्] 1 Taking hold of, seizing. --2 The place of seizing, a handle.
6709: आरंभिन् a. Enterprizing; one who forms new projects.
6710: आरम् {c1c} P. 1 To delight in, take pleasure in, sport; आरमंतं परं स्मरे Bk. 8. 52, 3. 38. --2 To cease, stop (to speak); leave off; विरामोऽस्त्विति चारमेत् Ms. 2. 73. --3 To rest, take rest.
6711: आरत p. p. 1 Stopped, ceased; Ki. 5. 6; see अनारत also. --2 Quiet, gentle.
6712: आरतिः f. 1 Cessation, stopping. --2 Waving lights before an image (Mar. आरती).
6713: आरमणं 1 Taking delight. --2 Cessation, pause. --3 A resting place.
6714: आराम a. [रम्-घञ्] Pleasing, delightful; रामभद्र गुणाराम Mv. 7. 40. --मः 1 Delight, pleasure; इंद्रियारामः Bg. 3. 16; आत्मारामाः Ve. 1. 31; एकाराम Y. 3. 58. --2 A garden, grove; प्रियारामा हि वैदेह्यासीत् U. 2; आरामाधिपतिर्विवेकविकलः Bv. 1. 31. [cf. Pers. ārām]. --Comp. --शीतला N. of a fragrant plant (आनंदी).
6720: आरात् ind. [आ-रा-बा° आति Tv.; abl. of आर q. v.] 1 Near, in the vicinity of; (with abl. or by itself); तमर्च्यमारादभिवर्तमानं R. 2. 10; 5. {3} --2 Far from; with acc. also in both these senses; Śi. 3. 31, 8. 29, 12. 28; to a distant place, distant. --3 Far, from a distance; U. 2. 24. --4 Directly, immediately.
6721: आरातीय a. [आरात्-छ; P. IV. 2. 104 Vārt.] 1 Near, proximate. --2 Remote, distant.
6722: आरात्तात् ind. Ved. From a distant place.
6724: आरात्रिकं [अरात्रावपि निर्वृत्तं ठञ्] 1 Waving a light (or the vessel containing it) at night before an idol (Mar. आरती ॐवाळणें); सर्वेषु चांगेषु च सप्तवारान् आरात्रिकं भक्तजनस्तु कुर्यात्. --2 The light so waved; शिरसि निहितभारं पात्रमारात्रिकस्य भ्रमयति मयि भूयस्ते कृपार्द्रः कटाक्षः Śaṅkara.
6725: आराध् {c5c} {c10c} P. 1 To propitiate, conciliate, please, try to win the favour of; परेषां चेतांसि प्रतिदिवसमाराध्य बहुधा Bh. 3. 34, 2. 4-5; R. 1. 77, 81, 10. 86, 18. 23; Me. 45. --2 To honour, worship, respect. --3 To deserve, merit.
6727: आराधनं 1 Pleasing, satisfaction, entertainment, gratification; येषामाराधनाय U. 1; यदि वा जानकीमपि आराधनाय लोकानां मुंचतो नास्ति मे व्यथा 1. 12, 41. --2 Serving, worshipping, adoration, propitiation (as of a deity); आराधनायास्य सखीसमेताम् Ku. 1. 58; Bg. 7. 22; कृतमाराधनं रवेः Mb. --3 A means of pleasing; इदं तु ते भक्तिनम्रं सतामाराधनं वपुः Ku. 6. 73. --4 Honouring, respecting; U. 4. 17. --5 Cooking. --6 Accomplishment, undertaking. --7 Acquirement, attainment; Bh. 3. 4. --ना Service. --नी Worship, adoration, propitiation (of a deity).
6728: आराधनीय, आराध्य pot. p. Fit to be worshipped or propitiated; R. 16. 82.
6729: आराधयितृ a. An adorer, humble servant, worshipper; तन्वयमाराधयिता जनस्तव समीपे वर्तते Ś. 3; पितरमाराधयिता भव V. 5.
6730: आराधयिष्णु a. Endeavouring to please, desirous of worshipping.
6731: आरालिकः [अरालं कुटिलं चरति ठक्] ‘One who deals crookedly’, a cook; (धनलोभेन परप्रोत्साहितः पाचको विषादिसंसृष्टं पचतीति तस्य तथात्वं).
6733: आरेकः [आ-रिच् घञ्] 1 Emptying. --2 Contraction. --3 Doubt. --4 Excess.
6734: आरेचित a. [अ-रिच्-णिच् क्त] 1 Emptied. --2 Mixed. --3 Contracted; आरेचितभ्रूचतुरैः कटाक्षैः Ku. 3. 5.
6735: आरित्रिक a. [P. IV. 2. 116] Pertaining to an oar &c.
6736: आरु {c2c} P. 1 To cry out, shout; Ki. 17. 24, to low (as cows). --2 To praise.
6737: आर(रा)वः [आ-रु-अप् पक्षे घञ्] 1 A cry, howling; वानराश्चक्रुरारवं Rām. --2 Sound; Śi. 11. 8, 12. 18, 8. 45. --3 N. of a people.
6738: आराविन् a. Sounding, noisy; नूपुराराविणा M. 3. 16.
6739: आरुः [ऋ-उण्] 1 A hog. --2 A crab. --3 N. of a tree. --रुः f. A pitcher.
6740: आरुकः A medicinal plant having cooling properties (growing on the Himālayas).
6741: आरुच् Caus. To regard as pleasant, choose, like; वासं नारोचयेऽरण्ये Rām.
6742: आरोकः 1 Shining through. --2 Small points of light between the threads of a web.
6744: आरुज्, --ज a. [आ-रुज्-क] 1 Distressing, giving pain. --2 Killing, destroying, breaking.
6746: आरुणि a. [अरुणस्य अपत्यं इण्] Belonging to, or sprung from, Aruṇa, q. v. --णिः 1 N. of Uddālaka. --2 Descendants of the sage अरुण. --3 The son of the sun, as Yama. --4 The son of Vinatā (वैनतेय).
6747: आरुणी f. Ved. ‘The red one’, a name given to the horses of the Maruts which are females.
6748: आरुध् {c7c} U. 1 To keep or ward off, keep away, restrain; बंधुता शुचमारुणत् Bk. 17. 49. --2 To shut up, confine. --3 To besiege. --4 To hold fast, grasp. --Caus. To obstruct, impede, block, besiege.
6749: आरोधनं Ved. Obstruction, means of obstruction.
6750: आरुषी N. of a daughter of Manu and the mother of और्व.
6751: आरुष्करं The fruit of the tree called भल्लातक q. v.
6752: आरुह् {c1c} P. 1 To ascend, mount, bestride, get upon (with acc., sometimes loc.); सिंहासनमारुरोह K. 111; आरुरुहू रथादिषु Bk. 14. 8; आरूढकुलालचक्रमिव Mu. 5. 5 mounted on a potter's wheel; 7. 12. --2 To ride upon, get ascendancy over, domineer over (fig.); वृषल भृत्यमिव मामारोढुमिच्छसि Mu. 3; Pt. 1. 36. --3 To venture upon, undertake, enter upon, make; प्रतिज्ञामारोढुं पुनरपि चलत्येष चरणः Mu. 3. 30, 27; so यौवनारूढ, योगारूढ. --4 To attain, gain, get to, reach; सौंदर्यस्य पारमारूढा न वा Dk. 88; Ki. 2. 13; तुलां यदारोहतिदंतवाससा Ku. 5. 34; आरुरोह कुमुदाकरोपमां R. 19. 34. The senses of this root are modified according to the noun with which it is joined; आरूढरुषा Ku. 7. 67 excited to anger; तदागमारूढगुरुप्रहर्षः R. 5. 61; मंत्रिपदमारूढः Mu. 6; तर्कारूढा 6. 19 engaged in guessing; Ś. 5. 9; शीघ्रं बुद्धिमारोहति Ś. B. strikes the mind; यौवनपदवीमारूढः attained his majority; अवस्थांतरमारूढा M. 3; संशयं पुनरारुह्य H. 1. 7 running a risk; संशयमारुरोह शैलः Ki. 13. 16. --Caus. (रोह-प-यति) 1 To cause to go up or ascend, raise up, elevate; अमात्योऽस्मान्पुरातनीमवस्थामारोपयिष्यति Mu. 2 will raise or elevate; शूलानारोपयेत् Y. 2. 273; आरोपितामनोविषयमात्मनः Ku. 6. 17. --2 To cause to mount or sit (on oneself) (Atm.); करेणुरारोहयते निषादिनं Śi. 12. 5. --3 To cause to grow, plant (lit.). --4 To establish, instal, seat (fig.); राज्ये चारोपिता वयं Mu. 7. 18; इत्यारोपितपुत्रास्ते R. 15. 91. --5 To cause, produce, bring out; उष्माणं K. 105; प्रणयं 134, 142; आरोपितप्रीतिरभूत् 173, 212; प्रतापमारोपयितुं 110, 119 show or exhibit. --6 To place, fix, direct; अंकमारोप्य placing in the lap; R. 3. 26, 14. 27; Ku. 1. 37; चक्षुः° cast a look at; Pt. 1. 243; आशीर्वादमारोपयंतः Ki. 18. 46 conferring or pronouncing; आभरणभारमंगेषु नारोपयंति K. 203 put or wear; पत्रे आरोपितं कुरु Ś. 6 commit to paper; आरोप्यते शिला शैले H. 2. 47. --7 To entrust to, appoint to, charge with; मंत्रिणि राज्यभारमारोप्य K. 57; अमात्यपदे आरोपितः Pt. 1. --8 To cause to go to or attain a particular state; करतलं कर्णपूरतामारोपितं K. 60; आरोपय गरीयस्त्वं 207 raise to greatness; 315; Dk. 118. --9 To ascribe, attribute, impute; आत्मन्यारोपिताभिमानाः K. 108, 185; छाया हि भूमेः शशिनो मलत्वेनारोपिता शुद्धिमतः प्रजाभिः R. 14. 40. --10 To string (as a bow); धनुरारोपयन् U. 4; तं देशमारोपितपुष्पचापे Ku. 3. 35; Bk. 14. 8.
6753: आरुरुक्षु a. Wishing to ascend, mount or reach; कैलासगौरं वृषमारुरुक्षोः R. 2. 35; योगं Bg. 6. 3.
6754: आरुह् a. Ved. Ascending. --f. 1 Excrescence. --2 A shoot (of a plant).
6756: आरूढ p. p. 1 Mounted, ascended; seated on; आरूढो वृक्षो भवता Sk.; oft. used actively; आरूढमद्रीन् R. 6. 77; Me. 8, 18; Ś. 4; so वृक्षं, नावं, हयं, रथं &c.; चक्र°, दोला°. --2 Raised up, elevated on high. --3 Arisen, produced. --ढं Ascending, mounting; see अत्यारूढ.
6757: आरूढिः f. Ascent, mounting; rise, elevation (lit. and fig.); अत्यारूढिर्भवति महतामप्यपभ्रंशनिष्ठा Ś. 4. v. l.
6758: आरोपः 1 Attributing the nature or properties of one thing to another; वस्तुन्यवस्त्वारोपोऽध्यारोपः Vedānta S.; attributing or assigning to, imputation; दोषारोपो गुणेष्वपि Ak. --2 Considering as equal; identification (as in सारोपा लक्षणा). --3 Superimposition. --4 Imposing (as a burden), burdening or charging with. --5 Placing in or upon. --6 Relating to. --7 Superior position.
6760: आरोपणं 1 Placing or fixing in or upon, putting; आर्द्राक्षतारोपणमन्वभूतां R. 7. 28; Ku. 7. 88; (fig.) establishing, installing; अधिकारारोपणं Mu. 3. --2 Causing to mount or ascend, raising (to heaven). --3 Planting. --4 The stringing of a bow. --5 Trusting, delivering.
6761: आरोपित p. p. 1 Raised, elevated. --2 Fixed, placed, made. --3 Strung (as a bow). --4 Deposited, entrusted. --5 Consecrated, hallowed. --6 Accidental, adventitious, ascribed.
6762: आरोहः [आ-रुह्-घञ्] 1 One who mounts, a rider, as in अश्वारोह, स्यंदनारोह; सारोहाणां च वाजिनां Rām.; one who is seated in a carriage. --2 Ascent, rising, mounting, ascending, riding. --3 An elevated place, elevation, altitude, height; नगाद्यारोह उच्छ्रायः Ak. --4 Haughtiness, pride. --5 A mountain, a heap. --6 A woman's waist; the buttocks; सा रामा न वरारोहा Udb.; आरोहैर्निबिडबृहन्नितंबबिंबैः Śi. 8. 8. --7 Length. --8 A kind of measure. --9 A mine. --10 Descending.
6763: आरोहक a. 1 Ascending, mounting, riding. --2 Raising up, elevating. --3 Rising. --कः 1 A rider, driver; हस्त्यारोहकः Pt. 2. --2 A tree.
6764: आरोहणं 1 The act of rising, ascending, mounting; आरोहणार्थं नवयौवनेन कामस्य सोपानमिव प्रयुक्तं Ku. 1. 39. --2 Riding (on a horse &c). --3 A stair-case, ladder. --4 The rising or growing of new shoots, growing (of plants). --5 A raised stage for dancing. --6 A carriage (Ved.).
6765: आरोहणिक a. Relating to mounting or ascending.
6767: आरू a. Of a tawny colour. --रू m. 1 The tawny colour. --2 A hog; a crab; see आरु. --3 N. of a medicinal plant on the Himālaya.
6768: आरे ind. Ved. 1 Far, far from, (with abl.). --2 Near. --Comp. --अघ a. Ved. having evil far removed. --अवद्य a. one from whom blame is far removed. --शत्रु a. one whose enemies are driven far away.
6769: आरेवतः N. of a tree(आरग्बघ q. v.). --तं The fruit of this tree.
6771: आरोग्यं [अरोगस्य भावः ष्यञ्] Freedom from disease, good health --Comp. --शाला an hospital.
6772: आर्किः [अर्कस्य अपत्यं इञ्] A son of अर्क, epithet of (1) Yama, (2) the planet Saturn, (3) Karṇa, (4) Sugrīva, (5) वैवस्वतमनु.
6773: आर्क्ष (र्क्षी f.) [ऋक्षस्येदं अण्] Stellar, regulated by stars or pertaining to them. --र्क्षः A son or descendant of Ṛkṣa. --Comp. --वर्षः a stellar year or revolution of a constellation.
6775: आर्गलः --ली [अर्गलमेव स्वार्थे अण्] A bolt or bar; see अर्गलं.
6777: आर्घा [आ-अर्घ-अच्] A kind of yellow bee.
6778: आर्घ्य a. Relating to this bee. --र्घ्यं Wild honey.
6779: आर्च a. (र्ची f.) [अर्चा अस्त्यस्य ण P. V. 2. 101] 1 Devout, worshipping, pious. --2 Relating to, the Ṛk or Ṛgveda.
6780: आर्चिक a. (की f.) [ऋचि भवः. ऋचो व्याख्यानो ग्रंथो वा ठञ्] Relating to the Ṛgveda, or explaining it. --कं An epithet of the Sāma-Veda.
6781: आर्चीक a. [ऋचीके पर्वते भवः अण्] Belonging to the ऋचीक mountain. --कः The mountain ऋचीक.
6782: आर्जवं [ऋजोर्भावः अण्] 1 Straightness; दूरं यात्युदरं च रोमलतिका नेत्रार्जवं धावति S. D. --2 Straightforwardness, rectitude of conduct, uprightness, honesty, sincerity, open-heartedness; अहिंसा क्षांतिरार्जवं Bg. 13. 7; क्षेत्रमार्जवस्य K. 45; Bh. 2. 22. --3 Simplicity, humility; Ki. 4. 13; Mv. 5. 46.
6783: आर्जीक a. [ऋजीकस्येदं अण्] Belonging to the ऋजीक country, or a vessel called ऋजीक. --कः A lake in the ऋजोक country; (according to others) perhaps a milk-vessel or celestial-vessel in which the heavenly Soma is purified.
6784: आर्जीकीय = आजींक a. --या 1 A terrestrial river. --2 N. of a river (विपाशा.)
6785: आर्जुनिः [अर्जुनस्य अपत्यं इञ्] The son of Arjuna, अभिमन्यु.
6786: आर्त a. [आ-ऋ-क्त] 1 Afflicted with, struck by, suffering from, pained by; usually in comp., कामार्त, क्षुधार्त तृषार्त &c. --2 Sick, diseased; आर्तस्य यथौषधं R. 1. 28; Ms. 4. 236. --3 Distressed, afflicted, struck by calamity, oppressed, unhappy; आर्तत्राणाय वः शस्त्रं न ग्रहर्तुमनागसि Ś. 1. 11, R. 2. 28, 8. 31, 12. 10, 32. --4 Perishable (विनाशिन्). --Comp. --नादः, --ध्वनिः, स्वरः a cry of distress, --बधुः, --साधुः a friend of the distressed.
6787: आर्तिः f. [आ-ऋ-क्तिन्] 1 Distress, affliction, suffering, pain, injury (bodily or mental); आर्तिं न पश्यसि पुरूरवसस्तदर्थे V. 2. 16; आपन्नार्तिप्रशमनफलाः संपदो ह्युत्तमानां Me. 53. --2 Mental agony, anguish; उत्कंठार्ति Amaru. 39. --3 Evil, mischief. --4 Sickness, disease. --5 The end of a bow. --6 Ruin, destruction.
6788: आर्तिमत् a. Suffering from pain, afflicted.
6789: आर्तगलः N. of a tree नीलझिंटी.
6790: आर्तना Ved. 1 A mortal combat. --2 An uncultivated ground.
6791: आर्तव a. (वा वी f.) [ऋतुरस्य प्राप्तः, अण्] 1 Conforming or relating to the season; seasonal; अभिभूय विभूतिमार्तवीं R. 8. 36, स्वयमंगेषु ममेदमार्तवं Ku. 4. 68; V. 1. 13; vernal; R. 9. 28, 48. --2 Menstrual, relating to or produced by this discharge. --वः A section of the year, a combination of several seasons (Ved.). --वी A mare. --वं 1 The menstrual discharge (of women); नोपगच्छेत्प्रमत्तोऽपि स्त्रियमार्तवदर्शने Ms. 4. 40, 3. 48. --2 Certain days after menstrual discharge, favourable to conception. --3 A flower.
6792: आर्तवेयी A woman during her courses.
6793: आर्त्निः The end of a bow.
6794: आर्त्विजीन a. (नी f.) [ऋत्विजं तत्कर्मार्हति खञ्] Fit for the office of a sacrificial priest (ऋत्विज्).
6795: आर्त्विज्यं [ऋत्विजो भावः कर्म वा ष्यञ्] The office of a priest, his rank.
6796: आर्थ a. (र्थी f.) [अर्थादागतः अण्] 1 Relating to a thing or object. --2 Relating to, dependent on, sense (opp. शाब्द); आर्थि उपमा &c. --3 Material, significant.
6797: आर्थपत्यं Power over a thing, possession of a thing.
6798: आर्थिक a. (की f.) [अर्थं गृह्णाति ठक्] 1 Significant. --2 Wise. --3 Rich. --4 Substantial, real, material.
6799: आर्द्र a. [आ-अर्द्-रक् दीर्घश्च Uṇ. 2. 18] 1 Wet, moist, damp, तंत्रीमार्द्रां नयनसलिलैः Me. 86, 43; आर्द्राक्षतारोपणमन्वभृतां R. 7. 28. --2 Succulent. living, not dry, green, juicy; आर्द्रं द्रव्यं द्विधा प्रोक्तं सरसं नीरसं तथा. --3 Fresh, new; कानीवार्द्रापराधः Amaru. 2; कांतमार्द्रापराधं M. 3. 12; R. 14. 4. --4 Soft, tender; oft. used with words like स्नेह, दया, करुणा in the sense of ‘flowing with,’ moved’, ‘melted’; स्नेहार्द्रं हृदयं a heart wet or melted with pity; करुणा°, दया°; प्रेमार्द्राः चेष्टाः Māl. 5. 7. --5 Full of feeling, warm. --6 Loose, flaccid. --र्द्रा N. of a constellation or the sixth lunar mansion so called (consisting of one star). [cf. Gr. ardo]. --Comp. --काष्ठं green wood. --दानु a. Ved. giving moisture. --नयन a. weeping --पदी a woman with wet feet. --पवित्र a. Ved. having a wet strainer, epithet of the Soma. --पृष्ठ a. watered, refreshed; आर्द्रपृष्ठाः क्रियंतां वाजिनः Ś. 1. --माषा a. leguminous shrub (माषपर्णी). --शाकं fresh ginger. --लुब्धकः (°र्द्रा° the dragon's tail or descending node, N. of Ketu.
6800: आर्द्रता Wetness, moisture, freshness, tenderness, softness.
6801: आर्द्रक a. (की f.) Born under the constellation Ārdrā; cf. P. IV. 3. 28. --कं Ginger in its undried state, wet ginger (Mar. आलें).
6802: आर्द्रयति Den. P. To wet, moisten; Bh. 2. 51.
6803: आर्ध a. (Only used at the beginning of comp.) Half. --Comp. --धातुक a. (की f.) (In gram.) applicable to half the root or to the shorter form of the verbal base. (--कं) a name given to those terminations and affixes which belong to the six non-conjugational or general tenses (opp. सार्वधातुक); cf. P. III. 4. 114, I. 1. 4; II. 4. 35; VII. 2. 35 &c. --प्रस्थिक, --कंसिक a. (--की f.) bought with half a Prastha or Kaṃsa. --मासिक a. (की f.) lasting for half a month, observing or practising (penance &c.) for a fortnight. --रात्रिकाः (pl.) N. of an astronomical school who reckoned the beginning of the motions of the planets from midnight.
6804: आर्धिक a. (की f.) [अर्धमर्हति ठक्] Sharing half, relating to a half. --कः One who ploughs the land for half the crop; one born of a Vaiśya woman, and brought up by a Brāhmaṇa; see the quotation under आर्धिक.
6805: आर्धुक a. (की f.) Ved. Conducive to success, beneficial, profitable.
6806: आर्पयितृ m. Ved. One who injures or hurts.
6807: आर्भव a. (वी f.) Belonging or sacred to the Ṛbhus.
6808: आर्य a. [ऋ-ण्यत्] 1 Āryan. --2 Worthy of an Ārya. --3 Worthy, venerable, respectable, honourable, noble, high; यदार्यमस्यामभिलाषि मे मनः Ś. 1. 22; so आर्यवेषः respectable dress; oft. used in theatrical language as an honorific adjective and a respectful mode of address; आर्यचाणक्यः, आर्या अरुंधती &c.; आर्य revered or honoured Sir; आर्ये revered or honoured lady. The following rules are laid down for the use of आर्य in addressing persons:-- (1) वाच्यौ नटीसूत्रधारावार्यनाम्ना परस्परं । (2) वयस्येत्युत्तमैर्वाच्यो मव्यैरार्येति चाग्रजः । (3) ( वक्तव्यो) अमात्य आर्येति घेतरैः । (4) स्वेच्छया नाममिविंप्रैविंप्र आर्येति चेतरैः । S. D. 431. --4 Noble, fine, excellent. --र्यः 1 N. of the Hindu and Iranian people, as distinguished from अनार्य, दस्यु and दासः विजानीह्यार्याव्ये च दरयवः Rv. 1. 51. 8. --2 A man who is faithful to the religion and laws of his country; कर्तव्यमाचरन् कार्यमकर्तव्यमनाचरन् । तिष्ठति प्रकृताचारे स वा आर्य इति स्मृतः ॥. --3 N. of the first three castes (as opp. to शूद्र). --4 A respectable or honourable man, esteemed person; वृत्तेन हि भवत्यार्यो न धनेन न विद्यया Mb. --5 A man of noble birth. --6 A man of noble character. --7 A master, owner. --8 A preceptor. --9 A friend. --10 A Vaiśya. --11 A father-in-law (as in आर्यपुंत्र). --12 A Buddha. --13 (With the Buddhists) A man who has thought on the four chief principles of Buddhism and lives according to them. --14 A son of Manu Sāvarṇa. --र्या 1 N. of Pārvatī. --2 A mother-in-law. --3 A respectable woman. --4 N. of a metre, see Appendix. --Comp. --अष्टशतं title of a work of Ārya Bhaṭṭa consisting of eight hundred verses. --आवर्तः [आर्या आवर्तंते अत्र] ‘abode of the noble or excellent (Āryas);’ particularly N. of the tract extending from the eastern to the western ocean, and bounded on the north and south by the Himālaya and Vindhya respectively; cf. Ms. 2. 22; आसमुद्रात्तु वै पूर्वादासमुद्राच्च पश्चिमात् । तयोरेवांतरं गिर्योः (हिमवद्विंध्ययोः) आर्यावर्तं विदुर्बुधाः; also 10. 34. --गृह्य a. [आर्यस्य गृह्यः पक्षः] {1} to be respected by the noble {2} a friend of the noble, readily accessible to honourable men; तमार्यगृह्यं निगृहीतधेनुः R. 2. 33. {3} respectable, right, decorous. --देशः a country inhabited by the Āryas. --पुत्रः {1} son of an honourable man. {2} the son of a spiritual preceptor. {3} honorific designation of the son of the elder brother; of a husband by his wife; or of a prince by his general &c. {4} the son of the father-in-law, i. e. a husband (occurring in every drama; mostly in the vocative case in the last two senses). --प्राय a. {1} inhabited by the Āryas. {2} abounding with respectable people. --भट्टः N. of a renowned astronomer, the inventor of Algebra among the Hindus; he flourished before the 5th century of the Christian era. --भावः honourable character or behaviour. --मार्गः the path or course of the respectable, a respectable way. --मिश्र a. respectable, worthy, distinguished. (--श्रः) a gentleman, a man of consequence; (pl.) {1} worthy or respectable men, an assembly of honourable men; आर्यमिश्रान् विज्ञापयामि V. 1. {2} your reverence or honour (a respectful address); नन्वार्यमिश्रैः प्रथममेव आज्ञप्तं Ś. 1; आर्यमिश्राः प्रमाणं M. 1. --युवन् m. an Āryan youth. --रूप a. having only the form of an Āryan, a hypocrite, impostor. --लिंगिन् m. an impostor; Ms. 9. 260. --वृत्त a. virtuous, good, pious; Ms. 9. 253; R. 14. 55. (--त्तं) the conduct of an Āryan or nobleman; Ms. 4. 175. --वेश a. well-clothed, having a respectable dress, fine. --व्रत a. observing the laws and ordinances of the Āryans or noblemen. (--तं) the duty of an Āryan. --श्वेतः a noble or honourable man. --संघः the whole body of the Āryans. --सत्यं a noble or sublime truth; (there are four such truths forming the chief principles of Buddhism). --हलं ind. [cf. P. I. 1. 47] forcibly. --हृद्य a. liked by the noble.
6809: आर्यकः [आर्य-स्वार्थे-कन्] 1 An honourable or respectable man. --2 A grand-father. --3 N. of a cow-herd who became a king; cf. Mk. 7. --कं A ceremony performed to the manes or the vessel used in sacrifices to the manes.
6810: आर्यका, आर्यिका 1 A respectable woman. --2 N. of a Nakṣatra.
6812: आर्श a. Belonging to the antelope.
6813: आर्ष a. (र्षी f.) [ऋषेरिदं अण्] 1 Used by a Ṛṣi only, relating or belonging to sages, archaic, Vedic (opp. लौकिक or classical); आर्षःप्रयोगः; संबुद्धौ शाकल्यस्येतावनार्षे Sk.; आर्षो धर्मः Ms. 3. 29; Y. 1. 59; आर्षः प्रत्ययः P. II. 4. 58. --2 Sacred, holy, divine, superhuman; U. 6. --र्षः A form of marriage derived from the Ṛṣis; one of the eight forms of marriage in which the father of the bride receives one or two pairs of cows from the bride-groom; आदायार्षस्तु गोद्वयम् Y. 1. 59; Ms. 3. 53, 9. 196; for the names of the {8} forms see उद्वाह; आर्षोढा a wife married according to this form. --र्षा A class of Vedic metres. --र्षं 1 The holy text, the Vedas. --2 Sacred descent. --3 Derivation (of a poem) from a Ṛṣi author.
6814: आर्षेय a. (यी f.) [ऋषि-ढक्] 1 Relating to a Ṛṣi. --2 Worthy, venerable, respectable. --यं 1 Sacred descent. --2 A collection of Ṛṣis (ऋषिसमूहः).
6815: आर्षभ a. (भी f.) [ऋषभ-अण्] Derived from or produced by a bull; Ms. 9. 50.
6816: आर्षभ्यः [ऋषभ-ञ्य] A steer sufficiently full-grown to be used or let loose, one fit to be castrated.
6817: आर्हत a. (ती f.) [अर्हत्-अण्] Belonging to the Jaina doctrines. --तः A Jaina, a follower of Jaina doctrines. --तं The doctrines of the Jainas.
6818: आर्हत्यं The quality or practice of an Arhat.
6820: आल a. [आ-अल्-पर्याप्तौ अच्] Large, extensive. --लः, --लं 1 Spawn, any discharge of venomous matter from poisonous animals; °अक्त anointed with poison as an arrow. --2 Trick, fraud; येषां श्रुतमालजालाय K. 288; °जालानि चिंतयंती 310. --3 Yellow arsenic, orpiment.
6823: आलक्ष्य pot. p. 1 Visible, apparent; R. 13. 30. --2 Slightly visible; °दंतमुकुलान् Ś. 7. 17.
6825: आलगर्दः [अलगर्द एव स्वार्थे अण्] A water cobra.
6826: आलप् {c1c} P. To address, speak to, converse; कमालपामि K. 164; तस्या नामधेयेन भर्त्रादेव्यालपिता V. 2 addressed. --Caus. To talk with, engage in conversation with, to question; यदा कश्चित्त्वामालापयिष्यति Pt. 5, 1. 387; K. 188.
6827: आलापः 1 Talking, speaking to, speech, conversation; अये दक्षिणेन वृक्षवाटिकामालाप इव श्रूयते Ś. 1; प्रवसनालाप Amaru. 97; ललितालापे Śrut. 36. --2 Narration, mention. --3 The seven notes in music (Mar. सा, रि, ग, म, प, ध, नि). --4 Statement of a question in an arithmetical or algebraical sum. --5 A question.
6828: आलापन a. Causing to speak or converse with. --नं 1 Speaking to, conversation. --2 Congratulation ( स्वस्तिवाचनं).
6829: आलाप्य, --लापनीय pot. p. To be spoken to, conversed with or narrated.
6830: आलापिन् a. Speaking to, conversing with. --नी A lute made of a gourd.
6831: आलभ् {c1c} A. 1 To touch; गामालभ्यार्कमीक्ष्य वा Ms. 5. 87, 4. 117; Bk. 14. 91; सत्येनायुधमालभे; सत्येन (सत्यं) आत्मानमालभे Mb. --2 To get, attain to; अतितरां कांतिमालप्स्यते ते (वपुः) Me. 15 v. l.; Kām. 9. 63. --3 To kill, immolate (as a victim in sacrifices); प्रातर्वै पशूनालभंते Śat. Br.; गर्दभं पशुमालभ्य Y. 3. 280. --4 To take hold of, seize, grasp, handle. --5 To gain or win over. --Caus. 1 To touch. --2 To commence.
6832: आलब्ध p. p. 1 Touched; united or in contact with. --2 Killed.
6834: आलभनं 1 Taking hold of, seizing. --2 Touching. --3 Killing.
6835: आलभ्य, आल(लं)भनीय pot. p. To be killed or sacrificed; to be touched or rubbed.
6836: आलंभः, --भनं [आ-लभ् घञ् ल्यट् मुम्] 1 Taking hold of, seizing, touching; Y. 3. 157; Ms. 2. 179. --2 Tearing off, uprooting (of plants); Ms. 11. 145. --3 Killing (especially an animal at a sacrifice); अश्वालंभं गवालंभं Ādipurāṇa.
6838: आलंब् {c1c} A. 1 To rest or lean upon, support oneself on; शाखामालंब्य Rām. --2 To lay hold of, seize, take; अथालंब्य धनू रामः Bk. 6. 35, 14. 95. --3 To support, hold or take up; आधोरणालंबितं R. 18. 39. --4 To win, conquer, overcome; तस्य कविता मच्चित्तमालंबते Dhūrtas. --5 To resort to, have recourse to, take, assume; अमुमेवार्थमालंब्य Mu. 2. 20; स्वातंत्र्यमालंब्य K. 181; Ki. 13. 14; यशःशरीरं नवमाललंबे Mv. 7. 18 obtained; Ki. 17. 34; so ध्यानं, धैर्यं, क्रोधं, औदास्यं, दक्षिणां दिशं &c. --6 To hang from, be suspended; मुखालंबितहेमसूत्रं V. 5. 2. --7 To depend upon; तमालंब्य रसोद्गमात् S. D. 63. --8 To stretch forth; V. 4. 34. --9 To strike up (a tune or note).
6839: आलंब a. Hanging down. --बः 1 Depending on or from. --2 That on which one rests or leans, prop, stay; इह हि पततां नास्त्यालंबो न चापि निवर्तनं Śānti. 3. 2. --3 Support, protection; तवालंबादंव स्फुरदलघुगर्वेण सहसा Jag.; सीतां शून्ये यथासुखं निरालंबां हरिष्यामि Rām. --4 Receptacle. --5 A perpendicular. --बा N. of a plant with poisonous leaves.
6840: आलंबनं 1 Depending on or from, hanging from. --2 Support, prop, stay; Ki. 2. 13; Pt. 1. 32; sustaining, supporting; Me. 4. --3 Receptacle, abode; U. 6. 10. --4 Reason, cause. --5 Base. --6 (In Rhet.) That on which a रस or sentiment, as it were hangs, person or thing with reference to which a sentiment arises, the natural and necessary connection of sentiment with the cause which excites it. The causes (विभाव) giving rise to a Rasa are classified as two: --आलंबन and उद्दीपन; e. g. in the Bībhatsa sentiment stinking flesh &c. is the आलंबन of the Rasa, and the attendant circumstances which enhance the feeling of loathing (the worms &c. in the flesh) are its उद्दीपनानि (exciters); for the other Rasas see S. D. 210-238. --7 The mental exercise practised by the Yogin in endeavouring to bring before his thoughts the gross form of the Eternal. --8 Silent repetition of a prayer. --9 (With Buddhists) The five attributes of things corresponding to the five senses, i. e. रूप, रस, गंध, स्पर्श and शब्द. --10 Dharma or law corresponding to manas.
6841: आलंबित p. p. 1 Pendent, suspended. --2 Supported, sustained, held; R. 7. 7; V. 5. 2.
6842: आलंबिन् a. 1 Hanging from, resting or leaning upon; दशालंबी शाटकः Pt. 1. 144; depending on; R. 12. 85. --2 Laying hold of, supporting, maintaining, upholding; कुलालंबी पुत्रः H. Pr. 20. --3 Wearing; गजाजिनालंबि Ku. 5. 78.
6843: आलर्क a. [अलर्कस्येदं अण] Relating to or caused by a mad dog; आलर्कं विषमिव सर्वतः प्रसृप्तं U. 1. 40.
6844: आलवण्यं [अलवणस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Insipidity, tastelessness. --2 Ugliness.
6845: आलवालं [आसमंतात् लवं जललवं आलाति, आ-ला-क Tv.] A basin or trench for water (round the root of a tree); °पूरणे नियुक्ता Ś. 1; विश्वासाय विहङ्गानामालवालाम्बुपायिनां R. 1. 51.
6846: आलस a. (सी f.) [आलसति ईषत् व्याप्रियते अच्] Idle, lazy, slothful.
6847: आलस्य a. Idle, slothful, apathetic. --स्यं [अलसस्य भावः, ष्यञ्] Idleness, sloth, want of energy; शक्तस्य चाप्यनुत्साहः कर्मस्वालस्यमुच्यते Suśr.; आलस्य ‘want of energy’ is regarded as one of the 33 subordinate feelings (व्यभिचारिभाव); for example: --न तथा भूषयत्यंगं न तथा भाषते सखीं । जृंभते मुहुरासीना बाला गर्भभरालसा S. D. 183.
6849: आलानं [आलीयतेऽत्र, आ-ली-ल्युट्] 1 The post to which an elephant is tied; tying post, also the rope that ties him; अरुंतुदमिवालानमनिर्वाणस्य दंतिनः R. 1. 71, 4. 69, 81; आलाने गृह्यते हस्ती Mk. 1. 50. --2 A fetter, tie. --3 A chain, rope, string. --4 Tying, binding.
6850: आलानिक a. (की f.) [आलान-ठक्] Serving as a post to which an elephant is tied; आलानिकं स्थाणुमिव द्विपेंद्रः R. 14. 38.
6851: आलाबुः(बूः) f. A pumpkin gourd; see अलाबु.
6852: आलावर्तं A fan made of cloth.
6854: आलि a. 1 Useless, idle, unmeaning. --2 Honest, sincere (विशदाशय). --लिः 1 A scorpion. --2 A bee. --लिः, --ली f. 1 A female companion or friend (of a woman); निवार्यतामालि किमप्ययं बटुः Ku. 5. 83, 7. 68; Amaru. 23. --2 A row, range, continuous line; (cf. आवलि); तोयांतर्भास्करालीव रेजे मुनिपरंपरा Ku. 6. 49; रथ्यालि Amaru. 89; खद्योतालि Me. 81. --3 A line, streak. --4 A bridge. --5 A dike. --6 A line, race, family.
6855: आलिख् {c6c} P. 1 To write, delineate, draw lines; मनो निष्ठाशून्यं भ्रमति च किमप्यालिखति च Māl. 1. 31; Mk. 2. --2 To paint, draw in a picture; आलिखित इव सर्वतो रंगः Ś. 1; V. 2; त्वामालिख्य प्रणयकुपितां Me. 105; R. 19. 19; M. 2. 2. --3 To portray, write, sketch. --4 To scratch, scrape, touch; as in विंध्यमालिखंतमिवांबरं.
6857: आलेखनं a. Scratching, painting. --नी A brush, pencil. --नं 1 Writing. --2 Painting. --3 Scratching.
6858: आलेख्य pot. p. To be written, painted &c. --ख्यं 1 A painting, picture; इति संरंभिणो वाणीर्बलस्यालेख्यदेवताः Śi. 2. 67; R. 3. 15; V. 2. 10. --2 A writing. --Comp. --लेखा a painting. --शेष a. having nothing left but a painting, i. e. deceased, dead; आलेख्यशेषस्य पितुः R. 14. 15.
6859: आलिंग् {c1c} U. or {c10c} P. To embrace, clasp, encircle.
6860: आलिंगः 1 Embracing. --2 A kind of drum.
6861: आलिंगनं Embracing, clasping, an embrace; (स प्राप) आलिंगननिर्वृतिं R. 12. 65; (said to be of seven kinds; आमोद°, मुदित°, प्रेमन्°, मानस°, रुचि°, मदन° and विनोद°).
6862: आलिंगित p. p. Embraced, clasped. --तः A kind of Mantra of 20 letters. --तं An embrace.
6863: आलिंगिन् a. Embracing &c. --m. (--गी), आलिंग्यः A small drum shaped like a barley-corn (यव); चतुरंगुलहीन्ॐक्यान्मुखे चैकांगुलेन यः । यवाकृतिः स आलिंग्य आलिंग्य स हि वाद्यते ॥ Śabdārṇava.
6864: आलिंजरः [अलिंजर एव स्वार्थे अण्] A large earthen water-jar.
6865: आलिंदः, --दकः [अलिंद एव स्वार्थे अण्] 1 A terrace before a house. --2 A raised place for sleeping upon; see अलिंद.
6867: आलिप् {c6c} P. 1 To anoint, besmear; आलिंपन्नमृतमयैरिव प्रलेपैः U. 3. 39; plaster, bedaub. --2 To rub (on the body); आलिप्यते चंदनमंगनाभिः Rs. 6. 12.
6869: आलिंपनं [लिप्-ल्युट्-मुम्] Whitening the walls, floor &c. on festive occasions; cf. आदीपन.
6870: आलेप a. To be anointed. --पः, --पनं 1 Anointing, smearing. --2 Liniment.
6872: आली {c4c} A. 1 To settle down upon; निर्भिद्योपरि कर्णिकारकुसुमान्यालीयते षट्पदः V. 2. 23. --2 To faint; मुहुरालीयते भीता Mb. --3 To melt.
6873: आलयः, --यं [आलीयतेऽस्मिन्, आली-अच्] 1 An abode, a house, a dwelling; आलयं देवशत्रूणां सुघोरं खांडवं वनं Mb.; न हि दुष्टात्मनामार्या निवसंत्यालये चिरं Rām.; सर्वाञ्जनस्थानकृतालयान् Rām. who lived or dwelt in Janasthāna. --2 A receptacle, seat, place; हिमालयो नाम नगाधिराजः Ku. 1. 1; so देवालयं, विद्यालयं &c; fig. also; दुःख° Bg. 8. 15; गुण°. --3 Contact. --यं ind. Till destruction.
6874: आलीन p. p. 1 Embraced. --2 Sticking or clinging to; आलीनचंदनौ R. 4. 51; so °भ्रमरे पद्मे. --3 Melted, fused. --नं, --नकं 1 Tin. --2 Lead. --3 Contact.
6875: आलीढ p. p. [आ-लिह् क्त] 1 Licked, eaten, lapped, scraped. --2 Wounded, hurt; सेनान्यमालीढमिवासुरास्त्रैः R. 2. 37. --3 Closed (as in sleep) Dk. 117. --ढं A particular attitude in shooting, the right knee being advanced and the left leg retracted; अतिष्ठदालीढविशेषशोभिना R. 3. 52; see Malli. on Ku. 3. 70.
6876: आलीढकं The frolicking of a calf.
6877: आलुः 1 An owl. --2 An esculent root (not applied to potato &c.). --3 Ebony; black ebony. --लुः f. A pitcher, water-jar. --लु (n.) A raft, float.
6878: आलुकः 1 A kind of ebony (कामालु). --2 An epithet of Śeṣa. --कं An esculent root.
6879: आलुंचनं Rending, tearing to pieces; श्येनो ग्रहालुंचने Mk. 3. 20.
6880: आलुड् {c1c} P. or Caus. To stir up, agitate, shake, disturb; कौरववनमालोडयंतौ Ve. 3, 4; विषमालोड्य पास्यामि Mb.; (fig.) to dive into; Pt. 1; to examine scrutinizingly; भरतादिमतं सर्वमालोड्यातिप्रयत्नतः ।.
6881: आलोडनं 1 Stirring, shaking, agitating. --2 Mixing, blending.
6882: आलोडित p. p. 1 Shaken, agitated. --2 Mixed, blended. --3 Powdered.
6883: आलुंटनं Plundering, taking away by force.
6886: आलून p. p. Cut, cut off; Ku. 2. 41.
6887: आलोक् {c1c} A., {c10c} P. 1 To see, perceive, behold; त्वन्मार्गमालोकते S. D.; अथालुलोके तपोवनं Bk. 2. 24; used in an astrological sense also. --2 To consider, regard, contemplate; तृणमिब जगज्जालमालोकयामः Bh. 3. 66. --3 To express congratulations, greet; इति वीरलोक आलोकयितुं प्रवृत्तः Ve. 4.
6888: आलोकः, --कनं 1 Seeing, beholding. --2 Sight, aspect, appearance; यदालोके सूक्ष्मं Ś. 1. 9; Ku. 7. 22, 46; सुख° V. 4. 24; Ś. 1. 33; R. 1. 84; Me. 3, 37. --3 Range of sight; आलोके ते निपतति पुरा सा बलिव्याकुला वा Me. 85; R. 7. 5; Ku. 2. 45. --4 Light, lustre, splendour; आलोकमार्गं सहसा व्रजंत्या R. 7. 6 air-hole, or window; निरालोकं लोकं Māl. 5. 30; 9. 37; 10. 4, 11; Ve. 2; K. 160, 290, 348, 68, 98. --5 Panegyric, praise, complimentary language; especially, a word of praise uttered by a bard (such as जय, आलोकय); ययावुदीरितालोकः R. 17. 27, 2. 9; K. 14. --6 Section, chapter.
6889: आलोकित p. p. Seen, beheld &c. --तं A look, glance; Māl. 1. 27.
6891: आलोच् {c1c} A., {c10c} U. 1 To see, perceive. --2 To consider, reflect, think, ponder over, study; K. 7; आलोचयंतो विस्तारमंभसां दक्षिणोदधेः Bk. 7. 40; इति-एवं-आलोच्य so thinking.
6892: आलोचक a. 1 Seeing, beholding. --2 Causing to see. --कं The faculty of vision, the cause of sight.
6893: आलोचनं, --ना 1 Seeing, perceiving, survey, view. --2 Considering, reflecting.
6894: आलोल a. Slightly 1 trembling, rolling (as eyes); आलोलायतलोचनाः Bh. 3. 48. --2 Shaken, agitated; आलोलामलकावलीं Amaru. 3; क्रीडालोलाः Me. 61. --लः Trembling, agitation.
6898: आवनेयः [अवंन्या अपत्यं ढक्] ‘Son of the earth’, an epithet of the planet Mars.
6899: आवंतः [अवंतेरयं राजा अण्] A king of Avantī.
6900: आवंतिक a. (की f.) Coming from or belonging to Avantī.
6901: आवंत्य a. [अवंतिषु भवः ञ्य] Coming from or belonging to Avantī. --त्यः 1 A prince or an inhabitant of Avantī. --2 The offspring of a degraded Brāhmaṇa; see Ms. 10. 21.
6902: आवप् {c1c} U. 1 To scatter, throw about; वयोभ्यश्चावपेद्भुवि Mb.; so अक्षान् throws. --2 To sow (as seed). --3 To fit in, insert. --4 To pour out or forth. --5 To offer (as in a sacrifice), perform (as a Śrāddha). --Caus. 1 To shave, cut off. --2 To trim. --3 To mix with.
6903: आवपनं 1 The act of sowing, throwing, scattering. --2 Sowing seed. --3 Wearing. --4 Shaving. --5 A vessel, jar, ewer. --6 Instilling, inserting. --नी Ved. A vessel, jar.
6905: आवाप a. [आवप्-घञ्] Throwing, scattering; (as in अक्षावाप q. v.). --पः 1 Sowing seed. --2 Scattering, throwing in general; casting, directing. --3 Mixing, inserting. --4 Especially, throwing additional ingredients into a compound in course of preparation. --5 A basin for water round the root of a tree (आलवाल). --6 A vessel, jar for corn. --7 Setting out or arranging vessels. --8 Hostile purpose, intention of fighting (with another); foreign affairs; Śi. 2. 88. --9 A principal sacrifice or oblation to fire. --10 A kind of drink. --11 A bracelet ( आवापक). --12 Uneven ground.
6907: आवापनं 1 A loom. --2 A reel or frame for winding thread. --3 Shaving.
6908: आवापिक a. [आवापाय साधु ठक्] 1 Good for sowing, shaving &c. --2 Additional, supplementary.
6909: आवयः 1 Coming. --2 One who comes. --3 N. of a country. --यः, --या Water (Ved.). --यं Ved. Nonconception, barrenness.
6910: आवयाज् m. One who makes a sacrifice to reach the gods (Sāy.); or one who averts by means of sacrifices.
6912: आवरसमक a. (की f.) [ अवरसमे देयमृणं वुञ्] (A debt) To be paid in the following year.
6914: आवलिः, --ली f. [आ-वल्-इन् वा ङीप्] 1 A line, row, range; अरावलीं V. 1. 4; so अलक°, धूम°, दंत°, हार°, रत्न° &c. --2 A series, continuous line. --3 A dynasty, lineage.
6917: आवल्गुज a. Produced from the plant अवल्गुज.
6918: आवश्यं [अवश्य-अण्] Necessity, inevitable act or conclusion.
6919: आवश्यक a. (की f.) [अवश्य-वुञ्] Inevitable, necessary; एतेष्वावश्यकस्त्वसौ Bhāṣā P. 22, 20. --कं 1 Necessity, inevitable act or duty. °कृ to do what nature compels one to do; Ms. 4. 93. --2 An inevitable conclusion.
6921: आवस् {c1c} P. (With acc.) 1 To inhabit, dwell in; रविमावसते सतां क्रियायै V. 3. 7; पुरीमिमामावसत् Rām.; sometimes with loc.; Ms. 7. 69; Y. 1. 320. --2 To be occupied or engaged, enter upon; गृहस्थाश्रमं Ms. 3. 2. --3 To take part carnally; cohabit. --4 To pass, spend (as night). --Caus. 1 To allow one to dwell, receive hospitably. --2 To inhabit, settle in a place. --3 To halt or encamp (for the night).
6922: आवसतिः f. Night(the time during which one rests); mid-night.
6923: आवसथः [आवस्-अथच् Uṇ. 3. 116] 1 A dwelling, dwelling-place, residence, house, habitation; निवसन्नावसथे पुराद्बहिः R. 8. 14. --2 A resting place; asylum. --3 A dwelling for pupils and ascetics. --4 A village. --5 A particular religious observance. --6 A fire-sanctuary, a place where sacrificial fire is preserved.
6924: आवसथिक a. (की f.) [आवसथे गृहे वसति ठण् Tv.] 1 Inhabiting a house. --2 Household, domestic. --3 Keeping a sacred fire in a house.
6925: आवसथ्य a. [आवसथ-ञ्य] Being in a house. --थ्यः The sacred fire kept in the house, one of the five fires used in sacrifices; see पंचाग्नि. --थ्यः --थ्यं A dwelling for pupils and ascetics. --थ्यं 1 Placing a sacred fire within a house. --2 A house.
6926: आवासः (a) A house, habitation, abode; आवासवृक्षोन्मुखबर्हिणानि R. 2. 17. (b) Apartment, room. (c) A place of refuge.
6927: आवसान a. [अवसानमभिजनोऽस्य अञ्] Living at the extremity of a town (as a चांडाल).
6928: आवसित a. [आ-अव-सो-क्त] 1 Finished or completed. --2 Decided, determined, settled. --3 Stored (as grain); winnowed. --4 Ripe, full-grown. --तं Ripe corn (when thrashed.)
6929: आवस्थिक a. (की f.) [अवस्थायां भवः ठञ्] Suited or adapted to circumstances.
6930: आवह् {c1c} P. 1 To bring; अग्ने पत्नीरिहावह Rv. 1. 22. 9. --2 To bring home (as a bride). --3 To conduce, lead or tend to, produce, bring on; व्रीडमावहति मे स संप्रति R. 11. 73 shames me; मनोरुजमावहन् Ś. 3. 4 tending to mental anguish; न मे सौख्यमावहति does not tend to my happiness Pt. 1; संगमं K. 174; Ms. 3. 82. --4 To pay; Y. 2. 193. --5 To lead forth, conduct away. --6 To flow (as blood &c.). --7 To bear, support, wear; मंडनमावहंतिं Ch. P. 18. --8 To apply, use, employ; मा रोदीर्धैर्यमावह Mārk. P. --Caus. 1 To send for, cause to be brought. --2 To invoke a deity (by means of Mantras); गणपतिमावाहयामि &c.
6931: आवह a. (As last member of comp.) Producing, leading or tending to, bringing on, क्लेशावहा भर्तुरलक्षणाऽहं R. 14. 5; so दुःख°, भय°, क्षय° &c. --हः 1 N. of one of the seven winds or bands of air, usually assigned to the भुवर्लोक or atmospheric region between the भूर्लोक and स्वर्लोक. --2 One of the seven tongues of fire.
6933: आवहमान a. 1 Bringing near. --2 Followed or succeeded by.
6935: आवाहनं 1 Sending for, inviting, calling. --2 Invoking a deity (to be present) (opp. विसर्जन); आवाहने विनियोगः, आवाहनं न जानामि न जानामि तवार्चनं Pūjā Mantra. --3 Offering oblations to fire; Y. 1. 251. --नी A particular position of the hands at the time of invoking a deity; हस्ताभ्यामंजलिं बद्ध्वाऽनामिकामूलपर्वणोः । अंगुष्ठौ निक्षिपेत्सेयं मुद्रा त्वावाहनी स्मृता ॥ Śabdak.
6936: आवालं [आ-वल्-णिच् अच् Tv.] A basin for water round the root of a tree; cf. आलवालं.
6937: आविक a. (की f.) [अविना तल्लोम्ना निर्मितं ठक्] 1 Relating to a sheep; आविकं क्षीरं Ms. 5. 8, 2. 41. --2 Woollen. --कं A woollen cloth, blanket; Ms. 5. 120. --Comp. --सौत्रिक a. made of woollen thread; Ms. 2. 44.
6938: आविग्न a. Distressed, troubled. --ग्नः N. of a fruit-tree (अविग्न).
6939: आविद् Caus. 1 To make known, report, declare, announce, tell, communicate, inform; किमिति नावेदयसि-अथवा किमावेदितेन Ve. 1; राज्ञ आवेदयध्वं मां संप्राप्तं Rām; आयुषः प्रमाणमावेदयति K. 46, 47; आवेदयंति प्रत्यासन्नमानंदं… निमित्तानि 65, 67 --2 foreshadow; 81, 168; Bk. 3. 49; Ku. 6. 21; R. 5. 23; आत्मनः सुमहत्कर्म व्रणैरावेद्य R. 12. 55; K. 158. --3 To bring to, offer, give.
6940: आविद् a. Ved. 1 Knowledge. --2 A technical name of the Vedic formulas beginning with आविस् and आवित्त.
6941: आविद्वस् a. Ved. Knowing fully, skilled in.
6942: आवेदक a. Making known, reporting, communicating. --कः 1 One who makes known, an informer. --2 A suitor, plaintiff.
6943: आवेदनं 1 Communicating, reporting, or addressing respectfully. --2 Representation. --3 Stating a complaint (in law); राज्ञे कुर्यात् पूर्वमावेदनं यः Nārada. --4 A plaint.
6944: आवेदनीय, --वेद्य pot. p. 1 To be declared or reported. --2 To be made the subject of a plaint.
6945: आवेदित p. p. Made known, communicated &c. --तः The person to whom something is made known. --तं That which is communicated.
6946: आवेदिन् a. 1 Declaring, announcing. --2 Giving orders.
6950: आविल a. [आविलति दृष्टिं स्तृणाति विल् स्तृतौ-क Tv.] 1 Turbid, foul, dirty, muddy; पंकच्छिदः फलस्येव निकषेणाविलं पयः M. 2. 8; तस्याविलांभःपरिशुद्धिहेतोः R. 13. 36. --2 Impure, spoiled; Ki. 8. 37; fig. also; त्वदीयैश्चरितैरनाविलैः Ku. 5. 37. --3 Dark-coloured, dark-blue, darkish; V. 5. 8. --4 Dim, obscure; आविलां मृगलेखां R. 8. 42.
6951: आविलयति Den. P. To sully, make turbid, stain, blot; Ś. 5. 21.
6952: आविश् {c6c} U. 1 To enter; गौरीगुरोर्गह्वरमाविवेश R. 2. 26, 3. 28. --2 To take possession of, possess, affect; मूढमाविशंति न पंडितं H. 1. 3; so भयं, मोहः, क्रोधः &c. --3 To go towards, approach. --4 To go or attain to a particular state; सुखं, मन्युं &c. --5 To arise. --Caus. 1 To cause to enter. --2 To possess; K. 107.
6953: आविष्ट p. p. 1 Entered. --2 Possessed (by an evil spirit); K. 120, 167, 318. --3 Possessed of, seized or filled with, full of, overpowered or overcome; भय°, क्रोध°, निद्रा°; कृपयाविष्टं Bg. 2. 1; भोगिनः कंचुकाविष्टाः Pt. 1. 65 covered with, clad in. --4 Engrossed or occupied in, intent on (तत्पर, उद्युत्क). --Comp. --लिंग a. (a noun) which in every relationship preserves its own gender (नियतलिंग); e. g. प्रधानं, अर्धः, उपसर्जनं.
6954: आवेशः 1 Entering into, entrance; आवेशं कृ Pt. 1 to enter or infuse oneself into. --2 Taking possession of, influence, exercise; स्मय° influence of pride R. 5. 19; so मदन°, क्रोध°, भय° &c. --3 Intentness, devotedness to an object, complete absorption in one wish or idea. --4 Pride, arrogance. --5 Flurry, agitation, anger, passion; K. 291. --6 Demoniacal possession. --7 Apoplectic or epileptic giddiness.
6955: आवेशनं 1 Entering, entrance. --2 Demoniacal possession. --3 Passion, anger, fury. --4 A manufactory, work-shop; Ms. 9. 265. --5 The disc of the sun or the moon. --6 A house, dwelling.
6956: आवेशिक a. (की f.) [आवेश-ठञ्] 1 Peculiar, one's own (असाधारण). --2 Inherent. --कः A guest, visitor. --कं 1 Entering into. --2 Hospitality.
6957: आविस् ind. A particle meaning ‘before the eyes’, ‘openly’, ‘evidently’ (usually prefixed to the roots अस्, भू and कृ); आचार्यकं विजयि मान्मथमाविरासीत् Māl. 1. 26.
6958: आविर्भू {c1c} P. To become manifest, appear, become visible, show oneself to; तमस्तपति घर्मांशौ कथमाविर्भविष्यति Ś. 5. 14; तेषामाविरभूद् ब्रह्मा परिम्लानमुखश्रियां Ku. 2. 2; आविर्बभूव कुशगर्भमुखं मृगाणां यूथं R. 9. 55.
6959: आविर्भावः 1 Manifestation, presence, appearance. --2 An incarnation. --3 Nature or property of things.
6960: आविष्कृ {c8c} U. To make apparent, lay bare, reveal, show, manifest, put forth; (याति) आविष्कृतारुणपुरस्सर एकतोर्कः Ś. 5. 1; Śi. 20. 76.
6961: आविष्करणं, --ष्कारः 1 Manifestation, making visible, showing; असूया मुणेषु दोषाविष्करणं Sk. --2 The means of making visible.
6963: आविस्तराम् ind. In a more manifest way.
6964: आवी f. [अवीरेव स्वार्थे अण्] 1 A woman in her courses. --2 A pregnant woman. --3 The pangs of childbirth.
6965: आवीत a. [आ-व्ये-क्त] 1 Worn, put on, held after throwing round. --2 Entered, passed, gone. --तं The sacrificial cord worn in any particular position.
6966: आवीतिन् m. [आवीत-इति] A Brāhmaṇa who makes the sacrificial cord hang over the right shoulder.
6969: आवुत्तः A sister's husband; brother-in-law; U. 1; Ś. 6.
6970: आवृ {c5c} {c9c} {c10c} U. 1 To cover, hide, conceal; आवृणोदात्मनो रंध्रं R. 17. 61; K. 199; आवरीतुमिवाकाशं Bk. 9. 24; धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निः Bg. 3. 38. --2 To fill, pervade; सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति Bg. 13. 13; Ms. 2. 144. --3 To choose, desire. --4 To enclose, obstruct, shut, hem in, block; आवृत्य पंथानमजस्य तस्थौ R. 7. 31; 12. 28. --5 To keep off; Bk. 14. 109. --Caus. 1 To cover or conceal. --2 To ward or keep off.
6971: आवरक a. Covering, concealing. --कं A cover, veil.
6972: आवरण a. Covering, hiding, obscuring, obstructing; नेत्रावरणमश्रु R. 14. 71. --णं 1 Covering, concealing, hiding, obscuring; सूर्ये तपत्यावरणाय दृष्टेः कल्पेत लोकस्य कथं तमिस्रा R. 5. 13, 10. 46, 19. 16. --2 Shutting, enclosing, fencing. --3 A covering, anything that covers or protects &c.; हस्तौ स्वौ नयति स्तनावरणतां M. 4. 14; Ś. 3. 22; (fig.) protection, defence; शीलमावरणं स्त्रियाः Rām.; चरित्रावरणाः स्त्रियः Chāṇ. 76. --4 Obstruction, interruption, restraint (of bashfulness &c.); कालेनावरणात्ययात् U. 1. 39. --5 An enclosure, fence, surrounding wall; लब्धांतरा सावरणेपि गेहे R. 16. 7; Ki. 5. 25. --6 A bolt, latch. --7 A shield. --Comp. --शक्तिः mental ignorance (which veils the real nature of things).
6973: आवरि(री)तृ a. One that covers or envelops; Ki. 18. 40.
6974: आवारः Enclosing, keeping off, as in दुरावार q. v.
6975: आवारिः [आवृ बाहु° इण्] A shop, a stall (n. according to some).
6976: आवृत p. p. 1 Covered, screened, concealed. --2 Invested, blocked. --3 Enclosed, surrounded (by a ditch, wall &c.). --4 Spread, overspread, overcast; आवृते नभस्तले H. 3. --5 Filled or abounding with. --तः A man of mixed origin, the son of a Brāhmaṇa by a woman of the Ugra caste; Ms. 10. 15.
6977: आवृतिः f. Covering, hiding; see आवरण.
6978: आवृज् {c1c} A. 1 To bestow, give (Ved.). --2 To turn to or towards. --3 To choose. --Caus. 1 To bend, bend down; incline; गौरवेणावर्जितः Pt. 4.; आवर्ज्य शाखाः सदयं च यासां R. 16. 19; 13. 17, 24; Mv. 5. 63; K. 14, 58; Ku. 2. 26, 3. 54; 7. 54; Me. 46. --2 To subdue, win or gain over, attract, please; आवर्जितानि मनांसि Nāg. 1; मरीचिमावर्जितवतीव श्लाघसे Dk. 45, 58, 133, 155; Mv. 2; K. 368. --3 To bring, collect; R. 6. 76. --4 To pour out, offer, give; अपि त्वदावर्जितवारिसंभृतं Ku. 5. 34; R. 15. 80; तनयावर्जितपिंडकांक्षिणः 8. 26; 1. 62, 67; Mu. 4; K. 241. --5 To draw or force out; Nāg. 4. --6 To empty, pour out the contents of (as a jar &c.); कलशमावर्जयति Ś. 1; V. 5; Ku. 7. 10; K. 82, 310.
6979: आवर्जनं 1 Bending down &c. --2 Giving. --3 Winning over, Dk. 139, 172.
6980: आवृत् {c1c} A. 1 To turn round, revolve. --2 To return, come or turn back; धेनुराववृते वनात् R. 1. 82, 2. 19; Bg. 8. 26. --3 To go to or towards. --4 To be restless or uneasy; Māl. 1. 41. --Caus. 1 To cause to turn or revolve; अक्षबलयमावर्तयंतं K. 42 telling the beads. --2 To roll, turn about or over. --3 To cause to roll down, shed (as tears &c.). --4 To attract, win over (see आवृज्) --5 To repeat, recite.
6981: आवर्तः 1 Turning round, winding, revolving; प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखः Rām. --2 A whirlpool, an eddy, whirl; नृपं तमावर्तमनोज्ञनाभिः R. 6. 52; दर्शितावर्तनाभेः Me. 28; Dk. 2; आवर्तः संशयानां Pt. 1. 191. --3 Deliberation, revolving (in the mind), anxiety. --4 A lock of hair curling backwards, especially on a horse. --5 The two depressions of the forehead above the eye-brows. --6 A crowded place (where many men live closely together). --7 A kind of jewel. --8 N. of a form of cloud personified; आवर्तो निर्जलो मेघः. --9 Melting (of metals). --10 Doubt. --11 Worldly existence (संसार). --र्तं A mineral substance, pyrites (माक्षिकधातु).
6982: आवर्तक a. [आवर्त एव स्वार्थे कन्] Revolving again and again. --कः 1 N. of a form of cloud personified; जातं वंशे भुवनविदिते पुष्करावर्तकानां Me. 6; Ku. 2. 50. --2 Depression above the eye-brows. --3 A whirlpool. --4 Revolution. --5 Revolution of the mind from the influence of the senses. --6 A curl of hair. --7 A sort of poisonous insect. --की N. of a creeping plant.
6983: आवर्तन a. 1 Turning round or towards. --2 Revolving. --नं 1 Turning round, returning, revolution. --2 Circular motion, gyration. --3 Churning or stirring up anything in fusion. --4 Melting together, fusion, alligation (said of metals). --5 Mid-day, the time when shadows are cast in an opposite direction. --6 Repeating, doing over and over again. --7 Study, practising. --नः Viṣṇu. --नी 1 A crucible. --2 A spoon, ladle.
6984: आवर्तिन् a. 1 Whirling or turning upon itself, returning; आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन Bg. 8. 16; कालांतरावर्ति H. 1. 207. --2 Melting, mixing &c. --m. (--र्ती) A horse having curls of hair on various parts of the body (considered as a sign of auspiciousness). --नी 1 A whirlpool. --2 N. of a plant (अजशृंगी).
6985: आवृत् f. 1 Causing to turn towards. --2 Turning towards or round; entering. --3 Order, succession, method, mode, manner; अनयैवावृता कार्यं पिंडनिर्वपणं सुतैः Ms. 3. 248; Y. 3. 2. --4 Progress of an action; occurrence. --5 Turn of a path, course, direction. --6 A purificatory rite; Ms. 2. 66.
6986: आवृत्त p. p. 1 Turned round, whirled, returned; Māl. 1. 29. --2 Repeated; द्विरावृत्ता दश द्विदशाः Sk. --3 Learnt (by heart), studied; U. 6. --4 Reverted, returned. --5 Averted. --6 Retreated, fled.
6987: आवृत्तिः f. 1 Turning towards; return, coming back; तपोवनावृत्तिपथं R. 2. 18; Bg. 8. 23. --2 Reversion, retreat, flight. --3 Revolving, whirling, going round; Māl. 5. 4. --4 Recurrence to the same point or place (of the sun); उदगावृत्तिपथेन नारदः R. 8. 33. --5 Repetition of birth and death, worldly existence; अनावृत्तिभयं Ku. 6. 77. --6 Repetition in general; an edition (modern use); सप्तमीयमंकनावृत्तिः seventh edition. --7 Repeated reading, study; आवृत्तिः सर्वशास्त्राणां बोधादपि गरीयसी Udb. --8 Use, employment, application. --9 Turn of a way, course or direction. --10 Occurrence. --Comp. --दीपकं a rhetorical figure; त्रिविधं दीपकावृत्तौ भवेदावृत्तिदीपकम् । (पदस्यार्थस्योभयोर्वा आवृत्तिः). क्रमेणोदाहरणंः-वर्षत्यंबुदमालेयं वर्षत्येषा च शर्वरी ॥ उन्मीलंति कदंबानि स्फुटांति कुटजोद्गमाः । माद्यंति चातकास्तृप्ता माद्यंति च शिखाबलाः ॥ Kuval.
6988: आवृष्टिः f. Raining, a shower of rain.
6989: आवेगः 1 Uneasiness, anxiety, excitement, agitation, flurry; अलमावेगेन Ś. 3, 7; Amaru. 83; शोक°, दुःख°, साध्वस° &c. --2 Hurry, haste; Ś. 4. --3 Agitation, regarded as one of the 33 subordinate feelings. --गी N. of a tree (वृद्धदारकवृक्ष).
6990: आवेष्ट् {c10c} P. To surround; तृणैरावेष्ट्यते रज्जुः is made or formed of straw; Pt. 1. 331.
6991: आवेष्टकः A wall, fence, an enclosure.
6992: आवेष्टनं 1 Wrapping round, tying, binding. --2 A wrapper, an envelope. --3 A wall, fence, enclosure.
6993: आव्य a. (वी f.) [अवेर्मेषस्य विकारः ष्यञ्] 1 Belonging to a sheep. --2 Woollen.
6994: आव्यध् {c4c} P. 1 To hit, pierce; see अनाविद्ध. --2 To wound. --3 To break or pierce through. --4 To put on; Bk. 20. 11. --5 To shoot at, throw or cast towards. --6 To throw away, cast off. --7 To wave, brandish. --8 To pin on. --9 To rouse, agitate, stir up. --10 To drive away, expel; निर्बंधमाविध्यति Mv. 5. 39.
6995: आविद्ध p. p. 1 Pierced, bored, rent, splintered, broken down; उत्पाताविद्धमूर्तिः Mv. 5. 44 rent or contracted; R. 12. 73. --2 Curved, crooked, uneven; V. 4. 28; हर्षाविद्धमभ्युत्थितः Dk. 37. --3 Cast with force; दूरनिक्षेप° Māl. 8 cast forth in taking long strides; Mv. 2; Ms. 9. 40; thrown, put in motion. --4 Disappointed. --5 Fallacious, false. --6 Stupid, foolish. --Comp. --कर्णी, --कर्णिका N. of a plant (पाठा).
6997: आव्याधिन् a. [आ-व्यध्-णिनि] Giving pain, wounding, attacking. --नी A gang of robbers (Ved.).
6998: आव्रश्च् {c6c} P. To tear off, cut off, tear in pieces, interrupt.
6999: आव्रश्चनं 1 Cutting or tearing off. --2 The stump of a tree (Ved.).
7000: आव्रस्कः Being torn off or tearing itself off (Ved.).
7001: आव्रीडकः [अव्रीडानां विषयो देशः] A country of the shameless.
7002: आश a. One who eats, eater (mostly as the last member of comp.); e. g. हुताश, आश्रयाश &c. &c. --शः [अश्-घञ्] Eating (as in प्रातराश).
7004: आशयितृ a. 1 Feeding, a feeder. --2 Protecting.
7005: आशिः f. The act of eating food.
7006: आशित a. 1 Eaten, given to eat. --2 Satisfied by eating. --3 Voracious, gluttonous. --तं Eating.
7007: आशितंगवीन a. [आशिता अशनेन तृप्ता गावो यत्र, खञ् नि° मुम्] Formerly grazed by cattle.
7008: आशितंभव a. [आशितोऽशनेन तृप्तो भवत्यनेन P. III. 2. 45] Satiating, satisfying (as food). --वं 1 Food, victuals. --2 Satisfaction, satiety (m. also); फलैर्येष्वासितंभवं Bk. 4. 11.
7011: आशंस् {c1c} A. (rarely P.) 1 To hope for, expect, desire, wish or long for; स्वकार्यसिद्धिं पुनराशशंसे Ku. 3. 57; Bk. 14. 70, 90; Ś. 2. 15; M. 1; मनोरथाय नाशंसे Ś. 7. 13. --2 To bless, wish well to; एवं ते देवा आशंसंतु Mk. 1; इत्याशशंसे करणैरबाह्यैः R. 14. 50. --3 To speak, say. --4 To tell; Ku. 3. 14. --5 To ask for, beg. --6 To praise. --7 To repeat, recite. --8 To fear, be afraid of. --Caus. To render famous or celebrated.
7012: आशंसनं 1 Expecting, wishing; इष्टाशंसनमाशीः Sk. --2 Telling, declaring.
7013: आशंसा 1 Desire, wish, expectation, hope; निदधे विजयाशंसां चापे सीतां च लक्ष्मणे R. 12. 44; Bk. 19. 5. --2 Speech, declaration. --3 Indication, reference; शरत्समयवर्णनाशंसया Ve. 1. --4 Imagination; आशंसापरिकल्पितास्वपि भवत्यानंदसांद्रो लयः Māl. 5. 7.
7014: आशंसित a. 1 Wished, hoped, expected. --2 Said, declared. --3 Considered, said to be.
7015: आशंसितृ, आशंसिन् a. 1 Wishing, desiring, expecting; V. 2. --2 Announcing, declaring.
7017: आशस् a. Ved. [आ-शंस्-क्विप्] Hoping. --f. 1 Praise. --2 Desire.
7018: आशक् {c5c} P. Ved. To make one capable or a master or possessor (of a thing).
7021: आशंक् {c1c} A. 1 To suspect, distrust; दयितां साध्वीं त्वमाशंकिष्वथाः कथं Bk. 21. 1. --2 To suspect or believe to be; आशंकसे यदग्निं Ś. 1. 28; Śi. 3. 72; Bk. 6. 6. --3 To be in doubt or suspense; M. 4. 5. --4 To fear, be afraid, apprehend; भरतागमनमाशंक्य R. 12. 24; Pt. 392; दत्तपूर्वेत्याशंक्यते Māl. 4. --5 To start a doubt or objection.
7022: आशंकनीय pot. p. 1 To be doubted or suspected. --2 To be apprehended. --3 Doubtful, questionable.
7023: आशंका 1 Fear, apprehension; नष्टाशंका हरिणशिशवो मंदमंदं चरंति Ś. 1. 16; आशंकया भुक्तं Bh. 3. 5. --2 Doubt, uncertainty; इत्याशंकायामाह Gadādhara. --3 Distrust, suspicion; °अन्वित a. apprehensive, afraid.
7024: आशंकित p. p. Feared, dreaded; इदं तदाशंकितं गुरुजनेनापि U. 3; doubted, suspected. --तं 1 Fear, apprehension. --2 Doubt, uncertainty.
7025: आशंकिन् a. Doubting, fearing; R. 4. 21; attended with fears; Pt. 1. 284.
7026: आशन a. [अशन-अण्] One who feeds. --नः 1 N. of a tree; see अशन. --2 The thunderbolt.
7028: आशरः [आ-शॄ-अच्] 1 Fire. --2 A demon, goblin (रक्षस्). --3 Wind.
7029: आशारिकः Violent and acute pain in the limbs (Ved.).
7031: आशवं [आशोर्भावः अण्] 1 Speed, quickness. --2 Distilled spirit, more, usually written आसव q. v.
7032: आशसनं Ved. Cutting up an animal (when killed).
7033: आशा [आसमंतात् अश्नुते आ-अश्-अच्] 1 (a) Hope, expectation, prospect; तामाशां च सुरद्विषां R. 12. 96; आशा हि परमं दुःखं नैराश्यं परमं सुखं Subhāṣ.; त्वमाशे मोघाशे Bh. 3. 6; so भग्न, °हत, °निराश &c. (b) Wish, desire (in Bh. 3. 25 आशा is compared to a river). --2 False hope or expectation. --3 Space, region, quarter of the compass, direction; अगस्त्याचरितामाशामनाशास्यजयो ययौ R. 4. 44; Ki. 7. 9. --Comp. --अन्वित, --जनन a. hopeful, inspiring hope; V. 3. 9. --कृत a. attended with the hope of success. --गजः a guardian elephant of a quarter or point of the compass; see अष्टदिग्गज. --तंतुः a thread of hope, slender hope; Māl. 4. 3, 9. 26. --पालः a guardian or regent of the regions or quarters; see अष्टदिक्पाल. --पिशाचिका deceptive or illusive hope, phantom of hope. --पुरगुग्गुलुः or --संभवः a kind of Bdellium. --प्राप्त a. successful (= प्राप्ताश). --बंधः {1} the tie or bond of hope, confidence, trust, expectation; गुर्वपि विरहदुःखमाशाबंधः साहयति Ś. 4. 15; Ve. 6. 25; V. 3; U. 3; Me. 10. {2} consolation. {3} a spider's web. --भंगः disappointment. --वह a. inspiring hope. (--हः) N. of a son of heaven. --विभिन्न a. disappointed in expectation. --हीन a. despairing, despondent.
7037: आशास् {c2c} A. 1 To bless, pronounce or give a blessing; ऋक्छंदसा आशास्ते Ś. 4; किमन्यदाशास्महे केवलं वीरप्रसवा भूयाः U. 1. --2 To desire, wish, hope, expect; यस्य भवान् मंगलमाशास्ते Ve. 6; Ms. 3. 80; सर्वमस्मिन्वयमाशास्महे Ś. 7; शांतिं Bk. 17. 1. --3 To order, command, relate (P. also in this sense). --4 To praise.
7038: आशास्य pot. p. 1 To be obtained by a boon. --2 To be blessed; Mv. 4. 13. --3 To be wished for, desirable; अनाशास्यजयो ययौ R. 4. 44 (who had not to wish for victory, to whom victory came unsought). --स्यं 1 A thing to be wished for, wish, desire; संपन्नास्ते सर्वाशिषः Mu. 7; M. 5. 20. --2 A blessing, benediction; आशास्यचिंतास्तिमितो बभूव Ku. 7. 87; आशास्यमन्यत् पुनरुक्तभूतं R. 5. 34.
7039: आशिस् f. (°शीः, °शीर्भ्यां &c.) [ आशास्-क्विप्, अत इत्वम्] 1 A blessing, benediction. (It is thus defined: --वात्सल्याद्यत्र मान्येन कनिष्ठस्याभिधीयते । इष्टावधारकं वाक्यमाशीः सा परिकीतिंता ॥). आशिस् is sometimes distinguished from वर, the former being taken to be merely an expression of one's good wishes which may or may not be realized; while a वर is a boon which is more permanent in character and surer of fulfilment; cf. वरः खल्वेषनाशीः Ś. 4; आशिषो गुरुजनवितीर्णा वरतामापद्यंते K. 291; अमोघाः प्रतिगृह्णंतावर्घ्यानुपदमाशिषः R. 1. 44, 11. 6; Ku. 5. 76, 7. 47. --2 Act of bestowing a blessing upon others. --3 A prayer, wish, desire; Ku. 5. 76, Bg. 4. 21, 6. 10. --4 A serpent's fang (cf. आशी). --5 One of the eight chief medicaments (वृद्धि). --Comp. --वादः, --वचनं ( आशीर्वादः &c.) a blessing, benediction, expression of a prayer or wish; आशीर्वचनसंयुक्तां नित्यं यस्मात् प्रकुर्वते S. D. 6; Ms. 2. 33. --विषः (आशीर्विषः) ‘having poison in its fangs,’ a snake.
7040: आशिंजित a. Tinkling(as of the ornaments worn on the hands and feet); Ku. 3. 26.
7043: आशिर् f. [आश्रीयते पच्यते आ-श्री-क्विप् Tv.] Milk &c. that is being boiled; (क्षीरादिकं श्रपणद्रव्यं Sāy.); the milk mixed with the Soma juice to purify it.
7044: आशिर a. Voracious. --रः 1 Fire. --2 The sun. --3 A demon.
7045: आशी [आशीर्यतेऽनया, आ-शॄ-क्विप् पृ°] 1 A serpent's fang. --2 A kind of venom. --3 A blessing, benediction. --Comp. --विषः [आश्यां विषमस्य] {1} a snake; गरुत्मदाशीविषभीमदर्शनैः R. 3. 57. {2} a particular kind of snake; कर्णाशीविषभोगिनिप्रशमिते Ve. 6. 1.
7046: आशी {c2c} A. 1 To lie or sleep on; कुसुमान्याशेरते षट्पदाः V. 2. 23 v. l. --2 To pass (the night) in sleep. --3 To wish, pray for. --4 To dwell, live, inhabit.
7047: आशयः [आ-शी-अच्] 1 A bedchamber, resting-place, asylum. --2 A place of residence, abode, seat, retreat; वायुर्गंधानिवाशयात् Bg. 15. 8; अपृथक्° U. 1. 45. --3 Sleeping, lying down. --4 Receptacle, reservoir; विषमोपि विगाह्यते नय कृततीर्थः पयसामिवाशयः Ki. 2. 3; cf. also words like जलाशय, आमाशय, रक्ताशय &c. --5 Any recipient vessel or viscus of the body; the Āśayas are 7: --वात°, पित्त°, श्लेष्मन्°, रक्त°, आम°, पक्व° (and गर्भ° in the case of women). --6 The stomach; आशयाग्निदीप्तिः Dk. 160. --7 Meaning, intention, purport, gist; इत्याशयः; एवं कवेराशयः (oft. used by commentators; see अभिप्राय). --8 The seat of feelings, mind, heart; अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः Bg. 10. 20; Mv. 2. 37. --9 Disposition of mind. --10 Prosperity. --11 A barn. --12 Will or pleasure. --13 Virtue or vice (as the eventual cause of pleasure or pain). --14 Fate, fortune. --15 Property, possession. --16 A miser. --17 A kind of pit (made for catching animals); आस्ते परमसंतप्तो नूनं सिंह इवाशये Mb. --18 N. of a tree (पनस). --Comp. --आशः fire.
7048: आशु a. [अश्-व्याप्तौ उण्] Fast, quick. --शुः Ved. 1 ‘The quick one’, a horse. --2 Rice (ripening quickly in the rainy season). --शु ind. Fast, quickly, immediately, directly; वर्त्म भानोस्त्यजाशु Me. 39, 22. [cf. L. acu; Gr. okus.]. --Comp. --आपस् a. obtaining quickly. --कारिन्, --कृत् a. {1} doing anything quickly, smart, active. {2} operating quickly (as a medicine). --कोपिन् a. irascible, irritable. --क्रिया quick operation of a medicine. --ग a. swift, quick. (--गः) {1} the wind. {2} the sun. {3} an arrow; पपावनास्वादितपूर्वमाशुगः R. 3. 54, 11. 83, 12. 91. --गामिन् a. going quickly. (--m.). the sun. --तोष a. easily appeased or pleased. (--षः) an epithet of Śiva. --पत्री a tree which yields frankincense (शल्लकीलता). --पत्वन् a. flying quickly. --बोध a. teaching quickly, N. of a grammar. --या a. going quickly. (--ind.) quickly. --व्रीहिः rice ripening in the rainy season. --षेण a. Ved. having swift arrows. --हेमन् a. running on quickly, urging the horses. --हेषस् a. Ved. quickly neighing; having quick horses, quickly praised; (शीघ्रशब्दायमान).
7051: आशुशुक्षणि a. [आ शुष् सन् अनि Uṇ. 2. 102] 1 Being worshipped on account of shining very quickly, or causing sorrow to one's enemies (Sāy). --2 Shining forth. --णिः 1 Wind, air. --2 Fire; मंत्रपूतानि हवींषि प्रतिगृह्णात्येतत्प्रीत्याशुशुक्षणिः K. 44.
7054: आशोकेय a. (यी f.) [अशोक-ढञ्] (A place &c.) Near an Aśoka tree.
7056: आशौचं [अशुचेर्भावः अण्; P. VII. 3. 30] Impurity, see अशौचं; दशाहं शावमाशौचं ब्राह्मणस्य विधीयते Ms. 5. 59, 61, 62, 74, 80; Y. 3. 18.
7057: आश्चर्य a. [आ-चर्-ण्यत् सुट् P. VI. 1. 147] Marvellous, wonderful, extraordinary, astonishing, strange, curious; आश्चर्यो गवां दोहोऽगोपेन Sk.; तदनु ववृषुः पुष्पमाश्चर्यमेघाः R. 16. 87; °दर्शनो मनुष्यलोकः Ś. 7. --र्यं 1 A wonder, miracle, marvel; किमाश्चर्यं क्षारदेशे प्राणदा यमदूतिका Udb.; कर्माश्चर्याणि U. 1 wonderful deeds; K. 65; Mv. 1; Bg. 11. 6, 2. 29. --2 Surprise, wonder, astonishment; °मय Bg. 11. 11. --3 A strange appearance, prodigy. --4 (Used as an exclamation) A wonder, how strange or curious; आश्चर्यं परिपीडितो ऽभिरमते यच्चातकस्तृष्णया Chāt. 2. 4; usually with यच्च, यत्र or यदि with a following potential or future. --Comp. --भूत a. wonderful, being an object of wonder; K. 8.
7059: आश्चो(श्च्यो)तन a. Sprinkling. --नं 1 Aspersion, sprinkling. --2 Applying ghee &c. to the eyelids.
7060: आश्म a. (श्मी f.) [अश्मन्-अण्] Made of stone, stony. --श्मः Anything made of stone. --Comp. --भारिक a. having a mass of stones. --रथ्यः N. of a teacher of ritual.
7061: आश्मन a. (नी f.) [अश्मनो विकारः अण्] Stony, made of stones. --नः 1 Anything made of stone. --2 N. of Aruṇa, the charioteer of the sun.
7062: आश्मरिक a. (की f.) [अश्मर्येव स्वार्थे बा° ठञ्] Suffering from stone in the bladder. --कः N. of a disease (अश्मरी q. v.).
7063: आश्मिक a. (की f.) 1 Made of stone. --2 Carrying or bearing stones.
7064: आश्यै {c1c} A. To become congealed or coagulated, to become dry; यावन्नाश्यायते वेदिः R. 17. 37.
7065: आश्यान p. p. 1 Congealed, consolidated; पंकैरिवाश्यानवनैस्तटानि Ki. 16. 10. --2 Partially dried; पथश्चाश्यानकर्दमान् R. 4. 24; Ku. 7. 9; dried by fumigation (as hair); R. 17. 22.
7067: आश्रपणं [आ-श्रा-णिच् ल्युट्] The act of cooking or boiling.
7068: आश्रमः, --मं [आ-श्रम् आधारे घञ् वृद्ध्य भावः] 1 A hermitage, hut, cell, dwelling or abode of ascetics. --2 A stage, order, or period of the (religious) life of a Brāhmaṇa. These are four: --ब्रह्मचर्य the life of a student; गार्हस्थ्य the life of a house holder: वानप्रस्य the life of an anchorite or hermit, and संन्यास the life of a Bhikṣu or beggar. Kṣatriyas (and Vaiśyas also) can enter upon the first three Āśramas; cf. Ś. 7. 20; V. 5; (according to some authorities they can enter the fourth also; cf. सकिलाश्रममंत्यमाश्रितः R. 8. 14); पूर्वाश्रमः Ku. 5. 50. --3 A college, school. --4 A wood or thicket (where ascetics practise penance). --5 N. of Viṣṇu. --Comp. --गुरुः the head of a religious order, a preceptor, principal. --धर्मः {1} the special duties of each order or life. {2} the duties of one leading a hermit's life; य इमामाश्रमधर्मे नियुङ्क्ते Ś. 1. --पदं, --मंडलं, --स्थानं {1} a hermitage (including the surrounding grounds), a penance forest (तपोवनं); शांतमिदमाश्रमपदं Ś. 1. 16. {2} a period in the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa. --भ्रष्ट a. fallen from any religious order, apostate. --वासः residence in a hermitage. --वासिक a. relating to residence in a hermitage; °कं पर्व the 15th book of the Mb. --वासिन्, --आलयः, --सद् m. an ascetic, hermit.
7069: आश्रमिक a., आश्रमिन् a. [आश्रम-ठन् इति] 1 Belonging to one of the four orders or periods of religious life; Ms. 6. 90-91, 12. 111, 3. 78. --2 Belonging to a hermitage.
7070: आश्रवः 1 Stream, river. --2 Fault, transgression; see आस्रव and under आश्रु also.
7071: आश्रि {c1c} U. 1 (a) To resort or betake oneself to; to have recourse to (a place, way, course of action &c.); विचरितमृगयूथान्याश्रयिष्ये वनानि V. 5. 17; Rs. 1. 27 v. l.; दक्षिणां मूर्तिमाश्रित्य K. 128, 132; न वयं कुमारमाश्रयामहे Mu. 4; आशिश्राय च भूतलं Bk. 14. 111 fell on the ground; 17. 92; वृतिमाश्रित्य वैतसीं R. 4. 35 resorting to or following; so धैर्यं, शोकं, बलं, मित्रभावं, संस्कृतमाश्रित्य &c.; आश्रित्य having recourse or reference; तामाश्रि य M. 4. 1; कततत्प्रकरणमाश्रित्य गीयतां Ś. 1 (b) To seek refuge with, dwell with or in, inhabit (as a place &c); शरण्यमेनमाश्रयन्ते R. 13. 7; Pt. 1. 51; तथा गृहस्थमाश्रित्य वर्तंते सर्व आश्रमाः Ms. 3. 77; सर्वे गुणाः कांचनमाश्रयंत्।. --2 To go through, experience; एकोरसः… पृथक्पृथगिवाश्रयते विवर्तान् U. 3. 47. --3 To rest or depend upon. --4 To adhere or stick to, fall to the lot of, happen, occur; पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान् Bg. 1. 36 we shall incur sin. --5 To choose, prefer. --6 To assist, help.
7072: आश्रयः [आश्रि-अच्] 1 A restingplace, seat, substratum; सौहृदादपृथगाश्रयामिमां U. 1. 45 v. l.; so आश्रयासिद्ध q. v. below. --2 That on which anything depends or rests, or with which it is closely connected. --3 Recipient, receptacle, a person or thing in which any quality is present or retained &c.; तमाश्रयं दुष्प्रसहस्य तेजसः R. 3. 58. --4 (a) A place of refuge, asylum; shelter; भर्ता वै ह्याश्रयः स्त्रीणां Vet.; तदहमाश्रयोन्मूलनेनैव त्वामकामां करोमि Mu. 2. (b) A dwelling, house. --5 Having recourse or resort to, resort; oft. in comp. साभूद्रामाश्रया भूयः R. 12. 35; नानाश्रया प्रकृतिः &c. --6 Following, practising; Ms. 2. 11. --7 Choosing, taking, attaching oneself to. --8 Dependence on; oft. in comp.; मम सर्वे विषयास्त्वदाश्रयाः R. 8. 69. --9 Patron, supporter; विनाश्रयं न तिष्ठंति पंडिता वनिता लताः Udb. --10 A prop, support; R. 9. 60. --11 Help, assistance, protection. --12 A quiver; बाणमाश्रयमुखात् समुद्धरन् R. 11. 26. --13 Authority, sanction, warrant. --14 Connection, relation, association. --15 Union, attachment. --16 A plea, an excuse. --17 Contiguity, vicinity. --18 Seeking shelter or protection with another (= संश्रय), one of the six gunas, q. v. --19 An appropriate act, or one consistent with character. --20 Source, origin. --21 (In gram.) The subject, or that to which the predicate is attached. --22 (With Buddhists) The five organs of sense with Manas or mind. --Comp. --असिद्धः, --द्धिः f. a kind of fallacy, one of the three sub-divisions of असिद्ध; (that whose substratum is false or fictitious); e. g. गगमारनिंदं सुरभि अरविंदत्व त्सरोजारविंदवत्. --आशः, --भुज् a. consuming every thing with which it comes in contact. (--शः, --क्) {1} fire; दुर्वृत्तः क्रियते धूर्तैः श्रीमानात्मविवृद्धये । किं नाम खलसंसर्गः कुरुते नाश्रयाशवत् ॥ Udb. {2} a forfeiter of asylum. {3} the constellation कृत्तिका. --भूत a. one who is the refuge or support (of another person). --लिंगं an adjective (a word which must agree in gender with the word which it qualifies or refers to).
7073: आश्रयण a. (णी f.) 1 Resorting to, seeking refuge with; Ku. 4. 20. --2 Referring to. --णं 1 Betaking oneself to, taking refuge with. --2 Accepting, choosing. --3 Joining. --4 Refuge, asylum.
7074: आश्रयणीय pot. p. 1 To be had recourse to; R. 17. 60. --2 To be practised or followed &c.
7075: आश्रयिन् a. 1 Resting with, dependent on. --2 Related to, concerning; तदाश्रयिणी कथा V. 3. 10; K. 213. --3 Resorting to; R. 6. 4; Ratn. 2.
7076: आश्रित p. p. (Used actively) (with an acc.) 1 Resorting to, having recourse to; स किलाश्रममंत्यमाश्रितः R. 8. 14; कृष्णाश्रितः = कृष्णमाश्रितः Sk.; मानुषीं तनुं Bg. 9. 11; R. 1. 13. --2 Dwelling in, inhabiting, seated or resting on, stationing oneself at or on; इदं स्फटिकतलमाश्रितो भवामि M. 4; so वातायनमाश्रितः पश्यति; द्रव्याश्रितो गुणः Ak.; R. 12. 21, 1. 75; ह्वार°, दुर्ग° &c. --3 Using, employing. --4 Following, practising, observing; माध्यस्थ्यं, धर्मं, प्रव्रज्यां; Ku. 6. 6; Bk. 7. 42. --5 Receiving anything as an inherent or integral part. --6 Dependent on; राष्ट्रं बाहुबलाश्रितं Ms. 9. 255. --7 Referring to, regarding; भीष्माश्रिताः कथाः Mb. --8 (Passively used) Resorted to, inhabited &c.; चटकाश्रिता शाखा Pt. 1; R. 3. 11. --तः A dependent, servant, follower; अस्मदाश्रितानां H. 1; प्रभूणां प्रायश्चलं गौरवमाश्रितेषु Ku. 3. 1. --तं (pl.) The objects perceived by the senses and mind.
7077: आश्रिः f. The edge of a sword.
7078: आश्रु {c5c} P. 1 To hear, listen to. --2 To promise (with dat. of person; cf. P. I. 4. 40; Y. 2. 196). --3 To accept, undertake. --Caus. 1 To cause to hear. --2 To call, particularly in ritualistic formulas; ओमित्याश्रावयति Ch. Up. --3 To draw towards, win over, attract; Bk. 12. 30. --4 To say, repeat (as a Mantra).
7079: आश्रव a. [आ-श्रु-अच्] Obedient, compliant; भिषजामनाश्रवः R. 19. 49; N. 3. 84. --वः 1 A promise, engagement. --2 Fault, transgression. --3 One of the categories according to the Jainas; see आस्रव.
7080: आश्रावणं 1 Calling out so as to make one listen. --2 N. of certain short words uttered at ceremonies; ॐ स्वधेत्याश्रावणमस्तु स्वधेति प्रत्याश्रावणं Āśval.
7081: आश्रुत p. p. 1 Heard. --2 Promised, agreed, accepted. --तं Calling so as to make one listen.
7083: आश्रुकर्ण a. One whose ears hear all around (Ved.).
7084: आश्लिष् {c4c} P. 1 To embrace, clasp; Bh. 3. 92. --2 To cleave or stick to.
7085: आश्लिष्ट p. p. 1 Embraced, clasped; used actively also; आश्लिष्टो लक्ष्मीं Sk. --2 Connected, interwoven, blended; परस्पराश्लिष्टशाखैः पादपैः Mb. --3 Joined to, touching, in contact with; अवनितलाश्लिष्टललाटरेखया K. 67; अंगद° भुज R. 6. 53; Śi. 3. 72; मेघमाश्लिष्टसानुं Me. 2. --4 Joining what adheres or attaches to. --5 Invested; spread. --6 Deduced, concluded.
7086: आश्लेषः 1 Embracing, clasping, an embrace; आश्लेषलोलुपवधूस्तनकार्कश्यसाक्षिणीं Śi. 2. 17; Amaru. 15, 72, 94; कंठाश्लेषप्रणयिनि जने Me. 3, 106. --2 Contact, intimate connection; relation; सामीप्याश्लेषविषयैर्व्याप्त्याधारश्चतुर्विधः Mugdha. --3 The site of an act. --षा f. (pl.) N. of the ninth Nakṣatra.
7087: आश्व a. (श्वी f.) [अश्वस्येदं अण्] 1 Belonging to or coming from a horse, equestrian; आश्वं कफहरं मूत्रं कृमिदद्रुषु शस्यते Suśr. --2 Drawn by horses (as a chariot). --श्वं 1 A number of horses. --2 A chariot drawn by horses. --3 The state or action of a horse (अश्वस्य भावः कर्म वा Sk.).
7088: आश्वत्थ a. (त्थी f.), आश्वथिक a. (की f.) [अश्वत्थस्येदं अण् ठक् वा] 1 Relating to or made of the holy fig-tree. --2 Relating to the fruit-bearing season of this tree, as a मुहूर्त. --त्था The night having the अश्वत्थ Nakṣatra. --त्थं The fruit of the holy fig-tree.
7089: आश्वभारिक a. (की f.) = अश्वभारं हरति, वहति आवहति वा.
7090: आश्वमेधिक a. (की f.) [अश्वमेधाय हितं ठण्] Belonging to the horsesacrifice. --कं N. of the 14th Parvan of Mahābhārata.
7091: आश्वयुज a. (जी f.) [अश्वयुज-अण्] 1 Belonging to the month Āśvina. --2 Born under the constellation अश्वयुज्. --जः The month आश्विन; भाद्रपदाश्वयुजौ वर्षाः Suśr.; Ms. 6. 15; Y. 3. 47. --जी The day of the full moon in Āśvina.
7092: आश्वयुजक a. (की f.) Sown at the day of full moon in Āśvina.
7093: आश्वरथ a. (थी f.) [अश्वरथ-अञ्] Belonging to a chariot drawn by horses.
7094: आश्वलक्षणिक a. (की f.) [ अश्वलक्षणठक्] Knowing the marks of horses. --कः A farrier, groom.
7095: आश्विक a. (की f.) [अश्व-ठञ्] Relating to a horse, drawn by horses, equestrian, cavalier. --कः 1 A cavalier. --2 A combination of stars or omens presaging acquisition of horses.
7096: आश्विन a. (नी f.) 1 Belonging or sacred to the Aśvins (अश्विनौ देवते अस्य). --2 Pervading. --नः 1 N. of a month (in which the moon is near ths constellation Aśvinī). --2 A sacrifice or a weapon presided over by the Aśvins. --3 (du.) The Aśvins. --नी 1 N. of certain bricks. --2 A pile, stack (चितिभेदः). --नं A day's journey for a horse or rider (Ved.).
7097: आश्विनेय m. [अश्विन्याः अपत्यं ढक्] The two Aśvins (physicians of gods). --नः 1 N. of Nakula and Sahadeva, the last two of the five Pāṇḍava princes. --2 A day's journey for a horse.
7098: आश्वीन a. (नी f.) [अश्व-खञ्] Made or traversed by a horse (as a journey &c.); °नोऽध्वा Sk. --नः --नं The distance travelled by a horse in a day; सहस्राश्वीने वा इतः स्वर्गो लोकः Ait. Br.
7100: आश्वलायनः N. of the author of a celebrated ritual work, called the Āśvalāyana Sūtras.
