25601: विकलीकृ {c8c} U. 1 To maim, mutilate. --2 To impair, harm. injure. --3 To agitate, perplex, confound.
25603: विकला The sixtieth part of a Kalā, q. v.
25606: विकस् {c1c} P. 1 To open, expand (fig. also); विकसति हि पतंगस्योदये पुंडरीकं Māl. 1. 28; Śi. 9. 47, 82; Ku. 7. 55; निजहृदि विकसंतः Bh. 2. 78. --2 To burst, become divided. --Caus. To open, cause to expand; चंद्रो विकासयति कैरवचक्रवालं Bh. 2. 73; Śi. 15. 12; Amaru. 84.
25608: विकसित p. p. Blown, fully opened or expanded; Bv. 1. 100.
25609: विकासः 1 Blowing, expanding, blooming, budding. --2 Increase, growth; U. 6. 28; see विकाश also.
25611: विकस्व(श्व)र a. 1 Opening, expanding; कुशेशयैरत्र जलाशयोषिता मुदा रमंते कलभा विकस्वरैः Śi. 4. 33. --2 Loud, distinctly audible (as a sound); उदडीयत वैकृतात्करग्रहजादस्य विकस्वरस्वरैः N. 2. 5.
25612: विकालः, विकालकः Evening, evening twilight, the close of day.
25613: विकालिका A perforated coppervessel which, placed in water, marks the time by gradually filling; cf. मानरंध्रा.
25614: विकाश् {c1c} A. 1 To appear, become visible. --2 To bloom, open. --3 To shine. --Caus. 1 To display, manifest. --2 To illuminate.
25615: विकाशः 1 Manifestation, display, exhibition. --2 Blowing, expanding (usually written विकास in this sense); Ku. 3. 29. --3 An open or direct course; विकाशमीयुर्जगतीशमार्गणाः Ki. 15. 52. --4 An oblique course; Ki. 15. 52. --5 Joy, pleasure; Ki. 15. 52. --6 Sky, heaven (आकाश); Ki. 15. 52. --7 Eagerness, ardent desire; Śi. 9. 41 (where it means ‘blowing’ also). --8 Retreat, solitude, privacy.
25617: विकाशनं 1 Manifestation, display, exhibition. --2 Blowing, expanding (of flowers &c.).
25618: विकाशि(सि)न् a. (नी f.) 1 Becoming visible, shining forth. --2 Expanding, opening, blowing. --3 Shining, resplendent; Pt. 3. 147.
25619: विकुंठ N. of Viṣṇu's heaven. --ठा N. of the mother of Viṣṇu.
25622: विकूजनं 1 Cooing, humming. --2 Rumbling (as of the bowels).
25625: विकृ {c8c} U. 1 To alter, change, affect; विकारहेतौ सति विक्रियंते येषां न चेतांसि त एव धीराः Ku. 1. 59; R. 13. 42. --2 To disfigure, deform; विकृताकृति Ms. 9. 52. --3 To create, produce, effect; Ms. 1. 75; नास्य विघ्नं विकुर्विंति दानवाः Mb. --4 To disturb, harm, injure (A.); हीनान्यनुपकर्तॄणि प्रवृद्धानि विकुर्वते R. 17. 58. --5 To utter (a sound); विकुर्वाणः स्वरानद्य Bk. 8. 20. --6 To be faithless (as a wife). --7 To deprave, pervert, spoil. --8 To display. --9 To change for the worse, deteriorate (A.). --10 To rejoice (A.). --11 To feel aversion (A.). --12 To act in various ways (A.). --13 To decorate in various ways. --14 To exercise. --15 To distribute. --16 To destroy, ruin. --17 To spread, extend. --18 To become restless; move to and fro. --19 To act in a hostile manner. --20 To contend together.
25626: विकारः 1 Change of form or nature, transformation, deviation from the natural state; cf. विकृति. --2 A change, alteration, a modification; Pt. 1. 44; Ś. 7. --3 Sickness, disease, malady; विकारं खलु परमार्थतोऽज्ञात्वाऽनारंभः प्रतीकारस्य Ś. 4; Ku. 2. 48. --4 Change of mind or purpose; मूर्छंत्यमी विकाराः प्रायेणैश्वर्यमत्तेषु Ś. 5. 18. --5 A feeling, an emotion; विकारश्चैतन्यं भ्रमयति च संमीलयति च U. 1. 35, 3. 25, 36; Māl. 1. 30. --6 Agitation, excitement, perturbation; Ki. 17. 23. --7 Contortion, contraction (as of the features of the face); प्रमथमुखबिकारैर्हासयामास गूढं Ku. 7. 95. --8 (In Sān, phil.) That which is evolved from a previous source or Prakṛti. --9 A wound. --Comp. --हेतुः a temptation, seduction, cause of perturbation; विकारहेतौ सति विक्रियंते येषां न चेतांसि त एव धीराः Ku. 1. 59.
25628: विकारिन् a. 1 Liable to change, susceptible of emotions or impressions; भ्रमति भुवने कंदर्पाज्ञा विकारि च यौवनं Māl. 1. 17. --2 Changing, modifying. --3 Spoiling, corrupting. --4 Affected by love.
25629: विकुर्वाण a. 1 Undergoing or causing a change. --2 Feeling glad, delighted, rejoiced.
25630: विकृत p. p. 1 Changed, altered, modified. --2 Sick, diseased. --3 Mutilated, deformed, disfigured. --4 Incomplete, imperfect. --5 Affected by passion or emotion. --6 Averse from, disgusted with. --7 Loathsome. --8 Strange, extraordinary. --9 Unnatural. --10 Perverted, spoiled; see विकृ above. --तं 1 Change, modification. --2 Change for the worse, sickness. --3 Aversion, disgust.
25631: विकृतिः f. 1 Change(as of purpose, mind, form &c.); चित्तविकृतिः, अंगुलीयकं सुवर्णस्य विकृतिः &c. --2 An unnatural or accidental circumstance, an accident; मरणं प्रकृतिः शरीरिणां विकृतिर्जीवितमुच्यते बुधैः R. 8. 87. --3 Sickness. --4 Excitement, perturbation, anger, rage; Ki. 13. 56; U. 5. 29; Śi. 15. 11, 40. --5 Emotion; Ś. 2. 5. --6 A sudden seizure or affection. --7 Fermented liquor; see विकार and विक्रिया also.
25632: विकृष् {c1c} P. 1 To draw, pull. --2 To bend (as a bow); शरासनं तेषु विकृष्यतामिदं Ś. 6. 28. --3 To deprive of, withhold, keep back. --4 To destroy, ruin.
25633: विकर्षः 1 Drawing asunder, pulling apart. --2 An arrow.
25634: विकर्षणः N. of one of the five arrows of Cupid. --णं 1 Drawing, dragging, pulling asunder. --2 A cross throw.
25635: विकृष्ट p. p. 1 Dragged asunder, pulled hither and thither. --2 Drawn, pulled, drawn towards or attracted. --3 Extended, protracted. --4 Making a noise; (see कृष् with वि).
25636: विकॄ {c6c} P. 1 To scatter, throw about; strew or spread about; Ku. 3. 61; Ki. 2. 59; Bk. 1. 3; 14. 25. --2 To split, cut to pieces; असिर्गात्रं गात्रं सपदि लवशस्ते विकिरतु Māl. 5. 34. --3 To pollute, contaminate. --4 To dissolve.
25637: विकिरः 1 A scattered portion or fallen bit. --2 One who tears or scatters, a bird; कंकोलीफलजग्धिमुग्धविकिरव्याहारिणस्तद्भुवो भागाः Māl. 6. 19. --3 A well. --4 A tree.
25638: विकिरणं 1 Scattering, throwing about, dispersing. --2 Spreading abroad. --3 Tearing up. --4 Killing (हिंसन). --5 Knowledge. --णः The Arka tree.
25639: विकीर्ण p. p. 1 Scattered, dispersed. --2 Diffused. --3 Celebrated. --Comp. --केश, --मूर्धज a. tearing the hair, having dishevelled hair; विललाप विकीर्णमूर्वजा Ku. 4. 4. --ज्ञं a kind of perfume.
25640: विकॢप् {c1c} A. 1 To doubt, be doubtful; Pt. 1. 339. --2 To be optional. --Caus. 1 To doubt, question. --2 To consider, reflect upon; सखीनियोगोऽपि विकल्प्यते Ś. 3. --3 To presume, conjecture. --4 To prepare or arrange differently. --5 To make, form. --6 To exchange. --7 To admit as optional.
25641: विकल्पः 1 Doubt, uncertainty, indecision, hesitation; तत्सिषेवे नियोगेन स विकल्पपराङ्मुखः R. 17. 49. --2 Suspicion; Mu. 1. --3 Contrivance, art; मायाविकल्परचितैः R. 13. 75. --4 Option, alternative (in gram.). --5 Sort, variety. --6 An error, a mistake, ignorance. --7 Distinction. --Comp. --उपहारः an optional offering. --जालं a net-like indecision, a dilemma.
25642: विकल्पनं 1 Admitting of a doubt. --2 Allowing an option. --3 Indecision. --4 Inconsideration.
25643: विकेश a. (शी f.) 1 Having loose hair. --2 Having no hair, bald (as head). --शी 1 A woman with loose hair. --2 A woman without hair. --3 A small tress of hair tied up separately and then collected into the larger braid or Veṇi. --4 N. of the wife of Śiva in the form of the Earth (one of the 8 forms of Śiva; cf. यामाहुः सर्वभूतप्रकृतिः Ś. 1. 1.).
25644: विकोश --ष a. 1 Without husk. --2 Unsheathed, uncovered; Ki. 17. 45; R. 7. 48.
25646: विक्रम् {c1c} A. 1 To walk along or through; विष्णुस्त्रेधा विचक्रमे ‘took {3} steps’; Bk. 1. 24. --2 To assail, overcome, conquer. --3 To cleave; split open (P.) --4 To advance, proceed. --5 To show prowess or valour; Māl. 8. 9.
25647: विक्रमः 1 A step, stride, pace; गतेषु लीलांचितविक्रमेषु Ku. 1. 34; Ś. 7. 6; cf. त्रिविक्रम. --2 Stepping over, walking. --3 Overcoming, overpowering. --4 Heroism, prowess, heroic valour; अनुत्सेकः खलु विक्रमालंकारः V. 1; R. 12. 87, 93. --5 N. of a celebrated king of Ujjayinī; see App. II. --6 N. of Viṣṇu. --7 Strength, power. --Comp. --अर्कः, --आदित्यः see विक्रम. --कर्मन् n. a heroic deed, feat of valour.
25648: विक्रमणं A stride (of Viṣṇu); छलयसि विक्रमणे बलिमद्भुतवामन Gīt. 1.
25649: विक्रमिन् a. 1 Chivalrous, heroic. --2 Powerful, strong. --m. 1 A lion. --2 A hero. --3 An epithet of Viṣṇu.
25650: विक्रांत p. p. 1 Stepped or passed beyond. --2 Powerful, heroic, valiant, chivalrous. --3 Victorious, overpowering (one's enemies). --तः 1 A hero, warrior. --2 A lion. --तं 1 A pace, stride. --2 Heroism, valour, prowess. --3 The jewel called वैक्रात.
25651: विक्रांतिः f. 1 Stepping, striding. --2 A horse's gallop or canter. --3 Heroism, valour, prowess.
25652: विक्रांतृ a. Valiant, victorious. --m. 1 A lion. --2 A hero, victor.
25654: विक्रिया 1 Change, modification, alternation; श्मश्रुप्रवृद्धिजनिताननविक्रियान् R. 13. 71, 10. 17. --2 Agitation, excitement, perturbation, excitement of passion; अथ तेन निगृह्य विक्रियामभिशप्तः फलमेतदन्वभूत् Ku. 4. 41, 3. 34. --3 Anger, wrath, displeasure; साधोः प्रकोपितस्यापि मनो नायाति विक्रियां Subhāṣ.; लिंगैर्मुदः संवृतविक्रियास्ते R. 7. 30. --4 Reverse, evil; Ku. 6. 29 (वैकल्यं Malli. ‘defect’.) --5 Knitting, contraction (of the eyebrows); भ्रूविक्रियायां विरतप्रसंगैः Ku. 3. 47. --6 Any sudden movement, as in रोमविक्रिया V. 1. 12 ‘thrill’. --7 A sudden affection or seizure, disease. --8 Violation, vitiation (of the proper duties); R. 15. 48. --9 A preparation or dish of rice &c. --Comp. --उपमा a kind of Upamā mentioned by Daṇḍin; see Kāv. 2. 41.
25655: विक्री {c9c} A. 1 To sell (Atm. in this sense); गवां शतसहस्रेण विक्रीणीषे सुतं यदि Rām; विक्रीणीत तिलाञ् शुद्धान् Ms. 10. 90; 8. 197, 222; Śānti. 1. 12. --2 To barter, exchange; नाक्रस्माच्छांडिलीमाता विक्रीणाति तिलैस्तिलान् Pt. 2. 65.
25656: विक्रयः Sale, selling: Ms. 3. 54. --Comp. --अनुशयः rescission of a sale. --पत्रं a bill of sale, sale-deed.
25657: विक्रयिकः, विक्रयिन् m. A dealer, seller, vendor.
25658: विक्रेय a. Saleable, vendible (as an article).
25659: विक्रुश् {c1c} P. 1 To call aloud, cry out loudly; आक्रोश विक्रोश लपाधिचंडं Mk. 1. 41; Bk. 14. 42; 16. 32. --2 To utter (with acc.). --3 To call out to (with acc.). --4 To resound. --5 To abuse, revile, censure.
25660: विक्रुष्ट p. p. 1 Exclaimed, cried out. --2 Harsh, cruel, unkind. --ष्टं 1 A cry for help. --2 Abuse.
25662: विक्लव a. 1 Overcome with fear, startled, alarmed, frightened; आचकांक्ष घनशब्दविक्लवाः R. 19. 38; Ku. 4. 11. --2 Timid; Śi. 7. 43; Me. 37. --3 Affected by, overcome with; निसर्गदुर्बोधमबोधविक्लवाः क्व भूपतीनां चरितं क्व जतवः Ki. 1. 6. --4 Agitated, excited, confused, bewildered; Ś. 3. 25. --5 Distressed, afflicted; grieved; निराकरणविक्लवायाः प्रियायाः Ś. 6; Śi. 12. 63; Ku. 4. 39. --6 Disgusted with, averse from; मृगयाविक्लवं चेतः Ś. 2. --7 Faltering; प्रस्थानाविक्लव गतेरवलंबनार्थं Ś. 5. 3.
25663: विक्लिन्न p. p. 1 Very moist, thoroughly wetted. --2 Decayed, withered up. --3 Old.
25664: विक्लिष्ट p. p. 1 Excessively afflicted, distressed. --2 Injured, destroyed. --ष्टं A fault in pronunciation.
25666: विक्लेशः An incorrect pronunciation of the dentals.
25667: विक्षत p. p. Torn asunder, wounded, hurt, struck. --तं Wounding, a wound.
25669: विक्षिप् {c6c} P. 1 To throw about, scatter. --2 To throw, cast. --3 To divert. --4 To distract. --5 To extend, stretch out. --6 To reject, discard.
25670: विक्षिप्त p. p. 1 Scattered, thrown about, dispersed, cast about. --2 Discarded, dismissed. --3 Sent, despatched. --4 Distracted, bewildered, agitated; Māl. 9. 8. --5 Refuted; (see क्षिप् with वि).
25671: विक्षेपः 1 Throwing away or asunder, scattering about. --2 Casting, throwing, discharging (opp. संहार); R. 5. 45. --3 Waving, moving about, shaking, moving to and fro; लांगूल° Ku. 1. 13. --4 Sending, despatching. --5 Distraction, confusion, perplexity; Māl. 1. --6 Alarm, fear. --7 Refutation of an argument. --8 Polar latitude. --9 Looking about vaguely or wildly. --Comp. --ध्रुवः (in astr.) the greatest inclination of a planet's orbit. --शक्ति f. (in Vedānta phil.) the power of Māyā (अविद्या).
25672: विक्षेपणं 1 Throwing, casting, discharging. --2 Despatching, sending. --3 Scattering, dispersing. --4 Confusion, perplexity.
25673: विक्षीणकः 1 N. of the chief of a class of beings attending on Śiva. --2 An assembly of the gods. --3 A destroyer. --4 A place from which flesh-eaters are excluded.
25675: विक्षुभ् {c1c} A., {c4c} {c9c} P. 1 To be greatly agitated or disturbed. --2 To confuse, disturb, perplex. --Caus. To agitate, disturb, confuse &c.
25676: विक्षोभः 1 Shaking. agitation, movement; वीचि° R. 1. 43. --2 Agitation of mind, distraction, alarm. --3 Conflict, struggle.
25677: विख a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.
25678: विखु a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.
25679: विख्य a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.
25680: विख्र a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.
25681: विख्रु a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.
25682: विग्र a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.
25683: विखंडित p. p. 1 Broken up, divided. --2 Cleft in two. --3 Disfigured, mutilated; Pt. 4. 89. --4 Refuted.
25686: विखुरः 1 A demon, goblin. --2 A thief.
25687: विख्या {c2c} P. 1 To be well-known or famous. --2 To look at, see. --3 To call, name. --4 To celebrate. --5 To make visible, illuminate. --Caus. To proclaim, announce, publish.
25688: विख्यात p. p. 1 Renowned, wellknown, celebrated, famous. --2 Called, named. --3 Avowed, confessed.
25690: विख्यापनं 1 Publishing, proclaiming. --2 Explanation, exposition. --3 Confessing, acknowledging.
25691: विगण् {c10c} P. 1 To number, compute; Y. 3. 104. --2 To regard, consider; Me. 109; R. 1. 87. --3 To disregard, not to mind. --4 To reflect, think; Pt. 3. 43.
25692: विगणनं 1 Reckoning, computing, calculation. --2 Considering, deliberating. --3 Paying off a debt.
25694: विगम् {c1c} P. 1 To pass away (as time &c.); संध्ययापि सपदि व्यगमि Śi. 9. 17. --2 To go away, depart. --3 To vanish; disappear; सलज्जाया लज्जा व्यगमदिव दूरं मृगदृशः Gīt. 11; Bg. 11. 1. --4 To die. --Caus. To spend, pass; विगमयत्युन्निद्र एव क्षपाः Ś. 6. 4.
25695: विगत p. p. 1 Departed, gone away, disappeared. --2 Parted, separated. --3 Dead. --4 Destitute or devoid of, free from (in comp.). विगतमदः. --5 Lost. --6 Dark, obscurd. --तं The flight of birds. --Comp. --आर्तवां a woman past child-bearing (in whom the menstrual discharge has ceased). --कल्मष a. sinless, pure. --भी a. fearless, intrepid. --लक्षण a. unlucky, inauspicious. --स्पृह a. indifferent, void of desire.
25696: विगमः 1 Departure, disappearance, cessation, end; चारुनृत्यविगमे च तन्मुखं R. 19. 15; ईतिविगम M. 5. 20; Rs. 6. 23. --2 Abandoning; करणविगमात् Me. 55 (देहत्यागात्). --3 Loss, destruction. --4 Death. --5 Separation.
25697: विगरः 1 A naked ascetic. --2 A mountain. --3 An abstemious man (abstaining from eating).
25698: विगर्ह् {c1c} U. 1 To blame, censure, reproach; तं विगंर्हति साधवः Ms. 9. 68; 3. 46; 11. 53. --2 To despise, contemn.
25699: विगर्हणं, --णा Censure, blame, reproach, abuse; Ve. 1. 12.
25700: विगर्हित p. p. 1 Censured, reviled, abused. --2 Disdained. --3 Condemned, reprobated, prohibited. --4 Low, vile. --5 Bad, wicked. --तं Censure.
25701: विगल् {c1c} P. 1 To drop down, get loose; रतिविगलितवंधे केशहस्ते सुकेश्याः V. 4. 10. --2 To ooze or trickle. --3 To vanish, disappear. --4 To melt away, be dissolved.
25702: विगलित p. p. 1 Trickled, oozed. --2 Disappeared, gone away. --3 Fallen or dropped down. --4 Melted away, dissolved. --5 Dispersed. --6 Slackened. untied. --7 Loose, dishevelled, disordered (as hair).
25703: विगाह् {c1c} A. 1 To plunge or dive into, bathe; (दीर्घिकाः) स व्यगाहत विगाढमन्मथः R. 19. 9. --2 To enter, penetrate into, pervade (fig. also); विषमोऽपि विगाह्यते नयः कृततीर्थः पयसामिवाशयः Ki. 2. 3; R. 13. 1, Mu. 1. 26. --3 To stir about, agitate; विगाह्यमानां सरयूं च नौभिः R. 14. 30. --4 To follow, practise; तया मुनीनां चरितं व्यगाह्यत Ku. 5. 19. --5 To approach, set in (as season &c.).
25704: विगाढ p. p. 1 Plunged into, bathed, immersed. --2 Deep, excessive.
25706: विगुण a. 1 Destitute of merits, worthless, bad; श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् Bg. 3. 35; Śi. 9. 12, Mu. 6. 11. --2 Destitute of qualities. --3 Having no string; Mu. 7. 11.
25707: विगूढ p. p. 1 Secret, concealed, hidden. --2 Reproached, censured.
25708: विगै {c1c} P. 1 To censure, reproach, blame; विगीयसे मन्मथदेहदाहिना N. 1. 79. --2 To sing in a discordant tone.
25709: विगानं 1 Censure, reproach, defamation, scandal. --2 A contradictory statement, contradiction, inconsistency; यत्पुनः कारणविषयं विगानं दर्शितं तत्परिहर्तव्यं Ś. B. (and in several other places of the same work).
25710: विगीत p. p. 1 Censured, abused, reviled. --2 Contradictory, inconsistent.
25711: विगीतिः f. 1 Censure, abuse, reproach. --2 Contradictory statement, contradiction.
25712: विग्रह् {c9c} P. 1 To hold or seize, catch hold of; विजगृहे तिसृणां जयिनं पुरां Ki. 18. 12. --2 To quarrel, fight, contend; विगृह्य चक्रे नमुचिद्विषा बली य इत्थमस्वास्थ्यमहर्दिवं दिवः Śi. 1. 51; Bk. 6. 86; 17. 23, Ki. 14. 24. --3 To divide into parts, separate (into constituent members). --4 To dissolve, analyse, resolve in general. --5 To receive, welcome (as a guest). --6 To perceive, observe. --7 To stretch or spread out.
25713: विगृहीत p. p. 1 Divided, dissolved, analysed, resolved (as a compound). --2 Seized. --3 Encountered, opposed. --4 Obstructed, stopped; see विग्रह् above.
25714: विग्रहः 1 Stretching out, extension, expansion. --2 Form, figure, shape. --3 The body; त्रयी विग्रहवत्येव सममध्यात्मविद्यया M. 1. 14; गूढविग्रहः R. 3. 39, 9. 52; Ki. 4. 11, 12. 43. --4 Resolution, dissolution, analysis, separation (as of a compound word into its component parts); वृत्त्यर्थ (समासार्थ) बोधकं वाक्यं विग्रहः. --5 Quarrel, strife (often, lovequarrel or प्रणयकलह); विग्रहाच्च शयने पराङ्मुखीर्नानुनेतुमबलाः स तत्वरे R. 19. 38, 9. 47; Śi. 11. 35. --6 War, hostilities, fighting, battle (opp. संधि), one of the six Guṇas or modes of policy; see गुण. --7 Disfavour. --8 A part, portion, division.
25715: विग्रहवत् a. having, body, incarnate, embodied; M. 1. 14.
25717: विघट् {c1c} A. 1 To be disunited or separated. --2 To be spoiled or ruined. --3 To be stopped, break down. --4 To assume various shapes; Māl. 9. 24. --Caus. 1 To separate, disperse, tear apart; विघटयंत्यग्रेनभ्ॐऽभोमुचः Māl. 5. 2. --2 To remove, displace.
25719: विघटित p. p. 1 Separated, severed. --2 Divided. --3 Broken, shattered; U. 3. 43.
25720: विघटिका A measure of time equal to one-sixtieth part of a Ghaṭikā (or nearly equal to 24 seconds).
25721: विघट्ट् {c10c} U. 1 To strike down, disperse, scatter, scare away; Śi. 1. 64; Bh. 3. 54. --2 To rub, strike, rub against; कारंडवाननविघट्टितवीचिमालाः Rs. 3. 8; 4. 9; विघटृइतानां सरलद्रुमाणां Ku. 1. 9 Ki. 8. 45; Śi. 8. 24, 13. 41. --3 To break, violate (as an agreement). --4 To break asunder, burst open (as a door).
25722: विघट्टनं --ना 1 Striking asunder. --2 Striking against, friction. --3 Separating, undoing, untying. --4 Offending, hurting.
25723: विघट्टित p. p. 1 Struck apart, severed, separated, dispersed; Bh. 3. 54. --2 Untied, loosened, opened. --3 Rubbed, touched. --4 Shaken about, churned. --5 Hurt, offended.
25724: विघनः 1 A mallet, hammer. --2 One who destroys, subdues or overpowers.
25725: विघसः 1 Half-chewed morsel, the residue or leavings of food eaten; विघसो भुक्तशेषं तु Ms. 3. 285; तृप्यत्कालकरालवक्त्रविघसव्याकीर्यमाणा इव U. 5. 6; Māl. 5. 14. --2 Food in general. --सं Bees'-wax. --Comp. --आशः, --आशिन् m. one who eats the remains of an offering or of food eaten.
25726: विघातः 1 Destruction, removing, warding off; क्रियादवानां मघवा विघातं Ki. 3. 52. --2 Killing, slaying. --3 An obstacle, impediment, interruption; opposition, prevention; क्रियाविघाताय कथं प्रवर्तसे R. 3. 44; अध्वरविघातशांतये 11. 1. --4 A blow, stroke. --5 Abandoning, leaving. --Comp. --सिद्धिः f. the removal of obstacles.
25727: विघूर्णित p. p. Rolled, shaken about, rolling (as eyes).
25728: विघृष्ट p. p. 1 Rubbed excessively. --2 Sore.
25729: विघ्नः [विहन्-क] (rarely n.) 1 An obstacle, interruption, impediment, a hindrance; कुतो धर्मक्रियाविघ्नः सतां रक्षितरि त्वयि Ś. 5. 14; मूर्तो विघ्नस्तपस इव नः Ś. 1. 33; हुंकारेणेव धनुषः स हि विघ्नानपोहति Ś. 3. 1; Ku. 3. 40. --2 Difficulty, trouble. --Comp. --ईशः, --ईशानः, --ईश्वरः epithets of Gaṇeśa. °वाहनं a rat. --कर, --कर्तृ, --कारिन् a. opposing, obstructing. --ध्वंसः, --विघातः removal of obstacles. --नायकः, --नाशकः, --नाशनः epithets of Gaṇeśa. --प्रतिक्रिया removal of impediments; R. 15. 4. --राजः --विनायकः, --हारिन् m. epithets of Gaṇeśa. --सिद्धिः f. removal of obstacles.
25730: विघ्नयति Den. P. To obstruct, hinder, impede, oppose.
25731: विघ्नित a. 1 Impeded, hindered, obstructed, opposed; Pt. 1. 387. --2 Obscured, blinded; Ku. 3. 31.
25733: विच् {c3c} {c7c} U. (वेवोक्ति, वेविक्ते, विनक्ति, विंक्ते, विक्त) 1 To separate, divide, sever. --2 To discriminate, distinguish, discern. --3 To deprive of, remove from (with instr.); शशास स बहून्योधान् जीवितेन विवेच च Bk. 14. 103.
25734: विचकिलः 1 A kind of jasmine. --2 N. of the tree called Madana.
25735: विचक्षण a. 1 Clear sighted, farseeing, circumspect. --2 Wise, clever, learned; विचक्षणः प्रस्तुतमाचचक्षे R. 5. 19. --3 Expert, skilful, able; R. 13. 69. --णः A learned man, wise man; न दत्वा कस्यचित्कन्यां पुनर्दद्याद्विचक्षणः Ms. 9. 71.
25736: विचक्षस् m. A spiritual teacher, preceptor.
25737: विचक्षुस् a. 1 Blind, sightless. --2 Perplexed, sad.
25738: विचर् {c1c} P. 1 To wander about, roam over (oft. with acc.); इष्टान्देशान् विचर जलद Me. 115; विचचार दावं R. 2. 8; Ku. 3. 31. --2 To do, perform, practise. --3 To act, deal, behave. --4 To deviate from the right path, go about wantonly; Ms. 9. 20. --5 To pass through, pervade. --6 To attack, march against. --7 To associate or have intercourse with. --8 To go badly, fail. --Caus. 1 To think, reflect or meditate upon. --2 To discuss, call in question, debate; आज्ञा गुरूणां ह्यविचारणीया R. 14. 46. --3 To calculate, estimate; take into account, consider; परेषामात्मनश्चैव यो विचार्य बलाबलं Pt. 3; सुविचार्य यत्कृतं H. 1. 22. --4 To hesitate, doubt. --5 To examine, investigate. --6 To seduce.
25740: विचारः 1 Reflection, deliberation, thought, consideration; विचारमार्गप्रहितेन चक्षुषा Ku. 5. 42. --2 Examination, discussion, investigation; तत्वार्थविचार. --3 Trial, (of a case); विषसलिलतुलाग्निप्रार्थिते मे विचारे Mk. 9. 43. --4 Judgment, discrimination, discernment, exercise of reason; विचारमूढः प्रतिभासि मे त्वं R. 2. 47. --5 Decision, determination. --6 Selection. --7 Doubt, hesitation. --8 Prudence, circumspection. --Comp. --ज्ञ a. able to decide, a judge. --भूः f. {1} a tribunal, seat of justice. {2} particularly, the judgment-seat of Yama. --शील a. thoughtful, considerate, prudent. --स्थलं {1} a tribunal. {2} logical discussion.
25741: विचारकः An investigator, a judge, an examiner.
25742: विचारणं 1 Discussion, consideration, examination, deliberation, investigation. --2 Doubt, hesitation.
25743: विचारणा 1 Examination, discussion, investigation. --2 Reflection, consideration, thought. --3 Hesitation, doubt. --4 The Mīmāṃsā system of philosophy.
25744: विचारित p. p. 1 Considered, inquired into, examined, discussed. --2 Decided, determined. --तं Deliberation, thought.
25745: विचारिन् a. 1 Roaming, wandering. --2 Dissolute, wanton. --3 Deliberating, judging.
25748: विचल् {c1c} P. 1 To shake, tremble, move; पतति पतत्रे विचलति पत्रे शंकितभवदुपयानं Gīt. 5. --2 To go, proceed, set out. --3 To be agitated or disturbed, be rough (as the sea); व्यचालीदंभसां पतिः Bk. 15. 70. --4 To deviate, swerve; Y. 1. 358. --5 To fall off or down. --Caus. 1 To shake, move, wave, --2 To cause to swerve, lead away from. --3 To excite, agitate, stir up. --4 To destroy, rescind, annul.
25749: विचल a. 1 Moving about, shaking, wavering, tottering, unsteady (fig. also). --2 Conceited, proud.
25750: विचलनं 1 Moving. --2 Deviation. --3 Unsteadiness, fickleness. --4 Conceit, pride.
25751: विचि {c5c} U. 1 To collect, gather, bring together, store up; Pt. 1. 45, 36. --2 To search for, look out for; विचितश्चैष समंतात् श्मशानवाटः Māl. 5; R. 12. 61, 13. 23; प्रियतमां विचिन्वन् V. 4. --3 To seek, investigate, examine, reflect upon; R. 10. 23; Ki. 16. 1. --4 To separate, discern, distinguish. --5 To disarrange. --6 To select, choose. --7 To destroy, efface. --8 Ved. To clear, prepare (as a way).
25752: विचयः 1 Search, seeking, looking out for; तुरगविचयव्यग्रान् U. 1. 23. --2 Investigation.
25754: विचित p. p. Searched, searched through.
25755: विचितिः f. 1 Searching, search, seeking for. --2 Inquiry, investigation.
25756: विचिः m. f., विची f. A wave; cf. वीचि.
25757: विचिकित्सा 1 Doubt, hesitation, uncertainty. --2 Mistake, error.
25758: विचित्र a. 1 Diversified, variegated, spotted, speckled; Mu. 1. 4. --2 Various, varied. --3 Painted. --4 Beautiful, lovely; क्वचिद्विचित्रं जलयंत्रमंदिरं Rs. 1. 2. --5 Wonderful, surprising, strange; हतविधिलसितानां ही विचित्रो विपाकः Śi. 11. 64. --त्रा A white deer. --त्रं 1 Variegated colour. --2 Surprise. --Comp. --अंग a. having a spotted body. (--गः) {1} a peacock. {2} tiger. --देह a. having a lovely body. (--हः) a cloud. --रूप a. diverse. --वीर्यः N. of a king of the lunar race. [He was a son of Śantanu by his wife Satyavatī and so half-brother of Bhīṣma. When he died childless, his mother called Vyāsa (her own son before her marriage), and requested him to raise up issue to Vicitravīrya in accordance with the practice of Niyoga. He complied with the request, and begot on Ambikā and Ambālikā, the two widows of his brother, two sons Dhṛtarāshṭra and Pāṇḍu respectively].
25759: विचित्रकः The birch tree. --कं Wonder, astonishment, surprise.
25760: विचिंत् {c10c} U. 1 To think, consider. --2 To think of, ponder over, call to mind; विचिंतयंती यमनन्यमानसा Ś. 4. 1. --3 To take into consideration, have regard to, regard; अस्मान्साधु विचिंत्य संमयधनानुच्चैःकुलं चात्मनः Ś. 4. 16. --4 To intend, fix upon, determine. --5 To devise, find out, discover. --6 To imagine. --7 To perceive, observe (Ved.).
25762: विचीर्ण a. 1 Occupied by, wandered through. --2 Entered.
25763: विचेतन a. 1 Senseless, lifeless, unconscious, dead. --2 Inanimate; Ku. 4. 33.
25764: विचेतस् a. 1 Senseless, stupid, ignorant. --2 Perplexed, confounded, sad. --3 Malevolent, wicked.
25765: विचेष्ट् {c1c} A. 1 To stir, move, be in motion, move about. --2 To act, behave. --3 To exert oneself, strive, try. --4 To roll, wallow, struggle, writhe.
25766: विचेष्टा 1 Effort, exertion. --2 Movement. --3 Conduct, behaviour.
25767: विचेष्टित p. p. 1 Striven, tried, struggled. --2 Examined, investigated. --3 Misdone, done foolishly. --तं 1 An act, a deed. --2 Effort, movement, undertaking, enterprise. --3 Gesture. --4 Working, sensation, play; किमपि चेदमनंगविचेष्टितं V. 2. 9. --5 Machination.
25768: विच्छ् {vI.v} {c6c} P. (विच्छति, also विच्छायति-ते) To go, move. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (विच्छयति-ते) 1 To shine. --2 To speak.
25769: विच्छंदः, विच्छंदकः A palace, a large building having several stories (ईश्वरगृह).
25770: विच्छर्दकः A palace; see विच्छंद above.
25772: विच्छर्दित p. p. 1 Vomited, ejected. --2 Neglected, disregarded. --3 Given up, abandoned, left; Māl. 7, U. 1. --4 Marred, impaired, lessened; Māl. 7.
25773: विच्छाय a. Pale, dim; Ratn. 1. 26. --यः A gem, jewel. --यं The shadow of a flock of birds.
25774: विच्छिद् {c7c} U. 1 To cut off, break, tear asunder, divide; यदर्धे विच्छिन्नं भवति कृतसंधानमिव तत् Ś. 1. 9; R. 16. 20; Bh. 1. 96. --2 To interrupt, break off, terminate, end, destroy, make extinct (as a family); विच्छिद्यमानेऽपि कुले परस्य Bk. 3. 52; Amaru. 74.
25775: विच्छित्तिः f. 1 (a) Cutting off or asunder, tearing off; Bh. 3. 11. (b) Breaking off, fracture. --2 Dividing, separating. --3 Disappearance, absence, loss. --4 Cessation. --5 Colouring the body with paints and unguents, painting colours, rouge; विच्छित्तिशेषैः सुरसुंदरीणां Ś. 7. 5; Śi. 16. 84. --6 Limit, boundary (of a house &c.). --7 A pause in a verse, cæsura. --8 A particular kind of amorous gesture, consisting in carelessness in dress and decoration (through pride of personal beauty); स्तोकाप्याकल्परचना विच्छित्तिः कांतिपोषकृत् S. D. 138.
25776: विच्छिन्न p. p. 1 Torn asunder, cut off. --2 Broken, severed, divided, separated; Ś. 1. 9. --3 Interrupted, prevented. --4 Ended, ceased, terminated. --5 Variegated. --6 Hidden. --7 Smeared or painted with unguents. --8 Crooked, curved.
25777: विच्छेदः 1 Cutting asunder, cutting, dividing, separation; Māl. 6. 11. --2 Breaking; Śi. 8. 51. --3 Break, interruption, cessation, discontinuance; विच्छेदमाप भुवि यस्तु कथाप्रबंधः K.; पिंडविच्छेददर्शिनः R. 1. 66. --4 Removal, prohibition. --5 Dissension. --6 A section, or division of a book. --7 Interval, space. --8 Interruption in family succession, failure of issue.
25778: विच्छेदनं Cutting off, breaking &c.; see विच्छेद.
25779: विच्छुर् {c6c} P. 1 To smear, anoint, cover, coat; मनःशिलाविच्छुरिता निषेदुः Ku. 1. 55; Ch. P. 11; V. 4. 42. --2 To set, inlay.
25780: विच्छुरित p. p. 1 Covered, overspread, coated. --2 Inlaid. --3 Besmeared, anointed.
25781: विच्यु {c1c} A. 1 To deviate or swerve from. --2 To fall to pieces, --3 To err, make mistake. --Caus. To throw down or destroy.
25782: विच्युत p. p. 1 Fallen down, slipped off. --2 Displaced, thrown down from. --3 Deviated or swerving from. --4 Separated from the living part, sloughed.
25783: विच्युतिः f. 1 Falling down from, severance, separation. --2 Decline, decay, downfall. --3 Deviation. --4 Miscarriage, failure; as in गर्भविच्युतिः.
25784: विज् {vI.v} {c3c} U. (वेवेक्ति, वेविक्ते, विक्त) 1 To separate, divide. --2 To distinguish, discern, discriminate (usually with वि and allied to विच् with वि q. v.) {vII.v} {c6c} A., {c7c} P. (विजते, विनाक्ति, विग्न) 1 To shake, tremble. --2 To be agitated, tremble with fear. --3 To fear, be afraid; चक्रंद विग्ना कुररीव भूयः R. 14. 68. --4 To be distressed or afflicted. --Caus. (वेजयति-ते) To terrify, frighten.
25785: विग्न p. p. 1 Trembling, agitated. --2 Frightened, alarmed.
25786: विज् m. A bird; a die (?).
25787: विजितृ m. 1 A discriminator, judge. --2 A partner, coheir.
25788: विजन् {c4c} A. 1 To be born or produced. --2 To generate, produce. --3 To grow, arise, spring. --4 To be changed or transformed.
25789: विजन a. Lonely, retired, solitary. --नं A solitary place, retreat (विजने means ‘privately’).
25791: विजन्मन् a. or m. A bastard, one born illegitimately. --n. Birth.
25792: विजात p. p. 1 Base-born, of mixed origin. --2 Born, produced. --3 Transformed. --ता A mother, matron, a woman who has given birth to children.
25793: विजातिः f. 1 Different origin, --2 Different kind, species or tribe.
25794: विजातीय a. 1 Of a different kind or species, dissimilar, unlike. --2 Of different caste or tribe. --3 Of mixed origin.
25797: विजर a. Young, fresh. --रं A stalk.
25798: विजल्पः 1 Prattle, idle or foolish talk. --2 Talk or speech in general. --3 A malignant or spiteful speech.
25799: विजल्पित p. p. 1 Spoken, talked; परिहासविजल्पितं सखे (वचः) Ś. 2. 18. --2 Prated, babbled.
25800: विजि {c1c} A. 1 To conquer, defeat, overcome, subdue; व्यजेष्ट षड्वर्गं Bk. 1. 2; प्रायस्त्वन्मुखसेवया विजयते विश्वं स पुष्पायुधः Gīt. 10; Bk. 2. 39; 15. 39. --2 To surpass, excel; चक्षुर्मेचकमंबुजं विजयते Vb. 1. 33. --3 To win, acquire by conquest; भुजविजितविमान R. 12. 104; विजितारिपुरः 1. 59; Śānti. 2. 14. --4 To be victorious, be supreme or pre-eminent; विजयतां देवः Ś. 5; रहस्यं साधूनामनुपधि विशुद्धं विजयते U. 2. 2; Māl. 2. 4.
25801: विजयः 1 Overcoming, vanquishing, defeating. --2 Conquest, victory, triumph; दिग्विजयादारभ्य ‘conquest of the world;’ Ki. 10. 35; R. 12. 44; Ku. 3. 19; Ś. 2. 14. --3 A chariot of the gods, celestial chariot. --4 N. of Arjuna; the Mb. thus explains the name: --अभिप्रयामि संग्रामे यदहं युद्धदुमदान् । नाजित्वा विनिवर्तामि तेन मांविजयं विदुः ॥. --5 An epithet of Yama. --6 N. of the first year of Jupiter's cycle. --7 N. of an attendant of Viṣṇu. --Comp. --अभ्युपायः a means of victory. --ईशः N. of Śiva. --कुंजरः a war-elephant. --छंदः a necklace of 500 strings. --डिंडिभः a large military drum. --नगरं N. of a town. --मर्दलः a large military drum. --सिद्धिः f. success, victory, triumph.
25802: विजया 1 N. of Durgā. --2 N. of one of her female attendants; Mu. 1. 1. --3 N. of a lore taught by Viśvāmitra to Rāma; Bk. 2. 21. --4 Hemp. --5 N. of a festival = विजयोत्सव, see below. --6 Yellow myrobalan. --Comp. --उत्सवः a festival in honour of Durgā held on the 10th day of the bright half of Āśvina. --दशमी the tenth day of the bright half of Āśvina, observed as a great holiday and commonly known as Daśarā. --सप्तमी the seventh day of the bright half of a month falling on a Sunday.
25803: विजयिन् m. A conqueror, victor. विजिगीषा 1 Desire to conquer or overcome. --2 Desire to surpass emulation, competition, ambition.
25804: विजिगीषु a. 1 Desirous of victory, wishing to conquer; यशसे विजिगीषूणां R. 1. 7. --2 Emulous, ambitious. --षुः 1 A warrior, a hero. --2 Antagonist, a disputant, an opponent.
25805: विजित p. p. Subdued, conquered, overcome, defeated. --Comp. --आत्मन् a. self-subdued, selfcontrolled. --इंद्रिय a. having the organs of sense subdued or controlled.
25806: विजितिः f. Conquest, victory, triumph; Kāv. 3. 85.
25808: विजिह्म a. 1 Crooked, bent, turned away; कृतं न वा कोपविजिह्ममाननं Ki. 1. 21; R. 19. 35. --2 Dishonest.
25810: विजृंभ् {c1c} A. 1 To yawn, gape, open the mouth; व्यजृंभिषत चापरे Bk. 15. 108; विजृंभितमिवांतरिक्षेण Mk. 5. --2 To open, expand (as a flower) --3 To spread everywhere, pervade, fill; सुखश्रवा मंगलतूर्यनिस्वनाः… न केवलं सद्मनि मागधीपतेः पथि व्यजृंभंत दिवौकसामपि R. 3. 19; 12. 72; रज्ॐधकारस्य विजृंभितस्य 7. 42. --4 To rise, appear, show, manifest oneself; तत्खल्विदं विजृंभते Māl. 7. --5 To spring back (as a bow). --6 To display activity. --7 To become increased or developed.
25811: विजृंभणं 1 Gaping, yawning. --2 Blossoming, budding, blowing, opening; वनेषु सायंतनमल्लिकानां विजृंभणोद्गंधिषु कुड्मलेषु R. 16. 47. --3 Exhibiting, displaying, unfolding. --4 Expanding. --5 Pastime, amorous sport.
25812: विजृंभित p. p. 1 Gaped, yawned; Mk. 5. 51. --2 Opened, blown, expanded. --3 Displayed, exhibited, manifested; R. 7. 42; U. 6. 2. --4 Appeared. --5 Sported. --तं 1 Sport, pastime. --2 Wish, desire. --3 Display, exhibition; अज्ञानविजृंभितमेतत्. --4 An act, action, conduct; Māl. 10. 21. --5 Fruit, result.
25813: विज्जनं --लं 1 A kind of sauce; see विजुल. --2 An arrow.
25816: विज्ञा {c9c} U. 1 To know, be aware of; Bh. 3. 21. --2 To learn, comprehend, understand. --3 To ascertain, find out, learn from. --4 To regard, know to be, consider as. --5 To discern, discriminate, distinguish. --6 To be familiar with. --7 To become wise or learned; Ms. 4. 20. --Caus. (विज्ञापयति) 1 To request, beg (opp. आज्ञापयति); सीता-आर्यपुत्र अस्ति मे विज्ञाप्यं; रामः-नन्वाज्ञापय U. 1; R. 5. 20. --2 To communicate, inform. --3 To say, speak in general. --4 To teach, instruct.
25817: विज्ञ, विजानत् a. 1 Knowing, intelligent, wise, learned. --2 Clever, skilful, proficient. --ज्ञः A wise or learned man.
25818: विज्ञप्त p. p. 1 Respectfully told, requested. --2 Made known, informed.
25819: विज्ञप्तिः f. 1 A respectful statement or communication, a request, an entreaty. --2 An announcement.
25820: विज्ञात p. p. 1 Known, understood, perceived. --2 Well-known, celebrated, famous.
25821: विज्ञानं 1 Knowledge, wisdom, intelligence, understanding; Pt. 1. 24; 5. 3; विज्ञानमयः कोशः ‘the sheath of intelligence’ (the first of the five sheaths of the soul). --2 Discrimination, discernment. --3 Skill, proficiency; प्रयोगविज्ञानं Ś. 1. 2. --4 Worldly or profane knowledge, knowledge derived from worldly experience (opp. ज्ञान which is ‘knowledge of Brahma or Supreme Spirit’); ज्ञानं तेहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः Bg. 7. 2, 3. 41; (the whole of the 7th Adhyāya of Bg. explains ज्ञान and विज्ञान). --5 Business, employment. --6 Music. --7 Knowledge of the fourteen lores. --Comp. --ईश्वरः N. of the author of the Mitākṣarā, a commentary on Yājñavalkya's Smṛti. --पादः N. of Vyāsa. --मातृकः an epithet of Buddha. --वादः the theory of knowledge, the doctrine taught by Buddha.
25822: विज्ञानिक a. Wise, learned; see विज्ञ.
25823: विज्ञापकः 1 An informant. --2 A teacher, an instructor.
25824: विज्ञापनं --ना 1 Respectful statement or communication, a request, an entreaty; कालप्रयुक्ता खलु कार्यविद्भिर्विज्ञापना भर्तृषु सिद्धिमेति Ku. 7. 93; R. 17. 40. --2 Information, representation. --3 Instruction.
25825: विज्ञापित p. p. 1 Respectfully told or communicated. --2 Requested. --3 Informed. --4 Instructed.
25828: विज्वर a. Free from fever, anxiety or distress.
25829: विंजामरं The white of the eye.
25831: विट् {c1c} P. (वेटति) 1 To sound. --2 To curse, rail at.
25832: विटः [विट्-क] 1 A paramour; त्वद्वत्सलः क्व स तपस्विजनस्य हंता कन्याविटः पतिरसौ परिरक्षतु त्वां Māl. 8. 8; Śi. 4. 48. --2 A voluptuary, sensualist. --3 (In dramas) The companion of a prince or dissolute young man, or of a courtezan (who is described as being skilled in the arts of singing, music, and poetry and as a parasite on familiar terms with his associate to whom he nearly serves the purpose of the Vidūṣaka; see inter alia Mk. acts 1, 5, and 8); for definition, see S. D. 78. --4 A rogue, cheat. --5 A catamite. --6 A rat. --7 The Khadira tree. --8 The orange tree. --9 A branch together with its shoot. --10 A mineral salt. --Comp. --माक्षिकं a kind of mineral. --लवणं a medicinal salt.
25833: विटंकः 1 An aviary, dove-cot. --2 The loftiest point, pinnacle, elevation; अयमेव महीधरविटंकः Māl. 10; Vikr. 5. 77.
25836: विटपः [विटं विस्तारं वा पाति पिबति पा° क Tv.] 1 A branch, bough (of a creeper or tree); कोमलविटपानुकारिणौ बाहू Ś. 1. 21, 32; यदनेन तरुर्त पातितः क्षपिता तद्विटपाश्रिता लता R. 8. 47; Śi. 4. 48; Ku. 6. 41. --2 A bush. --3 A new shoot or sprout; Śi. 7. 53. --4 A cluster, clump, thicket. --5 Extension. --6 The septum of the scrotum.
25837: विटपिन् m. [विटप-अस्त्यर्थे इनि] 1 A tree; परितो दृष्टाश्च विटपिनः सर्वे Bv. 1. 21, 29. --2 The fig-tree. --Comp. --मृगः a monkey, an ape.
25839: विट्ठ(ठ्ठ)लः N. of a form of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa (worshipped at Pandharpur in the Bombay presidency).
25840: विठंक a. Bad, vile, base, low.
25842: विड् {c1c} P. (वेडति) 1 To curse, rail at, revile. --2 To cry out loudly.
25843: विडं A kind of artificial salt.
25844: विडंग a. Clever, skilful. --गः, --गं N. of a vegetable and medicinal substance (largely used as a vermifuge).
25845: विडंब् {c10c} U. 1 To imitate, copy, resemble; (तं) ऋतुर्विडंबयामास न पुनः प्राप तच्छ्रियं R. 4. 17; वपुःप्रकर्षेण विडंबितेश्वरः 3. 52; 13. 29; 16. 11; Ki. 5. 46; 12. 38; Śi. 1. 6; 12. 5; 16. 58. --2 To ridicule, deride, mock; संमोहयंति मदयंति विडंबयंति निभर्त्सयंति रमयंति विषादयंति Bh. 1. 22; यथा न विडंब्यसे जनैः K. 109. --3 To cheat, deceive; एवमात्माभिप्रायसंभावितेष्टजनचित्तवृत्तिः प्रार्थयिता विडंब्य. ते Ś. 2. --4 To afflict, pain, molest. --5 To transform, distort.
25847: विडंबनं --ना 1 Imitation. --2 Disguise, imposture. --3 Deception, fraud. --4 Vexation, mortification. --5 Paining, distressing. --6 Disappointing. --7 Ridiculousness, mockery, a matter for laughter; इयं च तेऽन्या पुरतो विडंबना Ku. 5. 70; असति त्वयि वारुणीमदः प्रमदानामधुना विडंबना 4. 12.
25848: विडंबित p. p. 1 Imitated, copied. --2 Mocked, ridiculed. --3 Deceived. --4 Vexed, mortified. --5 Frustrated. --6 Low, abject, poor. --तं An object of ridicule.
25851: विडीनं One of the several modes of flight of birds; see डीन.
25855: वितंसः 1 A bird-cage. --2 A rope, chain, fetter &c. to confine beasts or birds.
25856: वितंडः 1 An elephant. --2 A sort of lock or bolt.
25857: वितंडा 1 A captious objection, idle carping, a frivolous or fallacious argument or controversy (one of the sixteen padārthas or categories in Nyāya philosophy); स (जल्पः) प्रतिपक्षस्थापनाहीनो वितंडा Gaut. S. --2 Wrangling, captious criticism in general. --3 A spoon, ladle. --4 Benzoin. --5 The oleander plant.
25858: वितथ a. 1 Untrue, false; आजन्मनो न भवता वितथं किलोक्तं Ve. 3. 13, 5. 41; R. 9. 8. --2 Vain, futile; as in वितथप्रयत्न R. 2. 42.
25860: वितथयति Den. P. To make false; Śi. 7. 8.
25861: वितद्रुः f. N. of a river in the Panjāb.
25862: वितन् {c8c} U. 1 To spread, stretch; स्फुरितविततजिह्वः Mk. 9. 12; Ki. 15. 53, Śi. 5. 38, 14. 53. --2 To cover, fill; प्रस्वेदबिंदुविततं वदनं प्रियायाः Ch. P. 9; यो वितत्व स्थितः खं Me. 58. --3 To form, make; श्रेणीबंधाद्वितन्वद्धिरस्तंभां तोरणस्रजं R. 1. 41; Ki. 16. 51. --4 To stretch, string (as a bow); U. 6. 1; Bk. 3. 47. --5 To cause, produce, create, give, bestow; V. 1. 4. --6 To write or compose (as a work); विराटपर्वप्रद्योती भावदीपो वितन्यते. --7 To do or perform (as a sacrifice or any other rite); Ku. 2. 46. --8 To unfold, manifest, exhibit, show; Māl. 9. 11. --9 To perform, carry out, accomplish. --10 To prepare, make ready.
25863: वितत p. p. 1 Spread out, extended, stretched. --2 Elongated, large, broad. --3 Performed, accomplished, effected; विततयज्ञः Ś. 7. 34. --4 Covered. --5 Diffused; (see तन् with वि). --तं Any stringed instrument, such as a lute &c. --Comp. --धन्वन् a. one who has fully drawn or stretched his bow.
25864: विततिः f. 1 Extension, expansion. --2 Quantity, collection, cluster, clump. --3 A line, row; Māl. 9. 47.
25866: वितंतुः A good horse. --f. A widow.
25867: वितंत्री A disordered or discordant lute; Ku. 1. 45.
25868: वितप् 1 A. To shine; रविर्बितपतेऽत्यर्थं Bk. 8. 14. --2 To warm, heat. --3 To warm oneself.
25869: वितमस् a. 1 Light. --2 Free from darkness or the quality of ignorance (तमस्).
25870: वितर्क् {c10c} U. 1 To guess, conjecture. --2 To think, suppose, believe. --3 To reflect, reason. --4 To expect, anticipate. --5 To find out, discover, ascertain.
25871: वितर्कः 1 Argument, reasoning, inference. --2 Guess, conjecture, supposition, belief; शिरीषपुष्पाधिकसौकुमार्यौ बाहू तदीयाविति मे वितर्कः Ku. 1. 41. --3 Fancy, thought; Bh. 3. 45. --4 Doubt; Ki. 4. 5, 13. 2. --5 Deliberation, discussion. --6 A teacher in divine knowledge.
25872: वितर्कणं 1 Reasoning. --2 Conjecturning, guessing. --3 Doubt. --4 Discussion.
25873: वितर्दिः, --र्दी, वितर्दिका f. 1 A raised seat of a quadrangular shape in a court-yard. --2 A balcony, verandah.
25875: वितलं The second of the seven lower regions under the earth, see पाताल or लोक.
25876: वितस्ता N. of a river in the Punjab called Hydaspes by the Greeks and now called Jhelum or Betustā.
25877: वितस्तिः [cf. Uṇ. 4. 181] A measure of length equal to 12 angulas (being the distance between the extended thumb and the little finger).
25878: वितान a. 1 Vacant, empty. --2 Pithless. --3 Dismayed, sad; क्षितिपतिमंडलमन्यतो वितानं R. 6. 86. --4 Dull, stupid. --5 Wicked, abandoned. --नः, --नं 1 Spreading out, expansion, extension; Śi. 11. 28. --2 An awning, a canopy; विद्युल्लेखाकनकरुचिरश्रीर्वितानं ममाब्दः V. 4. 4; R. 19. 39; Ki. 3. 42; Śi. 3. 50. --3 A cushion. --4 A collection, quantity, an assemblage; प्रस्तारस्पगिता इवोन्मुखमणिज्योतिर्वितानैर्दिशः Māl. 6. 5; Ki. 17. 61. --5 A sacrifice; an oblation; वितानेष्वप्ये वं तव मम च सोमे विधिरभूत Ve. 6. 30, 3. 16, Śi. 14. 10. --6 The sacrificial hearth or altar. --7 Season, opportunity. --नं Leisure, rest.
25879: वितानकः --कं 1 An expanse. --2 A heap, quantity, collection, mass; Śi. 3. 6. --3 An awning, a canopy. --4 The tree called Māda.
25880: वितानायते Den. A. To act or serve as an awning; Māl. 9. 15.
25881: वितानीकृ {c8c} U. To spread or extend over (as a canopy), overshadow.
25882: वितुन्नं 1 The pot-herb called सुनिषण्णक. --2 The plant called शैवाल.
25883: वितुन्नकं 1 Coriander-seed. --2 Blue vitriol. --कः The plant called तामलकी.
25884: वितुष्ट p. p. Dissatisfied, displeased, discontented.
25885: वितृष्ण a. Free from desire, content.
25886: वितॄ {c1c} P. 1 To cross or pass over, go beyond; R. 6. 77. --2 To give, grant, impart, confer or bestow on, vouchsafe, favour with; भगवान् मारचिस्ते दर्शनं वितरति Ś. 7; वितरति गुरुः प्राज्ञे विद्यां यथैव तथा जडे U. 2. 4; वितरति नृपो नोचितमहा Pt. 1. 11; U. 3. 48; निवासहेतोरुटजं वितेरुः R. 14. 81; Māl. 1. 3; 6. 7; 9. 5, 44. --3 To cause, produce; ज्योत्स्नाशंकामिह वितरति हंसश्रेणी Ki. 5. 31. --4 To carry over, ferry over. --5 To give (as medicine), apply a remedy. --6 To do, perform. --7 To forgive, pardon. --8 To increase, enhance. --Caus. To carry through, accomplish (fig. also).
25887: वितरणं 1 Crossing over. --2 A gift, donation, present; पूर्णाशा वहवः कृता वितरणैर्येन त्वया याचकाः Subhāṣ. --3 Giving up, leaving, abandoning.
25888: वितीर्ण p. p. 1 Crossed or passed over. --2 Given, bestowed, imparted; U. 3. 25, Śi. 7. 67, 17. 15. --3 Gone down, descended, R. 6. 77. --4 Conveyed. --5 Subdued, overcome (see तॄ with वि).
25889: वित्त् {c10c} U. (वित्तयति-ते; वित्तापयतिते also according to some) To give away, give as alms.
25890: वित्त p. p. [विद् लाभे क्त] 1 Found, discovered. --2 Gained, acquired. --3 Examined, investigated. --4 Known, famous. --त्तं 1 Wealth, possessions, property, substance. --2 Power. --Comp. --आगमः, --उपार्जनं acquisition of wealth. --ईशः an epithet of Kubera; Bg. 10. 23; Ms. 7. 4. --जानि a. one who has married a wife. --दः a donor, benefactor. --मात्रा property. --वर्धन a. profitable, lucrative. --समागमः acquisition of wealth, income; Pt. 1. 425.
25892: वित्तिः f. [विद्-क्तिन्] 1 Knowledge. --2 Judgment, discrimination, thought. --3 Gain, acquisition. --4 Likelihood.
25893: वित्रस् {c1c} {c4c} P. To be frightened or terrified; वित्रस्तमुग्धहरिणीसदृशैः कटाक्षैः Bh. 1. 9. --Caus. To terrify, frighten.
25897: विथुरः 1 A demon. --2 A thief. --रा A widow; cf. विधुरा.
25898: विद् {vI.v} {c2c} P. (वेत्ति or वेद, विवेद; विदांचकार, अवेदीत्, वेत्स्यति, वेत्तुं, विदित; desid. विविदिषति) 1 To know, understand, learn, find out, ascertain, discover; न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयो यद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः Bg. 2. 5; त मोहांधः कथमयममुं वेत्तु देवं पुराणं Ve. 1. 23, 3. 39; Ś. 5. 27, R. 3. 43; Bg. 4. 34, 18. 1. --2 To feel, experience; Mu. 3. 4. --3 To look upon, regard, consider, know or take to be; य एनं वेत्ति हंतांर Bg. 2. 19; विद्धि व्याधिव्यालग्रस्तं लोक शोकहतं च समस्तं Moha M. 5; Bg. 2. 17; Ms. 1. 33; Ku. 6. 30. --Caus. (वेदयति-ते) 1 To make known, communicate, inform, apprise, tell. --2 To teach, expound; वेदार्थं स्वानवेदयत् Sk. --3 To feel, experience; Ms. 12. 13. {vII.v} {c4c} A. (विद्यते, वित्त) 1 To be, to exist; अपापानां कुले जाते मयि पापं न विद्यते Mk. 9. 37; नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः Bg. 2. 16; (cf. the root 1 अस्). --2 To happen. {vIII.v} {c6c} U. (विंदति-ते, वित्त) 1 To get, obtain, acquire, gain; एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विदंते फलं Bg. 5. 4; Y. 3. 192. --2 To find, discover, recognise; यथा धेनुसर्हस्रेषु वत्सो विंदति मातरं Subhāṣ.; Ms. 8. 109. --3 To feel, experience; R. 14. 56; Bg. 5. 21, 11. 24, 18. 45. --4 To marry; Ms. 9. 69. {vIV.v} {c7c} A. (विंत्ते, वित्त or विन्न) 1 To know, understand. --2 To consider, regard, take for; न तृणेह्मीति लोकोयं विंत्ते मां निष्पराक्रमं Bk. 6. 39. --3 To find, meet with. --4 To reason, reflect. --5 To examine, inquire into. {vV.v} {c10c} A. (वेदयते) 1 To tell, declare, announce, communicate. --2 To feel, experience. --3 To dwell. (The following verse illustrates the root in some of its conjugations: --वेत्ति सर्वाणि शास्त्राणि गर्वस्तस्य न विद्यते । विंत्ते धर्मं सदा सद्भिस्तेषु पूजां च विंदति ॥; cf. also: --सत्तायां विद्यते ज्ञाने वेत्ति विंत्ते विचारणे । विंदते विंदति प्राप्तौ श्यन्लुक् श्नम्शेष्विदं क्रमात् ॥). [cf. L. video; A. S. witan; Goth. vait].
25899: विद् a. (At the end of comp.) Knowing, conversant with; वेदविद् &c. --m. 1 The planet Mercury. --2 A learned man, wise man. --f. 1 Knowledge. --2 Understanding, intellect.
25900: विदः 1 A learned man, wise man or Paṇḍita. --2 The planet Mercury. --दा 1 Knowledge, learning. --2 Understanding.
25901: विदित p. p. 1 Known, understood, learnt; अविदितगतयामा रात्रिरेव व्यरंसीत् U. 1. 27. --2 Informed. --3 Renowned, celebrated, well-known; भुवनविदिते वंशे Me. 6. --4 Promised, agreed to. --तः A learned man, scholar. --तं 1 Knowledge, information. --2 Celebrity, fame. --3 Acquisition, gaining.
25902: विदंशः Pungent food such as excites thirst.

25905: विदथः 1 A learned man, scholar. --2 An ascetic, a sage. --3 Ved. A sacrifice. --थं Ved. 1 Knowledge. --2 A sacrifice. --3 A battle (?)
25906: विदरः Breaking, bursting, rending. --रं The prickly pear.
25907: विदर्भाः (m. pl.) [विगताः दर्भाः कुशा यतः Tv.] 1 N. of a district, the modern Berar; अस्ति विदर्भो नाम जनपदः Dk.; अस्ति विदर्भेषु पद्मपुरं नाम नगरं Māl. 1; R. 5. 40, 60; N. 1. 50. --2 The natives of Vidarbha. --र्भः 1 A king of the Vidarbhas. --2 Any dry or desert soil. --Comp. --जा, --तनया, --राजतनया, --सुभ्रूः epithets of Damayantī, daughter of the king of the Vidarbhas. --जा N. of the wife of Agastya.
25908: विदल् {c1c} P. 1 To break, split, crack; त्वदिषुभिर्व्यदलिष्यदसावपि N. 4. 88. --2 To dig up. --3 To open, expand.
25909: विदल a. 1 Split, rent asunder. --2 Opened, blown (as a flower &c.). --लः 1 Dividing, separating. --2 Rending, splitting. --3 A cake. --4 Mountain ebony. --लं 1 A basket of split bamboos or any vessel of wicker-work. --2 The bark of pomegranate. --3 A twig. --4 The chips of a substance. --5 Split peas.
25910: विदलनं Splitting, rending asunder, cutting, dividing.
25912: विदाहः 1 Burning. --2 Great heat, inflammation. --3 Pungency, sharpness.
25913: विदाहिन् m. A substance causing inflammation.
25914: विदिश् f. An intermediate point of the compass.
25915: विदिशा 1 N. of the capital of the district called दशार्ण; तेषां ( दशार्णानां) दिक्षु प्रथितविदिशालक्षणां राजधानीं Me. 24. --2 N. of a river in Mālvā. --3 = विदिश् q. v.
25916: विदुः 1 The middle of the frontal globes on an elephant's forehead (हस्तिकुंभमध्यभागः). --2 A hippopotamus.
25917: विदुर a. [विद्-कुरच् P. III. 2. 162] Wise, intelligent. --रः 1 A wise or learned man. --2 A crafty man, an intriguer. --3 N. of the younger brother of Pāṇḍu. [When Satyavat; found that both the sons begotten by Vyāsa upon her two daughters-in-law were physically incapacitated for the throne-Dhṛtarāṣṭra being blind and Pāṇḍu pale and sickly-she asked them to seek the assistance of Vyāsa once more. But being frightened by the austere look of the sage, the elder widow sent one of her slave-girls dressed in her own clothes, and this girl became the mother of Vidura. He is remarkable for his great wisdom, righteousness, and strict impartiality. He particularly loved the Pāṇḍavas, and saved them from several critical dangers].
25918: विदुलः 1 A kind of reed or ratan. --2 Gum-myrrh.
25919: विदून p. p. Afflicted, tormented, distressed.
25920: विदूर a. Remote, distant; सरिद्विदूरांतरभावतन्वी R. 13. 48; U. 6. 39. --रः N. of a mountain or city from which the Vaidūrya jewel or lapis lazuli is brought; विदूरभूमिर्नवमेघशब्दादुद्भिन्नया रत्नशलाकयेव Ku. 1. 24; see Malli thereon, as well as on Śi. 3. 45. (The forms विदूरं, विदूरेण, विदूरतस् or विदूरात् are often used adverbially in the sense of ‘from a distance,’ ‘from afar’, ‘at a distance’, ‘far off’; Māl. 3. 18.). --Comp. --ग a. spreading far and wide. --जं the lapis lazuli.
25921: विदूषक a. (की f.) 1 Defiling, polluting, contaminating, corrupting. --2 Detracting, abusing. --3 Witty, humorous, jocular. --कः 1 A jester, buffoon. --2 Particularly, the humorous companion and confidential friend of the hero in a play, who excites mirth by his quaint dress, speeches, gestures, appearances &c., and by allowing himself to be made the butt of ridicule by almost every body; the S. D. thus defines him: --कुसुमवसंताद्यभिधः कर्मवपुर्वेशभाषाद्यैः । हास्यकरः कलहरतिर्विदूषकः स्यात्स्वकर्मज्ञः ॥ 79. --3 A libertine, lecher.
25922: विदूषणं 1 Pollution, corruption. --2 Abuse, reproach, detraction.
25924: विदॄ {c9c} P. or {c10c} U. 1 To split, tear asunder, divide, cut to pieces; ऐंद्रिः किल नखैस्तस्या विददार स्तनौ द्विज R. 12. 22; न विदीर्ये कठिनाः खलु स्त्रियः Ku. 4. 5; R. 15. 33. --2 To rend (fig.); चित्तं विदारयति कस्य न कोविदारः Rs. 3. 6. स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत् Bg. 1. 19. --Pass. To be rent or torn (with grief &c.) --Caus. To rend, tear in pieces, tear or rip up; Māl. 5. 15; 10. 1.
25925: विदारः 1 Rending or cutting asunder, splitting. --2 War, battle. --3 An inundation, overflowing (of a tank, river &c.). --री A swelling in the groin.
25926: विदारकः 1 A tearer, divider. --2 A tree or rock in the middle of a stream (which divides its course). --3 A hole sunk in water in the bed of a dry river. --कं Alkaline earth.
25927: विदारणः 1 A tree or rock in the middle of a stream (to which a boat is fastened). --2 War, battle. --3 The Karṇikāra tree. --णा War, battle. --णं 1 Rending, splitting, tearing, ripping up, breaking, (often with the force of an adj. at the end of comp.); श्रुतं सखे श्रवणविदारणं वचः Mu. 5. 6; युवजनहृदयविदारणमनसिजनखरुचिक्रिंशुक्रजाले Gīt. 1, Ki. 14. 54. --2 Afflicting, tormenting. --3 Killing, slaughter.
25928: विदीर्ण p. p. 1 Torn, split, rent asunder, split open. --2 Opened, expanded; (see दॄ with वि).
25929: विदेशः Another country, foreign land or country; भजते विदेशमधिकेन जितस्तदनुप्रवेशमथवा कुशलः Śi. 9. 48; को वीरस्य मनस्विनः स्वविषयः को बा विदेशस्तथा H. 1. --Comp. --ज a. exotic, foreign.
25930: विदेशिन्, विदेशीय a. Foreign, exotic. --m. A foreigner.
25931: विदेह a. 1 Bodiless; incorporeal. --2 Trunkless. --हाः (m. pl.) 1 N. of a country, the ancient Mithilā (see App. III.); R. 11. 36, 12. 26. --2 The natives of this country. --हः 1 The district Videha. --2 N. of Janaka. --हा The same as विदेह.
25932: विद्ध p. p. [व्यध्-क्त] 1 Pierced, penetrated; wounded, stabbed. --2 Beaten, whipped, lashed. --3 Thrown, directed, sent. --4 Opposed. --5 Resembling. --द्धं A wound. --Comp. --कर्ण a. having bored ears.
25934: विद्यमान a. 1 Being, existing. --2 Present. --3 Actual, real.
25935: विद्या [विद्-क्यप्] 1 Knowledge, learning, lore, science; (तां) विद्यामभ्यसनेनेव प्रसादयितुमर्हसि R. 1. 88; विद्या नाम नरस्य रूपमधिकं प्रच्छन्नगुप्तं धनं &c. Bh. 2. 20. (According to some Vidyās are four: --आन्वीक्षिकी त्रयी वार्ता दंडनीतिश्च शाश्वती Kāmandaka); चतसृष्वपि ते विवेकिनी नृप विद्यासु निरूढिमागता Ki. 2. 6; to these four Manu adds a fifth आत्मविद्या; see Ms. 7. 43. But the usual number of Vidyās is stated to be fourteen, i. e. the four Vedas, the six Aṅgas, Dharma, Mīmāṃsā, Tarka or Nyāya and the Purāṇas; see चतुर्दशविद्या under चतुर्; and N. 1. 4. --2 Right knowledge, spiritual knowledge; U. 6. 6; cf. अविद्या. --3 A spell, an incantation. --4 The goddess Durgā. --5 Magical skill. --Comp. --अनुपालिन्, --अनुसेविन् a. acquiring knowledge. --अभ्यासः, --अर्जनं, --आगमः acquisition of knowledge, pursuit of learning, study. --अर्थः seeking for knowledge. --अर्थिन् m. a student, scholar, pupil. --आधारः a receptacle of learning; Māl. 2. 11. --आरंभः introduction of a boy to learning. --आलयः a school, college, any place of learning. --उपार्जनं = विद्यार्जनं q. v. --करः a learned man. --चण, --चंचु a. famous for one's learning. --दलः the Bhūrja tree. --दातृ m. a teacher, an instructor. --दानं teaching, imparting instruction. --देवी the goddess of learning. --धनं {1} wealth in the form of learning. {2} wealth acquired by learning. --धरः, (--री f.) a class of demigods or semi-divine beings; विद्याधराध्युषितचारुशिलातलानि स्थानानि Bh. 3. 70. --प्राप्तिः = विद्यार्जन q. v. --लाभः {1} acquisition of learning. {2} wealth or any other acquisition made by learning. --विशिष्ट a. distinguished by learning. --विहीन a. illiterate, ignorant; Pt. 1. 35. --वृद्ध a. old in knowledge, advanced in learning. --व्यसनं, --व्यवसायः pursuit of knowledge. --व्रतस्नातक, --स्नातकः a Brāhmaṇa who has finished his course of religious studentship (ब्रह्मचारिव्रत).
25936: विद्युत् {c1c} A. 1 To shine, sparkle, be bright; व्यद्योतिष्ट सभावेद्यामसौ नरशिखित्रयी Śi. 2. 3; 1. 20. --2 To light, illuminate (usually caus. in this sense).
25937: विद्युत् f. 1 Lightning; वाताय कपिला विद्युत् Mbh.; Me. 38, 115. --2 A thunderbolt. --Comp. --उन्मेषः a flash of lightning. --जिह्वः a kind of demon or Rākṣasa. --ज्वाला, --द्योतः a flash or lustre of lightning. --दामन् n. a flash of zigzag or forked lightning. --पातः falling or stroke of lightning. --प्रियं bellmetal. --लता, --लेखा (विद्युल्लता, विद्युल्लेखा) {1} a streak of lightning. {2} forked or zigzag lightning.
25938: विद्युत्वत् a. Having lightning; Me. 64. --m. A cloud; विद्युत्वानिव चातकैः Ku. 6. 27.
25939: विद्योतन a. (नी f.) 1 Illuminating, irradiating. --2 Illustrating, elucidating.
25940: विद्रः 1 Tearing, splitting, piercing. --2 A fissure, hole, cavity.
25942: विद्राण a. Roused from sleep, awakened.
25943: विद्रु {c1c} P. 1 To run, run away, retreat; जलसंवात इवासि विद्रुतः Ku. 4. 6. --2 To melt, dissolve. --3 To become divided, burst asunder. --Caus. To put to flight, rout, scare away, disperse, scatter; प्रतिरवाभोगभीषितनष्टविद्राविताशेषजननिवहः Māl. 3; असौ कुंभिभ्रात्या खरनखरविद्रावितमहागुरुग्रावग्रामः स्वपिति गिरिगर्भे हरिपतिः Bv. 1. 52.
25944: विद्रवः 1 Running away, flight, retreat. --2 Panic. --3 Flowing out. --4 Melting, liquefaction. --5 Censure, abuse. --6 Intellect, understanding.
25946: विद्रावणं 1 Driving or scaring away, putting to flight, defeating. --2 Liquefying.
25947: विद्रावित a. 1 Put to flight, routed, chased away. --2 Scattered, dispersed: torn asunder. --3 Liquefied, fused, melted.
25948: विद्रुत p. p. 1 Flown, fled away, (in panic). --2 Agitated, frightened, alarmed. --3 Liquid, fluid.
25949: विद्रुमः 1 The coral tree (bearing reddish precious gems called corals). --2 A coral; तवाधरस्पर्धिषु विद्रुमेषु R. 13. 13; Ku. 1. 44. --3 A young shoot or sprout. --Comp. --लता {1} a branch of coral. {2} a kind of perfume. --लतिका a kind of perfume (नलिका).
25950: विद्वस् a. [विद्-क्वसु] (Nom. sing. m. विद्वान्; f. विदुषी; n. विद्वत्) 1 Knowing (with acc.); आनंदं ब्रह्मणो विद्वान् न बिभेति कदाचन; तव विद्वानपि तापकारणं R. 8. 76; Ki. 11. 30. --2 Wise, learned. --m. A learned or wise man, scholar; किं वस्तु विद्वन् गुरवे प्रदेयं R. 5. 18. --Comp. --कल्प, --देशीय, --देश्य a. (विद्वत्कल्प, विद्वद्देशीय, विद्वद्देश्य) slightly learned, a little learned. --जनः (विद्वज्जनः) a learned or wise man, sage.
25951: विद्विष् m., विद्वषः An enemy, a foe; विद्विषोऽप्यनुनय Bh. 2. 77; R. 3. 60; Y. 1. 162.
25952: विद्विष्ट p. p. Hated, disliked, odious.
25953: विद्वेषः 1 Enmity, hatred, odium; Ms. 8. 346. --2 Disdainful pride, contempt; विद्वेषोऽभिमतप्राप्तावपि गवार्दनादरः Bharata.
25954: विद्वेषणः A hater, an enemy. --णी A woman of a resentful temper. --णं 1 Causing hatred or enmity. --2 Enmity, hatred.
25955: विद्वेषिन्, विद्वेष्टृ a. Hating, inimical. --m. A hater, an enemy.
25956: विध् {vI.v} {c6c} P. (विधति) 1 To pierce, cut. --2 To honour, worship. --3 To rule, govern, administer. {vII.v} {c1c} A. (वेधते) To ask, beg.
25957: विधः [विध-क अच् वा] 1 Kind, sort; as in बहुविध, नानाविध. --2 Mode, manner, form. --3 Fold (at the end of comp., especially after numerals); त्रिविध, अष्टविध &c. --4 The food of elephants. --5 Prosperity. --6 Penetration.
25960: विधवा [विगतो धवो यस्याः सा] A widow; सा नारी विधवा जाता गृहे रोदिति तत्पतिः Subhāṣ. --Comp. --आवेदनं marrying a widow. --गामिन् m. one who has sexual intercourse with a widow.
25961: विधस् m. N. of Brahman, the creator.
25962: विधा {c3c} U. 1 To do, make, bring about, effect, accomplish, perform, cause, produce, occasion; यथाक्रमं पुंसवनादिकाः क्रिया धृतेश्च धीरः सदृशीर्व्यधत्त सः R. 3. 10; तन्नो देवा विधेयासुः Bk. 19. 2; विधेयासुर्देवाः परमरमणीयां परिणतिं Māl. 6. 7; प्रायः शुभं च विदधात्यशुभं च जंतोः सर्वंकषा भगवती भवितव्यतैव 1. 23; ये द्वे कालं विधत्तः Ś. 1. 1 ‘cause, produce, or regulate time’; तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहं Bg. 7. 21; R. 2. 38, 3. 66, Ve. 1. 1, Ki. 1. 3, 16. 62, 18. 28; (these senses may be further modified according to the noun with which विधा is used; cf. कृ). --2 To lay down, ordain, prescribe, fix, settle, command, enjoin; प्राङ्नाभिवर्धनात्पुंसो जातकर्म विधीयते Ms. 2. 29, 3. 19; Y. 1. 72; शूद्रस्य तु सवर्णैव नान्या भार्या विधीयते Ms. 9. 157, 3. 118; पाणिनिश्च क्रियाफलस्य कर्तृगामित्वे सत्यात्मनेपदं विदधाति J. N. V. --3 To make, form, shape, create, manufacture; तं वेधा विदधे नूनं सहाभूतसमाधिना R. 1. 29; अंगानि चंपकदलैः स विधाय नूनं कांते कथं घटितवानुपलेन चेतः Ś. Til. 3. --4 To appoint, depute (as a minister). --5 To put on, wear; Pt. 1. --6 To fix upon, direct towards (as mind &c.); योगे धैर्यसमाधिसिद्धिसुलभे बुद्धिं विधद्ध्वं बुधाः Bh. 3. 54, Bg. 2. 44. --7 To arrange, put in order. --8 To make ready, prepare. --9 To settle, fix, establish. --10 To give, grant; Ki. 14. 10. --11 To procure, furnish. --12 To place, put, lay.
25963: विधा 1 Mode, manner, form. --2 Kind, sort. --3 Prosperity, affluence. --4 The food of elephants, horses &c. --5 Penetration. --6 Hire, wages. --7 Act, action.
25964: विधातृ m. 1 A maker, creator; Ku. 7. 36. --2 The creator, N. of Brahman; विधाता भद्रं नो वितरतु मनोज्ञाय विधये Māl. 6. 7; R. 1. 35, 6. 11; 7. 25. --3 A granter, giver, bestower; Ku. 1. 57. --4 Fate, destiny; H. 1. 40. --5 N. of Viśvakarman. --6 N. of Kāma, the god of love. --7 Spirituous liquor. --Comp. --आयुस् m. {1} sunshine. {2} the sun-flower. --भूः an epithet of Nārada.
25966: विधानं 1 Arranging, disposing. --2 Performing, making, doing, executing; नेपथ्यविधानं Ś. 1; आज्ञा°, यज्ञ° &c. --3 Creation, creating; R. 6. 11, 7. 14; Ku. 7. 66. --4 Employment, use, application; प्रतिकारविधानं R. 8. 40. --5 Prescribing, enjoining, ordering. --6 A rule, precept, ordinance, sacred rule or precept, sacred injunction; Ms. 9. 148; Bg. 16. 24, 17. 24. --7 Mode, manner. --8 A means or expedient. --9 Performance of prescribed acts or rites. --10 A rite, ceremony. --11 Gaining, obtaining. --12 Affixing, prefixing (as terminations, suffixes &c.). --13 The food given to elephants (to make them intoxicated); विधानसंपादितदानशोभितैः K. (where विधान means ‘rule’ also); उत्क्षिप्तहस्ततलदत्तविधानपिंडस्नेहस्रुतिस्नपितबाहुरिभाधिराजं Śi. 5. 51. --14 Wealth. --15 Pain, agony, torment, distress. --16 An act of hostility. --Comp. --गः, --ज्ञः a wise or learned man. --युक्त a. in accordance with or conformable to sacred precept.
25968: विधायक a. (यिका f.,) विधायिन् a. 1 Arranging, disposing. --2 Doing, making, performing, executing. --3 Creating. --4 Enjoying, prescribing, laying down --5 Consigning, committing, delivering (to the care of).
25969: विधिः [विधा-कि] 1 Doing, performance, practice, an act or action; ब्रह्मध्यानाभ्यसनविधिना योगनिद्रां गतस्य Bh. 3. 41; योगविधि R. 8. 22; अस्याः सर्गविधौ V. 1. 8; लेत्वाविधि Māl. 1. 35. --2 Method, manner, way, means, mode; Pt. 1. 376. --3 A rule, commandment, any precept which enjoins something for the first time (as distinguished from नियम and परिसंख्या q. q. v. v.); विधिरत्यंतमप्राप्तौ; चि कीर्षाकृतिसाध्यत्वहेतुधीविषयो विधिः, वहति विधिहुतं या हविः Ś. 1. 1. --4 A sacred precept or rule, ordinance, injunction, law, a sacred command, religious commandment (opp. अर्थवाद which means ‘an explanatory statement coupled with legends and illustrations’; see अर्थवाद); प्रवृत्तिपरं वाक्यं विधिः, as ज्योतिष्टोमेन स्वर्गकामो यजेत; श्रद्धा वित्तं विधिश्चेति त्रितयं तत्समागतं Ś. 7. 29; R. 2. 16. --5 Any religious act or ceremony, a rite, ceremony; स चेत् स्वयं कर्मसु धर्मचारिणां त्वमंतरायो भवसि च्युतो विधिः R. 3. 45, 1. 34. --6 Behaviour, conduct. --7 Condition; V. 4. --8 Creation, formation; सामग्र्यविधौ Ku. 3. 28; कल्याणी विधिषु विचित्रता विधातुः Ki. 7. 7. --9 The creator. --10 Fate, destiny, luck; विधौ वामारंभे मन समुचितैषा परिणतिः Māl. 4. 4. --11 The food of elephants. --12 Time. --13 A physician. --14 N. of Viṣṇu. --Comp. --घ्न a. disregarding prescribed rites or rules. --ज्ञ a. knowing the ritual. (--ज्ञः) a Brāhmaṇa versed in the ritual, a ritualist. --दर्शकः a priest at a sacrifice who sees that everything is done according to the precepts, and corrects any deviation from them. --दुष्ट, --विहित a. prescribed by rule, enjoined by law. --देशकः {1} = विधिदर्शक above. {2} a preceptor, teacher. --द्वैधं diversity of rules, variance of precept or commandment. --पूर्वकं ind. according to rule. --प्रयोगः application of a rule. --योगः the force or influence of fate. --वधूः f. an epithet of Sarasvatī. --हीन a. devoid of rule, unauthorised, irregular.
25970: विधित्सा 1 Desire to do or perform. --2 Design, purpose, desire in general.
25971: विधित्सित a. Intended to be done. --तं Intention, design.
25972: विधिवत्, विधितः ind. According to law, agreeably to precept or rule, in conformity to prescribed rules, in due form.
25973: विधेय pot. p. 1 To be done or performed. --2 To be enjoyed or prescribed. --3 (a) Dependent on. at the disposal of; अथ विधिविधेयः परिचयः Māl. 2. 13. (b) Subject to, influenced or controlled by, subdued or overpowered by (usually in comp.); तिद्राविधेयं नरदेवसैन्यं R. 7. 62; संभाव्यमानस्नेहरसेनाभिसंधिना विधेयीकृतोऽपि Māl. 1. Bg. 2. 64; भ्रातुः सौहार्देन विधेयीकृतोस्मि Mv. 7; Mu. 3. 1; Śi. 3. 20; R. 19. 4. --4 Obedient, tractable, compliant, submissive; अविधेयेंद्रियः पुंसां गौरिवैति विधेयतां Ki. 11. 33. --5 To be predicated (in gram &c.); अत्र मिथ्यामहिमत्वं नानुवाद्यं अपि तु विधेयं K. P. 7. --यं 1 What ought to be done, a duty; Ki. 1. 25, 16. 62. --2 The predicate of a proposition. --यः A servant, dependant. --Comp. --अविमर्शः a fault of composition which consists in assigning to the predicate a subordinate position or in expressing it imperfectly ( अविमृष्टः प्राधान्येनानिर्दिष्टो विधेयांशो यत्र K. P. 7: see examples ad loc.). --आत्मन् m. N. of Viṣṇu. --ज्ञ a. one who knows one's duty; स भृत्यो यो विधेयज्ञः Pt. 1. 337. --पदं {1} the object to be accomplished. {2} the predicate.
25974: विधुः [व्यध्-कु; Uṇ. 1. 23] 1 The moon; सविता विधवति विधुरपि सवितरति दिनंति यामिन्यः K. P. 10. --2 Camphor. --3 A demon, fiend. --4 An expiatory oblation. --5 N. of Viṣṇu. --6 N. of Brahman. --7 N. of Śiva. --8 Wind. --9 War, battle. --Comp. --क्षयः waning of the moon, the period of the dark fortnight of a month. --पंजरः (also पिंजरः) a scimitar, sabre. --प्रिया a Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.
25976: विधुतिः f. Shaking, trepidation, tremor; वैनायक्यश्चिरं वो वदनविधुतयः पांतु चीत्कारवत्यः Māl. 1. 1.
25977: विधुननं 1 Shaking or tossing about, agitating. --2 Trembling, tremor.
25978: विधुंतुदः N. of Rāhu; विधुमिव विकटविधुंतुददंतदलनगलितामृतधारं Gīt. 4; आभिमुख्यं शशांकस्य यथाद्यापि विधुंतुदः Pt. 1. 326; N. 4. 71; Śi. 2. 61.
25979: विधुर a. [विगता धूर्यस्य अच् समा°] 1 Distressed, troubled, afflicted, overwhelmed with grief, miserable; Māl. 2. 3, 9. 11, U. 3. 38, 6. 41, Ki. 11. 26; Śi. 9. 77, 17. 66, Bh. 3. 8, 114. --2 Love-lorn, bereaved, suffering separation from a wife or husband; मयि च विधुरे भावः कांताप्रवृत्तिपराङ्मुखः V. 4. 20; विधुरां ज्वलनातिसर्जनान्ननु मां प्रापय पत्युरंतिकं Ku. 4. 32; विधुरबंधुरबंधुरमैक्षत Śi. 6. 29, 12. 8. --3 Devoid, deprived, or destitute of, free from; सा बै कलंकविधुरा मधुराननश्रीः Bv. 2. 5. --4 Adverse, hostile, unfriendly; Pt. 2. 81. --रः A widower. --रं 1 Alarm, fear, anxiety. --2 Separation from a wife or husband, bereavement suffered by a lover or mistress. --Comp. --दर्शनं {1} the sight of danger or alarm; विना विधुरदर्शनं स्वामिनो मंदादरा भवंति H. 2. {2} a feeling of agitation.
25980: विधुरा Curds mixed with sugar and spices.
25981: विधू {5} {c10c} U., {c6c} P. 1 To shake, move, cause to tremble; वायुर्विधूनयति चंपकपुष्परेणून् Kavirahasya; मृदुपवनविधूतान् Rs. 6. 29; 3. 10; दीर्घां वेणीं विधुन्वाना Mb. --2 To shake off, destroy, expel, drive away; कपेर्विधवितुं द्युतिं Bk. 9. 28; R. 9. 72 v. l. --3 To spurn, despise, treat with contempt; R. 11. 40. --4 To leave, give up, abandon; N. 1. 35.
25983: विधूत p. p. 1 Shaken or tossed about, waved. --2 Tremulous. --3 Shaken off, dispelled, removed. --4 Unsteady. --5 Abandoned. --तं Repugnance. --Comp. --कल्मष a. free from sin. --केश a. one who has tossed about the hair; Ki. 8. 33. --निद्र a. awakened.
25984: विधूतिः f., विधूननं Shaking, tremor, agitation.
25985: विधूनित a. 1 Agitated, alarmed. --2 Harassed, annoyed, molested.
25986: विधृ {c10c} U. 1 To seize, catch, catch or take hold of; अंशुकपल्लवेन विधृतः Amaru. 79, 85. --2 To put on, wear, use; R. 12. 40. --3 To maintain, bear, support, hold up; शिरसा विधृता नित्यं Pt. 1. 82 (where sense 2 is also intended); Bh. 3. 23. --4 To fix upon, direct towards. --5 To separate, divide. --6 To arrange; manage. --7 To with hold, obstruct, restrain.
25987: विधृत p. p. 1 Seized, held, grasped. --2 Separated, kept asunder or separate. --3 Assumed, possessed. --4 Checked, restrained. --5 Supported, protected, borne up; (see धृ with वि). --तं 1 Disregard of a command. --2 Dissatisfaction.
25989: विध्वंस् {c1c} A. 1 To fall to pieces. --2 To be dispersed or scattered. --3 To perish, be destroyed or ruined. --Caus. 1 To destroy, crush, annihilate. --2 To injure, hurt.
25990: विध्वंसः 1 Ruin, destruction. --2 Enmity, aversion; dislike. --3 An insult, offence.
25991: विध्वंसिन् a. 1 Being ruined, falling to pieces. --2 Hostile, adverse.
25992: विध्वस्त p. p. 1 Ruined, destroyed; Pt. 2. 113. --2 Scattered about, tossed up. --3 Obscured, darkened. --4 Eclipsed.
25993: विनद् {c1c} P. 1 To sound, resound; Bg. 1. 12. --2 To roar, cry out. --3 To fill with cries. --Caus. To cause to cry or utter notes; अंबुदैः शिखिगणो विनाद्यते Ghaṭ. 10.
25994: विनदः 1 Sound, noise. --2 N. of a tree.
25995: विनम् {c1c} P. To bend oneself, stoop, be bent; विनमंति चास्य तरवः प्रचये Ki. 6. 34; Bh. 1. 67; Bk. 7. 52.
25996: विनत p. p. 1 Bent down, bowed. --2 Stooping, drooping, inclined; Ś. 3. 10. --3 Sunk down, depressed. --4 Bent, crooked, curved. --5 Humble, modest. --6 Changed into a lingual letter; see विनाम. --Comp. --आनन a. with downcast face, dejected.
25997: विनता 1 N. of the mother of Aruṇa and Garuḍa, said to be one of the wives of Kaśyapa; see गरुड. --2 A kind of basket. --Comp. --नंदनः, --सुतः, --सूनुः epithets of Garuḍa or Aruṇa.
25998: विनतिः f. 1 Bowing down, bending, stooping. --2 Modesty, humility. --3 A request.
26000: विनम्र a. 1 Bent down, stooping; Ki. 4. 2. --2 Depressed, sunk down. --3 Modest, humble.
26001: विनम्रकं The flower of the Tagara tree.
26002: विनश् {c4c} P. 1 To be destroyed, perish, die. --2 To disappear, vanish. --3 To be lost or ruined. --4 To be frustrated or foiled. --Caus. To destroy, annihilate.
26003: विनशनं Perishing, loss, destruction, disappearance. --नः N. of the place where the river Sarasvatī is lost in the sand; cf. Ms. 2. 21.
26004: विनष्ट p. p. 1 Perished, destroyed, ruined. --2 Disappeared, lost. --3 Spoiled, corrupted.
26005: विनष्टिः f. 1 Utter ruin or destruction. --2 Disappearance, vanishing.
26006: विनाशः 1 Destruction, ruin, utter loss, decay. --2 Removal. --Comp. --उन्मुख a. about to perish, ripe to meet one's doom. --धर्मन्, --धर्मिन् a. subject to decay, perishable, transient; विषयेषु विनाशधर्मसु त्रिदिवस्थेष्वपि निःस्पृहोऽभवत् R. 8. 10.
26007: विनाशनं Destruction, ruin, annihilation. --नः A destroyer.
26009: विना ind. Without, except (with acc., instr. or abl.); यथा तानं विना रागो यथा मानं विना नृपः । यथा दानं विना हस्ती तथा ज्ञानं विना यतिः Bv. 1. 119; पंकैर्विना सरो भाति सदः खलजनैर्विना । कटुवर्णैर्विना काव्यं मानसं विषयैर्विना 1. 116; विना वाहनहस्तिभ्यः क्रियतां सर्वमोक्षः Mu. 7; Śi. 2. 9. (विनाकृ means ‘to leave, abandon, bereave, deprive of’; मदनेन विनाकृता रतिः Ku. 4. 21 ‘bereft of Cupid’). --Comp. --उक्तिः f. a figure of speech in which विना is used in a poetically charming way; विनार्थसंबंध एव विनोक्तिः R. G.; see K. P. 10 also.
26010: विनाडिः, विनाडिका A measure of time equal to one-sixtieth part of a Ghaṭikā or equal to 24 seconds.
26011: विनामः (In gram.). Change into a lingual or cerebral letter, the substitution of ष् for स् and ण् for न्.
26012: विनायकः 1 A remover (of obstacles). --2 N. of Gaṇeśa. --3 A Buddhist deified teacher. --4 N. of Garuḍa. --5 An obstacle, impediment. --6 A spiritual preceptor.
26015: विनाहः A cover for the mouth of a well; cf. वीनाह.
26016: विनिकॄ {c6c} A. 1 To throw, abandon, cast off; Ku. 4. 6. --2 To throw about, scatter.
26017: विनिकीर्ण p. p. Scattered, thrown about.
26018: विनिक्षिप् {c6c} A. 1 To entrust, deliver over. --2 To place in or upon. --3 To throw down, overthrow. --4 To engage in.
26020: विनिगड a. Without fetters, unrestrained, free.
26021: विनिग्रह् {c9c} U. 1 To restrain, check; obstruct, impede. --2 To lay hold of, seize.
26022: विनिग्रहः 1 Restraining, curbing, subduing; Bg. 13. 7, 17. 16; Ms. 9. 263. --2 Mutual opposition or antithesis.
26023: विनिद्र a. 1 Sleepless, awake (fig. also); तामेकतस्तव बिभार्त्ति गुरुर्विनिद्रः R. 5. 66. --2 Budded, opened, full-blown, expanded; विनिद्रमंदाररजोरुणांगुली Ku. 5. 80.
26024: विनिपत् {c1c} P. 1 To fly at, fall down, descend; Rs. 4. 19. --2 To attack, assail. --Caus. 1 To cause to fall down, ruin, destroy; कटेन विनिपातितो यामि Mk. 2. 8. --2 To throw or pull down. --3 To kill, deprive of life.
26025: विनिपातः 1 Falling down, a fall. --2 A great fall, calamity, an evil, loss, ruin, destruction; विवेकभ्रष्टानां भवति विनिपातः शतमुखः Bh. 2. 10 (where it has sense 1 also); विधिहेतुरहेतुरागसां विनिपातोपि समः समुन्नतेः Ki. 2. 34. --3 Decay, death. --4 Hell, perdition; Ś. 5. --5 Occurrence, happening. --6 Pain, distress. --7 Disrespect. --Comp. --शंसिन् a. portentous, foreboding ruin.
26026: विनिमयः 1 Exchange, barter; कार्यविनिमयेन M. 1; संपद्विनिमयेनोभौ दधतुर्भुवनद्वयं R. 1. 26. --2 A pledge, deposit, security. --3 Transmutation (of letters).
26028: विनियम् {c1c} P. 1 To restrain, check, curb; Bg. 6. 24. --2 To limit, restrict.
26029: विनियत p. p. Controlled, checked, restrained, regulated; as in विनियताहार, विनियतवाच् &c.
26031: विनियुज् {c7c} U. 1 To use, expend. --2 To appoint, employ. --3 To divide, apportion, distribute; प्रत्येकं विनियुक्तात्मा कथं न ज्ञास्यसि प्रभो Ku. 2. 31. --4 To disconnect, separate. --Caus. 1 To appoint, employ. --2 To enjoin, order, command. --3 To offer, present, give. --4 To perform, do, dispose of.
26032: विनियुक्त p. p. 1 Separated, loosed, detached. --2 Attached to, appointed. --3 Applied to. --4 Commanded, enjoined.
26033: विनियोगः 1 Separation, parting, detachment. --2 Leaving, giving up, abandoning. --3 Employment, use, application, disposal; बभूव विनियोगज्ञः साधनीयेषु वस्तुषु R. 17. 67; प्राणायामे विनियागेः &c. --4 Appointment to a duty, commission, charge; विनियोगप्रसादा हि किंकराः प्रभविष्णुषु Ku. 6. 62. --5 An obstacle, impediment.
26034: विनिर्गम् {c1c} P. 1 To go out. --2 To disappear, vanish. --3 To go away, depart. --4 To escape from, liberate oneself from.
26036: विनिर्जि {c1c} P. 1 To conquer completely. --2 To subdue, overpower, master.
26039: विनिर्णयः 1 Complete settlement or ascertainment, full decision. --2 Certainty. --3 A settled rule.
26042: विनिर्मित p. p. 1 Formed or made of. --2 Made, created. --3 Celebrated, observed (as a feast). --4 Determined, destined.
26043: विनिर्मुच् {c6c} P. 1 To loosen, free from. --2 To set free, release, liberate. --3 To discharge, shoot off. --4 To abandon, give up.
26047: विनिविश् {c6c} P. To be placed or be seated in. --Caus. 1 To fix, place; Ku. 1. 49; R. 5. 63; मदुरसि कुचकलशं विनिवेशय Gīt. 12. --2 To populate or colonize. --3 To introduce. --4 To add, insert.
26048: विनिवेशः 1 Entrance, settling down in a place. --2 An impression; Ś. 6. 14.
26049: विनिवृ {c10c} U. or --Caus. 1 To prevent, ward off, suppress; विनयं विनिवार्य Māl. 1. 18. --2 To prohibit, forbid.
26050: विनिवृत् {c1c} A. 1 To turn back, return. --2 To cease, come to an end; सपिंडता तु पुरुषे सप्तमे विनिवर्तते Ms. 5. 60; Bg. 2. 59. --3 To desist, turn away, abstain (from); देवनात्, युद्धात् &c. --Caus. 1 To cause to cease or step, withdraw; Ś. 7. 26. --2 To restrain, withhold. --3 To renounce.
26051: विनिवृत्त p. p. 1 Returned, turned away. --2 Stopped, ceased, desisted from. --3 Retired.
26052: विनिवृत्तिः f. 1 Cessation, stopping, removing; शक्राभ्यसूयाविनिवृत्तये R. 6. 74. --2 End, stop, termination.
26053: विनिश्चि {c5c} U. To determine, resolve, ascertain; विनिश्चेतुं शक्यो न सुखमिति वा दुःखमिति वा U. 1. 36.
26054: विनिश्चयः 1 Fixing, settling, ascertainment. --2 A decision, resolution.
26055: विनिश्वासः Hard breathing or respiration, sighing, a sigh.
26057: विनिहत p. p. 1 Struck down, wounded. --2 Killed. --3 Completely overcome. --तः 1 Any great or unavoidable calamity, such as that inflicted by fate or heaven. --2 A portent, comet.
26058: विनी {c1c} P. 1 To remove, take away, destroy (said to be Atm. only except where it has ‘a part of the body’ for its object); पटुपटहध्वनिभिर्विनीतनिद्रः R. 9. 71; विनीतखेदः 13. 35, 46; 15. 48; Śi. 10. 62, Ki. 7. 30, Ku. 1. 9, 5. 32. --2 To teach, instruct, educate, train; विनिन्युरेनं गुरवो गुरुप्रियं R. 3. 29; 5. 101. 15. 69; 18. 51; Y. 1. 311; Ku. 1. 34. --3 To tame, subdue, govern, control (fig. also); वन्यान्विनेष्यन्निव दुष्ट सत्वान् R. 2. 8; 6. 27, 14. 75; Ki. 2. 41; वनगज इव तस्मात्सोभ्युपायैर्विनेयः Mu. 3. 25. --4 To appease, pacify (anger) (Atm.); R. 2. 49. --5 To pass away, spend (as time); कथमपि यामिनीं विनीय Gīt. 8. --6 To carry through, perform, complete, finish. --7 To spend, apply to use (Atm.). शतं विनयते Sk. --8 To give, present, pay, pay off (as tribute) (Atm.); करं विनयते Sk. --9 To lead or conduct towards; Ku. 7. 9. --10 To bid, direct, order; Ku. 3. 41. --11 To bend down, incline. --12 To spread, stretch out.
26059: विनय a. 1 Cast, thrown. --2 Secret. --3 Ill-behaved. --यः 1 Guidance, discipline, instruction (in one's duties), moral training; प्रजानां विनयाधानात् R. 1. 24; Māl. 10. 5. --2 Sense of propriety, decorum, decency; अनुयास्यन्मुनितनयां सहसा विनयेन वारितप्रसरः Ś. 1. 29. --3 Polite conduct, gentleman-like bearing, good breeding or manners; R. 6. 79; Māl. 1. 18. --4 Modesty, humility; सुष्ठु शोभसे आर्यपुत्र एतेन विनयमाहात्म्येन U. 1; विद्या ददाति वि नयम्; तथापि नीचैर्विनयाददृश्यत R. 3. 34; 10. 71 (where Malli. renders विनय by इंद्रियजय or restraint of passions, unnecessarily in our opinion). --5 Reverence, courtesy, obeisance. --6 Conduct in general. --7 Drawing off, taking away, removing; Śi. 10. 42. --8 A man who has subdued his senses. --9 A trader, merchant. --Comp. --अवनत a. stooping humbly. --ग्राहिन् a. tractable, obedient, submissive. --भाज् a. modest, wellbehaved. --वाच् a. speaking mildly or affably. --स्थ a. modest.
26060: विनयनं 1 Removing, taking away; Me. 52. --2 Education, instruction, training, discipline.
26061: विनीत p. p. 1 Taken away, removed. --2 Well-trained, educated, disciplined. --3 Refined, well-behaved. --4 Modest, humble, meek, gentle. --5 Decent, decorous, gentlemanly. --6 Sent away, dismissed. --7 Tamed, broken in. --8 Plain, simple, (as a dress). --9 Having the passions under control, selfsubdued. --10 Chastised, punished. --11 Tractable, governable. --12 Lovely, handsome. (See नी with वि also). --तः 1 A trained horse. --2 A trader. --Comp. --आत्मन् a. humble, lowly.
26062: विनीतकं 1 A vehicle or conveyance (a litter &c.). --2 A carrier, bearer.
26063: विनीतिः f. 1 Training, good behaviour. --2 Respect, reverence, esteem.
26065: विनेतृ m. 1 A leader, guide. --2 A teacher, an instructor; स तथेति विनेतुरुदारमतेः प्रतिगृह्य वचो विससर्ज मुनिं R. 8. 91. --3 A king, ruler. --4 A chastiser, punisher; अयं विनेता दृप्तानां Mv. 3. 46, 4. 1, R. 6. 39, 14. 23.
26066: विनुद् {c6c} P. 1 To strike, pierce. --2 To play on a musical instrument (वीणां, आतोद्यं &c.). --3 To remove, drive away, dispel. --Caus. 1 To remove, drive away, dispel, cast off; तापं विनोदय दृष्टिभिः Gīt. 10; Śi. 4. 66; Ś. 3. 21; Māl. 9. 41. --2 To pass, spend (as time). --3 To divert, amuse, entertain; क्व नु खल्वात्मानं विनोदयामि Ś. 3; लतासु दृष्टिं विनोदयामि Ś. 6; R. 14. 77. --4 To amuse oneself with; लक्ष्मीर्विमोदयाति येन दिगंतलंबी सोपि त्वदाननरुचिं विजहाति चंद्रः R. 5. 67.
26067: विनोदः 1 Removing, driving away; श्रमविनोद. --2 A diversion, an amusement, any interesting or amusing pursuit or occupation; प्रायेणैते रमणविरहेष्वंगनानां विनोदाः Me. 87; मिथ्यैव व्यसनं वदंति मृगयामीदृग्विनोदः कुतः Ś. 2. 5. --3 Play, sport, pastime. --4 Eagerness, vehement desire. --5 Pleasure, happiness, gratification; विलपनवितोदोप्यसुलभः U. 3. 30; जनयतु रसिकजनेषु मनोरमरतिरसभावविनोदं Gīt. 12. --6 A particular mode of sexual enjoyment. --7 A kind of house.
26068: विनोदनं 1 Removing. --2 A diversion &c.; see विनोद.
26069: विंदु a. 1 Intelligent, wise. --2 Liberal. --दुः A drop; see बिंदु.
26070: विंध्यः 1 N. of a range of mountains which separates Hindustān proper from the Deccan or south; it is one of the seven Kulaparvatas q. v., and forms the southern limit of Madhyadeśa; see Ms. 2. 21. [According to a legend, the Vindhya mountain, being jealous of the mount Meru (or Himālaya) demanded that the sun should revolve round himself as about Meru, which the sun declined to do; whereupon the Vindhya began to rise higher and higher so as to obstruct the path of the sun and moon.
