The gods being alarmed sought the aid of the sage Agastya, who approached the mountain and requested that by bending down he would give him an easy passage to the south, and that he would retain the same position till his return. This Vindhya consented to do (because according to one account, he regarded Agastya as his teacher); but Agastya never returned from the south, and Vindhya never attained the height of Meru]. --2 A hunter. --ध्या 1 N. of a plant (लबली). --2 Small cardamoms. --Comp. --अटवी the great Vindhya forest. --कूटः, --कूटनं epithets of the sage Agastya. --वासिन् m. an epithet of the grammarian व्याडि. (--नी) an epithet of Durgā.
26071: विन्न p. p. [विद् कर्मणि क्त] 1 Known. --2 Got, obtained. --3 Discussed, investigated. --4 Placed, fixed. --5 Married; (See विद्).
26073: विन्यस् {c4c} P. 1 To put down, deposit, place; विन्यस्यंती भुवि गणनया देहलीदत्तषुष्पैः Me. 87; Bk. 3. 3. --2 To fix in or on, direct towards; रामे विन्यस्तमानसाः Rām. --3 To deliver or make over, commit to the care of, entrust; सुतविन्यस्तपत्नीकः Y. 3. 45. --4 To arrange, dispose, adjust.
26074: विन्यस्त p. p. 1 Placed or put down. --2 Inlaid, paved. --3 Fixed. --4 Arranged. --5 Delivered. --6 Presented, offered. --7 Deposited.
26075: विन्यासः 1 Entrusting, depositing. --2 A deposit. --3 Arrangement, adjustment, disposition; अक्षरविन्यासः ‘inscribing letters’; प्रत्यक्षरश्लेषमयप्रबंधविन्यासवैदग्धनिधिः Vās. ‘composition of a work &c.’ --4 A collection, an assemblage. --5 A site or receptacle.
26077: विप् m. 1 A praiser, singer of hymns. --2 A wise man. --f. 1 Praise, a hymn. --2 A finger.
26078: विपक्ष a. Hostile, inimical, adverse, contrary. --क्षः 1 An enemy, adversary, opponent; गुणास्तस्य विपक्षेपि गुणिनो लेभिरेंतरं R. 17. 75; Śi. 11. 59. --2 A rival or fellow wife; R. 19. 20. --3 A disputant; Ki. 17. 43. --4 (In logic) A negative instance, an instance on the opposite side, (i. e. that in which the साध्य or major term is not found); निश्चितसाध्याभाववान् विपक्षः T. S.; Mu. 5. 10. --5 (In gram.) An exception. --Comp. --भावः, --वृत्ति f. hostility.
26080: विपच् {c1c} P. 1 To mature, develop, ripen; bear fruit; (समारंभाः) गर्भशालिसधर्माणस्तस्य गूढं विपेचिरे R. 17. 53. --2 To digest. --3 To cook thoroughly. --4 To melt, dissolve, liquefy. --5 To roast. --Caus. 1 To cook thoroughly. --2 To melt, liquefy.
26081: विपक्त्रिम a. 1 Fully ripened or matured. --2 Developed, fulfilled (as the consequences of former acts).
26082: विपक्व a. 1 Fully ripened or matured. --2 Developed, fulfilled; यच्च तप्तं तपस्तस्य विपक्वं फलमद्य नः Ku. 6. 10. --3 Cooked.
26083: विपंचिका, विपंची 1 A lute. --2 Play, sport, pastime.
26084: विपट् {c10c} U. 1 To tear up or out; (केतकबर्हं) विपाटयामास युवा नखाग्रैः R. 6. 17. --2 To pull or draw out, extract. --3 To root up, eradicate. --4 To open, unfold.
26085: विपाटनं 1 Tearing open, splitting. --2 Eradication. --3 Spoliation.
26086: विपण् {c1c} A. 1 To sell, barter; आभीरदेशे किल चंद्रकांतं त्रिभिर्वराटैर्विपणंति गोपाः Subhāṣ. --2 To bet, stake.
26087: विपणः, विपणनं 1 Sale; Ms. 3. 152. --2 Petty trade.
26088: विपणिः, --णी f. 1 A market, market-place, stall; हा हा नश्यति मन्मथस्य विपणिः सौभाग्यपण्याकरः Mk. 8. 38; Śi. 5. 24; R. 16. 41. --2 An article or commodity for sale. --3 Trade, traffic; Ms. 10. 116.
26089: विपणिन् m. A trader, merchant, shop-keeper; Śi. 5. 24.
26090: विपथः A wrong road, bad way (lit. and fig.).
26091: विपद् {c4c} A. 1 To go badly; fail, miscarry (as a business &c.). --2 To fall into misfortune or bad state; स बंधुर्यो विपन्नानामापदुद्धरणक्षमः H. 1. 31. --3 To be disabled or incapacitated. --4 To die, perish; नाथवंतस्त्वया लोकास्त्वमनाथा विपत्स्यसे U. 1. 44; हा तात एष ते नरेंद्रचित्ताराधनोपकरणं जनो विपद्यते Māl. 5; Mk. 1. 38. --5 To obstruct. --Caus. To destroy, kill.
26092: विपत्तिः f. 1 A calamity, misfortune, disaster, mishap, adversity; संपत्तौ च विपत्तौ च महतामेकरूपता Subhāṣ. --2 Death, destruction; अतिरभसकृतानां कर्मणामाविपत्तेर्भवति हृदयदाही शल्यतुल्यो विपाकः Bh. 2. 99; R. 19. 56; Ve. 4. 6; हिमसेकविपत्तिः नलिनी R. 8. 45. --3 Agony, torment (यातना). --त्तिः (m.) An excellent or distinguished footsoldier; Ki. 15. 16.
26093: विपद् f. 1 A calamity, misfortune, adversity, distress; तत्त्वनिकषग्रावा तु तेषां (मित्राणां) विपद् H. 1. 210. --2 Death; सिंहादवापद्विपदं नृसिंहः R. 18. 35. --Comp. --उद्धरणं, --उद्धारः relieving or extricating (one) from misfortune. --कालः times of need, season of calamity, adversity. --ग्रस्त, --युक्त a. overtaken by or involved in calamity, unhappy, unfortunate. --सागरः ‘sea of misery’ a very heavy calamity or disaster.
26095: विपन्न p. p. 1 Dead. --2 Lost, destroyed. --3 Unfortunate, afflicted, distressed, fallen into adversity. --4 Declined. --5 Disabled, incapacitated. --न्नः A snake.
26096: विपरिणम् Caus. To change or transform into. --Pass. 1 To be changed into. --2 To undergo a change for the worse.
26097: विपरिणमनं, विपरिणामः 1 A change, an alteration. --2 Change of form, transformation.
26098: विपरिवृत् {c1c} A. 1 To turn round, revolve (fig. also); Bg. 9. 10. --2 To roll about. --3 To wander about, move to and fro. --4 To return. --5 To surround; attend upon (with acc.).
26100: विपरी (विपरि + इ) {c2c} P. 1 To turn in an opposite direction. --2 To be otherwise, fail, prove fruitless; कल्याणं विदधातु वा भगवतीनीतिर्विपर्येतु वा Māl. 6. 3. --3 To change for the worse. --4 To go round, return.
26101: विपरीत a. 1 Reversed, inverted. --2 Contrary, opposite, reverse, inverse; R. 2. 53. --3 Wrong, contrary to rule. --4 False, untrue; Bv. 2 177. --5 Unfavourable, adverse. --6 Cross, acting in an opposite manner. --7 Disagreeable, inauspicious. --तः A particular mode of sexual enjoyment. --ता 1 An unchaste or faithless wife. --2 A perverse woman. --Comp. --कर, --कारक, --कारिन्, --कृत्, a. perverse, acting in a contrary manner; Śi. 14. 66. --चेतस्,--मति a. having a perverted mind. --रतं inverted sexual intercourse; cf. पुरुषायित. --लक्षणा ironical description of a thing by mentioning its contrary properties.
26102: विपरीतता --त्वं Contrariety, inversion, opposition; लोके गुरुत्वं विपरीततां वा स्वचेष्टितान्येव नरं नयतिं Subhāṣ.
26103: विपर्ययः 1 Contrariety, reverse, inversion; आहितो जयविपर्ययोपि मे श्लाध्य एव परमेष्ठिना त्वया R. 11. 86; स्वशरीरशरीरिणावपि श्रुतसंयोगविपर्ययौ यदा 8. 89; नभसः स्फुटतारस्य रात्रेरिव विपर्ययः (न भाजनं) Ki. 11. 44; विपर्यये तु Ś. 5. ‘if it be otherwise’, if contrary be the case; विपर्यये त्वस्याधिपतेरुल्लंधितः क्षात्रधर्मः स्यात् Ve. 5. --2 Change (of purpose, dress &c.); कथमेत्य मतिर्विपर्ययं करिणी पंकमिवावसीदति Ki. 2. 6; so वेषविपर्ययः Pt. 1. --3 Absence or non-existence; समुद्रगारूपविपर्ययेऽपि Ku. 7. 42; त्यागे श्लाघाविपर्ययः R. 1. 22. --4 Loss; निद्रा संज्ञाविपर्ययः Ku. 6. 44 ‘loss of consciousness’. --5 Complete destruction, annihilation. --6 Exchange, barter. --7 Error, trespass, mistake, misapprehension. --8 A calamity, misfortune, adverse fate. --9 Hostility, enmity. --10 Perverseness, opposition.
26104: विपर्यायः Reverse, contrariety; V. 4; see विपर्यय above.
26105: विपर्यस् {c4c} P. 1 To overturn, reverse, invert. --2 To change, alter. --3 To take wrongly, misunderstand; प्रतीकारो व्याधेः सुखमिति विपर्यस्यति जनः Bh. 3. 92. --4 To undergo change, be affected, (intrans.); दैवेनोपहतस्य बुद्धिरथवा सर्वा विपर्यस्यति Mu. 6. 8; (cf. the Latin adage ‘quem deus vult perdere prius dementat’).
26106: विपर्यस्त p. p. 1 Changed, inverted, reversed; हंत विपर्यस्तः संप्रति जीवलोकः U. 1. --2 Opposite, contrary. --3 Wrongly considered to be real. --Comp. --पुत्रा a woman bearing no male children.
26107: विपर्यासः 1 Change, contrariety, reverse; विपर्यासं यातो घनविरलभावः क्षितिरुहां U. 2. 27. --2 Adverseness, unfavourableness; as in दैवविपर्यासात्. --3 Interchange, exchange; प्रवहणविपर्यासेनागता Mk. 8. --4 An error, a mistake.
26108: विपलं A moment, an extremely small division of time (said to be equal to one-sixth or one-sixtieth part of a pala).
26109: विपलायनं Running away, fleeing in different directions.
26110: विपश्चित् a. Learned, wise; विपश्चितो विनिन्युरेनं गुरवो गुरुप्रियं R. 3. 29. --m. A learned or wise man sage; भवंति ते सभ्यतमा विपश्चितां मनोगतं वाचि निवेशयंति ये Ki. 14. 4; Pt. 1. 100.
26111: विपाकः 1 Cooking, dressing. --2 Digestion. --3 Ripening, ripeness, maturity, development (fig. also); अमी पृथुस्तंबभृतः पिशंगतां गता विपाकेन फलस्य शालयः Ki. 4. 26; वाचां विपाको मम Bv. 4. 42 ‘my mature, full-developed, or dignified words’. --4 Consequence, fruit, result, the result of actions either in this or in a former birth; अहो मे दारुणतरः कर्मणां विपाकः K. 354; ममैव जन्मांतरपातकानां विपाकविस्फूर्जथुरषसह्यः R. 14. 62; Bh. 2. 99; Mv. 5. 56. --5 (a) Change of state; कष्टं बतान्यदिव दैववशेन जाता दुःखात्मकं किमपि भूतमहो विपाकः U. 4. 6. (b) An unexpected event or occurrence, a reverse, adverse turn of fate, distress, calamity; रिदृशानां विपाकोऽपि जायते परमाद्भुतः U. 3. 3; विपाके घोरेऽस्मिन्नथ खलु विमूढा तव सखी 4. 12. --6 Difficulty, embarrassment. --7 Flavour, taste.
26112: विपाठः A kind of large arrow.
26113: विपांडु a. Pale, pallid; परितो विपांडु दधदभ्रशिरः Śi. 9. 3; Ki. 5. 6; so विपांडुर Śi. 4. 5; Ratn. 2. 4.
26115: विपादिका 1 A sore or tumour on the foot. --2 An enigma, a riddle.
26116: विपाश्, विपाशा f. N. of one of the five rivers in the Panjab (now called Beas).
26117: विपिनं [वप्-इनन् पृषो°; cf. Uṇ. 2. 52] A wood, forest, grove, thicket; वृंदावनविपिने ललितं वितनोतु शुभानि यशंस्यं Gīt. 1; विपिनानि प्रकाशानि शक्तिमत्वाच्चकार सः R. 4. 31; Māl. 9. 2.
26118: विपुल a. 1 Large, extensive, capacious, broad, wide, spacious; विपुलं नितंबदेशे M. 3. 7; शिरसि तनुर्विपुलश्च मध्यदेशे Mk. 3. 22; कालो ह्ययं निरवधिर्विपुला च पृथ्वी Māl. 1. 6; so विपुलं पृष्ठं, विपुलः कुक्षिः &c. --2 Much, ample, copious, abundant; Ki. 18. 14. --3 Deep, profound; Mv. 1. 2. --4 With the hair standing on end, thrilling; Śi. 16. 3 (where it has sense 1 also). --लः 1 N. of the mountain Meru. --2 Of Himālaya. --3 A respectable man. --Comp. --छाय a. shady, umbrageous. --जघना a woman with large hips. --मति a. endowed with great talents or understanding. --रसः the sugarcane.
26122: विप्रः [वप्-रन् पृषो °अत इत्वम्; Uṇ. 2. 28] 1 A Brāhmaṇa; see the quotations under ब्राह्मण. --2 A sage, wise man. --3 The Aśvattha tree. --4 (In prosody) A foot of four short syllables. --5 A singer of hymns, praiser. --Comp. --ऋषिः = ब्रह्मषिंः q. v. --काष्ठं the cotton-plant. --प्रियः the Palāśa tree. --समागमः a concourse or synod of Brāhmaṇas. --स्वं the property of a Brāhmaṇa.
26123: विप्रकीर्ण p. p. 1 Spread about, dispersed, scattered. --2 Loose, dishevelled (as hair). --3 Expanded, outstretched. --4 Wide, broad.
26124: विप्रकृ {c8c} U. 1 (a) To tease, trouble, harass, harm; किं सत्त्वानि विप्रकरोषि Ś. 7; (b) To oppress; तस्मिन् विप्रकृताः काले तारकेण दिवौकसः Ku. 2. 1. --2 To wrong, ill-treat, offend; Ś. 4. 17. --3 To affect, cause a change in; कमपरमवशं नविप्रकुर्युर्विभुमपि तं यदमी स्पृशंति भावाः Ku. 6. 95. --4 To disfigure, deform; आभरणोचितं रूपमाश्रमसुलभैः प्रसाधनैर्विप्रकार्यते Ś. 4.
26125: विप्रकारः 1 Insult, contumely, abuse, treating with disrespect; Ki. 3. 55. --2 Injury, offence. --3 Wickedness. --4 Opposition, counteraction. --5 Retaliation.
26126: विप्रकृत p. p. 1 Hurt, offended, injured. --2 Insulted, abused, treated with contumely. --3 Opposed. --4 Retaliated, requited. --5 Oppressed, troubled, disturbed. --6 Irritated, provoked; विप्रकृतः पन्नगः फणां कुरुते Ś. 6. 31.
26127: विप्रकृतिः f. 1 Injury, offence. --2 An insult, abuse, contumely. --3 Retaliation, retort.
26128: विप्रकृष् {c1c} P. To draw away, remove, counteract; U. 5. 31.
26130: विप्रकृष्ट p. p. 1 Drawn away, removed. --2 Distant, remote. --3 Protracted, lengthened, extended.
26134: विप्रतिपद् {c4c} A. 1 To differ, be mutually opposed, conflict. --2 To waver, vacillate.
26135: विप्रतिपत्तिः f. 1 Mutual discrepancy, contest, conflict, dispute, opposition (as of opinions or interests). --2 Dissent, objection. --3 Perplexity, confusion. --4 Mutual relation. --5 Conversancy.
26136: विप्रतिपन्न p. p. 1 Mutually opposed, opposite, dissentient. --2 Confused, bewildered, perplexed. --3 Contested, disputed. --4 Mutually connected or related.
26137: विप्रतिषेधः 1 Keeping under control, controlling; क्रव्याद्भ्य इव भूतानामदांतेभ्यः सदा भयम् । तेषां विप्रतिषेधार्थं राजा सृष्टः स्वयंभुवा Mb. --2 The opposition of two courses of action which are equally important, the conflict of two even-matched interests; हरिर्विप्रतिषेधं तमाच चक्षे विचक्षणः Śi. 2. 6 (तुल्यबलविरोधो विप्रतिषेधः Malli.). --3 (In gram.) The conflict of two different grammatical operations become possible according to two different rules, conflict of two equally important rules; विप्रतिषेधे परं कार्यं P. I. 4. 2; विरोधो विप्रतिषेधः । यत्र द्वौ प्रसंगावन्यार्थावेकस्मिन् प्राप्नुतः स विप्रतिषेधः Kāśikā.; See Mbh. also. --4 Prohibition.
26138: विप्रति(ती)सारः 1 Repentance; Śi. 10. 20. --2 Anger, rage, wrath. --3 Wickedness, evil.
26139: विप्रदुष्ट p. p. 1 Vitiated, spoiled, dissolute. --2 Corrupt.
26140: विप्रनष्ट p. p. 1 Lost. --2 Vain, useless.
26142: विप्रमुक्त p. p. 1 Set free, liberated, loosened. --2 Shot, discharged. --3 Free from (in comp.).
26143: विप्रयुज् {c7c} A. To separate, disjoin; to deprive (one) of --Pass. To be separated from (with instr.). --Caus. 1 To deprive of, free from. --2 To separate, disjoin.
26144: विप्रयुक्त p. p. 1 Separated, severed, detached. --2 Separated from, being absent or away from (with instr. or in comp.); अबलाविप्रयुक्तः स कामी Me. 2. --3 Freed or released from. --4 Deprived or destitute of, without (in comp.).
26145: विप्रयोगः 1 Disunion, severance, separation, dissociation; as प्रिय°. --2 Especially, separation of lovers; मा भूदेवं क्षणमपि च ते विद्युता विप्रयोगः Me. 115, 10; सद्यस्त्वया सह कृशोदरि विप्रयोगः V. 5. 16; R. 13. 26, 14. 66. --3 Quarrel, disagreement. --4 Being fit or deserved.
26146: विप्रलप् {c1c} P. 1 To dispute, contradict, wrangle, quarrel. --2 To discuss, debate. --3 To lament, bewail.
26147: विप्रलप्तं 1 Discussion, debate, controversy. --2 Bewailing, lamentation.
26148: विप्रलापः 1 Idle or unmeaning talk, prattle, gibberish, nonsense. --2 Mutual contradiction, contradictory statement. --3 A dispute, wrangling. --4 Violation of one's promise, breaking one's word.
26149: विप्रलभ् {c1c} A. 1 To cheat, deceive, impose upon. --2 To recover, regain. --3 To insult, disrespect. --4 To violate, disregard.
26150: विप्रलब्ध p. p. 1 Deceived, cheated. --2 Disappointed. --3 Hurt, injured. --ब्धा A woman disappointed by her lover's breaking his appointment; (one of the several classes of a Nāyikā in poetic composition); she is thus defined in S. D. : --प्रियः कृत्वापि संकेतं यस्या नायाति संनिधिम् । विप्रलब्धेति सा ज्ञेया नितांतमवमानिता ॥ 118.
26151: विप्रलंभः 1 (a) Deceiving, deceit, tricking; Ki. 11. 27. (b) Delusion; अतिक्लामिता खलु प्रियसखी अनेनानुकूलविप्रलंभेन Māl. 6. --2 Especially, deceiving by false statement or by not keeping promises. --3 Quarrel, disagreement. --4 Disunion, separation, disjunction. --5 The separation of lovers; शुश्रुवे प्रियजनस्य कातरं विप्रलंभपरिशंकिनो वचः R. 19. 18; Ve. 2. 12. --6 (In Rhet.) The feeling or sentiment of love in separation, one of the two main kinds of शृंगार (opp. संभोग); अपरः (विप्रलंभः) अभिलाषविरहेर्ष्याप्रवासशापहेतुक इति पंचविधः K. P. 4; यूनोरयुक्तयोर्भावो युक्तयोर्वाथवा मिथः । अभीष्टालिंगनादीनामनवाप्तौ प्रहृष्यते । विप्रलंभः स विज्ञेयः -उज्ज्वलमणिः; cf. S. D. 212 et seq.
26153: विप्रलयः Complete destruction or dissolution, annihilation; विद्याकल्पेन मरुता मेघानां भूयसामपि । ब्रह्मणीव विवर्तानां क्वापि विप्रलयः कृतः U. 6. 6.
26154: विप्रलुप्त p. p. 1 Carried away, snatched away. --2 Disturbed, interrupted.
26155: विप्रवस् {c1c} P. To sojourn, be absent from (one's home); R. 12. 11. --Caus. 1 To banish, expel. --2 To remove, take away.
26156: विप्रवासः Staying abroad, dwelling in a foreign country (away from one's home).
26158: विप्रोषित p. p. 1 Staying abroad, away from, absent. --2 Banished, being in exile. --Comp. --भर्तृका a woman whose husband is absent from home.
26160: विप्रहीण a. Deprived or destitute of.
26161: विप्रिय a. Disagreeable, disliked, unpleasant, distasteful. --यं; Offence, wrong, a disagreeable act; मनसापि न विप्रियं मया कृतपूर्वं तव किं जहासि मां R. 8. 52, Ku. 4. 7; Ki. 9. 39; Śi. 15. 11; U. 3. 13.
26162: विप्रुष् f. 1 A drop (of water or any other liquid); संतापं नवजलविप्रुषो गृहीत्वा Śi. 8. 40; स्वेदविप्रुषः 2. 18. --2 A mark, dot, spot.
26163: विप्लु {c1c} A. 1 To float about, swing to and fro, fluctuate. --2 To drift (in the sea), be scattered; यदि न स्यान्नरपतिः सम्यङ् नेता ततः प्रजा । अकर्णधारा जलधौ विप्लवेतेह नैरिव H. 3. 2, Pt. 3. 73. --3 To be confused (as mind). --4 To be ruined or destroyed. --5 To fail. --Caus. 1 To cause to float or swim. --2 To divulge, spread abroad. --3 To teach (to unworthy persons); Ms. 11. 199. --4 To cause to fail, spoil, mar; गुणानामायथातर्थ्यादर्थं विप्लावयंति ये Śi. 2. 56. --5 To confound, bewilder.
26164: विप्लवः 1 Floating or drifting about floating in different directions. --2 Opposition, contrariety. --3 Confusion, perplexity. --4 Tumult, scuffle, affray; M. 1. --5 Devastation, predatory warfare; danger from an enemy. --6 Extortion. --7 Loss, destruction; सत्त्वविप्लवात् R. 8. 41. --8 Adverseness, evil turn; अथवा मम भाग्यविप्लवात् R. 8. 47. --9 The rust on a mirror (dust accumulating on its surface); अपवर्जितविप्लवे शुचौ… मतिरादर्श इवाभिदृश्यते Ki. 2. 26 (where विप्लव also means प्रमाणबाधः ‘absence of reasoning’). --10 Transgression, violation; Ki. 1. 13. --11 An evil, a calamity. --12 Sin, wickedness, sinfulness. --13 Terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures. --14 Divulging, making public.
26165: विप्लावः 1 Deluging, inundating. --2 Causing tumult. --3 A horse's canter or gallop.
26166: विप्लुत p. p. 1 Drifted about. --2 Drowned, submerged, deluged, overflowed. --3 Confounded, disturbed. --4 Ravaged, devastated. --5 Lost, disappeared. --6 Disgraced, dishonoured. --7 Ruined. --8 Obscured, disfigured. --9 Depraved, dissolute, profligate, guilty of lewdness. --10 Contrary, reverse. --11 Turning out false; नैते वाचं विप्लुतां व्याहरंति U. 4. 18.
26169: विफल a. 1 Fruitless, useless vain, ineffectual, unprofitable; मम विफलमेतदनुरूपमपि यौवनं Gīt. 7; जगता वा विफलेन किं फलं R. G.; Śi. 9. 6; Ku. 7. 66; Me. 68. --2 Idle, unmeaning. --ला N. of a plant ( केतकी).
26170: विफलीकृ {c8c} U. To frustrate, defeat, foil, render fruitless.
26171: विफलीभू {c1c} P. To become useless or unprofitable, be foiled.
26172: विबंध् {c9c} P. 1 To bind or fasten (on different sides). --2 To stretch out, extend.
26173: विबद्ध p. p. 1 Fastened, tied. --2 Obstructed, stopped.
26177: विबुध् {c1c} P., {c4c} A. 1 To wake up, awake; निमील्य नेत्रे सहसा व्यबुध्यत Ku. 5. 57. --2 To become conscious. --3 To observe, perceive; find out. --Caus. 1 To awaken, rouse. --2 To restore to consciousness; अथ मोहपरायणा सती विवशा कामपधूर्विबोधिता Ku. 4. 1.
26178: विबुद्ध p. p. 1 Aroused, awakened, wide awake; Ś. 2. --2 Expanded, blossomed, full-blown. --3 Clever, skilful. --4 Unconscious.
26179: विबुधः 1 A wise or learned man, sage; सख्यं साप्तपदीनं भो इत्याहुर्विबुधा जनाः Pt. 2. 43. --2 A god, deity; अभून्नृपो विबुधसखः परंतपः Bk. 1. 1; गोप्तारं न निधीनां महयंति महेश्वरं विबुधाः Subhāṣ. --3 The moon. --Comp. --अधिपतिः, --इंद्रः, --ईश्वरः epithets of Indra. --द्विष्, --शत्रुः a demon; V. 1. 3.
26180: विबुधानः 1 A learned man. --2 A teacher.
26181: विबोधः 1 Awakening, being awake. --2 Perceiving, discovering. --3 Intelligence. --4 Awaking, becoming conscious, one of the 33 or 34 subordinate feelings (or व्यभिचारिभाव) in Rhetoric; निद्रानाशोत्तरं जायमानो बोधो विबोधः R. G. --5 Inattention, absence of mind.
26183: विब्रू {c2c} U. 1 To say, speak. --2 To speak of or about. --3 To speak falsely or wrongly. --4 To explain, expound, interpret. --5 To quarrel, dispute, contend about. --6 To disagree with, contradict.
26184: विभज् {c1c} U. 1 To divide, distribute; विभज्य मेरुर्न यदर्थिसात्कृतः N. 1. 16; पत्रिणां व्यभजदाश्रमाद्बहिः R. 11. 29; 10. 54; वपुर्विभक्तावयवं पुमानिति Śi. 1. 3; संध्यामंगलदीपिका विभजते शुद्धांतवृद्धो जनः V. 3. 2. ‘distributes or places’. --2 To divide (as property, patrimony &c.); विभक्ता भ्रातरः ‘divided brothers’. --3 To distinguish, discriminate. --4 To honour, worship.
26185: विभक्त p. p. 1 Divided, partitioned (as property &c.). --2 Divided, separated in interest, as in विभक्ता भ्रातरः --3 Parted, separated, made distinct; Śi. 1. 3. --4 Different, multifarious. --5 Retired, secluded. --6 Regular, symmetrical. --7 Ornamented. --8 Measured. --क्तः N. of Kārtikeya. --क्तं 1 Solitude, retirement. --2 A share. --3 Property (divided). --4 Separation. --Comp. --जः a son born after partition of the family-property (between his parents and brothers).
26186: विभक्तिः f. 1 Separation, division, partition, apportionment. --2 Division, separation in interest. --3 A portion or share of inheritance. --4 (In gram.) Inflection of nouns, a case or case-termination.
26187: विभंज् {c7c} P. To break asunder, break to pieces, shatter.
26188: विभंगः 1 Breaking, fracture. --2 Stopping, obstruction, stoppage; Bg. 2. 26. --3 Bending, contraction (as of the eyebrows); भ्रूविभंगकुटिलं च वीक्षितं R. 19. 17. --4 A fold, wrinkle. --5 A step, stair; R. 6. 3. --6 Breaking out, manifestation; विविधविकारविभंगं Gīt. 11. --7 Division.
26189: विभवः 1 Wealth, riches, property; अतनुषु विभवेषु ज्ञातयः संतु नाम Ś. 5. 8; R. 8. 69. --2 Might, power, prowess, greatness; एतावान्मम मतिविभवः V. 2; वाग्विभवः Māl. 1. 26, R. 1. 9; Ki. 5. 21. --3 Exalted position, rank, dignity. --4 Magnanimity. --5 Final beatitude, absolution.
26190: विभा {c2c} P. 1 To shine; पयसा कमलेन विभाति सरः; Bh. 2. 71. --2 To seem, appear. --3 To become visible, come to light.
26191: विभा 1 Light, lustre. --2 A ray of light. --3 Beauty; splendour. --Comp. --करः {1} the sun; बत बत लसत्तेजःपुंजो विभाति विभाकरः K. P. 10. {2} the arka plant. {3} the moon. {4} fire. --वसुः {1} the sun. {2} fire; रचयिष्यामि तनुं विभावसौ Ku. 4. 34; R. 3. 37, 10. 82; Bg. 7. 9. {3} the moon. {4} a kind of necklace.
26193: विभागः 1 Division, partition, apportionment (as of inheritance); समस्तत्र विभागः स्यात् Ms. 9. 120, 210; Y. 2. 114. --2 The share of an inheritance. --3 A part or share in general --4 Division, separation, disjunction (regarded in Nyāya phil. as a Guṇa); Ku. 2. 4; Bg. 3. 28. --5 The numerator of a fraction. --6 A section. --7 Arrangement. --Comp. --कल्पना allotment of shares; Y. 2. 149. --धर्मः the law of inheritance. --पत्रिका a deed of partition. --भाज् m. one who shares in a property already distributed; Y. 1. 122.
26195: विभागशः ind. Part by part, share by share, proportionately.
26197: विभाज्य a. 1 Portionable, to be divided. --2 Divisible.
26198: विभावरी 1 Night; अपर्वाणि ग्रहकलुषेंदुमंडला विभावरी कथय कथं भविष्यति M. 4. 15, 5. 7; Ku. 5. 44. --2 Turmeric. --3 A bawd. --4 A harlot. --5 A perverse woman. --6 A talkative woman (मुखरस्त्री).
26199: विभाष् {c1c} A. 1 To lay down as an optional rule. --2 To abuse, revile, defame, censure.
26200: विभाषा 1 An option, alternative. --2 Optionality of a rule.
26202: विभिद् {c7c} U. 1 To break, tear down. --2 To pierce, penetrate. --3 To divide, separate. --4 To interrupt. --5 To scatter, unbind, disperse. --6 To loosen, untie. --7 To alienate, estrange. --Pass. To change, become changed. --Caus. 1 To divide, separate. --2 To alienate, estrange. --3 To dispel, remove, drive away or off.
26203: विभिन्न p. p. 1 Broken asunder, divided, split. --2 Pierced, wounded. --3 Dispelled, driven away, dispersed. --4 Perplexed, bewildered. --5 Moved to and fro. --6 Disappointed. --7 Different, various. --8 Mixed, blended, variegated; विभिन्नवर्णा गरुडाग्रजेन सूर्यस्य रथ्याः परितः स्फुरंत्या Śi. 4. 14. --9 Manifested, displayed. --10 Become faithless. --न्नः N. of Śiva.
26204: विभेदः 1 Breaking asunder, dividing. --2 Division, separation. --3 Wounding. --4 Perplexing, bewildering. --5 Contradiction. --6 Enmity, opposition. --7 Variety, distinction.
26205: विभीतः, -तं, विभीतकः -कं, विभीतकी, विभीता N. of a tree, Terminalia Belerica, one of the three myrobalans.
26207: विभीषिका 1 Terror. --2 A means of terrifying, a scare (a scare-crow); यदि ते संति संत्वेव केयमन्या विभीषिका U. 4. 29.
26208: विभु a. (भू-भ्वी f.) 1 Mighty, powerful. --2 Eminent, supreme. --3 Able to, capable of (with inf.); (धनुः) पूरयितुं भवंति विभवः शिखरमणिउचः Ki. 5. 43. --4 Self-subdued, firm, self-controlled; कमपरमवशं न विप्रकुर्यर्विभुमपि तं यदमी स्पृशति भावाः Ku. 6. 95. --5 (In Nyāya phil.) Eternal, existing everywhere, allpervading, pervading all material things; सर्वमूर्तद्रव्यसंयोगित्वं विभुत्वम्. --6 Firm, hard. --भुः 1 Ether. --2 Space. --3 Time. --4 The soul. --5 A lord, ruler, master, sovereign, king. --6 The supreme ruler; Bg. 5. 15; 10. 12. --7 A servant. --8 N. of Brahman. --9 Of Śiva; Ku. 6. 95; 7. 31; Mu. 1. 1. --10 Of Viṣṇu.
26209: विभू {c1c} P. 1 To appear, become manifest. --2 To be equal to, suffice for. --3 To pervade. --4 To be able, be capable of, prevail. --Caus. 1 To think of, reflect, contemplate. --2 To be aware of, know, perceive, discover, see; Māl. 1. 18; 5. 21; Pt. 5. 7; U. 2. 24. --3 To see or observe minutely, perceive carefully; V. 4. --4 To decide, settle, make clear. --5 To manifest, show, reveal. --6 To separate. --7 To suppose, imagine. --8 To convince. --9 To establish, prove; Ś. 6. 10.
26210: विभावः 1 (In Rhet.) Any condition which produces or develops a particular state of body or mind; (one of the three main divisions of Bhāvas, the other two being अनुभाव and ब्याभिचारिभाव q. v.); रत्याद्युद्वोधका लोके विभावाः काव्यनाट्ययोः S. D. 62; its chief subdivisions are आलंबन and उद्दीपक; see आलंबन. --2 A friend, an acquaintance. --3 Any exciting circumtance, (as dress &c.).
26212: विभावनं --ना 1 Clear perception or ascertainment, discrimination, judgment. --2 Discussion, investigation, examination. --3 Conception, imagination. --ना (In Rhet.) A figure of speech in which effects are represented as taking place though their usual causes are absent; क्रियायाः प्रतिषेधेपि फलव्यक्तिर्विभावना K. P. 10.
26213: विभावित p. p. 1 Manifested, made clearly visible. --2 Known, understood, ascertained. --3 Seen, conceived. --4 Judged, discriminated. --5 Inferred, indicated. --6 Proved, established. --Comp. --एकदेश a. ‘with whom a part has been discovered’, who has been found guilty with regard to a part (of what is in dispute); विभावितैकदशेने देयं यदभियुज्यते V. 4. 17.
26214: विभूत p. p. 1 Arisen, produced. --2 Appeared, manifested. --3 Great, mighty.
26215: विभूतिः f. 1 Mighty, power, greatness; Śi. 14. 5; Ku. 2. 61. --2 Prosperity, welfare. --3 Dignity, exalted rank. --4 Riches, plenty, magnificence, splendour; अहो राजाधिराजमंत्रिणो विभूतिः Mu. 3; R. 8. 36. --5 Wealth, riches; R. 4. 19, 6. 76, 17. 43. --6 Superhuman power (which consists of eight faculties, अणिमन्, लघिमन्, प्राप्ति, प्राकाम्य, महिमन्, रिशिता, वशिता and कामावसायिता); Ku. 2. 11. --7 Ashes of cow-dung.
26216: विभूष् {c10c} U. 1 To adorn, decorate; केयूरा न विभूषयंति पुरुषं Bh. 2. 19; Śi. 9. 33; Ku. 1. 28. --2 Ved. To shine forth, appear.
26217: विभूषणं Ornament, decoration; विशेषतः सर्वविदां समाजे विभूषणं मौनमपंडितानां Bh. 2. 7; R. 16. 80.
26218: विभूषा 1 Ornament, decoration; संपेदे श्रमसालिलोद्गमो विभूषा Ki. 7. 5, R. 4. 54. --2 Light, lustre. --3 Beauty, splendour.
26219: विभूषित p. p. Adorned, decorated, ornamented.
26220: विभृत p. p. Upheld, supported, maintained.
26221: विभ्रंश् {c1c} A., {c4c} P. 1 To drop or fall down. --2 To go to ruin, decay. --3 To fall stray from, go astray. --4 To lose. --5 To disappear, vanish. --6 To fail. --Caus. 1 To strike off, knock down. --2 To lead astray, seduce. --3 To destroy, ruin, annihilate. --4 To deprive (one) of.
26222: विभ्रंशः 1 Falling away or off. --2 Decay, decline, ruin. --3 A precipice.
26223: विभ्रंशित p. p. 1 Led astray, seduced. --2 Deprived of. --3 Destroyed; ruined.
26224: विभ्रष्ट p. p. 1 Fallen off or away, separated. --2 Decayed, lost, fallen. ruined. --3 Disappeared. vanished. --4 Deprived or devoid of.
26225: विभ्रम् {c1c} {c4c} P. 1 To roam, wander about. --2 To hover, whirl or wheel round. --3 To scare away, disperse, scatter about. --4 To be confused or disordered, be bewildered or perplexed; Bg. 16. 16. --Caus. To confuse, confound; प्रभामत्तश्चंद्रो जगादिदमहो विभ्रमयति K. P. 10.
26226: विभ्रमः 1 Roaming or wandering about. --2 Whirling or going round, rolling about. --3 Error, mistake, blunder. --4 Hurry, confusion, flurry, perturbation; especially, the flurry of mind caused by love; चित्तवृत्त्यनवस्थानं शृंगाराद्बिभ्रमो भवेत्. --5 (Hence) Putting on of ornaments &c. in wrong places through flurry; विभ्रमस्त्वरयाऽकाले भूषास्थानाविपर्ययः; यश्चाप्सरोविभ्रममंडनानां संपादयित्रीं शिखरैर्बिभर्त्ति Ku. 1. 4. (see Malli. thereon). --6 Any amorous or sportive action, amorous play or movement; Māl. 1. 26, 9. 38. --7 Beauty, grace, charm; N. 15. 25, U. 1. 20, 34, 6. 4; Śi. 6. 46, 7. 15, 16. 64, Māl. 7. --8 Doubt, apprehension. --9 Caprice, whim.
26228: विभ्रांत p. p. 1 Whirled about. --2 Agitated, bewildered, confused, flurried. --3 Mistaken, erring. --Comp. --नयन a. with rolling eyes. --शील a. {1} confused in mind. {2} intoxicated, drunk. (--लः) {1} a monkey. {2} the disc of the sun or moon.
26229: विभ्रांतिः f. 1 Whirling, going round. --2 Flurry, error, confusion. --3 Hurry, precipitation.
26230: विभ्राज् {c1c} A. To shine brilliantly or intensely; विभ्राजसे मकरकेतनमर्चयंती Ratn. 1. 21.
26231: विभ्राज् a. Shining, splendid, bright, luminous.
26232: विमत्सर a. Free from jealousy, unenvious; Bg. 4. 22.
26233: विम(मं)थ् {c9c} P. 1 To disperse, scatter. --2 To destroy, annihilate. --3 To confound, confuse.
26235: विमद् {c4c} P. 1 To become perplexed or confused. --2 To be intoxicated or mad. --Caus. 1 To confound, perplex. --2 To intoxicate, madden.
26236: विमत्त p. p. 1 Intoxicated. --2 Ruttish; furious, in rut.
26237: विमद a. 1 Free from intoxication; Pt. 1. 238. --2 Devoid of joy, sad, cheerless.
26238: विमन् Caus. To disrespect, dishonour, insult; त्वया नाम मुनिर्विमान्यः Ś. 5. 20; स्त्रीभिर्विमानितानां कापुरुषाणां विवधते मदनः Mk. 8. 9.
26239: विमत p. p. 1 Disagreeing, dissenting, differing in opinion. --2 At variance, inconsistent. --3 Slighted, despised, neglected. --4 Dubious, doubtful. --तः An enemy.
26240: विमति a. Stupid, devoid of intelligence, foolish. --तिः f. 1 Dissent, disagreement, difference of opinion. --2 Dislike. --3 Stupidity.
26241: विमानः --नं 1 Disrespect, dishonour. --2 A measure. --3 A balloon, a heavenly car (moving through the skies); पदं विमानेन विगाहमानः R. 13. 1, 7. 51; विमानीकृतराजहंसमंडलः K.; R. 12. 104; Ku. 2. 45, 7. 40; V. 4. 43; Ki. 7. 11. --4 A vehicle or conveyance in general; R. 16. 68. --5 A palace (with seven stories); नेत्रा नीताः सततगतिना यद्विमानाग्रभूमीः Me. 69. --6 A horse. --Comp. --चारिन्, --यान a. moving in a balloon. --राजः {1} an excellent heavenly car; U. 3. {2} the driver of a heavenly car.
26242: विमानना Disrespect, dishonour, contempt, humiliation; विमानना सुभ्रु कुतः पितुर्गृहे Ku. 5. 43; अभवन्नास्य विमानना क्वचित् R. 8. 8.
26244: विमनस्, --विमनस्क a. 1 Sad, disconsolate, depressed in mind or spirits, sorry, discomposed; U. 1. 7. --2 Absent-minded. --3 Perplexed, bewildered. --4 Displeased. --5 Changed in mind or feeling.
26245: विमनीकृत a. 1 Displeased. --2 Changed in mind or feeling. --3 Sad, discomposed.
26246: विमन्यु a. 1 Free from anger. --2 Free from grief.
26248: विमर्षः 1 Thought, deliberation. --2 Impatience, non-forbearance. --3 Dissatisfaction, displeasure. --4 (In dramas) A change in the successful progress of a dramatic plot, a change in the prosperous course of a love-story caused by some unforeseen reverse or accident, one of the five Saṃdhis in a drama; it is thus defined in S. D.; यत्र मुख्यफलोपाय उद्भिन्नो गर्भतोऽधिकः । शापाद्यैः सांतरायश्च स विमर्ष इति स्मृतः 336; see Mu. 4. 3; (often written विमर्श in all these senses).
26249: विमल a. 1 Pure, stainless, spotless, clean (fig. also). --2 Clear, limpid, pellucid, transparent (as water); विमलं जलं. --3 White, bright. --लः An Arhat. --लं 1 Silver-gilt. --2 Talc. --Comp. --अद्रिः the mountain Girnār in Gujerāt (famous for its inscriptions). --दानं an offering to a deity. --मणिः a crystal.
26251: विमातृ f. A step-mother. --Comp. --जः a step-mother's son.
26252: विमार्गः 1 A bad road. --2 A wrong road, evil conduct or course, immorality. --3 A broom. --Comp. --गा an unchaste woman; विमार्गगायाश्च रुचिः स्वकाते Bv. 1. 125. --गामिन्, --प्रस्थित a. following evil courses; नियमयसिविमार्गप्रस्थितानात्तदंडः Ś. 5. 8.
26253: विमार्गणं Searching, looking out for, seeking for.
26254: विमिश्र, विमिश्रित a. Mixed, blended, mingled (with instr. or in comp.); पुंभिर्विमिश्रा नार्यश्च Mb.; दंपत्योरिह को न को न तमसि व्रीडाविमिश्रो रसः Gīt. 5.
26255: विमुख a. (खी f.) 1 With the face averted or turned away from. --2 Averse, disinclined, opposed; न क्षुद्रेपि प्रथमसुकृतापेक्षया संश्रयाय प्राप्ते मित्रे भवति विमुखः किं पुनर्यस्तथोच्चैः Me. 17; 27; Mu. 2. 7; (रघूणां) मनः परस्त्रीविमुखप्रवृति R. 16. 8, 19. 47. --3 Adverse; H. 1. 130. --4 Without, devoid of (in comp.); करुणाविमुखेन मृत्युना हरता त्वां वद किं न मे हृतं R. 8. 67.
26256: विमुच् {c6c} P. 1 To free, liberate. --2 To loosen, unbind, unfasten, untie आसीद्विवृत्तवदना च विमोचयंती ( वल्कलं) Ś. 2. 12. --3 To give up, lay aside, abandon, quit; विमुच्य वासांसि गुरूनि सांप्रतं Rs. 1. 7. --4 To let go, let loose; Bk. 7. 50. --5 To except, set aside, set apart; Ku. 4. 31. --6 To shed, pour down (te ars); चिरमश्रूणि विमुच्य राघवः R. 8. 25. --7 To throw, cast. --8 To take off (clothes), undress oneself. --9 To stop, cease. --10 To take, assume. --Pass. To be deprived of, be freed from.
26257: विमुक्त p. p. 1 Set free, released, liberated. --2 Abandoned, given up, quitted, left. --3 Freed from. --4 Hurled, discharged. --5 Given vent to. --Comp. --कंठ a. raising a loud cry, weeping bitterly.
26258: विमुक्तिः f. 1 Release, liberation. --2 Separation. --3 Absolution, final liberation.
26259: विमुद्र a. 1 Unsealed. --2 Opened, budded, blown (as a flower &c).
26260: विमुह् {c4c} P. 1 To be confused, bewildered, or perplexed, be embarrassed; Bg. 2. 72; 3. 6, 27. --2 To be foolish or infatuated. --Caus. 1 To infatuate, bewilder. --2 To allure, tempt, seduce.
26262: विमूढ p. p. 1 Confounded, bewildered. --2 Seduced, tempted, beguiled. --3 Stupid. --4 Wise, learned. --ढः A kind of divine being.
26263: विमृद् {c9c} P. 1 To press, squeeze. --2 To bruise, crush, pound. --3 To kill, destroy. --4 To lay waste, devastate.
26264: विमर्दः 1 Pounding, crushing, bruising. --2 Rubbing together, trituration (as of perfumes), friction; विमर्दसुरभिर्बकुलावलिका खल्वहं M. 3; R. 5. 65; कस्तूरिका मृगविमर्दसुगंधिरेति Śi. 4. 61, 11. 28. --3 Pressing together (as in embrace). --4 Spoiling, marring; कुतूहलविमर्दकारिणा परिश्रमेण Mk. 1. --5 Touch; contact. --6 Rubbing the person with saffron or other unguents. --7 War, battle, fight, encounter; विमर्दक्षमां भूमिमवतरावः U. 5, 3. 44. --8 Destruction, devastation; R. 6. 62. --9 Conjunction of the sun and moon. --10 An eclipse. --11 Weariness, tediousness.
26265: विमर्दकः 1 Grinding, pounding bruising. --2 The trituration of perfumes. --3 An eclipse. --4 The conjunction of the sun and moon. --5 Destroying.
26266: विमर्दनं, --ना 1 Pounding, crushing, trampling. --2 Rubbing together, friction. --3 Destruction, killing. --4 An eclipse.
26267: विमर्दित, --विमृदित p. p. 1 Pounded, crushed, ground. --2 Rubbed. --3 Anointed, smeared.
26268: विमृश् {c6c} P. 1 To touch, feel. --2 To stroke, rub. --3 To think, consider, reflect, ponder (over); वृणते हि विमृश्यकारिणं गुणलुब्धाः स्वयमेव संपदः Ki. 2. 30; रामप्रवासे व्यमृशन्न दोषं जनापवादं स नरद्रेंमृत्युं Bk. 3. 7; 12. 24; Ku. 6. 87; Bg. 18. 63; Śi. 10. 56. --4 To perceive, observe. --5 To examine, test; तदत्रभवानिमं मां च शास्त्रे प्रयोगे च विमृशतु M. 1. --6 To hesitate, doubt.
26269: विमर्शः --र्शनं 1 Deliberation, consideration, examination, discussion. --2 Reasoning. --3 A conflicting judgment. --4 Hesitation, doubt. --5 The impression left on the mind by past good or bad actions; see वासना.
26270: विमृष्ट p. p. Considered, reflected upon, pondered over.
26271: विमोक्षः 1 Release, liberation, freeing. --2 Discharging, shooting. --3 Final emancipation or beatitude.
26272: विमोक्षणं --णा 1 Liberating, releasing, setting free. --2 Discharging. --3 Quitting, leaving, abandoning. --4 Laying (as eggs).
26273: विमोचनं 1 Unloosing, unyoking. --2 Release, freedom. --3 Liberation, emancipation.
26274: विमोहन a. (ना or नी f.) Alluring, tempting, fascinating. --नः --नं N. of a division of Hell. --नं 1 Seducing, tempting, fascinating. --2 Infatuation.
26275: विम्लापनं 1 Refreshing, reviving. --2 Cleaning, wiping. --3 Causing to wither or fade away, wasting away.
26279: विंबा --बी f. N. of a creeper.
26282: वियत् n. The sky, atmosphere, ether; पश्योदग्रवतत्वाद्बियति बहुतरं स्तोकमुर्व्यां प्रयाति Ś. 1. 7; R. 13. 40. --Comp. --गंगा {1} the heavenly Ganges. {2} the galaxy. --चारिन् ( वियच्चारिन्) m. a kite. --भूतिः f. darkness. --मणिः (वियन्मणिः) the sun.
26284: वियम् {c1c} P. 1 To spread out, extend. --2 To curb, restrain. --3 To give, grant, bestow.
26285: वियमः 1 Restraint, check, control. --2 Distress, pain, affliction. --3 Cessation, stop.
26286: वियात a. 1 Bold(धृष्ट). --2 Audacious, shameless, impudent. --3 Abandoned, wretched.
26288: वियु {c3c} P. 1 To be separated or dissolved (intran.). --2 To lose or be deprived of. --3 To exclude, deprive of. --4 To keep or ward off, prevent.
26289: वियुत p. p. 1 Deprived of, separated from; V. 4. 18. --2 Without, devoid of.
26290: वियुज् {c7c} A. 1 To leave, abandon; part with, forsake; मदमानसमुद्धतं नृपं न वियुंक्ते नियमेन मूढता Ki. 2. 49; R. 13. 63. --2 To separate; पुरो वियुक्ते मिथुने कृपावती Ku. 5. 26. --3 To relax, slacken. --4 To disjoin, divide, sever. --5 To free or deliver from, deprive of (with instr.); प्राणैर्न वियोजयति Pt. 1; असुभिर्न वियुज्यते K. 38. --Caus. 1 To separate. --2 To free from, deprive of; अजानता मया सैव पत्रैः शाखा वियोजिता Mk. 4. 18.
26291: वियुक्त p. p. 1 Detached, severed, separated. --2 Separated from, deserted by. --3 Free from, deprived of (with instr. or in comp.). --4 Failing, deficient.
26292: वियोगः 1 Separation, disunion; अयमेकपदे तया वियोगः सहसा चोपनतः सुदुःसहो मे V. 4. 3; त्वयोपस्थितवियोगस्य तपोवनस्यापि समवस्था दृश्यते Ś. 4; संधत्ते भृशमरतिं हि सद्वियोगः Ki. 5. 51; R. 12. 10; Me. 88; Śi. 12. 63. --2 Absence, loss. --3 Subtraction.
26293: वियोगिन् a. 1 Separated. --2 Absent, apart. --m. The ruddy goose.
26294: वियोगिनी 1 A woman separated from her lover or husband; गुरुनिःश्वसितैः कपिर्मनीषी निरणैषीदथ तां वियोगिनीति Bv. 4. 35. --2 N. of a metre; (see App. I).
26295: वियोजित p. p. 1 Separated. --2 Separated from, deprived of.
26296: वियोनिः --नी f. 1 Manifold birth. --2 The womb of animals (Kull. on Ms. 12. 77). --3 A debased or ignominious birth.
26297: विरच् {c10c} U. 1 To arrange; Ki. 7. 94. --2 To compose, put together, write; R. 5. 75, Me. 86, 103. --3 To effect, produce, cause, make; Bv. 1. 30. --4 To put on. --5 To set, inlay.
26298: विरचनं --ना 1 Arrangement, disposition; Śi. 5. 21. --2 Contriving, constructing. --3 Formation, creation. --4 Composition, compilation.
26299: विरचित p. p. 1 Arranged, made, formed, prepared. --2 Contrived, constructed. --3 Written, composed. --4 Trimmed, dressed, embellished, ornamented. --5 Put on, worn. --6 Set, inlaid.
26300: विरज a. Free from dust or passion. --जः An epithet of Viṣṇu. --जा 1 Dūrvā grass. --2 N. of the wife of Nahuṣa.
26301: विरजस्, विरजस्क a. 1 Free from dust. --2 Free from passion; Śi. 20. 80. --3 Free from menstrual excretion.
26302: विरजस्का A woman in whom the menstrual secretion has ceased
26303: विरजीकृ {c8c} U. To render free from dust.
26304: विरजीभू {c1c} P. To become free from. dust, be pure.
26306: विरंज् {c1c} {c4c} U. 1 To grow discoloured or soiled, be coarse or rough; केशा अपि विरज्यंते निःस्नेहाः किं न सेवकाः Pt. 1. 82 (where it has sense 2 also). --2 To be discontented or disaffected, to dislike, hate; चिरानुरक्तोऽपि विरज्यते जनः Mk. 1. 53; यां चिंतयामि सततं मयि सा विरक्ता Bh. 2. 2; Bk. 18. 22. --3 To become disgusted with the world and hence to renounce all worldly attachments. --Caus. To colour, dye.
26307: विरक्त p. p. 1 Very red, ruddy, R. 13. 64. --2 Discoloured. --3 Changed in mind, disaffected, displeased; Bh. 2. 2. --4 Free from passion or worldly attachment, indifferent. --5 Impassioned. --क्ता An unfortunate or unhappy woman.
26308: विरक्तिः f. 1 Change of disposition, dissatisfaction, discontent, disaffection. --2 Estrangement. --3 Indifference, absence of desire, freedom from passion or worldly attachment.
26309: विरटः A kind of black agallochum.
26310: विरणं A kind of fragrant grass; cf. वीरण.
26311: विरम् {c1c} P. 1 To end, terminate, come to an end; अविदितगतयामा रात्रिरेव व्यरंसीत् U. 1. 27; 6. 33. --2 To cease, desist, stop, leave off (speaking &c.); एतावदुक्त्वा विरते मृगेंद्रे R. 2. 51; Śi. 2. 13; oft. with abl.; हा हंत किमिति चित्तं विरमति नाद्यपि विषयेभ्यः Bv. 4. 25; न स्थिरकर्मा विरराम कर्मणः R. 8. 22; वत्सैतस्माद्विरम विरमातः परं न क्षमोस्मि U. 1. 33; Bh. 2. 80.
26312: विरत p. p. 1 Ceased or desisting from (with abl.). --2 Rested, stopped, ceased. --3 Ended, concluded, at an end; विरतं गेयमृतुर्निरुत्सवः R. 8. 66.
26313: विरतिः f. 1 Cessation, stop, discontinuance. --2 Rest, end, pause. --3 Indifference to worldly attachments; विरतिवनितासंगमुदितः Bh. 3. 79.
26315: विरामः 1 (a) Cessation, discontinuance; सुधां विना न प्रययुर्विरामं Bh. 2. 80; प्रवृत्तस्याविरामे भवंती शासितव्या Mbh. (b) Rest, repose. --2 End, termination, conclusion; रजनिरिदानीमियमपि याति विरामं Gīt. 5; U. 3. 16, Māl. 9. 34. --3 Pause, stop. --4 The stop or pause of the voice; Mk. 3. 5. --5 A small oblique stroke placed under a consonant, usually at the end of a sentence. --6 N. of Viṣṇu.
26316: विरल a. 1 Having interstices, separated by intervals, thin, not thick or compact; विपर्यासं यातो घनविरलभावः क्षितिरुहां U. 2. 27; 1. 20; भवति विरलभक्तिर्म्लानपुष्पापहारः R. 5. 74. --2 Fine, delicate. --3 Loose, wide apart. --4 Rare, scarcely found, unfrequent; विरला हि तेषामुपदेष्टारः K.; Pt. 1. 29. --5 Few, little (referring to number or quantity); तत्त्वं किमपि काव्यानां जानाति विरलो भुवि Bv. 1. 117; विरलातपच्छविः Śi. 9. 3. --6 Remote, distant, long (as time, distance &c.). --लं Curds, coagulated milk. --लं ind. Scarcely, rarely, not frequently. --Comp. --जानुक a. bandy-legged, bowkneed. --द्रवा a kind of gruel.
26317: विरस a. 1 Tasteless, insipid, flavourless. --2 Unpleasant, disagreeable, painful; तावत्कोकिल विरसान् यापय दिवसान् वनांतरे निवसन् Bv. 1. 7; Māl. 1. 31; 6. 10. --3 Cruel, unfeeling. --सः Pain.
26318: विरहः 1 Parting with, separation. --2 Especially, the separation of lovers; सा विरहे तव दीना Gīt. 4; क्षणमपि विरहः पुरा न सेहे ibid.; Me. 8, 12, 29, 85, 87. --3 Absence. --4 Want. --5 Desertion, abandonment, relinquishment. --6 The feeling of love in separation; see विप्रलंभ (6). --7 Loneliness. --Comp. --अनलः the fire of separation. --अवस्था the state of separation. --आर्त, --उत्कंठ, --उत्सुक a. suffering from separation, pining away in separation. --उत्कंठिता a woman distressed by the absence of her lover or husband, one of the several classes of a Nāyikā in poetic compositions; see S. D. 121. --ज्वरः the fever or anguish of separation.
26319: विरहिणी 1 A woman separated from her lover or husband. --2 Wages, hire.
26320: विरहित p. p. 1 Deserted, abandoned, forsaken. --2 Separated from. --3 Lonely, solitary. --4 Bereft of, devoid or destitute of, free from (mostly in comp.).
26321: विरहिन् a. (णी f.) 1 Absent from, being separated from a mistress or lover; नृत्यति युवतिजनेन समं सखि विरहिजनस्य दुरंते Gīt. 1. --2 Lonely, solitary.
26322: विरागः 1 Change of colour. --2 Change of disposition, disaffection, discontent, dissatisfaction; विरागकारणेषु परिहृतेषु Mu. 1. --3 Aversion, disinclination. --4 Indifference to worldly attachments, freedom from passion.
26323: विराज् {c1c} U. 1 To shine, glitter; Bv. 1. 88. --2 To appear or look like; R. 2. 20. --3 To be eminent or illustrious. --Caus. To brighten, illuminate, irradiate.
26324: विराज् m. 1 Beauty, splendour. --2 A man of the Kṣatriya or warrior tribe. --3 The first progeny of Brahman; cf. Ms. 1. 32; तस्मात् विराडजायत Rv. 10. 90. 5 (where विराज् is represented as born from Puruṣa). --4 The body. --5 (In Vedānta phil.) N. of ‘intellect’ considered as ruling over the aggregate of bodies. --f. N. of a Vedic metre.
26326: विराजित p. p. 1 Irradiated, illuminated. --2 Displayed, manifested.
26327: विराटः 1 N. of a district in India. --2 N. of a king of the Matsyas. The Pāṇḍavas lived incognito in the service of this king for one year, (the thirteenth of their exile) having assumed different disguises. His daughter Uttarā was married to Abhimanyu and was mother of Parīkṣit who succeeded Yudhisṭhira to the throne of Hastināpura. --Comp. --जः a sort of inferior diamond. --पर्वन् n. the fourth book of the Mahābhārata.
26328: विराटकः A sort of inferior diamond.
26330: विराध् {c4c} P. 1 To hurt, injure, offend, wrong; क्रियासमभिहारेण विराध्यंतं क्षमेत कः Śi. 2. 43; विराद्ध एवं भवता विरा द्धा बहुधा च नः 2. 41. --2 To lose, be deprived of.
26331: विराद्ध p. p. 1 Opposed, counteracted. --2 Offended, injured, treated with contempt; see the quotations under राध् with वि above.
26332: विराधः 1 Opposition. --2 Annoyance, vexation, molestation. --3 N. of a powerful Rākṣasa slain by Rāma.
26333: विराधनं 1 Opposing. --2 Hurting, injuring, offending. --3 Pain, anguish.
26335: विरिंचः, विरिंचनः 1 N. of Brahman. --2 Of Śiva. --3 Of Viṣṇu.
26336: विरिंचिः 1 N. of Brahman; Vikr. 1. 46; N. 3. 44; Śi. 9. 9. --2 Of Viṣṇu. --3 Of Śiva.
26338: विरु {c2c} P. 1 To cry, bewail, lament; ननु सहवरीं दूरे मत्वा विरौषि समुत्सुकः V. 4. 20; Bk. 5. 54; Rs. 6. 27. --2 To make a sound, sound in general; न स विरौति न चापि स शोभते Pt. 1. 75; जीर्णत्वाद गृहस्य विरौति कपाटं Mk. 3; एते त एव गिरयो विरुवन्मयूराः U. 2. 23. --3 To cry out, shout, scream.
26339: विरावः Clamour, noise, sound; आलोकशब्दं वयसां विरावैः R. 2. 9, 16. 31.
26340: विराविन् a. 1 Weeping, crying, shouting. --2 Lamenting. --णी 1 Weeping, crying. --2 A broom.
26341: विरुत p. p. 1 Screamed, shouted. --2 Resounding, filled with cries. --त 1 Crying, shrieking, roaring &c. --2 Cry, sound, noise, clamour, din. --3 Singing, humming, chirping, buzzing; परभृतविरुतं कलं यथा प्रतिवचनीकृतमेभिरीदृशं Ś. 4. 9.
26342: विरुग्ण p. p. 1 Broken to pieces, shattered. --2 Destroyed. --3 Bent. --4 Blunted, dulled.
26343: विरुच् {c1c} A. 1 To shine, be resplendent; R. 6. 5; 17. 14; Bk. 8. 66. --2 To be eminent or conspicuous. --3 To become visible, appear. --4 To illuminate, brighten (P.). --5 To please, delight. --Caus. 1 To irradiate, illuminate. --2 To delight in. --3 To sport with.
26345: विरुदः --दं 1 Proclaiming. --2 Crying aloud. --3 A panegyric, laudatory poem; गद्यपद्यमयी राजस्तुतिर्बिरुदमुच्यते S. D. 570; नदंति मददंतिनः परिलसंति वाजिव्रजाः पठंति विरुदावलीमहितमंदिरे वंदिनः ॥ R. G.
26346: विरुदितं Loud cry or lamentation; U. 3. 30 v. l.
26347: विरुध् {c7c} U. To oppose, obstruct, hinder, prevent. --Pass. 1 To be opposed to, be inconsistent or at variance with. --2 To contend or quarrel with; Pt. 4. 116. --3 To fail. --4 To be kept back or withheld.
26348: विरुद्ध p. p. 1 Hindered, checked, opposed, obstructed. --2 Blocked up, confined or shut up. --3 Besieged, blockaded. --4 Opposed to, inconsistent with, incongruous, inconsistent. --5 Contrary, opposite, opposed in quality. --6 Contradictory, proving the reverse, (as a hetu in Logic); साध्याभवव्याप्तो हेतुर्विरुद्धः Tarka K.: e. g. शब्दो नित्यः कृतकत्वात् T. S. --7 Hostile, adverse, inimical. --8 Unfavourable, unpropitious. --9 Prohibited, forbidden (as food). --10 Wrong, unlawful, improper. --11 Excluded. --12 Uncertain, doubtful. --द्धं 1 Opposition, contrariety, hostility. --2 Discord, disagreement. --Comp. --धी a. evil-minded, wicked --मतिकृत् m. a fault or defect in composition; विपरीतार्थधीयर्स्मात् विरुद्धमतिकृन्मतम्.
26349: विरोधः 1 Opposition, obstruction, impediment. --2 Blockade, siege, investment. --3 Restraint, check. --4 Inconsistency, incongruity, contradiction. --5 Antithesis, contrast. --6 Enmity, hostility; विरोधो विश्रांतः U. 6. 11; Pt. 1. 332; R. 10. 13. --7 A quarrel, disagreement. --8 A calamity, misfortune. --9 (In Rhet.) An apparent incongruity which is merely verbal and is explained away by properly construing the passage; it consists in representing objects as antithetical to one another though in the nature of things they are not so: representing things as being together though really they cannot be together; (this figure is largely used by Bāṇa and Subandhu; पुष्पवत्यपि पवित्रा, कृष्णोप्यसुदर्शनः, भरतोपि शत्रुघ्नः being familiar instances); it is thus defined by Mammaṭa: --विरोध सोऽविरोधेऽपि विरुद्धत्वेन यद्वचः K. P. 10; this figure is also called विरोधाभास. --Comp. --उक्तिः f., --वचनं contradiction, opposition. --कारिन् a. fomenting quarrels. --कृत् a. opposing. (--m.) an enemy.
26350: विरोधनं 1 Hindering, opposing, obstructing. --2 Besieging, blockading. --3 Opposition, resistance. --4 Contradiction, inconsistency.
26351: विरोधिन् a. (नी f.) 1 Resisting, opposing, obstructing. --2 Besieging. --3 Contradictory, opposed to, inconsistent with; तपोवन° Ś. 1. --4 Hostile, inimical, adverse; विरोधिसत्त्वोज्झितपूर्वमत्सरं Ku. 5. 17. --5 Quarrelsome. --m. An enemy; Śi. 16. 64.
26352: विरुह् {c1c} P. 1 To grow, shoot up; R. 2. 26; Mk. 1. 19. --2 To mount, ascend. --3 To arise, proceed. --Caus. 1 To heal (as a wound). --2 To plant.
26353: विरूढ p. p. 1 Grown, germinated, shot up; Mk. 1. 9. --2 Produced, born, arisen. --3 Grown, increased. --4 Budded, blossomed. --5 Ascended, mounted.
26354: विरोप(ह)णं 1 Healing (as a sore); व्रणविरोपणं तैलं Ś. 4. 13. --2 Planting.
26356: विरूक्षणं 1 Roughening. --2 Acting as an astringent. --3 Blame, censure. --4 A curse, an imprecation.
26357: विरूप a. (पा or पी f.) 1 Deformed, ugly, misshapen, disfigured; Pt. 1. 143. --2 Unnatural, monstrous. --3 Multiform, diverse. --पं 1 Deformity, ugliness. --2 Variety of form, nature, or character. --Comp. --अक्ष a. having deformed eyes: वपुर्विरूपाक्षं Ku. 5. 72. (--क्षः) N. of Śiva (having an unusual number of eyes); दृशा दग्धं मनसिजं जीवयंति दृशैव याः । विरूपाक्षस्य जयिनीस्ताः स्तुवे वामलोचनाः Vb. 1. 2; Ku. 6. 21. --करणं {1} disfiguring. {2} injuring. --चक्षुस् m. an epithet of Śiva. --रूप a. deformed.
26358: विरूपक a. 1 Deformed, ugly. --2 Hideous, frightful, monstrous. --कः A nickname.
26359: विरूपिन् a. (णी f.) Deformed, ugly, disfigured. --m. A pole-cat.
26360: विरेकः 1 Evacuation of the bowels, purging. --2 A purgative.
26363: विरेफः 1 A river, stream. --2 Absence of the letter र्.
26364: विरोकः --कं A hole, pit, chasm; Śi. 5. 54. --कः A ray of light.
26365: विरोचनः 1 The sun. --2 The moon. --3 Fire. --4 N. of the son of Prahrāda and father of Bali; Śi. 14. 74. --Comp. --सुतः an epithet of Bali.
26366: विल् {vI.v} {c6c} P. (विलति) 1 To cover, conceal. --2 To break, divide. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (वेलयति-ते) To throw, send forth.
26368: विलक्ष् {c10c} U. 1 To see, observe, perceive, notice. --2 To characterize, distinguish. --3 To be confused, be bewildered; निर्व्यापारविलक्षितानि सांत्वय बलानि U. 6; see विलक्ष below.
26369: विलक्ष a. 1 Having no characteristic or distinguishing marks. --2 Bewildered, embarrassed. --3 Surprised, astonished. --4 Ashamed, abashed, disconcerted; गोत्रेषु स्खलितस्तदा भवति च व्रीडाविलक्षश्चिरं Ś. 6. 4. --5 Forced, unnatural, embarrassed (as a smile); विलक्षस्मितस्फुरितैर्दशनांशुभिः K. 233; Ratn. 3. 14.
26370: विलक्षण a. 1 Having no characteristic or distinguishing marks. --2 Different, other. --3 Strange, extraordinary, unusual. --4 Possessed of inauspicious marks. --णं 1 A vain or useless state. --2 Perceiving, observing.
26371: विलक्षित p. p. 1 Distinguished, perceived, seen, discovered. --2 Discernible by. --3 Dismayed, perplexed, embarrassed, puzzled. --4 Vexed, annoyed. --5 Undistinguished.
26372: विलग् {c1c} P. To stick or adhere to, cling to.
26373: विलग्न a. 1 Clinging or sticking to, resting on, fastened on; आकुटिलपक्ष्मविलग्नं Ś. 7. 25; Śi. 9. 20. --2 Cast, fixed, directed; Ku. 7. 50 --3 Gone by, elapsed (as time). --4 Thin, slender, delicate; मध्येन सा वेदिविलग्नमध्या Ku. 1. 39; V. 4. 37. --ग्नं 1 The waist. --2 The hips. --3 The rising of constellations.
26374: विलंघ् {c10c} U. 1 To pass or spring over, traverse; निवेशयमास विलंघिताध्वा R. 5. 42; 16. 32; Śi. 12. 24, 8. 26. --2 To violate, transgress, overstep, disregard, neglect; गतुं प्रवृत्ते समयं विलंध्य Ku. 3. 25; R. 5. 48, Ki. 2. 45, Śi. 17. 12. --3 To violate the limits of propriety; R. 9. 74. --4 To rise towards, ascend or go up to; Ki. 5. 1; N. 5. 2. --5 To give up, abandon, leave aside; मनो बबंधान्यरसान् विलंघ्य सा R. 3. 4. --6 To surpass, excel; इति कर्णोत्पलं प्रायस्तव दृष्ट्या विलंघ्यते Kāv. 2. 224. --7 To cause to fast. --8 To overcome, surmount. --9 To offend, insult.
26375: विलंघनं 1 Transgressing, overstepping. --2 Offence, transgression, injury.
26376: विलंघित p. p. 1 Passed over or beyond, gone over. --2 Transgressed. --3 Surpassed, excelled. --4 Overcome, defeated.
26377: विलज्ज् {c6c} A. To be bashful or modest, to blush, feel ashamed; यत्रांशुकाक्षेपविलज्जितानां Ku. 1. 14; R. 14. 27.
26379: विलप् {c1c} P. 1 To say, speak. --2 To lament, moan, bewail, cry, weep; विललाप विकीर्णमूर्घजा Ku. 4. 4; विललाप स बाष्पगद्गदं R. 8. 43, 70; Bk. 6. 11; तमिह वृथा किं विलपामि Gīt {3} --3 To prattle, talk idly, babble.
26380: विलपनं 1 Talking. --2 Talking idly, chattering, prattle --3 Lamenting, wailing; विलपनविनोदोप्यसुलभः U. 3. 30. --4 The sediment of any oily substance.
26382: विलापः Wailing, lamentation, a wail, moan; लंकास्त्रीणां पुनश्चक्रे विलापाचार्यकं शरैः R. 12. 78.
26383: विलंब् {c1c} A. 1 To hang down, hang from, be suspended from; R. 10. 62. --2 To set, decline (as the sun &c.). --3 To stay or lag behind, stay or remain, wait, stand still, तां प्राङ्मुखीं तत्र निवेश्य तन्वीं क्षणं व्यलबंत पुरो निषण्णाः Ku. 7. 13. --4 To delay, be retarded; विलांबितफलैः कालं निनाय स मनोरथैः R. 1. 33; किं विलंव्यते त्वरितं तं प्रवेशय U. 1. --Caus. 1 To delay, detain. --2 To put off, retard, procrastinate, postpone. --3 To waste, lose.
26384: विलंबः 1 Hanging over, pendulousness. --2 Tardiness, delay, procrastination.
26385: विलंबनं 1 Hanging down, depending. --2 Delay, procrastination; न करु नितंबिनि गमनविलंबनं Gīt. 5; or तन्मुग्धे विफलं विलंबनमसौ रम्योऽ भिसारक्षणः ibid.
26387: विलंबित p. p. 1 Hanging, depending. --2 Pendent, pendulous. --3 Depending on, closely connected with. --4 Tardy, delayed, retarded. --5 Slow (as time in music). --तं Delay. --तं ind. Slowly, tardily.
26388: विलंबिन् a. (नी f.) 1 Hanging down, depending, pendent; नवांबुभिर्भूरिबिलंबिनो घनाः Ś. 5. 12. शिरीषम गंडविलंबि केशरं 6. 17; अलघुविलंबिपयोधरोपरुद्धाः Śi. 4. 29, 59; Ku. 1. 14; Ki. 5. 6; R. 16. 14, 18. 26; Mk. 5. 13. --2 Delaying, dilatory, being slow; भवति विलंबिनि विगलितलज्जा विलपति रोदिति वासकसज्जा Gīt. 6.
26390: विलयः 1 Dissolution, liquefaction. --2 Destruction, death, end; नयतु मामात्मम्ॐऽगेषु विलयमंबा U. 7. --3 Destruction or dissolution of the world; (विलयं गम् to be dissolved, to end, to be terminated, दिवसोऽ नुमित्रमगपद्विलयं Śi. 9. 17).
26391: विलयनं 1 Dissolving, liquefying, dissolution. --2 Corroding. --3 Removing, taking away. --4 Attenuating. --5 An attenuant.
26392: विलस् {c1c} P. 1 To shine, flash, glitter; वियति च विलिलास तद्वदिंदुर्विलसति चंद्रमसो न यद्वदन्यः Bk. 10. 68; Me. 47; R. 13. 76. --2 To appear, arise, become manifest; प्रेम विलसति महत्तदहो Śi. 15. 14; 9. 87. --3 To sport, amuse oneself, play, frolic about sportively; कापि चपला मधुरिपुणा विलसति युवतिरधिकगुणा Gīt. 7; or हरिरिह मुग्धवधूनिकरे विलासिनि विलसाति केलिपरे Gīt. 1; पर्यंके तया सह विललास H. 1. --4 To sound, echo, reverberate. --5 To act upon, work upon, show oneself; (खेदः) त्वयि विलसति तुल्यं वल्लभालोकनेन Māl. 3. 8. --6 To move about, dart, shoot up wards.
26393: विलसत् pres. a. (न्ती f.) 1 Glittering, shining, bright. --2 Flashing, darting. --3 Waving. --4 Sportive, playful; see विलस् above.
26394: विलसनं 1 Glittering, flashing, gleaming. --2 Sporting, dallying.
26395: विलसित p. p. 1 Glittering, shining, gleaming. --2 Appeared, manifested. --3 Sportive, wanton. --तं 1 Glittering, gleaming. --2 A gleam, flash; रोधोभुवां मुहुग्मुत्र हिरण्मयीनां भासस्तडिद्विलसितानि विडंबयंति Ki. 5. 46. Me. 81, V. 4. --3 Appearance, manifestation; as in अज्ञानाविलसितं &c. --4 Sport, play, dalliance, amorous or wanton gesture (fig. also); अतिपिशुनानि चैकांतनिष्टुरस्य दवैह कस्य विलसितानि K. --5 Action or gesture in general. --6 Effect, fruit, result; Māl. 2. 9.
26396: विलासः 1 Sport, play, pastime. --2 Amorous pastime, diversion, pleasure; as in विलासमेखला R. 8. 64; so विलासकाननं, विलासमंदिरं &c. --3 Coquetry, dalliance, affectation, wantonness, graceful movement or play, any feminine gesture indicative of amorous sentiment; Ś. 2. 2; कविकुलगुरुः कालिदासो विलासः P. R. 1. 22; Śi. 9. 26. --4 Grace, beauty, elegance, charm; Māl. 2. 6. --5 Flash, gleam. --Comp. --काननं a pleasuregrove. --मंदिर a pleasure-house. --चेष्टितं amorous movement; Ku. 5. 13.
26397: विलासनं 1 Sport, play, pastime. --2 Wantonness, dalliance.
26398: विलासवती A wanton or amorous woman; R. 9. 48; Rs. 1. 12.
26399: विलासिका A drama in one act full of love-incidents; it is thus defined in S. D.: --शृंगारबहुलैकांका दशलास्यांगसंयुता । विदूषकविटभ्यां च पीठमर्देन भूषिता । हीना गर्भविमर्षाभ्यां संधिभ्यां हीननायका । स्वल्पवृत्ता सुमेपथ्या विख्याता सा विलासिका 552.
26400: विलासिन् a. (नीं f.) Sportive, playful, dallying, wanton, coquettish; R. 6. 14. --m. 1 A sensualist, voluptuary, an amorous person; उपमानमभूद्विलासिनां करणं यत्तव कांतिमतया Ku. 4. 5. --2 Fire. --3 The moon. --4 A snake. --5 An epithet of Kṛshṇa or Viṣṇu. --6 Of Śiva. --7 Of the god of love.
26401: विलासिनी 1 A woman (in general). --2 A coquettish or wanton woman; हरिघि मग्धवधूनि करे विलासिनि विलसति केलिपरे Gīt. 1; Ku. 7. 69; Śi. 8. 10, R. 6. 17. --3 A wanton, harlot.
26402: विलालः 1 A cat (= बिडाल). --2 An instrument, a machine.
26403: विलिख् {c6c} P. 1 To write, inscribe. --2 To draw, paint, delineate, portray; विलिखति रहसि कुरंगमदेन भवंतमसमशरभूतं Gīt. 4. --3 To scratch, scrape, tear up; मंदं शब्दायमानो विलिखति शयनादुत्थितः क्ष्मां खुरण K. P. 10; व्यलिखच्चचुपुटेन पक्षती N. 2. 2; पादेन हैमं विलिलेख पीठं R. 6. 15; Ku. 2. 23. --4 To implant, infix; तावंतोपि विलिख्यंते हृदये शाकशकवः H. 4. 72 v. l.
26405: विलेखनं 1 Scratching, scraping, making a mark or furrow. --2 Digging. --3 Uprooting. --4 Dividing, splitting.
26406: विलिप् {c6c} P. 1 To smear, anoint. rub on; तथाहि नृत्याभिनयक्रियाच्युतं विलिप्यते मौलिभिरंबरौकसां Ku. 5. 79; Bk. 3. 20; 15. 6; Śi. 16. 62. --2 To pollute, defile, taint, contaminate.
26407: विलिप्त p. p. 1 Anointed, besmeared, smeared over. --2 Polluted, stained, defiled.
26408: विलेपः 1 An unguent, an ointment. --2 Mortar. --3 Plaster (in general). --4 Anointing, plastering.
26409: विलेपनं 1 Smearing, anointing. --2 An ointment, unguent, any cosmetic or perfume for the body (such as saffron, sandal &c); न स्नानं न विलेपनं न कुसुमं नालंकृता मूर्धजाः Bh. 2. 19; यान्येव सुरभिकुसुमधूपावलेपनादीनि K.
26410: विलेपनी 1 A woman scented with perfumes --2 A woman beautifully dressed or attired (सुवेशा). --3 Ricegruel.
26412: विली {vI.v} {c4c} A. 1 To cling or stick to, adhere to. --2 To rest on, settle down or alight on; पुरोऽस्य यावन्न भुविव्यलीयत Śi. 1. 12. --3 To be dissolved, to melt away, be absorbed in; विलिल्ये यत्कुक्षिस्थितशिखिनि वातापिवपुषा Mv. 6. 60; 7. 14. --4 To vanish, disappear. --5 To perish. {vII.v} {c9c} P. To melt, liquefy.
26413: विलीन p. p. 1 Sticking to, clung or attached to. --2 Perched or settled on, alighting on. --3 Contiguous to, in contact with. --4 Melted, dissolved, liquefied. --5 Disappeared, vanished. --6 Dead, perished.
26415: विलुड् Caus. 1 To agitate, stir up, toss about. --2 To disturb, confuse. --3 To turn over, upset.
26416: विलोडनं Agitating, shaking about, stirring up, churning; Śi. 14. 83.
26417: विलोडित p. p. 1 Shaken, churned, stirred, agitated. --2 Rolling on the ground. --तं Butter-milk.
26419: विलुप् {c6c} P. 1 To break off, pull out, cut off. --2 To seize, plunder, rob, carry off. --3 To mar, spoil, impair. --4 (a) To destroy, ruin, cause to disappear; प्रियमत्यंतविलुप्तदर्शनं Ku. 4. 2 ‘for ever lost to view’. (b) To eat up; क्रव्याद्भिरंगलतिका नियतं विलुप्ता U. 3. 28, Mk. 1. 9. --5 To wipe or rub off. --Pass. To be destroyed or lost, to perish, disappear; जराविलुप्तमानावमानचिंतः Dk.
26420: विलुप्त p. p. 1 Broken or torn off; Pt. 2. 2. --2 Seized, snatched away, carried off --3 Robbed, plundered. --4 Destroyed, ruined. --5 Impaired, mutilated.
26422: विलोपः 1 Taking away, carrying off, seizure, plunder. --2 Loss, destruction, disappearance.
26423: विलोपनं 1 Cutting off. --2 Carrying away. --3 Destroying, destruction.
26424: विलुभ् {c4c} P. To be disturbed or deranged; be disordered; Bk. 9. 40. --Caus. 1 To allure, entice, attract; स्मर यावन्न विलाभ्यसे दिवि Ku. 4. 20; अंगनास्तमधिकं व्यलोभयन् (मुखैः) R. 19. 10. --2 To divert, amuse, entertain; क्वदृष्टिं विलोभयामि Ś. 6; ललितलताविलोभ्यमाननयनो भवानुत्कठां विनोदयतु V. 2.
26426: विलोभनं 1 Enticing, alluring. --2 An allurement, a temptation, seduction; प्रयुज्य सामाचरितं विलोभनं भयं विभेदाय धियः प्रदर्शितं Ki. 14. 7; R. 8. 60. --3 Praise, flattery.
26427: विलुल् {c1c} P. 1 To move to and fro. --2 To shake, make tremulous. --3 To disorder, derange, dishevel (as hair). --Caus. To agitate, stir, disturb.
26428: विलुलित p. p. 1 Moving to and fro, unsteady, shaken, tossed about, tremulous; U. 3. 23. --2 Disordered, disarranged; गलितकुसुमदलविलुलितकेशा Gīt. 7. --3 Waving, fickle, unsteady.
26429: विलून p. p. Cut off, lopped off, clipt, cut asunder.
26430: विलोक् {c10c} U. 1 To see, behold, look at, perceive; विलोक्य वृद्धोक्षमधिष्ठितं त्वया महाजनः स्मेरमुखो भविष्यति Ku. 5. 70; R. 2. 11; 6. 59. --2 To search for, look out for.
26431: विलोकनं 1 Seeing, looking at, observing; Ki. 5. 16. --2 Sight, observation; Śi. 1. 29.
26432: विलोकित p. p. 1 Seen, observed, viewed, beheld. --2 Examined, thought about. --तं A look, glance; Ś. 2. 3.
26433: विलोचनं The eye; R. 7. 8; Ku. 4. 1, 3. 67. --Comp. --अंबु n. tears.
26434: विलोम a. (मी f.) 1 Inverted reverse, inverse, contrary, opposite. --2 Produced in the reverse order. --3 Backward. --मः 1 Reverse order, inversion. --2 A dog. --3 A snake. --4 N. of Varuṇa. --मं A waterwheel, machine for raising water from a well. --Comp. --उत्पन्न, --ज, --जात, --वर्ण a. ‘born in the reverse order’; i. e. born of a mother whose caste is superior to the father's; cf. प्रतिलोमज also. --क्रिया, --विधिः {1} a reverse action. {2} a rule of inversion (in math.). --जिह्वः an elephant.
26436: विलोल a. 1 Shaking about, trembling, tremulous, unsteady, rolling, waving, tossing about; पृषतीषु विलोलमीक्षितं R. 8. 59; Ku. 5. 8; Śi. 8. 8, 15. 62, 20. 42; Ve. 2. 28, 24; R. 7. 41, 16. 68. --2 Loose, disordered, dishevelled (as hair); दधती विलोलकबरीकमाननं U. 3. 4.
26438: विलोहित a. 1 Of a purple colour. --2 Reddish, red; धनुर्धरः कोपविलोहिताक्षः R. 16. 77. --तः N. of Rudra. --ता One of the tongues of fire.
26441: विवक्षा 1 A desire to speak. --2 Wish, desire. --3 Meaning, sense. --4 Intention, purpose.
26442: विवक्षित a. 1 Intended to be said or spoken; विवक्षितं ह्यनुक्तमनुतापं जनयति Ś. 3. --2 Meant, intended, purposed. --3 Wished, desired. --4 Favourite. --तं 1 Purpose, intention. --2 Sense, meaning.
26443: विवक्षु a. Wishing or about to speak; पुनर्विवक्षुः स्फुरितोत्तराधरः Ku. 5. 83.
26445: विवद् {c1c} A. 1 To quarrel, dispute; परस्परं विवदमानौ भ्रातरौ. --2 To be at variance, to conflict, be in opposition; परस्परंविवदमानानां शास्त्राणां H. 1. --3 To contend (as in a court of law).
26446: विवादः 1 (a) A dispute, contest, contention, controversy, discussion, debate, quarrel, strife; अलं विवादेन Ku. 5. 82; एतयोर्विवाद एव मे न रोचते M. 1; एकप्सरःप्रार्थितयार्विवादः R. 7. 53. (b) Argument, argumentation, discussion. --2 Contradiction; एष विवाद एव प्रत्याययति Ś. 7. --3 A litigation, law-suit, contest at law; सीमाविवादः, विवादपदं &c.; (it is thus defined: --ऋणादिदायकलहे द्वयोर्बहुतरस्य वा विवादो व्यवहरश्च); see व्यवहर also. --4 Crying aloud, sounding. --5 An order, a command; तस्याननादुच्चरितो विवादश्चस्खाल वेलास्वपि नार्णवानां R. 18. 43. --Comp. --आर्यिन् m. {1} a litigant. {2} a plaintiff, complainant, prosecutor. --पदं a title of dispute. --वस्तु n. the subject of dispute, the matter at issue.
26447: विवादिन् a. 1 Disputing, contending, disputatious, quarrelling. --2 Litigating. --m. A litigant, party in a law suit.
26449: विवधः 1 A yoke for carrying burdens. --2 A road, high-way. --3 A load, burden. --4 Storing grain. --5 A pitcher.
26450: विवधिकः 1 A carrier of loads, porter. --2 A pedlar, hawker.
26451: विवरं 1 A fissure, hole, cavity, hollow, vacuity; यच्चकार विवरं शिलाघने ताडकोरसि स रामसायकः R. 11. 18, 9. 61, 19. 7; धीरनादभरितकर्णविवरं प्रिये मदयंतिके इति व्याहरति Māl. 7. --2 An interstice, interval, intervening space; Ś. 7. 7. --3 A solitary place; Ki. 12. 37. --4 A fault, flaw, defect, weak point. --5 A breach, wound. --6 The number ‘nine’. --रः Expansion. --Comp. --नालिका a flute, fife --प्रवेशः entrance into a chasm (one of the means of getting one's desired object); Pt. 5.
26452: विवर्ण a. 1 Colourless, pale, wan, pallid; नरेंद्रमार्गट्ट इव प्रपेदे विवर्णभावं स स भूमिपालः R. 6. 67. --2 Discoloured, deprived of water (as a gem.); विवर्णमणीकृतं (कनकवलयं) Ś. 3. 13. --3 Low, vile. --4 Ignorant, stupid, unlettered. --र्णः An outcast, a man belonging to low caste.
26453: विवश a. 1 Uncontrolled, independent, unsubdued. --2 Having lost control over oneself, dependent, subject, under control (of another), helpless; परीता रक्षोभिः श्रयति विवशा कामपि दशां Bv. 1. 83; मित्रस्नेहाद्विवशमधुना साहसे मां नियुंक्ते Mu. 6. 18; जातं जातमवश्यमाशु विवशं मृत्युः करोत्यात्मसात् Bh. 3. 105; Śi. 20. 58; H. 1. 172; Mv. 6. 32, 63. --3 Insensible, not master of oneself; विवशा कामवधूर्विबोधिता Ku. 4. 1. --4 Dead, perished; उपलब्धवती दिवश्च्युतं विवशा शापनिवृत्तिकारणं R. 8. 82. --5 Desirous or apprehensive of death.
26454: विवस् {vI.v} {c1c} P. 1 To dwell abroad. --2 To live, dwell. --3 To spend, pass (time). --4 To retire, withdraw. --Caus. To banish, send into exile; Bk. 4. 35. {vII.v} {c2c} A. 1 To exchange clothes. --2 To wear, put on.
26455: विवासः, विवासनं Banishment, sending into exile, expulsion; रामस्य गात्रमसि दुर्वहगर्भाखन्नसीताविवासनपटोः करुणा कुतस्ते U. 2. 10.
26456: विवासित p. p. Banished, exiled, expelled.
26457: विवसन a. Naked, unclothed. --नः A Jaina mendicant.
26458: विवस्वत् m. 1 The sun; त्वष्टा विवस्वतमिवोल्लिलेख Ki. 17. 48, 5. 48; R. 10. 30, 17. 48. --2 N. of Aruṇa. --3 N. of the present Manu. --4 A god. --5 The Arka plant.
26459: विवह् {c1c} P. 1 To remove, take away, drive off. --2 To marry. --Caus. To give in marriage.
26460: विवहः N. of one of the seven tongues of fire.
26461: विवाहः Marriage; (Hindu lawgivers enumerate eight forms of marriage; ब्राह्म दैवस्तथै वार्षः प्राजापत्यस्तथासुरः । गांधर्वे राक्षसश्चैव पैशाचश्च ष्टमोऽधमः Ms. 3. 21; see Y. 1. 58-61 also; for explanation of these forms see s. v.). --Comp. --चतुष्टयं marrying four wives. --दीक्षा the marriage ceremony or rite; R. 3. 33.
26465: विवारः 1 Opening, expansion. --2 Expansion of the throat in the articulation of letters, (one of the Ābhyantara Prayatnas, opp. संवार); cf. विवृतमूष्मणां स्वराणां च Sk. on P. I. 1. 9.
26466: विविग्न a. 1 Very much agitated or terrified; R. 18. 13; Ku. 1. 56. --2 Very angry.
26467: विविच् {c3c} {c7c} U. 1 To separate, divide, remove from; विविनच्मि दिवः सुरान् Bk. 6. 36. --2 To discern, discriminate. --3 To judge, ascertain, determine; रे खल तव खलु चरितं विदुषामग्रे विविच्य वक्ष्यामि Bv. 1. 108. --4 To describe, treat of. --5 To tear up, rend asunder.
26468: विविक्त p. p. 1 Separated, detached, disjoined, abstracted. --2 Lonely, solitary, retired, sequestered. --3 Single, alone. --4 Distinguished, discriminated. --5 Judicious --6 Pure, faultless; Ratn. 1. 21. --7 Profound (as a judgment or thought). --8 Intent on. --9 Devoid of, free from; Ku. 1. 23. --क्तं 1 A lonely or solitary place; विविक्तादृते नान्यदुत्सुकस्य शरणमस्ति V. 2, Ś. 5. 5, Śi. 8. 70. --2 Loneliness, privacy, seclusion. --क्ता An unlucky or ill-fated woman, one disliked by her husband ( दुर्भगा). --Comp. --सेविन् a. seeking solitude, lonely.
26469: विविध a. Various, diverse, manifold, multiform, sundry; Ms. 1. 8, 39. --धं A variety of action or gesture.
26470: विवीतः An enclosed or preserved spot of ground, such as pastureland.
26471: विवृ {5} {c9c} U. 1 To cover up, stop. --2 To open; Ku. 4. 26. --3 To unfold, disclose, reveal, show, display; द्वंद्वानि भावं क्रियया विवव्रुः Ku. 3. 35; N. 9. 1; Bk. 7. 73, Śi. 16. 30. --4 To speak, utter; श्रवणकटु नृपाणामेकवाक्यं विवव्रुः R. 6. 85. --5 To teach, explain, expound; Mv. 2. 43. --6 To spread; Bv. 1. 5. --7 To choose.
26472: विवरणं 1 Displaying, expressing, unfolding, opening. --2 Exposing, laying bare or open. --3 Exposition, explanation, gloss, comment, interpretation. --4 Describing, description. --5 A sentence.
26473: विवृत p. p. 1 Displayed, manifested, expressed. --2 Evident, clear, open. --3 Uncovered, exposed, laid bare. --4 Opened, unclosed; bare, open. --5 Proclaimed. --6 Expounded, explained, commented upon. --7 Expanded, spread out. --8 Extensive, large, spacious. --9 Bare, barren (as ground). --तं Open articulation. --तं ind. Openly. --Comp. --अक्ष a. large-eyed. (--क्षः) a cock. --द्वार a. with the gates thrown open; Ku. 4. 26.
26474: विवृतिः f. 1 Display, manifestation. --2 Expansion. --3 Exposure, discovery. --4 Exposition, comment, interpretation, gloss.
26475: विवृज् {c10c} U. or Caus. 1 To shun, avoid. --2 To make destitute of, deprive of. --3 To exclude. --4 To distribute, give.
26477: विवर्जित p. p. 1 Left, abandoned. --2 Shunned. --3 Deprived of, destitute of, without (usually in comp); Pt. 1. 34. --4 Given, distributed.
26478: विवृक्त p. p. Left, abandoned, deserted. --क्ता A woman disliked by her husband; cf. विविक्ता.
26479: विवृत् {c1c} A. 1 To turn round, roll, revolve, move round; Māl. 1. 40. --2 To turn or move about. --3 To turn aside, bend; कश्चिद्विवृत्तत्रिकभिन्नहारः R. 6. 16; Ś. 2. 12. --4 To become. --5 To turn away from, depart from, return. --6 To descend. --7 To attack, fall upon.
26480: विवर्तः 1 Turning round, revolving, whirling. --2 Rolling onward, moving about; Mv. 6. 26. --3 Rolling back, returning. --4 Dancing. --5 Alteration, modification, change of form, altered condition or state; शब्दब्रह्मणस्तादृशं विवर्तमितिहासं रामायणं प्रणिनाय U. 2; एको रसः करुण एव निमित्तभेदाद्भन्नः पृथक् पृथगिवाश्रयते विवर्तान् U. 3. 47; अकांडशुष्काशनिपातरौद्रः क एष धातुर्विषमो विवर्तः Mv. 5. 57. --6 (In Vedānta phil.) An apparent or illusory form, an unreal appearance caused by अविद्या or human error; (this is a favourite doctrine of the Vedāntins according to whom the whole visible world is a mere illusion-an unreal and illusory appearance-while Brahman or Supreme Spirit is the only real entity; as a serpent (सर्प) is a vivarta of a rope (रज्जु), so is the world a vivarta of the real entity Brahman, and the illusion is removed by Vidyā or true knowledge; cf. Bhavabhūti: --विद्याकल्पेन मरुता भेघानां भूयसामपि । ब्रह्मणीव विवर्तानां क्वापि विप्रलयः कृतः ॥ U. 6. 6). --7 A heap, multitude, collection, an assemblage. --Comp. --वादः the doctrine of the Vedāntins that the visible world is illusory and Brahman alone is the real entity.
26481: विवर्तनं 1 Revolving, revolution, whirling round. --2 Rolling about, turning round; शय्याप्रांतविवर्तनैर्विगमयत्युन्निद्र एव क्षपाः Ś. 6. 4; Ve. 2. 8, 5. 40: Mv. 7. 5. --3 Rolling back, returning. --4 Rolling down, descending. --5 Existing, abiding. --6 Reverential salutation. --7 Passing through various states or existences. --8 An altered condition; पुनरकांडविवर्ननदारुणो प्रविशितष्टि विधिर्तनसो रुजं U. 4. 15; Māl. 4. 7.
26482: विवर्तित p. p. 1 Turned or whirled round, revolved. --2 Moved round or about, rolling; विवर्तितभ्रूरियमद्य शिक्षते Ś. 1. 23. --3 Mangled, hacked, cut to pieces; Māl. 3. 17. --4 Unfolded. --5 Distorted, bent down.
26483: विवृत्त p. p. 1 Turned round. --2 Turning round, revolving, rolling, whirling.
26484: विवृत्तिः f. 1 Turning round, whirling, revolution. --2 (In gram.) A hiatus.
26485: विवृध् {c1c} A. 1 To grow, increase. --2 To thrive, prosper. --3 To spring up, arise. --Caus. 1 To increase, augment. --2 To promote, advance, further. --3 To raise, elevate. --4 To gratify, exhilarate. --5 To congratulate (one) upon.
26486: विवर्धनं 1 Increasing. --2 Increase, augmentation, growth. --3 Enlargement, aggrandisement. --4 Cutting, dividing.
26487: विवर्धित p. p. 1 Increased, augmented. --2 Advanced, promoted, furthered. --3 Gratified, satisfied. --4 Cut, divided.
26488: विवृद्ध p. p. 1 Grown up. --2 Increased, augmented, heightened, enhanced, intensified (as grief, joy &c.). --3 Copious, large, plentiful.
26489: विवृद्धिः f. 1 Growth, increase, augmentation, development; ययुः शरीरावयवा विवृद्धिं R. 18. 49; विवृद्धिमत्राश्नुवते व सूनि 13. 4; so शोक°, हर्ष° &c. --2 Prosperity.
26490: विवेकः 1 Discrimination, judgment, discernment, discretion; काश्यपि यातस्तवापि च विवेकः Bv. 1. 68, 66; ज्ञातोयं जलधर तावको विवेकः 96; विवेकभ्रष्टानां भवति विनितः शतमुखः Bh. 2. 10. --2 Consideration, discussion, investigation; यच्छृगारविवेकतत्त्वमपि यत्काव्येषु लीलायित Gīt. 12, so द्वैत,° धर्म° --3 Distinction, difference, discriminating (between two things); नीरक्षीरविवेके हंसालस्यं त्वमेव तनुषे चेत् Bv. 1. 13; Bk. 17. 60. --4 (In Vedānta phil.) The power of distinguishing between the visible world and the invisible spirit, or of separating reality from mere semblance or illusion. --5 True knowledge. --6 A receptacle for water, basin, reservoir. --Comp. --ज्ञ a. judicious, discriminative; Pt. 1. 262, 387. --ज्ञानं the faculty of discrimination. --दृशान् m. a discerning man. --पदवी reflection, consideration.
26491: विवेकिन् a. Discriminating, discreet, judicious; Pt. 1. 418. --m. 1 A judge, discriminator. --2 A philosopher.
26492: विवेक्तृ m. 1 A judge. --2 A sage, philosopher.
26493: विवेचनं --ना 1 Discrimination. --2 Discussion, consideration. --3 Settle. ment, decision.
26494: विवोढृ m. 1 A bridegroom, husband. --2 A son-in-law.
26495: विव्वोक See बिब्बोकः विव्वोकस्ते मुरविजयिनो वर्त्मपाती बभूव Ud. S. 43.
26496: विश् {c6c} P. (विशति, विवेश, अविक्षत्, वेक्ष्यति, वेष्टुं, विष्ट) 1 To enter, go or enter into; विवेश कश्चिज्जटिलस्तपोवनं Ku. 5. 30; R. 6. 10, Me. 102; Bg. 11. 29; so दोलायमानेत चेतसा विंतां विवेश K. 199 ‘fell a-thinking’. --2 To go or come to, come into the possession of, fall to the share of; उपदा विविशुः शश्वन्नात्सेकाः कोशलेश्वरं R. 4. 70. --3 To sit or settle down upon. --4 To penetrate, pervade. --5 To enter upon, undertake. --Caus. (वेशयति-ते) To cause to enter. --Desid. (विपिक्षति) To wish to enter.
26497: विश् m. 1 A man of the third caste, a Vaiśya. --2 A man in general. --3 People. --f. 1 People, subjects. --2 A daughter. --3 Ved. Entrance. --4 A family, tribe, race. --Comp. --पण्यं goods, merchandise. --पतिः (also विशांपतिः) {1} a king, lord of subjects. {2} a son-in-law. {3} a head-merchant.
26498: विशं The fibres of the stalk of a lotus; cf. बिस. --Comp. --आकरः a kind of plant (भद्रवूड). --कठा a crane.
26499: विशंक् {c1c} A. 1 To suspect, fear, have doubts or suspicions about; विशंकसे भीरु यताऽवधीरणां Ś. 3. 14. सतीमपि ज्ञातिकुलैकसंश्रयां जनोऽन्यथा भर्तृमतीं विशकते 5. 17. --2 To think to be, fancy, imagine, विशंकमाना रमितं कयापि जनार्दनं दृष्टवदेतदाह Gīt. 7.
26501: विशंकट a. (टा-टी f.) 1 Great, large, big; विशंकटो वक्षासि बाण पाणिः Bk. 2. 50, Śi. 13. 34. --2 Strong, vehement, powerful. --टं ind. Vehemently, intensely.
26502: विशद a. 1 Clear, pure, pellucid, clean, spotless; योगनिद्रातविशदैः पावनैरवलोकनैः R. 10. 14, 19. 39; 8. 3 प्रणयविशदा दृष्टिं वक्त्रे ददाति न शंकि ता Ratn. 3. 9. Ki. 5. 12. --2 White, of a pure, white colour; निर्धौतहारगुलिकाविशदं हिमांभः R. 5. 70; Ku. 1. 44. 6. 25, Śi. 9. 26, Ki. 4. 23. --3 Bright, shining, beautiful; Ku. 3. 33; Śi. 8. 70. --4 Clear, evident, manifest. --5 Calm, free from anxiety, at ease: जातो ममायं विशदः प्रकामं (अंतरात्मा) Ś. 4. 21, V. 3. --दः The white colour. (विशदीकृ {c8c} U. ‘to explain make clear, illustrate’).
26503: विशयः 1 Doubt, uncertainty, the second of the five members of an Adhikaraṇa, q. v. --2 Refuge, asylum.
26504: विशरः 1 Splitting, bursting. --2 Slaughter, killing, destruction.
26505: विशल्य a. 1 Free from trouble or anxiety, secure. --2 Free from thorns or darts. --ल्या N. of several plants: --दंती, गुडूवी, अजमोदा &c.
26506: विशस् {c1c} P. 1 To cut up, kill; U. 4. --2 To immolate, sacrifice.
26507: विशसनं 1 Killing, slaughter, immolation; तस्यास्त्वं दुहितुस्तथा विशसनं किं दारुणेऽमृष्यथाः U. 4. 5. --2 Ruin. --नः 1 A sabre, crooked sword. --2 A sword in general.
26508: विशस्त p. p. 1 Cut up, hacked. --2 Rude, ill-mannered. --3 Praised, celebrated.
26509: विशस्तृ m. 1 An immolator. --2 A Cāṇḍāla.
26511: विशाखः 1 N. of Kārtikeya. Mv. 2. 38. --2 An attitude in shooting (in which the archer stands with the feet a span apart). --3 A beggar, petitioner. --4 A spindle, --5 N. of Śiva. --6 N. of a god, frequently mentioned by Pāṇini and Patañjali along with Skanda; e. g. see Mbh. on P. VI. 3. 26, VIII. 1. 15. --Comp. --जः the orange tree.
26513: विशाखा (usually in the dual) N. of the 16th lunar mansion consisting of two stars; किमत्र चित्रं यदि विशाखे शशांकलेखामनुवर्तेते Ś. 3.
26514: विशातनं 1 Rending asunder, cutting off. --2 Setting free, delivering, releasing.
26515: विशायः Sleeping in rotation, the rest enjoyed in rotation by the sentinels on watch.
26517: विशारद a. 1 Clever, skilful or proficient in, versed in, conversant with (usually in comp.); मधुदानविशारदाः R. 9. 29, 8. 17. --2 Learned, wise. --3 Famous, celebrated. --4 Bold, confident. --दः The Bakula tree.
26518: विशाल a. 1 Large, great, extensive, spacious, broad, wide; गृहैर्विशालैरपि भूरिशालैः Śi. 3. 50; रथचरणविशालश्र णिलोलेक्षणेन 11. 23, 17. 47; R. 2. 21. 6. 32, Bg. 9. 21. --2 Rich or abounding in: श्रीविशालां विशालां Me. 30. --3 Eminent, illustrious, great, noble, celebrated. --लः 1 A kind of deer. --2 A kind of bird. --ला 1 N. of the town Ujjayinī; पूर्वोद्दिष्टामनुसर पुरीं श्रीविशालां विशालां Me. 30. --2 N. of a river. --Comp. --अक्ष a. large-eyed. (--क्षः) {1} N. of Viṣṇu. {2} of Garuḍa. {3} an epithet of Śiva. (--क्षी) an epithet of Pārvatī.
26520: विशिख a. Crownless, crestless, pointless. --खः 1 An arrow; माधव मनसिजविशिखभयादिव भावनया त्वयि लीना Gīt. 4; R. 5. 50; Mv. 2. 38. --2 A kind of reed. --3 An iron crow.
26521: विशिखा 1 A spade. --2 A spindle. --3 A needle or pin. --4 A minute arrow. --5 A highway. --6 A barber's wife.
26523: विशिपं 1 A temple. --2 An abode, a house. --3 A palace.
26524: विशिष् {c7c} P. 1 To particularize, individualize, specify, define. --2 To distinguish, discriminate. --3 To aggravate, heighten, enhance, intensify; पुनरकांडविवर्तनदारुणो विधिरहो विशिनाष्टि मनोरुजं Māl. 4. 7; U. 4. 15. --4 To surpass, excel; विशेषको वा विशिशेष यस्याः श्रियं त्रिलोकीतिलकः स एव Śi. 3. 63. --Pass. 1 To be different from R. 17. 62. --2 To be better or higher than, surpass, excel, be preferable or superior to (often with abl.); तस्माद्दुर्गं विशिष्यते H. 3. 50; Mv. 7. 39; मौनात् सत्यं विशिष्यते Ms. 2. 83; 3. 203; (also with instr and gen.); सर्वेषामेव दानानां ब्रह्मदानं विशिष्यते Ms. 4. 233. --Caus. 1 To distinguish, particularize. --2 To surpass, excel. मदनमपि गुणैर्विशेषयंती Mk. 4. 4; M. 3. 5.
26525: विशिष्ट p. p. 1 Distinguished, distinct. --2 Particular, special, peculiar, distinctive. --3 Characterized by, endowed with, possessed of, having. --4 Superior, best (of all), eminent, excellent, choice; विशिष्टाया विशेषेण संगमो गुणवान् भवेत् Mb. --ष्टः N. of Viṣṇu. --Comp. --अद्वैतवादः a doctrine of Rāmānuja which regards Brahman and Prakṛti as identical and real entities. --बुद्धिः f. a distinguishing knowledge, differentiation. --वर्ण a. of an eminent or excellent colour.
